sum: This study investigates strong ground motion attenuation in the Sichuan basin using dense records from ten moderate-to-large earthquakes. It reveals a slower attenuation rate and a plateau between 80–160 km source distances, attributed to constructive interference between direct waves and post-critical Moho reflections. The basin exhibits lower anelastic attenuation and smaller within-event variability compared to surrounding regions, linked to its homogeneous crustal structure. The authors propose a novel four-segment geometric attenuation function with specific breakpoints, offering a statistically superior fit and better capturing far-field attenuation characteristics than conventional models. This work has significant implications for ground-motion modeling and seismic hazard assessment in the region.
本研究利用四川盆地密集地震台网记录的十次中强地震数据，分析了盆地的强地面运动衰减特征。结果显示，盆地在80-160公里震源距离处出现衰减平台，这归因于直达波与莫霍面反射波的相干叠加。盆地内部的非弹性衰减率和事件内变异性低于周边地区，与均一的地壳结构有关。研究提出了一个包含80、150、240公里断点……

sum: This study investigates the Cenozoic evolution of the Farallon slab beneath southwestern North America using 3D finite-element mantle convection modeling (CitcomS) from 60 Ma to the present, constrained by reconstructed plate kinematics and paleo-seafloor ages. The authors fill a gap in regional 3D modeling regarding the timing and dynamics of the first Pacific-North America contact. Results show subduction waning between 40 and 30 Ma as young, buoyant lithosphere near the East Pacific Rise entered the trench, flattening the slab before ridge abandonment and detachment at ~26 Ma. The resulting slab window propagated northward and southward, driving asthenospheric upwelling that closely aligns with post-30 Ma mafic volcanism and present-day upper-mantle P-wave tomographic anomalies. However, earlier Eocene-Oligocene silicic ignimbrite flare-ups predate the modeled slab window, indicating that additional processes like earlier Farallon-Vancouver boundary subduction were required.

Subduction of young lithosphere near the EPR caused slab thinning and dynamic flattening at 30 Ma, complete detachment at 26 Ma, and slab window upwelling matching post-30 Ma mafic volcanism.

First regional 3D numerical subduction model capturing the initial Pacific-North America plate contact, EPR-trench collision, and continuous 60-0 Ma slab window evolution beneath southwestern North America.

sum: This paper presents a unified framework for causal and uncertainty-aware instrument correction in broadband seismology. Instead of using heuristic stabilization, the author formulates deconvolution as a constrained inverse problem in the digital domain. The method enforces causal realizability and bounded inverse behavior while introducing regularization to control the bias-noise trade-off. It quantifies discretization effects that cause systematic amplitude bias and propagates parametric instrument uncertainties to derive confidence bounds on amplitude response and noise amplification. A data-driven decision framework with diagnostic metrics is introduced to objectively select the inverse filter and define the reliable frequency range.
本文提出了一种用于宽频带地震学中因果与不确定性感知仪器校正的统一框架。作者将反褶积公式化为数字域中的约束反问题，而非采用启发式稳定方法。该方法在引入正则化以控制偏差-噪声权衡的同时，确保了因果可实现性和有界反向行为。它量化了导致系统振幅偏差的离散化效应，并传播参数化仪器不确定性以推导振幅响应和噪声放……

sum: This study presents a new 3D lithospheric-scale resistivity model of the Miocene-Recent Malawi rift, Africa, to investigate the roles of magmatic modification and pre-rift structural heterogeneity on early-stage rifting. The magnetotelluric imaging reveals low-resistivity zones beneath the Rungwe Volcanic Province, interpreted as magma storage in the crust (8-20 km depth) and mantle-lithosphere (30-70 km depth). It also identifies highly resistive Proterozoic orogenic terranes bounded by linear conductive belts at lower-crustal and upper-mantle depths, likely representing graphite-bearing suture zones. The results show that Malawi rift border faults mostly cross-cut, rather than follow, these ancient suture zones.
本研究利用全新的三维岩石圈尺度电阻率模型，结合地震成像，评估了岩浆改造和裂谷前结构非均匀性对东非马拉维裂谷早期发育的影响。大地电磁成像显示，Rungwe火山区下方存在低电阻率异常，代表地壳（8-20 km）和地幔岩石圈（30-70 km）中的岩浆存储区。此外，研究识别出高阻的前寒武纪造山地块，其边界……

sum: This paper proposes the Tripartite Spatiotemporal Triggering Hypothesis (TSTH) to explain remote earthquake triggering beyond traditional near-field limits. TSTH categorizes far-field effects into three mechanisms: Antipodal Resonance (~20,000 km, days-to-months lag), Plate-Margin Symmetric-End Stress Transfer (>5,000 km, 1-3 years lag), and Conventional Plate-Margin Compressional Transfer. The hypothesis is validated using historical cases (2010 Chile Mw8.8, 2023 Turkey Mw7.8) and real-time tracking of a 2026 global sequence. Monte Carlo simulations (10,000 runs) demonstrate that the observed spatiotemporal clustering is highly statistically significant (p < 1e-5), suggesting a physical basis for cross-scale remote triggering.
本文提出了“三部式时空触发假说”（TSTH），以解释传统近场限制之外的远距离地震触发机制。该假说将远场效应分为三种机制：对跖共振（约2万公里，延迟数天至数月）、板块边缘对称端应力传递（大于5千公里，延迟1至3年）以及传统的板块边缘挤压传递。研究通过2010年智利Mw8.8和2023年土耳其Mw7.8……

The mechanisms involve plate-margin stress transfer and antipodal resonance across global scales.

sum: This paper presents a Bayesian geometry-based gravity inversion framework designed for stratigraphic reconstruction. To overcome the limited vertical resolution and strong non-uniqueness of gravity data, the authors parameterize stratigraphic interfaces using a compact Fourier series. This parameterization enables a controllable representation of layer geometry and improves vertical resolution. Uncertainty in the inferred stratigraphy is quantified using Stein variational inference (SVI), which provides an ensemble approximation of the posterior distribution. The method is validated on two toy examples, two synthetic lunar basin models representing alternative crustal layering hypotheses, and real satellite gravity observations from the Orientale Basin on the Moon, successfully recovering its large-scale tectonic structure.
本文提出了一种用于地层重建的贝叶斯几何重力反演框架。为解决重力反演多解性强和纵向分辨率低的问题，研究采用傅里叶级数对地层界面进行参数化，实现了对地层几何形态的紧凑且可控表征。利用斯坦变分推断（SVI）进行不确定性量化，获得后验分布的集合逼近。该方法在两个简单示例、两个月球盆地合成模型以及月球东海盆地……

t: A Bayesian gravity inversion framework that parameterizes stratigraphic interfaces using a Fourier series and quantifies uncertainty using Stein variational inference.
该方法利用傅里叶级数参数化地层界面，并结合斯坦变分推断进行贝叶斯重力反演。
Synthetic toy models, two synthetic lunar basin crustal models, and real satellite gravity observations from the lunar Orientale Basin.
使用了简单合成模型、两个合成月球盆地模型以及月球东海盆地的实际卫星重力数据。
The framework successfully recovered the large-scale tectonic structure and stratigraphic interfaces of the Orientale Basin while providing posterior uncertainty estimates.
成功重建了月球东海盆地的大尺度构造地层界面，并给出了后验不确定性估计。
The resolution of the recovered interfaces remains inherently constrained by the non-uniqueness and limited vertical resolution of gravity data.
反演界面的精度仍受限于重力数据固有的多解性和有限的纵向分辨率。
Combining Fourier-parameterized interface geometry with Stein variational inference to achieve efficient, uncertainty-aware stratigraphic gravity inversion.
首次将傅里叶参数化界面几何与斯坦变分推断相结合，实现了高效的重力不确定性反演。

kc: Developed a novel Bayesian geometry-based gravity inversion framework for stratigraphic reconstruction.
Introduced a Fourier series parameterization for stratigraphic interfaces to reduce parameter dimensionality and improve vertical resolution.
Applied Stein variational inference (SVI) to efficiently quantify uncertainty and obtain posterior ensembles of stratigraphic models.
开发了一种用于地层重建的新型贝叶斯几何重力反演框架。
引入了地层界面的傅里叶级数参数化方法，降低了参数维度并提高了纵向分辨率。
应用斯坦变分推断（SVI）高效量化不确定性，并获得了地层模型的后验集合。
me: Fourier series parameterization of stratigraphic interfaces.
Stein variational inference (SVI) for Bayesian posterior approximation.
Forward gravity modeling of layered density structures.
地层界面的傅里叶级数参数化。
用于贝叶斯后验逼近的斯坦变分推断（SVI）。
分层密度结构的重力正演模拟。
de: Two simple toy examples to demonstrate the core concepts of the inversion.
Two synthetic lunar basin models representing alternative hypotheses for upper-crustal layering.
Satellite gravity observations from the Orientale Basin on the Moon.
两个用于展示反演核心概念的简单玩具示例。
代表上地壳分层不同假设的两个合成月球盆地模型。
月球东海盆地（Orientale Basin）的卫星重力观测数据。
li: The method assumes distinct stratigraphic layers with constant or pre-defined density contrasts, which may not capture complex, continuous density gradients.
该方法假设存在具有恒定或预定义密度差的清晰地层边界，可能无法捕捉复杂的连续密度梯度。

tm.why: The paper develops a Bayesian geometry-based gravity inversion framework using Stein variational inference for uncertainty quantification.
The paper addresses the non-uniqueness and vertical resolution limits of gravity inversion using a new parameterization and inference method.
The method is applied to synthetic lunar basin models and satellite gravity observations from the Orientale Basin on the Moon.
