sum: Near-seafloor marine sediments on seismically active margins often exhibit higher undrained shear strengths than those on passive margins, yet the underlying cause remains debated. This study investigates whether intrinsic material properties explain this difference by performing 1-D laboratory resedimentation and oedometer consolidation tests up to 1 MPa on marine muds from three active margins (Nankai, Cascadia, Surveyor Fan) and three passive margins (Amazon Fan, Carolina, New Jersey). The authors measured grain size, mineralogy, Atterberg limits, compression behavior, and undrained shear strength, comparing them against shipboard field measurements. All six resedimented samples developed normal shear strength ratios (0.15–0.26) in the laboratory, failing to reproduce the elevated in-situ ratios (0.45–0.55) and anomalously low shallow void indices observed at Nankai and Cascadia. This demonstrates that elevated active-margin strength is not an intrinsic material property, pointing instead to repeated earthquake shaking (seismic strengthening) and lateral tectonic shear strain.
地震活跃的主动陆缘海底浅表沉积物通常比被动陆缘具有更高的不排水剪切强度，但其成因尚不明确。本研究对来自三个主动陆缘（南海海槽、卡斯卡迪亚、Surveyor扇）和三个被动陆缘（亚马逊扇、卡罗来纳、新泽西）的海洋泥质沉积物进行了高达1 MPa的一维实验室再沉积和固结仪测试，并测量了粒度、矿物学、阿太堡界……

t: Samples were characterized for grain size, mineralogy, and Atterberg limits, then uniaxially resedimented to 100 kPa and consolidated in an oedometer to 1 MPa before measuring undrained shear strength with vane shear and penetrometers.
表征样品粒度、矿物和阿太堡界限后，进行100 kPa再沉积和1 MPa单轴固结，并测量不排水剪切强度。

Siliciclastic marine muds from the upper 100 m of three passive margins (New Jersey, North Carolina, Amazon Fan) and three active margins (Nankai, Cascadia, Surveyor Fan) acquired during ODP and IODP expeditions.
来自三个被动陆缘和三个主动陆缘ODP/IODP钻探站位顶部100米的硅质碎屑海洋泥质沉积物。

All six resedimented samples yielded normal laboratory undrained shear strength ratios (0.15–0.26). Field strength ratios at Nankai (0.55) and Cascadia (0.45) are much higher and correspond to anomalously low field void indices below 110 kPa.
所有再沉积样品均呈正常实验室强度比（0.15–0.26），无法重现南海海槽（0.55）和卡斯卡迪亚（0.45）的原位高强…

The 1-D uniaxial consolidation experiments do not directly simulate cyclic earthquake shaking or horizontal tectonic stresses, leaving the exact contribution of seismic shaking versus lateral strain unquantified.
一维固结实验未直接模拟循环地震摇晃或水平构造应力，未能单独量化各外部机制的贡献。

First direct comparison of in-situ and 1-D resedimented shear strengths across six active and passive margins, definitively ruling out intrinsic sediment properties as the cause of active-margin strengthening.
首次系统对比六个主动与被动陆缘的原位与再沉积强度，排除了沉积物内在属性差异导致强化的假说。

kc: Demonstrated that 1-D laboratory resedimentation and uniaxial consolidation of active margin sediments yield normal undrained shear strength ratios (0.15–0.26), failing to reproduce elevated in-situ strengths (0.45–0.55 at Nankai and Cascadia).
Ruled out intrinsic differences in grain size, bulk mineralogy, plasticity, and compressibility as the cause of enhanced shear strength on active margins.

Showed via Burland void index analysis that Nankai and Cascadia sediments have anomalously low in-situ void ratios at shallow burial depths (<110 kPa) compared to the sedimentation compression line, supporting extrinsic strengthening via earthquake shaking and lateral shear strain.
证明了主动陆缘沉积物的一维实验室再沉积和单轴固结产生正常的不排水剪切强度比（0.15–0.26），无法重现南海海槽和卡斯卡迪亚的原位高强度（0.45–0.55）。
排除了粒度、全岩矿物组成、塑性和压缩性等内在材料属性差异作为主动陆缘剪切强度增强的原因。
通过Burland孔隙指数分析表明，在浅埋深（<110 kPa）下南海海槽和卡斯卡迪亚沉积物的原位孔隙比显著低于沉积压缩线，支持地震摇晃和侧向剪切应变等外部强化机制。
me: 1-D laboratory resedimentation (up to 100 kPa) and oedometer uniaxial consolidation (up to 1 MPa vertical effective stress).
Undrained shear strength measurements using automated vane shear, fall cone penetrometer, and pocket penetrometer, alongside Skempton plasticity predictions.
Sedimentological and geotechnical characterization (hydrometer grain size, X-ray diffraction mineralogy, Atterberg limits) and Burland (1990) void index normalization.
一维实验室再沉积（高达100 kPa）和固结仪单轴固结实验（垂直有效应力高达1 MPa）。
使用自动十字板剪切仪、落锥贯入仪和微型贯入仪测量不排水剪切强度，并结合Skempton塑性指数公式进行预测。
沉积学与岩土工程表征（密度计法粒度分析、X射线衍射矿物分析、阿太堡界限）以及Burland (1990) 孔隙指数归一化分析。
de: Marine mud core samples (0–100 mbsf, 10 subsamples combined per site) from three passive margins (ODP Sites 1073, 1054, 942) and three active margins (IODP Sites C0001, U1329, U1418).
Shipboard in-situ undrained shear strength and moisture/density (void ratio) profiles from ODP and IODP databases.
来自三个被动陆缘（ODP 1073、1054、942站位）和三个主动陆缘（IODP C0001、U1329、U1418站位）海底以下0–100米的海洋泥质岩芯样品（每个站位混合10个子样品）。
来自ODP和IODP数据库的船载原位不排水剪切强度及含水率/密度（孔隙比）剖面数据。
li: Experiments were strictly limited to 1-D uniaxial consolidation without cyclic seismic shaking or lateral tectonic stress paths.
Ten subsamples across the top 100 m at each site were homogenized into a single composite sample, smoothing out fine-scale stratigraphic variations.
实验严格限制为一维单轴固结，未施加循环地震摇晃或侧向构造应力路径。
每个站位顶部100米内的10个子样品被均质化为单一复合样品，平滑了细尺度的地层变化。

tm.why: The paper investigates seismic strengthening of marine sediments and its role in subaqueous slope stability and earthquake-triggered submarine landslide hazards.
It examines environmental and marine geotechnical responses of shallow seafloor sediments to repeated earthquake shaking.

ev.notes: Full 10-page GRL PDF analyzed, including all text sections, 4 figures, and 1 table.

sum: This study evaluates historical earthquake recurrence patterns along the Dead Sea transform (DST) by integrating instrumental, historical, archaeological, and paleoseismic datasets spanning the past ~2000 years. The authors compile destructive earthquakes and analyze their magnitude distribution alongside ~40 years of microseismicity. They find that M >= 7.0 earthquakes occur more frequently than predicted by the Gutenberg-Richter relation, while M 6.0-6.9 events are relatively scarce. This supports a characteristic earthquake model. However, several exceptionally large historical events (e.g., 749, 1202, 1759 C.E.) suggest a bimodal or multimodal distribution. The paper concludes that M 7.0-7.3 earthquakes are most characteristic of the DST, with less frequent M 7.4-8.0 events, reconciling the debate on characteristic earthquake behavior and improving regional seismic hazard assessments.
本研究通过整合仪器记录、历史文献、考古和古地震数据，评估了死海转换带（DST）过去约2000年的地震复现规律。研究表明，M >= 7.0的地震发生频率高于Gutenberg-Richter关系预测值，而M 6.0-6.9地震相对稀缺，证实了特征地震行为。然而，历史上几次特大地震（如749、1202、……

t: Integration of multi-disciplinary catalogs (paleoseismic, historical, archaeological, instrumental) to analyze magnitude-frequency distributions and evaluate deviation from the Gutenberg-Richter relation.
整合多学科目录（古地震、历史、考古、仪器记录）以分析震级-频度分布并评估其对G-R关系的偏离。
An integrated dataset of instrumental seismicity (past ~40 yr) and historical, archaeological, and paleoseismic records spanning the past ~2000 yr along the Dead Sea transform.
死海转换带过去约2000年的历史、考古和古地震记录，以及过去约40年的仪器地震记录整合数据集。
M >= 7.0 earthquakes occur more frequently than Gutenberg-Richter predictions, with a scarcity of M 6.0-6.9 events, and a few exceptionally large events (M 7.4-8.0) suggesting bimodal behavior.
M >= 7.0地震发生率高于G-R预测，M 6.0-6.9地震稀缺，且存在极少数特大地震（M 7.4-8.0）呈双峰特…
The findings are subject to large uncertainties inherent in preinstrumental historical, archaeological, and paleoseismic data sources.
研究结果受限于非仪器历史、考古和古地震数据源中固有的大不确定性。
Reconciles the characteristic earthquake debate by demonstrating a bimodal size distribution (typical M 7.0-7.3 and rare M 7.4-8.0) on the Dead Sea transform.
通过展示死海转换带的双峰震级分布（典型M 7.0-7.3和罕见M 7.4-8.0），调和了特征地震假说的争议。

kc: Compiled a unique integrated dataset of instrumental, historical, archaeological, and paleoseismic earthquake records for the southern Dead Sea transform.
Demonstrated that M >= 7.0 earthquakes along the DST occur more frequently than predicted by the instrumental Gutenberg-Richter relation.
Identified a relative scarcity of intermediate M 6.0-6.9 earthquakes, supporting characteristic earthquake behavior.
Proposed a bimodal or multimodal earthquake size distribution to reconcile exceptionally large historical events (M 7.4-8.0) with typical characteristic events (M 7.0-7.3).
编制了死海转换带南部整合仪器、历史、考古和古地震记录的独特综合数据集。
证实了DST沿线M >= 7.0地震的发生频率高于仪器记录的Gutenberg-Richter关系预测值。
发现了中等强度（M 6.0-6.9）地震的相对稀缺性，支持了特征地震行为假说。
提出了双峰或多峰地震震级分布模型，以调和特大历史地震（M 7.4-8.0）与典型特征地震（M 7.0-7.3）之间的关系。
me: Compilation and integration of multi-disciplinary earthquake catalogs (instrumental, historical, archaeological, and paleoseismic).
Magnitude distribution and frequency-magnitude relationship (Gutenberg-Richter) analysis.
Comparison of historical recurrence patterns with modern microseismicity data from the past ~40 years.
多学科地震目录（仪器、历史、考古和古地震）的编制与整合。
震级分布与频度-震级关系（Gutenberg-Richter）分析。
将历史复现模式与过去约40年的现代微震数据进行对比分析。
de: An integrated seismic catalog of the Dead Sea transform spanning the past ~2000 years.
Microseismicity data from the last ~40 years along the plate boundary.
Historical and paleoseismic records of major destructive earthquakes (e.g., 749, 1068, 1202, 1759 C.E.).
跨越过去约2000年的死海转换带整合地震目录。
沿该板块边界过去约40年的微震活动数据。
主要破坏性地震（如公元749、1068、1202、1759年）的历史和古地震记录。
li: Large uncertainties associated with preinstrumental earthquake magnitudes and location estimates.
Potential incompleteness of the historical and archaeological records over the 2000-year timespan.
非仪器记录时期的地震震级和位置估计存在较大的不确定性。
在2000年时间跨度内，历史和考古记录可能存在不完整性。

tm.why: The paper compiles and analyzes a comprehensive earthquake catalog integrating instrumental, historical, archaeological, and paleoseismic sources to evaluate magnitude distributions.
The study evaluates earthquake recurrence patterns and magnitude distributions along the Dead Sea transform, which are critical for regional seismic hazard analyses.
It investigates the characteristic earthquake hypothesis and fault behavior (bimodal/multimodal earthquake size groups) along a major plate boundary.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the detailed abstract and metadata available from BSSA, Crossref, and Semantic Scholar, as no PDF was available.

sum: This study investigates the 14-year stress evolution and seismicity rate changes in the Longmenshan fault zone (LMSFZ) and surrounding regions following the 2008 Mw 7.9 Wenchuan earthquake. The authors combine a space-time ETAS model applied to a high-resolution AI earthquake catalog (2013–2023, Mc = 2.0) and a conventional CEDC catalog (2008–2023, Mc = 4.0) with 3D layered viscoelastic Coulomb failure stress change (ΔCFS) modeling via PSGRN/PSCMP. Results indicate that the Wenchuan earthquake promoted the 2013 Lushan, 2014 Kangding, and 2017 Jiuzhaigou earthquakes, while inhibiting the 2022 Maerkang and Luding events. Notably, the 2022 Mw 5.8 Lushan event shows low ETAS background probability (0.115) and high positive ΔCFS (0.163 MPa), indicating direct triggering. Postseismic viscoelastic relaxation progressively shifted the southwestern LMSFZ out of its coseismic stress shadow. Integrating ETAS background seismicity, cumulative ΔCFS, and geodetic asperities highlights elevated seismic potential in the southwestern/central LMSFZ and Xianshuihe-Xiaojinhe junction.
本研究结合时空ETAS模型与三维分层粘弹性库仑破裂应力变化（ΔCFS）模拟（PSGRN/PSCMP），系统探讨了2008年汶川Mw7.9地震后龙门山断裂带及邻区14年的应力演化与地震活动率变化。利用高分辨率AI地震目录（完备震级降至2.0）精细刻画了背景地震活动。结果表明，汶川地震促进了2013年芦……

t: The authors pair a space-time ETAS model with stochastic declustering to extract background seismicity rates, and calculate coseismic and postseismic viscoelastic Coulomb failure stress changes (ΔCFS) using the 3D layered PSGRN/PSCMP code.
结合时空ETAS模型随机去丛集提取背景地震率，并用PSGRN/PSCMP计算三维分层粘弹性ΔCFS。

The study uses the CEDC catalog (2008–2023, cutoff magnitude 4.0) and a high-resolution AI earthquake catalog (2013–2023, cutoff magnitude 2.0), alongside published coseismic slip models for seven major earthquakes and 12 active receiver faults.
采用CEDC目录（Mc 4.0）、高分辨率AI目录（Mc 2.0）以及7次强震滑动模型与12条断层参数。

Wenchuan imparted positive ΔCFS to the 2013 Lushan, 2014 Kangding, and 2017 Jiuzhaigou events, but negative ΔCFS to 2022 Maerkang (-0.0744 MPa) and Luding (-0.0406 MPa). The 2022 Lushan event had 0.163 MPa cumulative ΔCFS and 0.115 background probability.
汶川地震促进芦山、康定和九寨沟地震，抑制马尔康和泸定地震；2022芦山地震具0.163 MPa正应力与0.115背景概率…
The modeling neglects power-law rheology, dynamic triggering, and poroelastic rebound, and ΔCFS estimates are inaccurate within the surface projection of coseismic rupture zones.
忽略了幂律流变、动态触发与孔隙弹性回跳，且同震破裂面投影区内ΔCFS计算不准。

This work systematically tracks 14-year continuous multi-earthquake viscoelastic stress interactions while leveraging an AI microseismicity catalog and geodetic fault coupling asperities to assess regional seismic potential.
首次融合AI微震目录ETAS分析、多震连续粘弹性应力传递与震间闭锁凹凸体综合评估地震潜势。

kc: Applied a space-time ETAS model to a high-resolution AI catalog (Mc = 2.0), resolving fine-scale background seismicity along branch faults and source zones.
Quantified 14-year cumulative coseismic and postseismic viscoelastic ΔCFS across seven major earthquakes and 12 active receiver faults in the LMSFZ region.
Demonstrated that the 2022 Mw 5.8 Lushan earthquake was likely directly triggered by stress transfer (0.163 MPa, background probability 0.115) primarily from the 2013 Lushan event.
Integrated ETAS background rates, viscoelastic ΔCFS, and interseismic coupling asperities to identify elevated seismic hazard in the southwestern/central LMSFZ and Xianshuihe-Xiaojinhe junction.
将时空ETAS模型应用于高分辨率AI地震目录（Mc = 2.0），精细解析了分支断层和震源区的背景地震活动。
量化了龙门山及邻区7次强震和12条活跃接收断层在14年间的累积同震和震后粘弹性库仑应力变化（ΔCFS）。
证明2022年芦山Mw 5.8地震很可能是由2013年芦山地震主导的累积应力传递（0.163 MPa，背景概率0.115）直接触发的。
综合ETAS背景地震活动率、粘弹性ΔCFS与震间耦合凹凸体分布，圈定了龙门山中南段及鲜水河-小金河交汇区的高地震潜势区。
me: Space-time Epidemic-Type Aftershock Sequence (ETAS) modeling with maximum likelihood estimation and stochastic declustering to extract background seismicity rates and probabilities.
3D layered viscoelastic Coulomb failure stress change (ΔCFS) calculation using PSGRN/PSCMP with an elastic upper crust (0–20 km) and viscoelastic lower crust and upper mantle.
Sensitivity testing of ΔCFS across varying friction coefficients (0.2–0.8), resolving depths (0–15 km), coseismic slip models, focal mechanisms, fault geometries, and layer thicknesses/viscosities.
Qualitative multi-constraint synthesis combining statistical ETAS background seismicity, physical ΔCFS loading, and geodetically derived interseismic fault coupling asperities.
采用时空传染型余震序列（ETAS）模型结合最大似然估计与随机去丛集方法，提取背景地震活动率及事件背景概率。
利用PSGRN/PSCMP程序，基于弹性上地壳（0–20 km）及粘弹性下地壳和上地幔的三维分层模型计算同震与震后粘弹性ΔCFS。
针对摩擦系数（0.2–0.8）、计算深度（0–15 km）、同震滑动模型、震源机制、断层几何及分层厚度与粘滞度开展系统敏感性测试。
将统计ETAS背景地震活动、物理ΔCFS加载与大地测量反演的震间断层耦合凹凸体进行多约束定性综合评估。
de: China Earthquake Data Center (CEDC) catalog spanning 2008–2023 with a cutoff magnitude Mc = 4.0.
High-resolution AI deep-learning earthquake catalog (Li et al., 2026) spanning 2013–2023 with a cutoff magnitude Mc = 2.0.
Published finite-fault coseismic slip models (from teleseismic and strong-motion inversions) and GCMT focal mechanisms for seven major earthquakes (Mw 5.8–7.9).
Fault geometry parameters and apparent friction coefficients for 12 regional active receiver faults, plus interseismic block-model fault coupling distributions (Li et al., 2022).
中国地震台网中心（CEDC）2008–2023年地震目录（截止完备震级Mc = 4.0）。
基于深度学习的高分辨率AI地震目录（Li et al., 2026），涵盖2013–2023年（截止完备震级Mc = 2.0）。
研究区7次主要强震（Mw 5.8–7.9）的已发表有限断层同震滑动分布模型（源自远震和强震动反演）及GCMT震源机制解。
区域12条活跃接收断层的几何参数与视摩擦系数，以及基于弹性块体模型的震间断层耦合凹凸体分布数据（Li et al., 2022）。
li: Neglects power-law rheology, dynamic stress triggering from seismic waves, and fluid-related poroelastic rebound processes.
ΔCFS calculations are considered inaccurate within the surface projection of the coseismic rupture area, limiting near-field aftershock spatial comparisons.
The high-resolution AI catalog only spans 2013–2023, missing the immediate 2008–2012 post-Wenchuan period.
未考虑幂律流变学性质、地震波传播引起的动态应力触发以及流体相关的孔隙弹性回跳过程。
同震破裂区地表投影范围内的ΔCFS计算存在较大不确定性，限制了对近场余震空间分布的解释能力。
高分辨率AI地震目录仅覆盖2013–2023年，缺失2008–2012年汶川震后早期的微震数据。

tm.why: The paper systematically investigates coseismic and postseismic viscoelastic Coulomb failure stress changes (ΔCFS) and fault interactions across the Longmenshan and surrounding fault zones.
A high-resolution AI earthquake catalog with a lowered magnitude of completeness (Mc = 2.0) is analyzed using the space-time ETAS model and stochastic declustering to resolve background seismicity.
The study synthesizes ETAS background seismicity, cumulative viscoelastic ΔCFS, and interseismic fault coupling asperities to evaluate regional seismic potential along active faults.

ev.notes: Full 12-page PDF analyzed, including equations, tables, figures, and sensitivity discussions.

sum: This study models earthquake populations propagating and arresting within a stochastic stress field using a 1D fracture mechanics framework. The authors show that realistic earthquake populations (with Gutenberg-Richter-like scaling) are produced when the standard deviation of the potential stress drop far exceeds its mean, creating significant sections of highly negative potential stress. The resulting earthquake populations exhibit b-values that decrease with increasing mean stress, and magnitude-independent stress drops. The preferred scaling exponent (0 to 0.25) suggests highly variable stress even at short wavelengths, consistent with exhumed fault roughness.
本研究利用一维断裂力学框架，模拟了地震在随机应力场中的传播与停止。结果表明，当潜在应力降的标准差远大于其平均值（导致出现显著的负应力降区域）时，能够产生符合实际观测的地震序列。模拟得到的b值随平均应力增加而减小，且应力降与震级无关。优选的标度指数（0至0.25）表明短波长下应力具有极高变异性，这与露……

t: A 1D fracture mechanics framework is used to model earthquake propagation and arrest within a parameterized stochastic stress field.
采用一维断裂力学框架模拟参数化随机应力场中的地震传播与停止。
Synthetic earthquake populations simulated under highly variable stress fields with standard deviations ranging from 8 to 80 MPa.
在标准差为8至80 MPa的高变异性应力场下模拟合成地震序列。
Realistic populations are produced when stress standard deviation far exceeds the mean, yielding b-values that decrease with mean stress.
当应力标准差远超平均值时能产生逼真序列，且b值随平均应力增加而减小。
The simplified 1D representation of fracture mechanics may not capture full 3D fault complexity.
简化的一维断裂力学表征可能无法完全捕获真实三维断层的复杂性。
Demonstrates that highly variable and negative potential stress fields at short wavelengths are essential for realistic seismicity populations.
证明了短波长下高度变异且存在负值的潜在应力场对产生逼真地震学特征至关重要。

kc: Demonstrated that highly variable stochastic stress fields with negative potential stress regions are required to produce realistic earthquake populations.
Showed that simulated b-values decrease with increasing mean potential stress drop.
Constrained the preferred stress field scaling exponent to 0-0.25, indicating white-noise-like high variability at short wavelengths.
证明了产生逼真地震序列需要具有高度变异性且包含负潜在应力区域的随机应力场。
展示了模拟的b值随着平均潜在应力降的增加而减小。
将优选的应力场标度指数约束在0-0.25之间，表明短波长下存在类似白噪声的高变异性。
me: 1D fracture mechanics modeling of earthquake propagation and arrest.
Stochastic stress field parameterization using mean, standard deviation, and scaling exponent.
地震传播与停止的一维断裂力学数值模拟。
利用平均值、标准差和标度指数对随机应力场进行参数化表征。
de: Synthetic simulations of earthquake populations under varying stochastic stress parameters (stdev of 8-80 MPa).
在不同随机应力参数（标准差为8-80 MPa）下对地震序列进行合成数值模拟。
li: The model is simplified to a 1D fracture mechanics framework, which may omit 2D/3D geometric and dynamic effects.
该模型简化为一维断裂力学框架，可能忽略了二维或三维的几何与动力学效应。

tm.why: The paper models earthquake populations, propagation, and arrest within a stochastic stress field using a 1D fracture mechanics framework.
The study links stochastic stress fields to heterogeneous stresses in fault zones with multi-scale geometrical complexity.

ev.notes: No PDF was available; analysis is based entirely on the detailed abstract and metadata.

sum: This study analyzes 30 three-component strong-motion recordings from Myanmar and Thailand to quantify the regional ground-motion characteristics of the 2025 Mw 7.7 Mandalay earthquake. By calculating amplitude and duration residuals relative to NGA-West2 models, the authors identify a pronounced azimuthal directivity pattern. Stations aligned with the Mach fronts of the southward-propagating supershear rupture (110–155 degrees azimuth) exhibit large positive spectral acceleration residuals and strongly negative D5–95 duration residuals. Conversely, stations to the southwest and west show negative amplitude and positive duration residuals. This bilateral contrast matches the expected Mach cone radiation pattern, demonstrating that supershear rupture effects persist into the far-field (150–600 km) and should be incorporated into seismic hazard assessments for large strike-slip faults.
本研究分析了缅甸和泰国30个三分量强震动记录，以量化2025年Mw 7.7曼德勒地震的区域地面运动特征。通过计算相对于NGA-West2模型的振幅和持续时间残差，研究人员发现了显著的方位角直接性特征。位于向南传播的超剪切破裂马赫锋方向（方位角110-155度）的台站表现出显著的正谱加速度残差和强负D……

t: Analysis of regional strong-motion amplitude and duration residuals relative to NGA-West2 ground-motion and duration models.
利用NGA-West2地面运动和持续时间模型，分析区域强震动的振幅和持续时间残差。
30 three-component strong-motion recordings from Myanmar and Thailand at regional distances of 150 to 600 km.
来自缅甸和泰国、传播距离在150至600公里之间的30个三分量强震动记录。
Stations at 110-155 degrees azimuth aligned with Mach fronts show large positive spectral acceleration residuals and strongly negative duration residuals.
位于马赫锋方向（方位角110-155度）的台站表现出显著的正谱加速度残差和强负持续时间残差。
The analysis relies on a relatively sparse regional network of 30 stations to resolve complex azimuthal variations.
分析依赖于相对稀疏的30个区域台站网络来解析复杂的方位角变化。
Quantifying regional-scale (150-600 km) ground-motion amplitude and duration imprints of supershear Mach cone radiation.
首次量化了超剪切马赫锥辐射在区域尺度（150-600公里）上留下的地面运动振幅和持续时间印记。

kc: Quantified the regional ground-motion amplitude and duration characteristics of the 2025 Mw 7.7 Mandalay earthquake.
Demonstrated that supershear-related directivity and Mach cone radiation patterns persist into the far-field (150–600 km).
Provided empirical evidence supporting the integration of fault-to-site azimuth parameters in ground-motion models for large strike-slip faults.
量化了2025年Mw 7.7曼德勒地震的区域地面运动振幅和持续时间特征。
证实了超剪切相关的直接性和马赫锥辐射特征可延伸至远场（150-600公里）。
为大型走滑断层地面运动预测模型中引入断层-台站方位角参数提供了经验证据。
me: Analysis of 30 three-component strong-motion recordings from Myanmar and Thailand.
Calculation of spectral acceleration and D5–95 duration residuals relative to Next Generation Attenuation-West2 (NGA-West2) models.
Azimuthal analysis of residuals to identify directivity and Mach cone radiation patterns.
分析了来自缅甸和泰国的30个三分量强震动记录。
计算了相对于新一代衰减关系（NGA-West2）模型的谱加速度和D5-95持续时间残差。
对残差进行方位角分析，以识别直接性和马赫锥辐射特征。
de: Used 30 three-component strong-motion recordings from the 28 March 2025 Mw 7.7 Mandalay earthquake, captured at regional distances (150–600 km) in Myanmar and Thailand.
使用了2025年3月28日Mw 7.7曼德勒地震期间，在缅甸和泰国区域距离（150-600公里）处记录的30个三分量强震动数据。
li: The study is limited by the spatial distribution and density of the 30 regional strong-motion stations.
该研究受限于30个区域强震台站的空间分布和密度。

tm.why: The paper analyzes regional strong-motion recordings to quantify amplitude and duration residuals for seismic hazard assessment.
It investigates the influence of a southward-propagating supershear rupture and its Mach cone radiation pattern on ground motions.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the detailed abstract and metadata provided, as the full PDF was not available.

sum: Single-borehole Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) struggles with earthquake localization due to single-component axial sensitivity and azimuthal ambiguity. This study introduces a wavefield-based deep learning approach that turns geological complexity into a localization constraint. Using 2D spectral-element simulations (SPECFEM2D) across velocity models of varying complexity (step-like, graben-flank, and Marmousi), the authors generate synthetic DAS wavefield images for gridded sources. A U-Net convolutional neural network with SE-Residual blocks is trained to map these 2D wavefield images directly to source coordinates (x, z) without P- or S-wave phase picking. Lateral heterogeneities break wavefield symmetry, enabling average localization errors of 100–300 m in a single vertical well. Furthermore, training with band-limited noise significantly improves resilience against velocity model perturbations, while adding a second DAS borehole largely eliminates remaining spatial uncertainties.
单井分布式声学传感（DAS）因单分量灵敏度限制，存在震源方位角模糊问题。本研究提出一种基于波场的深度学习定位方法，将地下结构复杂性转化为定位约束。作者利用二维谱元法（SPECFEM2D）在阶跃、地堑和Marmousi等非均匀速度模型中生成合成DAS波场图像，并训练带有SE残差块的U-Net卷积神经网……

t: A U-Net CNN with SE-Residual blocks and channel-wise attention is trained on 2D SPECFEM2D synthetic DAS wavefield images using Smooth L1 loss to directly regress normalized 2D earthquake source coordinates (x, z).
基于SPECFEM2D合成波场图像，利用含SE残差块的U-Net直接回归二维震源坐标。

2D synthetic wavefields generated via SPECFEM2D across four velocity models (9.2 km × 3.5 km), recorded by 600 virtual DAS channels (5 m spacing) in a 3 km vertical borehole for 846 training and 828 testing/validation sources.
四个二维速度模型中3 km垂直井（600道DAS）记录的846个训练和828个测试震源合成波场。

Lateral velocity heterogeneities break left–right ambiguity, yielding localization errors mostly between 100 and 300 m for single-well DAS. Training with noisy data and adding a second well drastically reduce errors under 100 m velocity perturbations.
横向非均匀性消除了左右模糊性，单井定位误差多在100–300米；含噪训练与双井配置显著提升了抗扰动能力。

The framework is restricted to 2D simulations with cylindrical spreading, a fixed double-couple focal mechanism, particle velocity instead of gauge-averaged strain, and known background velocity models.
局限于二维柱面扩散模拟、固定双力偶震源机制及已知先验速度结构。

Exploits subsurface structural heterogeneities as natural wavefield fingerprints to overcome single-well DAS directional ambiguity via phase-picking-free deep learning regression on full-wavefield images.
利用地下结构非均匀性产生的波场指纹，通过免震相拾取的深度学习克服单井DAS方向模糊性。

kc: Demonstrated that subsurface lateral heterogeneity breaks wavefield symmetry in single-well vertical DAS, providing natural constraints for source localization.
Developed a phase-picking-free U-Net regression architecture that maps 2D DAS wavefield images directly to 2D source coordinates (x, z).
Showed that training the CNN on noisy wavefields regularizes the network and drastically improves generalization when the true velocity structure deviates from the assumed model.
Benchmarked the deep learning approach against SSIM-based template matching and demonstrated superior accuracy and computational efficiency, plus major gains from adding a second DAS well.
证明了地下横向非均匀性可打破单垂直井DAS波场的对称性，为震源定位提供天然约束。
开发了无需震相拾取的U-Net回归架构，可将二维DAS波场图像直接映射为二维震源坐标（x, z）。
发现使用含噪波场训练CNN能起到正则化作用，显著提升模型在真实速度结构偏离假设模型时的泛化能力。
将该深度学习方法与基于SSIM的模板匹配进行了对比，证明了其更高的精度和计算效率，并展示了增加第二口DAS井带来的显著提升。
me: 2D spectral-element full-waveform modeling (SPECFEM2D) with PML boundaries and 10 Hz dominant frequency double-couple sources.
U-Net convolutional neural network with four SE-Residual encoder/decoder blocks, channel-wise attention, global average pooling, and Smooth L1 regression loss.
Sensitivity testing against 5–15 Hz band-limited white noise, 100 m lateral shifts in velocity structure, and single-well vs. two-well configurations.
Baseline comparison against cross-correlation template matching quantified via the Structural Similarity Index Metric (SSIM).
采用带PML边界条件和10 Hz主频双力偶震源的二维谱元法全波形模拟（SPECFEM2D）。
构建包含四个SE-Residual编解码块、通道注意力机制、全局平均池化和Smooth L1回归损失的U-Net卷积神经网络。
针对5–15 Hz带限白噪声、100米速度结构横向偏移以及单井与双井配置进行敏感性测试。
与采用结构相似性指标（SSIM）量化的互相关模板匹配方法进行基线对比。
de: Four 2D synthetic velocity models (9.2 km × 3.5 km): two-layer (2LM), step-like (STM), graben-flank (GFM), and Marmousi (MRM).
Virtual vertical borehole at x = 0 m extending to 3.0 km depth with 600 DAS channels spaced at 5 m.
Dataset A (846 events on a 200 m × 200 m grid) for training and Dataset B (828 events offset by 100 m) split into validation and test sets.
四个二维合成速度模型（9.2 km × 3.5 km）：两层模型（2LM）、阶跃模型（STM）、地堑侧翼模型（GFM）和Marmousi模型（MRM）。
位于x = 0 m处、深3.0 km的虚拟垂直井，包含600个间距为5米的DAS通道。
用于训练的数据集A（200 m × 200 m网格上的846个事件）和偏移100米用于验证与测试的数据集B（828个事件）。
li: Simulations are restricted to 2D (cylindrical spreading), which does not capture full 3D azimuthal ambiguity or realistic 3D scattering and amplitude decay.
Assumes a fixed double-couple focal mechanism, fixed source onset time, and particle velocity response without DAS gauge-length spatial averaging.
Requires detailed a priori knowledge of the heterogeneous subsurface velocity model (e.g., from active seismic surveys).
模拟局限于二维（柱面扩散），未能完全反映三维方位角模糊性或真实的三维散射与振幅衰减。
假设了固定的双力偶震源机制、固定的发震时刻以及未考虑DAS标距空间平均效应的质点速度响应。
需要预先掌握高精度的地下非均匀速度模型（例如来自主动源地震勘探）。

tm.why: The paper develops an earthquake localization method specifically tailored to overcome the single-component directional sensitivity of borehole Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) systems.
A U-Net based convolutional neural network (CNN) is trained on synthetic wavefield images to directly regress 2D earthquake source coordinates.
The core objective is phase-picking-free microseismic source localization using full wavefield signatures recorded in single and dual vertical boreholes.

ev.notes: Full preprint PDF (15 pages) including abstract, methodology, results, discussion, and 6 main figures was analyzed directly.

sum: This paper introduces a novel characterization of seismic site response called the time-frequency transfer function, TFTF(t, f). While the standard Fourier transfer function (FTF) only provides frequency-domain amplification and resonance peaks, it lacks temporal resolution. The proposed TFTF(t, f) overcomes this limitation by tracking the temporal development of the frequency content of the transfer function. The authors present the underlying theory and demonstrate its application to quasi-1D canonical models of local sedimentary structures. In a semi-infinite layer model, TFTF successfully distinguishes vertical resonance modes from surface wave modes, a task that is impossible using standard FTF.
本文提出了一种新型的地震场地响应表征方法——时频传递函数 TFTF(t, f)。传统的傅里叶传递函数仅能提供频域放大和共振峰信息，无法提供时间演化特征。TFTF(t, f) 克服了这一限制，能够追踪传递函数频率成分随时间的变化。作者阐述了其理论基础，并将其应用于局部沉积结构的准一维典型模型中。在半无……

t: The time-frequency transfer function TFTF(t, f) is formulated to characterize the temporal development of the frequency content of the transfer function.
构建了时频传递函数 TFTF(t, f)，用以表征传递函数频率成分随时间的变化过程。
Synthetic seismograms from quasi-1D canonical models of local surface sedimentary structures, including a semi-infinite layer.
采用局部地表沉积结构（包括半无限层）的准一维典型模型生成的合成地震图。
TFTF(t, f) successfully distinguished modes of vertical resonance and modes of surface waves in a semi-infinite layer model.
在半无限层模型中，TFTF(t, f) 成功区分了垂直共振模式和地表波模式。
The analysis is limited to quasi-1D canonical models of local surface sedimentary structures.
目前该方法的应用和验证仅限于局部地表沉积结构的准一维典型模型。
Introduction of a time-frequency transfer function that resolves the temporal development of site response, which standard Fourier transfer functions cannot do.
首次引入时频传递函数，解决了传统傅里叶传递函数无法提供时间演化信息的问题。

kc: Introduced the time-frequency transfer function (TFTF) to characterize the temporal evolution of seismic site response.
Developed a theoretical framework applicable to any time-dependent output signal.
Demonstrated that TFTF can distinguish between vertical resonance modes and surface wave modes in sedimentary structures.
引入了时频传递函数（TFTF）以表征地震场地响应的时间演化特征。
开发了适用于任何随时间变化输出信号的理论框架。
证明了 TFTF 能够区分沉积结构中的垂直共振模式和地表波模式。
me: Time-frequency analysis of transfer functions.
Quasi-1D canonical numerical modeling of local surface sedimentary structures.
传递函数的时频分析方法。
局部地表沉积结构的准一维典型数值模拟。
de: Synthetic seismograms generated from quasi-1D canonical models of local surface sedimentary structures, including a semi-infinite layer model.
基于局部地表沉积结构准一维典型模型（包括半无限层模型）生成的合成地震图。
li: The method is demonstrated primarily on quasi-1D canonical synthetic models and needs further validation with complex 2D/3D structures and real-world observations.
该方法主要在准一维典型合成模型上进行了演示，仍需在复杂的二维/三维结构和实际观测中进行进一步验证。

tm.why: The paper introduces a time-frequency transfer function to characterize seismic site response, which is crucial for evaluating local amplification and seismic hazard.
The method is demonstrated on quasi-1D canonical models of local surface sedimentary structures to analyze wavefield composition.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the detailed abstract and metadata from BSSA and Semantic Scholar, as no PDF was available.

sum: This study investigates the crustal architecture and seismogenic mechanism of the 1976 Ms7.8 Tangshan earthquake by applying 2D multi-scale wavelet decomposition and radially averaged power spectrum analysis to high-resolution Bouguer gravity anomalies (733 new joint gravity-GNSS stations integrated with a 1:200,000 regional map) and a 1,175-event seismic catalog (2008–2026). The decomposed residual gravity anomalies (1st to 10th orders, corresponding to depths from 2.66 km to 26.45 km) exhibit a distinct transition from 'shallow dispersion' to 'deep convergence.' Shallow anomalies (<10 km) reflect Quaternary sediments and fragmented flower structures of the Tangshan rhombic fault block. Intermediate and deep anomalies (13.16–26.45 km) coalesce into continuous high-density bands along the Tangshan fault, imaging mantle-derived magmatic underplating driven by Western Pacific Plate subduction. The sharp rheological contrast between high-density intrusive bodies and host rocks along high-angle faults promotes middle-crustal stress locking (10–25 km) and catastrophic rupture.
本研究结合733个新增重力与GNSS联合测点数据、区域重力资料及2008–2026年1175次地震目录，利用二维多尺度小波分解和径向对数功率谱分析，研究了唐山地震带不同深度（2.66至26.45 km）的壳幔结构与孕震机制。研究创新性地揭示了重力异常“浅部离散、深部汇聚”的空间演化特征：1–4阶浅部……

t: 2D multi-scale wavelet decomposition using a Biorthogonal wavelet basis and the Mallat pyramidal algorithm, paired with radially averaged log-power spectrum analysis to estimate equivalent burial depths of gravity anomaly components.
采用基于双正交小波基和Mallat算法的二维多尺度小波分解，结合径向平均对数功率谱估算各阶重力异常场源深度。
733 new joint gravity (<0.01 mGal precision) and GNSS survey stations (1–2 km spacing) fused with a 1:200,000 regional Bouguer gravity map, alongside 1,175 seismic catalog events from 2008 to 2026.
733个高精度重力（<0.01 mGal）与GNSS联合测点融合1:20万区域重力图，以及2008–2026年1175次…

Wavelet details D1–D10 correspond to depths from 2.66 to 26.45 km (±0.02 km), revealing a transition from fragmented shallow anomalies (<10 km) to coalesced deep positive anomalies (13.16–26.45 km) where 10–25 km seismicity clusters.
1–10阶小波细节对应2.66至26.45 km深度，呈现浅部（<10 km）离散破碎向深部（13.16–26.45 k…
Superposition of multi-source gravity signals causes uncertainty in conventional 3D density modeling, while MT and seismic tomography in the source region remain limited by station density.
多源重力信号叠加导致常规密度建模存在不确定性，且震源区电磁与地震层析成像受限于台站密度。

Applies 10-order multi-scale wavelet separation to newly acquired dense gravity-GNSS data in Tangshan, establishing a 'shallow dispersion–deep convergence' tectonic model linking mantle upwelling to shallow fault locking.
将10阶小波多尺度分解应用于唐山高密度实测重力数据，提出“浅部离散、深部汇聚”的深浅耦合孕震模型。

kc: Acquired 733 high-precision joint gravity and GNSS measurements across the Tangshan seismic zone and fused them with 1:200,000 regional gravity data.
Isolated crustal gravity anomalies across 10 wavelet decomposition orders corresponding to source depths from 2.66 km to 26.45 km.
Established a 'Shallow Dispersion–Deep Convergence' structural framework and a 'Deep Dynamic Loading–Shallow Locking' seismogenic model for the Tangshan earthquake.
在唐山地震带采集了733个高精度重力与GNSS联合测点数据，并与1:20万区域重力图进行了融合处理。
利用1至10阶小波细节分离了场源深度在2.66 km至26.45 km范围内的地壳重力异常响应。
构建了唐山地震带“浅部离散、深部汇聚”的构造格架以及“深部动力加载—浅部闭锁储能”的孕震模式。
me: 2D multi-scale discrete wavelet decomposition using a Biorthogonal wavelet basis and the Mallat pyramidal algorithm.
Radially averaged log-power spectrum linear regression fitting to estimate equivalent source depths of wavelet detail components.
Variable-weight sliding smoothing and least-squares adjustment for fusing field gravity data with regional Bouguer gravity maps.
基于双正交小波基和Mallat塔式算法的二维多尺度离散小波分解。
利用径向平均对数功率谱线性回归拟合估算各阶小波细节的等效场源深度。
采用变权重滑动平滑和最小二乘平差融合实测重力数据与区域布格重力图。
de: 733 field gravity (<0.01 mGal precision) and GNSS (<0.04 m horizontal, <0.06 m vertical accuracy) stations with 1–2 km station spacing and ~5 km line spacing.
1:200,000 regional Bouguer gravity anomaly map of East Hebei compiled in 1989.
China Earthquake Networks Center (CENC) catalog of 1,175 seismic events (Feb 2008 to Jan 2026) in the Tangshan region.
733个野外流动重力（精度优于0.01 mGal）与GNSS（水平优于0.04 m，垂直优于0.06 m）联合测点，点距1–2 km，线距约5 km。
1989年编制的冀东地区1:20万区域布格重力异常图。
中国地震台网中心（CENC）2008年2月至2026年1月期间唐山地区的1175个地震事件目录。
li: Conventional gravity modeling suffers from non-uniqueness due to the superposition of multi-source anomaly signals.
Magnetotelluric sounding and seismic tomography in the source area remain constrained by station density and limited lateral resolution.
Depth estimates from radially averaged power spectra represent equivalent average burial depths across the study region rather than exact local 3D density boundaries.
多源重力异常信号的叠加导致常规三维密度反演存在显著的多解性与不确定性。
震源区的大地电磁测深与地震层析成像受限于台站密度，横向分辨率依然不足。
径向对数功率谱估算的深度仅代表研究区等效平均场源埋深，而非精确的局部三维密度界面。

tm.why: The paper investigates the crustal density structure, mantle thermal upwelling, and North China Craton destruction beneath the Tangshan seismic zone using multi-scale wavelet decomposition of gravity anomalies.
The study analyzes the Tangshan rhombic fault block, shallow flower structures, high-angle fault locking, and deep-shallow dynamical stress transfer leading to the 1976 Ms7.8 rupture.

ev.notes: Full 19-page PDF text and all 8 figures were analyzed directly.

sum: This study investigates strain localization and thinning styles across the East African Rift System (EARS) by combining a high-resolution anisotropic full-waveform tomography model of Africa with compiled active- and passive-source crustal and lithospheric structure models. The authors invert vertically polarized shear-wave speeds (Vsv) for mantle temperatures, fit steady-state geotherms to map the thermal lithosphere-asthenosphere boundary (LAB) and integrated yield strength, and compute crustal (beta_C) and lithospheric mantle (beta_L) thinning and decoupling (gamma = beta_L/beta_C) factors. Results demonstrate widespread lithospheric mantle necking (beta_L > 2) and weakened lithosphere (~5 TN/m) along both branches. While the magma-rich eastern branch exhibits commensurate crust-mantle thinning (gamma < 3), the magma-poor western branch shows segments with extreme decoupling (up to gamma = 21.3 in Rungwe). The dearth of necked crust relative to necked mantle implies lithospheric mantle necking precedes crustal necking, aided by inheritance, foundering, delamination, and melt lubrication.
本研究结合非洲高分辨率各向异性全波形层析成像模型与主动源、被动源地震岩石圈结构汇编数据，探究了东非裂谷系（EARS）的应变局部化与减薄模式。作者利用Vsv波速反演地幔温度并拟合稳态地温线以确定热岩石圈-软流圈边界（LAB）及岩石圈屈服强度，进而计算地壳与岩石圈地幔减薄因子及形变解耦参数。结果表明东西……

t: Vsv speeds are inverted for mantle temperature using Newton optimization, fitted with steady-state geotherms to map the 1300 °C LAB and yield strength, and combined with Moho depths to compute thinning and decoupling factors.
利用牛顿优化将Vsv转换为地幔温度并拟合地温线以确定1300°C热LAB和强度，结合莫霍面计算减薄与解耦因子。

Uses the regional anisotropic FWI shear-wave model of van Herwaarden et al. (2023) alongside a comprehensive compilation of active- and passive-source seismic sediment thicknesses, Moho depths, Vp/Vs, and NVGs.
采用非洲区域各向异性全波形反演剪切波模型，结合主动源和被动源沉积层厚度、莫霍面、Vp/Vs及NVG汇编数据。
Crustal thinning reaches ~3 in Turkana and Urema Graben, while lithospheric mantle thinning reaches ~22 in Rungwe (western branch) and ~9 in northern Kenya, yielding decoupling factors up to 21.3.
地壳最大减薄因子达~3，西支鲁נג威岩石圈地幔减薄因子高达~22，形变解耦参数最高达21.3，裂谷强度弱化至~5 TN/…

Pre-rift thicknesses are uncertain due to inheritance and underplating, active-source sediment grids are sparse, and uniform rheological parameters and geotherm bounds limit LAB accuracy at thermal extremes.
裂谷前初始厚度受构造继承和底侵影响不确定性大，沉积物网格稀疏，且均匀流变参数和热流边界限制了极值区精度。
Introduces the deformation decoupling factor across the entire EARS using multiscale seismic models, revealing that lithospheric mantle necking precedes crustal necking in evolving continental rifts.
首次在全东非裂谷系引入形变解耦参数进行多尺度量化对比，揭示了发育中大陆裂谷的岩石圈地幔颈缩先于地壳颈缩。

kc: Compiled a comprehensive multiscale dataset of sediment thickness, Moho depth, crustal Vp/Vs, and mantle negative velocity gradients (NVGs) across the EARS.
Derived new regional mantle temperature, thermal LAB depth, and integrated lithospheric yield strength maps for the EARS from anisotropic FWI shear wave speeds.
Quantified crustal and lithospheric mantle thinning factors and introduced a deformation decoupling parameter (gamma) across 26 rift segments.
Demonstrated that lithospheric mantle necking precedes crustal necking and identified extreme crust-mantle decoupling in segments of the magma-poor western branch.
汇编了东非裂谷系多尺度沉积层厚度、莫霍面深度、地壳Vp/Vs及地幔负速度梯度（NVG）综合数据集。
基于各向异性全波形反演剪切波速，构建了东非裂谷系地幔温度、热LAB深度及岩石圈积分屈服强度新模型。
量化了26个裂谷段的地壳与岩石圈地幔减薄因子，并引入形变解耦参数（gamma）进行对比分析。
证实了岩石圈地幔颈缩先于地壳颈缩，并发现贫岩浆西支存在强烈的壳幔减薄解耦现象。
me: Conversion of Vsv from full-waveform tomography to temperature via Newton-Raphson optimization using anelasticity parameterizations.
Steady-state continental geotherm fitting via directed grid search over surface heat flow (30-90 mW/m2) to define the thermal LAB at the 1300 °C isotherm.
Depth integration of brittle-ductile yield stress envelopes to estimate first-order integrated lithospheric yield strength.
Calculation of inverse-uncertainty-weighted crustal and lithospheric mantle thinning factors and deformation decoupling ratios relative to unrifted flank maxima.
利用非弹性参数化与牛顿-拉夫逊优化方法，将全波形层析成像的Vsv波速转换为地幔温度。
在地表热流（30-90 mW/m2）网格搜索下拟合稳态大陆地温线，以1300 °C等温线定义热LAB深度。
对脆-韧性屈服应力包络线进行深度积分，估算一阶岩石圈积分屈服强度。
基于裂谷侧翼未裂解区最大厚度，计算逆不确定度加权的地壳与岩石圈地幔减薄因子及形变解耦比。
de: Regional anisotropic shear-wave speed model (Vsv) of the African Plate from full-waveform inversion (van Herwaarden et al., 2023) at periods >= 35 s.
Compilation of passive-source receiver function results (Moho depths, crustal Vp/Vs ratios, and Sp/Ps negative velocity gradients).
Digitized 2D wide-angle reflection/refraction crustal profiles and active-source sediment thickness maps, supplemented by AFROMOHO and CRUST1.0.
周期>=35秒的非洲板块区域各向异性全波形反演剪切波速模型（van Herwaarden et al., 2023）。
被动源接收函数研究结果汇编（莫霍面深度、地壳平均Vp/Vs比值以及Sp/Ps负速度梯度）。
数字化二维广角反射/折射地壳剖面与主动源沉积物厚度图，并以AFROMOHO和CRUST1.0补充。
li: Sparse active-source sediment thickness coverage outside western branch rift basins and limited seismic station sampling directly along some rift axes.
Reliance on uniform, standard thermo-rheological parameters and steady-state geotherm bounds (imposing a minimum LAB depth of ~56.8 km and maximum of 250 km).
High uncertainties in pre-rift crustal and lithospheric thicknesses due to structural inheritance, adjacent cratonic keels, and unaccounted magmatic underplating.
西支裂谷盆地外主动源沉积物厚度数据稀疏，且部分裂谷轴部缺乏直接的地震台站采样。
采用均匀标准的热-流变学参数及稳态地温线约束（强制设定LAB深度下限约56.8 km、上限250 km）。
受构造继承、邻近克拉通陆根及未扣除的岩浆底侵影响，裂谷前初始地壳与岩石圈厚度存在较大不确定性。

tm.why: The paper investigates crustal and lithospheric mantle thinning, LAB depths, thermal structure, and geodynamic strain localization mechanisms across the East African Rift System.
The study extensively compiles and analyzes Moho depths, crustal Vp/Vs ratios, and negative velocity gradients (LAB/MLDs) derived from Ps and Sp receiver function studies.
The core mantle temperature and thermal LAB models are derived directly from a high-resolution regional anisotropic full-waveform tomography model of the African Plate.

ev.notes: Full 25-page PDF including text, equations, Table 1, and Figures 1-12 was read and analyzed.

sum: This study presents the first systematic investigation of tectonic tremor tidal sensitivity in a mixed fast and slow earthquake system along the northeastern Japan subduction zone. Using a machine-learning-derived tremor catalog (125,830 events from S-net OBS data) and the JMA fast earthquake catalog from 2016 to 2024, the authors calculate tidal shear and normal stresses and evaluate tidal modulation via phase-based and amplitude-based statistical fittings. They find the strongest tidal sensitivity at the southern Kuril Trench (α = 2.21 kPa⁻¹), characterized by coherent tremor migration and weak seismicity, and the weakest in the northern Japan Trench (α = 0.94 kPa⁻¹), where tremors coexist with frequent Mj ≥ 4 earthquakes. Furthermore, tidal sensitivity increases from early (α = 1.42 kPa⁻¹) to later stages (α = 2.56 kPa⁻¹) of tremor migration. These patterns demonstrate that tidal sensitivity effectively probes competing background stress perturbations from slow slip and nearby earthquakes.
本研究首次系统调查了日本东北俯冲带快慢地震混合系统中构造颤动的潮汐敏感性。利用2016至2024年基于S-net海底地震仪深度学习构建的125,830个颤动目录及JMA地震目录，结合体潮与海潮负荷模型计算潮汐应力，并采用相位和振幅统计拟合量化敏感性。结果表明：千岛海沟南端（具颤动迁移和弱地震活动）潮……

t: Tidal body and ocean loading stresses are resolved onto representative slab fault planes. Tremor tidal sensitivity is quantified using phase-based cosine fitting (modulation amplitude P) and amplitude-based exponential fitting (stress sensitivity coefficient α).
计算体潮和海潮负荷并投影至板片断层面，通过相位余弦拟合(P)和振幅指数拟合(α)量化颤动潮汐敏感性。

The study uses 125,830 tectonic tremors (2016–2024) detected from S-net ocean-bottom seismometer waveforms via machine learning (Sagae et al. 2025) and 18,752 fast earthquakes (Mj ≥ 2) from the JMA catalog across three Japan Trench regions.
使用2016-2024年S-net海底地震仪深度学习检测的125,830个颤动事件及JMA目录中18,752个Mj≥2快…

Tidal shear stress sensitivity α is highest in the Northern region (2.21 kPa⁻¹), intermediate in the Southern (1.44 kPa⁻¹), and lowest in the Central (0.94 kPa⁻¹). During northern tremor migration, α rises from 1.42 (early) to 2.56 kPa⁻¹ (late).
潮汐剪应力敏感性α在北区最高(2.21)，南区居中(1.44)，中区最低(0.94)；北区颤动迁移后期α从1.42升至2…
Coseismic stress changes, aftershocks, and postseismic deformation overlap in space and time, preventing unique isolation of individual background perturbation processes from tidal sensitivity alone.
同震应力、余震和震后形变时空交叠，仅凭潮汐敏感性难以独立区分单一扰动过程的贡献。
First systematic investigation of tremor tidal sensitivity in a mixed fast and slow earthquake system, linking weaker tidal sensitivity to nearby fast earthquake perturbations.
首次系统研究快慢混合地震系统的颤动潮汐敏感性，揭示邻近快地震扰动与弱潮汐敏感性的关联。

kc: First systematic characterization of shallow tectonic tremor tidal sensitivity in a mixed fast and slow earthquake system (northeastern Japan).
Discovery of an inverse spatial relationship between tremor tidal sensitivity and the density of moderate fast earthquakes (Mj ≥ 4) and tremors.
Observation that tidal sensitivity increases from the early stage (α = 1.42 kPa⁻¹) to the later stage (α = 2.56 kPa⁻¹) during along-strike tremor migration in the southern Kuril Trench.
首次在快慢地震混合系统（日本东北俯冲带）中系统表征了浅层构造颤动的潮汐敏感性。
发现颤动潮汐敏感性与中等规模快地震（Mj ≥ 4）及颤动密度之间存在空间负相关关系。
观测到千岛海沟南端沿走向颤动迁移过程中，潮汐敏感性从早期（α = 1.42 kPa⁻¹）到后期（α = 2.56 kPa⁻¹）显著增强。
me: Tidal stress modeling combining solid Earth body tides (Tamura 1987) and ocean tidal loading (SPOTL with NAO99b/NAO99Jb models) using 10 tidal constituents and PREM Green's functions.
Phase-based cosine fitting and amplitude-based exponential fitting of observed-to-reference tremor frequencies against resolved tidal shear stress, normal stress, and stress invariants (p, q).
Grid-based spatial quantile ranking (0.1° spacing, 20 km radius) and moving-window temporal evolution analysis of tidal sensitivity and earthquake-associated tremor rates.
结合固体地球体潮（Tamura 1987）和海洋潮汐负荷（基于NAO99b/NAO99Jb模型的SPOTL），利用10个潮汐分潮和PREM格林函数计算断层潮汐应力。
针对分解的潮汐剪应力、正应力及应力不变量（p, q），对观测与参考颤动频率比进行基于相位的余弦拟合和基于振幅的指数拟合。
开展基于网格的空间分位数排序（0.1°间距，20 km半径）及滑动窗口时间演化分析，评估潮汐敏感性与地震伴生颤动率。
de: Machine-learning-derived tectonic tremor catalog (Sagae et al. 2025) obtained from the S-net cable-type ocean-bottom seismometer network from August 2016 to August 2024 (125,830 events across three regions).
Japan Meteorological Agency (JMA) unified earthquake catalog and daily reports for fast earthquakes (18,752 events with Mj ≥ 2).
2016年8月至2024年8月由S-net海底电缆地震仪网通过机器学习构建的构造颤动目录（Sagae et al. 2025，三个区域共125,830个事件）。
日本气象厅（JMA）统一地震目录及每日快报中的快地震数据（共18,752个Mj ≥ 2事件）。
li: Coseismic stress changes, aftershocks, and postseismic deformation overlap in space and time, making it difficult to isolate the contribution of individual perturbation processes from tidal sensitivity alone.
Tremor focal mechanisms and depths have large uncertainties, requiring representative slab geometry fault orientations on the plate interface.
同震应力变化、余震和震后形变在时空上相互重叠，仅凭潮汐敏感性难以独立区分单一扰动过程的贡献。
颤动震源机制和深度不确定性较大，需假设颤动发生在板块界面并采用代表性板片几何断层产状。

tm.why: The paper systematically investigates the tidal modulation and sensitivity of shallow tectonic tremors in a mixed fast and slow earthquake system along the Japan Trench.
The study relies on spatiotemporal statistical analysis of a machine-learning-derived S-net tectonic tremor catalog and the JMA earthquake catalog from 2016 to 2024.

ev.notes: Full 26-page manuscript PDF (including Supporting Information Text S1 and Figures S1-S9) was read and analyzed.

sum: This paper introduces GeoRisk-MLLM, a multimodal large language model framework designed for natural disaster risk detection and early warning in geosciences, including earthquakes and landslides. The framework integrates remote sensing imagery, temporal monitoring data, and IoT sensor streams using a hierarchical Transformer architecture with contrastive learning. It aligns visual features with reasoning processes to generate interpretable risk assessment reports and utilizes KV cache compression and knowledge distillation for efficient edge deployment. Evaluated on three geoscience benchmark datasets, GeoRisk-MLLM achieves an average AUC of 0.934, demonstrating superior performance, generalization, and interpretability compared to existing methods.
本文提出GeoRisk-MLLM，一种专为地球科学自然灾害（如地震、滑坡）风险检测与预警设计的双模态大语言模型框架。该框架通过分层Transformer架构和对比学习，融合了遥感图像、时序监测和物联网传感器数据；利用风险感知推理对齐模块生成可解释的风险评估报告；并采用KV缓存压缩和知识蒸馏实现边缘设……

t: A multimodal large language model framework utilizing a hierarchical Transformer with contrastive learning, risk-aware reasoning alignment, and edge inference optimization.
利用对比学习分层Transformer、风险感知推理对齐和边缘推理优化的多模态大语言模型框架。
Three geoscience benchmark datasets containing remote sensing imagery, temporal monitoring data, and IoT sensor streams.
包含遥感图像、时序监测数据和物联网传感器数据流的三个地球科学基准数据集。
The framework achieves an average AUC of 0.934 on three geoscience benchmark datasets, outperforming existing baseline methods.
该框架在三个地学基准数据集上达到了0.934的平均AUC，优于现有的基线方法。
Potential challenges in deploying on highly resource-constrained edge devices and handling highly heterogeneous unaligned multimodal data.
在极度资源受限的边缘设备上部署以及处理高度异构且未对齐的多模态数据时存在挑战。
First framework to combine multimodal spatiotemporal fusion, risk-aware reasoning alignment, and edge compression for geoscience disaster warning.
首次将多模态时空融合、风险感知推理对齐和边缘压缩结合用于地学灾害预警。

kc: Proposed GeoRisk-MLLM, a novel multimodal large language model framework for geoscience disaster risk detection and early warning.
Developed a Multimodal Spatiotemporal Fusion Encoder integrating remote sensing, temporal monitoring, and IoT sensor streams.
Introduced an Efficient Edge Inference module using KV cache compression and knowledge distillation for real-time edge deployment.
提出了GeoRisk-MLLM，一种用于地球科学灾害风险检测与早期预警的新型多模态大语言模型框架。
开发了多模态时空融合编码器，集成了遥感、时序监测和物联网传感器数据流。
引入了高效边缘推理模块，利用KV缓存压缩和知识蒸馏实现实时边缘部署。
me: Hierarchical Transformer architecture with contrastive learning for multimodal spatiotemporal fusion.
Risk-Aware Reasoning Alignment to align visual features with reasoning processes for interpretable reports.
KV cache compression and knowledge distillation for model compression and edge deployment.
采用带对比学习的分层Transformer架构进行多模态时空融合。
利用风险感知推理对齐，将视觉特征与推理过程对齐以生成可解释的报告。
采用KV缓存压缩和知识蒸馏进行模型压缩与边缘部署。
de: Evaluated on three geoscience benchmark datasets for natural disaster risk detection.
Conducted ablation studies to verify the effectiveness of each proposed module.
Performed cross-domain evaluations and human evaluations to validate generalization and interpretability.
在三个用于自然灾害风险检测的地球科学基准数据集上进行了评估。
进行了消融实验以验证每个所提模块的有效性。
进行了跨领域评估和人工评估，以验证泛化能力和可解释性。
li: The performance relies heavily on the quality and synchronization of multimodal input streams.
Deployment on extremely low-resource edge devices may still face hardware constraints despite compression.
模型性能在很大程度上依赖于多模态输入流的质量和同步性。
尽管进行了压缩，在极低资源的边缘设备上部署可能仍面临硬件限制。

tm.why: The paper proposes a multimodal large language model framework for natural disaster risk detection, specifically targeting earthquakes and landslides.
The framework is designed for natural disaster risk detection and early warning, which directly relates to seismic hazard assessment.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the metadata and abstract from ESS Open Archive and Crossref since the full PDF was not available.

sum: As part of the SEIS-ADELICE project (2020–2025), hundreds of seismological instruments—including multi-year broadband stations, short-period nodes in shallow boreholes, ocean-bottom seismometers (OBS), and surface fibre-optic Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) cables—were sequentially deployed on and around the Astrolabe Glacier in East Antarctica. This paper serves as a field experiment report and dataset overview, detailing Polar installation practices, sensor orientation techniques, and power management. The authors evaluate probabilistic power spectral densities (PPSD) across environments and showcase data quality through preliminary analyses: STA/LTA detection of surface icequakes and basal stick-slip events correlated with ocean tides, tap tests, and ambient-noise cross-correlations yielding high-SNR surface waves for dispersion analysis. A key novel observation is the progressive appearance of a 16-second spectral energy peak as stations transition from grounded ice to the floating glacier tongue.
作为SEIS-ADELICE项目（2020–2025）的一部分，研究团队在东南极阿斯特罗拉布冰川及其周边部署了宽频带地震仪、浅钻孔短周期节点、海底地震仪（OBS）和分布式声学传感（DAS）光缆。本文详细介绍了极地仪器布设规范、传感器定向方法和不同环境下的背景噪声水平（PPSD）。通过STA/LTA检……

t: STA/LTA detection (using a 5–40 Hz bandpass filter and averaged over 500 m fibre segments for DAS), Probabilistic Power Spectral Density (PPSD) noise evaluation, and ambient-noise cross-correlation with short time windows.
采用5–40 Hz带通滤波的STA/LTA事件检测、概率功率谱密度（PPSD）噪声评估及短时窗背景噪声互相关。

Multi-year broadband stations (Trillium 120), three annual deployments of shallow-borehole seismic nodes (2023–2025), ocean-bottom seismometers (OBS), and two surface fibre-optic DAS cables on and around the Astrolabe Glacier.
阿斯特罗拉布冰川及周边的多年宽频带台站、三期浅钻孔节点阵列（2023–2025）、海底地震仪（OBS）及两条地表DAS光…

PPSD analyses reveal a prominent 16 s (and 50 s) spectral energy peak appearing progressively from grounded to floating ice, alongside high-SNR surface-wave cross-correlations and tide-modulated basal stick-slip and surface icequake detections.
PPSD揭示从接地冰到漂浮冰舌逐渐出现16秒谱能量峰值，并获得高信噪比面波互相关函数及受潮汐调制的粘滑与冰震检测。
High wind noise during storms raises LTA thresholds and lowers icequake detection rates; surface melting tilts sensors, and surface-laid DAS has weaker coupling than buried nodes.
暴风雪期间强风噪声抬高LTA阈值降低检测率，表面融化导致传感器倾斜，且地表DAS耦合弱于深埋节点。

First comprehensive multi-sensor cryoseismic dataset and practical polar deployment guide for the Astrolabe Glacier, newly identifying the spatial emergence of a 16 s spectral peak across the grounding zone.
首次提供阿斯特罗拉布冰川多传感器冰震数据集与极地布设指南，新发现跨越接地带出现的16秒能量峰值。

kc: Detailed field deployment guide and dataset report for multi-year broadband stations, dense nodal arrays, OBS, and DAS cables on an Antarctic outlet glacier.
Characterization of seismic noise levels (PPSD) across grounded ice, floating glacier tongue, bedrock, and seabed environments, revealing a prominent 16 s spectral peak on floating ice.
Demonstration of dataset versatility through examples of surface icequake and basal stick-slip detection, active tap tests, and ambient noise cross-correlation for dispersion analysis.
提供了南极溢流冰川多年宽频带台站、密集节点阵列、OBS和DAS光缆的详细野外部署指南与数据集报告。
表征了接地冰、漂浮冰舌、基岩和海底环境下的地震背景噪声水平（PPSD），揭示了漂浮冰舌上显著的16秒谱能量峰值。
通过表面冰震和底部粘滑事件检测、主动源敲击测试以及用于频散分析的背景噪声互相关示例，展示了数据集的多功能性。
me: Probabilistic Power Spectral Density (PPSD) analysis across diverse glacial and marine instrumentation sites.
STA/LTA event detection (5–40 Hz bandpass on DAS and nodal arrays) to identify surface brittle icequakes and basal stick-slip seismicity.
Ambient-noise cross-correlation with shortened time windows for transient rejection to extract surface-wave phase dispersion.
在不同冰川和海洋仪器站点进行概率功率谱密度（PPSD）分析。
利用STA/LTA事件检测（DAS和节点阵列采用5–40 Hz带通滤波）识别表面脆性冰震和底部粘滑地震活动。
采用缩短时间窗口以剔除瞬态信号的背景噪声互相关方法，提取面波相速度频散。
de: Multi-year broadband velocimeters (e.g., Trillium 120 at AST02, AST04, AST05, AST07, AST13) deployed on rock, grounded ice, and the floating tongue.
Three successive temporary deployments (2023, 2024, 2025) of short-period seismic nodes installed in shallow drilled boreholes.
Two surface fibre-optic cables interrogated with DAS alongside active-source hammer tap tests, plus ocean-bottom seismometers (OBS) deployed via barge and vessel.
在基岩、接地冰和漂浮冰舌上多年部署的宽频带速度计（如AST02、AST04、AST05、AST07、AST13台站的Trillium 120）。
2023、2024和2025年连续三次在浅钻孔中临时部署的短周期地震节点阵列。
两条配合主动源大锤敲击测试的地表DAS光缆，以及通过驳船和后勤船布设的海底地震仪（OBS）。
li: Wind storms elevate ambient noise and LTA levels on surface DAS and ice stations, significantly reducing STA/LTA icequake detection rates during high-wind periods.
Surface melting around grounded zone stations (e.g., AST05) and shallow borehole nodes induces sensor tilt, while surface-laid DAS cables suffer weaker coupling compared to buried nodes.
Large data volumes from dense nodal arrays and DAS delay public archiving on RESIF, currently requiring direct requests for access.
暴风雪会提高地表DAS和冰面台站的背景噪声及LTA水平，显著降低大风期间的STA/LTA冰震检测率。
接地带台站（如AST05）和浅钻孔节点周围的表面融化会导致传感器倾斜，且地表铺设的DAS光缆耦合效果弱于深埋节点。
密集节点阵列和DAS产生的海量数据推迟了在RESIF上的公开归档，目前需通过申请获取。

tm.why: The paper focuses on monitoring the cryoseismic activity, internal structure, and dynamics of the Astrolabe Coastal Glacier in East Antarctica.
The study extensively details the field deployment, installation practices, and noise levels of broadband stations, short-period nodes, and ocean-bottom seismometers.
The experiment incorporates fibre-optic DAS cables deployed on the glacier surface for tap tests and local icequake detection.

ev.notes: The provided PDF is the comprehensive 14-page 'Response to reviewers letter' for the Seismica manuscript, which contains detailed verbatim descriptions of the revised manuscript sections, methodology, deployments, figures (Figs. 1, 4, 5, 6, 8, and Suppl. Fig. S2), and preliminary scientific results, combined with the article metadata and abstract.

sum: Prior to inner-core nucleation, the mechanical power source driving Earth's geodynamo remains uncertain. This paper develops a linear mathematical theory for lunar tides in a two-layer early Earth system consisting of a liquid-metal core overlain by a silicate basal magma ocean (BMO). Unlike traditional models where tidal flows are driven by imposed solid-mantle boundary deformation, here the lunar gravitational potential acts directly on the core–BMO density contrast. In the inviscid limit, the response transitions from a low-frequency equilibrium tide to a high-frequency interfacial gravity wave across a resonance matching the degree-2, order-2 natural interfacial mode, producing a core flow formally identical to the canonical elliptical vortex. Finite viscosity regularizes the resonance, introduces phase lag, and forms oscillatory boundary layers. Combining this theory with parameterized lunar recession and BMO crystallization trajectories shows that resonant BMO coupling substantially enhances core flow speeds, magnetic Reynolds numbers, and elliptical instability metrics.
内核成核前的早期地球发电机动力来源尚不明确。本文建立了由液态金属外核和硅酸盐基底岩浆洋（BMO）组成的双层系统月球潮汐线性理论。不同于传统强加固体地幔边界形变的模型，该理论中潮汐引力势直接作用于核–BMO密度界面。无粘极限下，响应随强迫频率增加从平衡潮过渡到界面重力波，并在匹配2阶2次本征模态处发生……

t: Linearizes incompressible Navier-Stokes and Poisson self-gravity equations around a hydrostatic two-layer core–BMO state, solving for spherical harmonic degree-2, order-2 forced poloidal velocity and potential perturbations analytically (inviscid) and semi-analytically (viscous).
围绕双层静水压参考态线性化不可压缩N-S与自引力泊松方程，解析和半解析求解2阶2次球谐潮汐强迫响应。

Evaluates theoretical solutions across Earth–Moon physical parameter ranges (Table 1) and three parameterized 4.5-Gyr trajectories of lunar orbital distance, length of day, and exponential BMO thinning (initial thicknesses 100–400 km).
采用早期地月系统物理参数（表1）及三条参数化45亿年月球轨道、日长和BMO指数减薄轨迹（初始厚度100–400 km）。

Near resonance, CMB ellipticity reaches ~10^-5 (vs ~25.7*psi_M in equilibrium), core kinetic energy spans 10^14–10^20 J, BMO viscous dissipation reaches 0.01–10 TW, and magnetic Reynolds and elliptical instability numbers exceed critical thresholds.
共振附近CMB椭率达10^-5，地核动能跨10^14–10^20 J，BMO粘性耗散达0.01–10 TW，Rm与Ei超…
The model neglects the Coriolis force, nonlinear momentum advection, self-consistent viscoelastic mantle deformation, and thermal-orbital dissipation feedback.
忽略了科里奥利力、非线性动量平流、固体地幔自洽粘弹性形变及热–轨道演化反馈。
Formulates lunar tidal forcing acting directly on the deformable core–BMO density interface rather than via imposed solid-mantle ellipticity, uncovering an interfacial gravity wave resonance.
首次建立潮汐势直接作用于核–BMO可变形密度界面的双层模型，发现了界面重力波共振放大机制。

kc: Formulated a self-gravitating, two-layer linear tidal theory where lunar gravitational forcing acts directly on the deformable core–basal magma ocean (BMO) density interface.

Derived an analytical inviscid solution showing a transition from equilibrium tide to interfacial gravity wave separated by a degree-2, order-2 interfacial mode resonance, with core flow identical to the canonical elliptical vortex.

Quantified viscous regularization, phase lags, oscillatory boundary layers, and viscous dissipation (reaching 0.01–10 TW in the BMO near resonance) using high-precision semi-analytical Bessel function inversions.

Demonstrated along parameterized Earth-Moon orbital and BMO crystallization histories that resonance crossing around 1–2 Ga substantially amplifies magnetic Reynolds numbers and elliptical/boundary-layer instability metrics.
建立了自引力双层线性潮汐理论，使月球引力强迫直接作用于可变形的地核–基底岩浆洋（BMO）密度界面。
推导了无粘解析解，揭示了由2阶2次界面模态共振分隔的平衡潮与界面重力波机制，并证明地核流场在数学上等同于经典椭圆涡旋。
利用高精度半解析贝塞尔函数求逆，量化了粘性正则化、相位滞后、振荡边界层及粘性耗散（共振附近BMO耗散可达0.01–10 TW）。
结合参数化的地月轨道与BMO结晶历史，证明在1–2 Ga穿越共振区可显著放大磁雷诺数以及椭圆和边界层不稳定性指标。
me: Linearization of incompressible Navier-Stokes and Poisson self-gravity equations around a two-layer hydrostatic reference state in a rotating frame (neglecting Coriolis and nonlinear advection).
Poloidal-toroidal velocity decomposition and spherical harmonic expansion for degree-2, order-2 lunar tidal potential forcing.

Analytical inversion of the boundary-condition matrix in the inviscid limit and high-precision numerical inversion (up to thousands of decimal digits via Advanpix) of complex-argument Bessel function matrices for finite viscosity.
Asymptotic boundary-layer rescaling and evaluation of secondary instability metrics (magnetic Reynolds number Rm, elliptical instability number Ei, and Stokes boundary-layer Reynolds number R_delta).
在旋转参考系中围绕双层流体静力学参考态对不可压缩Navier-Stokes方程和泊松自引力方程进行线性化（忽略科里奥利力与非线性平流）。
针对2阶2次月球潮汐势强迫，采用极向–环向速度分解与球谐函数展开求解径向特征函数。
在无粘极限下解析求逆边界条件矩阵，并在有限粘度下对复宗量贝塞尔函数构成的病态矩阵进行高精度数值求逆（使用Advanpix多精度工具箱）。
进行渐近边界层重标度分析，并评估次级不稳定性与发电机指标（磁雷诺数Rm、椭圆不稳定性数Ei及边界层雷诺数R_delta）。
de: Theoretical parameter space exploration over dimensionless forcing frequency (Omega), BMO thickness (R - 1), Reynolds number (Re up to 10^10), and viscosity ratio (nu_OC = 20).
Comparison of three model variants: fully inviscid, fully viscous (viscous core and BMO), and inviscid core with viscous BMO (ICVO), plus an extension with imposed solid-mantle tidal deformation.
Evaluation of three illustrative 4.5-Gyr Earth-Moon thermal-orbital trajectories (initial BMO thicknesses of 100, 200, and 400 km) parameterized from Farhat et al. (2022) and Schaeffer et al. (2025).
在无量纲强迫频率（Omega）、BMO厚度（R - 1）、雷诺数（Re高达10^10）和粘度比（nu_OC = 20）参数空间内进行理论数值探索。
对比三种模型变体：完全无粘模型、完全粘性模型（粘性核与BMO）、无粘地核–粘性BMO（ICVO）模型，并在附录中扩展分析固体地幔潮汐形变强迫。
基于Farhat等（2022）和Schaeffer等（2025）的参数化结果，评估三条代表性45亿年地月轨道与BMO厚度演化轨迹（初始厚度100、200和400 km）。
li: Omits the Coriolis force in the governing momentum equations, which in reality modifies the free-oscillation spectrum and couples spheroidal and toroidal modes into gravito-inertial modes.
Neglects nonlinear momentum advection, precluding direct simulation of turbulent saturation amplitudes, wave breaking, and full magnetohydrodynamic dynamo action.
Assumes a static, rigid outer boundary for the solid mantle in the main text rather than solving a self-consistent viscoelastic solid-mantle flexure problem.
Prescribes lunar orbital recession and BMO crystallization histories externally without accounting for the two-way feedback of BMO tidal dissipation on thermal and orbital evolution.
动量方程忽略了科里奥利力，而地球自转会改变自由振荡谱并通过耦合球型和环型模态产生重力–惯性波分支。
忽略了非线性动量平流项，无法直接模拟湍流饱和振幅、波破碎及完整的磁流体动力学发电机过程。
正文中假设上覆固体地幔为静态刚性边界，未求解自洽的粘弹性固体地幔潮汐弯曲耦合问题。
外部预设了月球轨道退行和BMO结晶历史，未考虑BMO潮汐耗散对热演化和轨道演化的双向反馈。

tm.why: The paper develops a mathematical fluid-dynamical theory for lunar tidal forcing and dynamo implications in the early Earth's liquid core and basal magma ocean (lowermost mantle) system.
The paper formulates free and forced interfacial oscillation modes (normal modes/eigenfrequencies) of differentiated two-layer planetary interiors.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 40-page manuscript PDF (including main text §§1–8, Figures 1–12, Tables 1–2, and Appendices A–E).

sum: This study analyzes an improved, densified GNSS velocity field spanning up to 35 years across central and southwestern Greece to quantify slip rates, strain localization, and interseismic loading. Using spherical bicubic spline interpolation (Haines & Holt method) and kinematic transects in local reference frames, the authors distinguish between aseismic creep, distributed deformation, and elastic fault locking using Okada dislocation and arctangent modeling. Results show westward-increasing Corinth Rift extension (7 to 15 mm/yr) combining ~6.5 mm/yr creep and ~8.5 mm/yr elastic loading on the Psathopyrgos Fault, plus a possible deep slow-slip transient. The Katouna–Stamna system creeps left-laterally at 8–13 mm/yr, whereas the Movri (~4 mm/yr) and Cephalonia (~16 mm/yr) faults are strongly locked, posing high seismic hazard. Conversely, the Astros Fault shows negligible strain, lowering its inferred hazard. This provides unprecedented fault-scale kinematic resolution for the western Aegean.
本研究利用希腊中西南部长达35年的加密GNSS速度场，量化了希腊俯冲带上盘的断层滑动率、应变局部化与震间加载。通过球面双三次样条插值（Haines & Holt方法）、局部参考系转换及运动学剖面（结合反正切函数与Okada位错反演），区分了无震蠕滑、分布式应变与震间弹性闭锁。结果显示：科林斯裂谷张裂……

t: Horizontal GNSS velocities are interpolated onto a spherical grid using bicubic splines (Haines & Holt method), and reprojected into local block reference frames along kinematic transects to invert fault creep and elastic locking via Okada and arctangent models.
利用Haines & Holt球面双三次样条插值GNSS速度，转换至局部参考系并基于Okada与反正切模型反演蠕滑和闭锁…

The study uses a densified GNSS velocity field of central and southwestern Greece (Briole et al. 2026a), combining permanent stations and hundreds of campaign points with time-series spanning up to 35 years, corrected for earthquake displacements.
采用涵盖永久站和数百个流动站、跨度达35年并经同震/震后改正的希腊中西南部加密GNSS速度场。

Corinth Rift extension increases westward from ~7 to ~15 mm/yr; Katouna–Stamna creeps left-laterally at 13 and 8 mm/yr; Movri (~4 mm/yr) and Cephalonia (~16 mm/yr total) faults accumulate locked elastic strain; Astros Fault shows no resolvable strain.
科林斯裂谷扩张7–15 mm/yr；Katouna-Stamna蠕滑8–13 mm/yr；Movri和Cephaloni…
Non-tectonic site scatter of ±1 mm/yr limits resolution of velocity gradients below 2 mm/yr, and offshore fault locations hamper unique inversions of locking depth and slip partitioning.
非构造噪声达±1 mm/yr限制了<2 mm/yr梯度分辨，且近海断层缺乏台站覆盖导致闭锁反演存在多解性。

Leverages an unprecedentedly dense 35-year campaign and continuous GNSS network to separate fault-scale aseismic creep, interseismic elastic locking, and diffuse deformation across eight major western Aegean tectonic systems.
利用高密度35年GNSS网首次在断层尺度精细分离了爱琴海西部八大构造系的无震蠕滑、弹性加载与弥散变形。

kc: Derives continuous strain-rate, rotation, dilatation, and strike-slip potential fields for central and southwestern Greece from a densified 35-year GNSS dataset.

Quantifies partitioning between aseismic creep (~6.5 mm/yr) and shallow elastic loading (~8.5 mm/yr) on the Psathopyrgos Fault in the western Corinth Rift, and identifies a potential deep slow-slip transient.
Demonstrates that the Katouna–Stamna strike-slip system is predominantly creeping (13 and 8 mm/yr), linked via the Trichonida pull-apart basin and Nafpaktia diffuse shear zone.

Identifies full interseismic locking on the Movri Fault (~4 mm/yr, ~14 km coupling thickness) and high transpressional loading on the Cephalonia Transform Fault (~16 mm/yr total rate), while finding negligible loading on the Astros Fault.
基于35年加密GNSS数据集，导出希腊中西南部连续的应变率、旋转率、膨胀率及走滑潜力场。
量化了西科林斯裂谷Psathopyrgos断层上的无震蠕滑（约6.5 mm/yr）与浅部弹性加载（约8.5 mm/yr）分配，并识别出一个潜在的深部慢滑移瞬态事件。
证明Katouna–Stamna走滑系统以无震蠕滑为主（分别为13和8 mm/yr），并通过Trichonida拉分盆地和Nafpaktia弥散剪切带传递应变。
揭示Movri断层（约4 mm/yr，耦合厚度约14 km）和Cephalonia转换断层（总速率约16 mm/yr）存在强震间闭锁，而Astros断层现代应变加载可忽略不计。
me: Continuous velocity and strain-rate tensor interpolation on a spherical grid using bicubic splines (Haines & Holt approach in Sparse code) with relaxed smoothness constraints along major faults.

Transformation of GNSS velocities into local block-fixed reference frames (Central Greece, Stable Peloponnese, IAB, Attica) to isolate fault-normal and fault-parallel deformation along kinematic transects.
Analytical arctangent curve fitting and Okada elastic half-space dislocation inversions to estimate fault locking depths, coupling thicknesses, and slow-slip source geometry.
采用球面双三次样条（Sparse代码中的Haines & Holt方法）进行连续速度场和应变率张量插值，并在主断层带放宽平滑约束。
将GNSS速度转换至局部块体固定参考系（中希腊、稳定伯罗奔尼撒、IAB、阿提卡），提取横跨构造的运动学剖面以分离平行与垂直断层变形分量。
利用反正切函数拟合与Okada弹性半空间位错反演，估算断层闭锁深度、耦合厚度及慢滑移事件源几何参数。
de: Densified horizontal GNSS velocity field of central Greece and the Peloponnese (Briole et al. 2026a, b) combining permanent stations and hundreds of campaign sites spanning up to 35 years, corrected for coseismic and post-seismic offsets.
中希腊和伯罗奔尼撒半岛的加密水平GNSS速度场（Briole et al. 2026a, b），融合了永久台站与数百个流动观测点长达35年的数据，并进行了同震和震后位移校正。
li: Offshore fault segments (e.g., eastern Corinth Rift, western compartment of Cephalonia Transform Fault) lack direct spatial coverage, creating non-uniqueness in locking depth and slip partitioning models.
Velocity scatter of ±1 mm/yr from non-tectonic noise (hydrological loading, local subsidence, landslides) limits resolution of deformation gradients below 2 mm/yr.
Temporal resolution in campaign GNSS time-series is insufficient to pinpoint the exact timing of the inferred 2021 slow-slip transient in the northwestern Corinth Gulf.
近海断层段（如东科林斯裂谷、Cephalonia转换断层西盘）缺乏直接观测覆盖，导致闭锁深度和滑动分配反演存在多解性。
非构造噪声（水文负载、局部沉降、滑坡等）引起的±1 mm/yr速度离散限制了对低于2 mm/yr微弱变形梯度的分辨能力。
流动GNSS时间序列的时间分辨率不足以精确约束西北科林斯湾推断的慢滑移瞬态事件的具体发生时间。

tm.why: The paper quantifies fault slip rates, aseismic creep, interseismic elastic locking depths, and a candidate slow-slip transient across major fault systems in Greece using GNSS velocities.
It characterizes microplate rotations, strain partitioning, and upper-plate deformation driven by Hellenic slab rollback and North Anatolian Fault termination.
The study evaluates interseismic elastic strain accumulation and coupling thickness on active faults to reassess regional seismic and tsunami hazard potential.

ev.notes: Full 36-page GJI article PDF (HAL preprint / OUP typeset version) used, including all 12 figures and detailed kinematic analyses.

sum: This study presents geochemical and isotopic data for hydrothermal gases from the southeastern Tibetan Plateau, including the Changning–Menglian suture (CMS), Tengchong volcanic field (TCV), and Red River fault zone (RRF). The authors identify distinct regional contrasts in hydrogen (H2) concentrations and origins. In the CMS, active H2 seepage is driven by the serpentinization of remnant oceanic lithosphere. In the TCV, magmatic degassing dominates, whereas fault-related processes and radiolysis prevail in the RRF. Tectonic activity and lithospheric deformation drive H2 release, with faults acting as conduits. Secondary processes during ascent, such as calcite precipitation and CO2 dissolution, further enrich H2, forming N2-rich and H2-bearing fluids. These findings provide critical insights into the tectonic controls on natural hydrogen generation and migration in active continental collision zones.
本研究提供了青藏高原东南部昌宁-孟连缝合带（CMS）、腾冲火山区（TCV）和红河断裂带（RRF）热液气体的地球化学和同位素数据。研究发现不同区域的氢气浓度和成因存在显著差异：CMS的活跃氢气渗漏反映了残留洋壳岩石圈的蛇纹石化作用；TCV以岩浆脱气为主；而RRF则受断裂相关作用和辐射分解主导。构造活动……

t: Geochemical and stable/noble gas isotopic analysis of hydrothermal gases to determine volatile origins and secondary modification processes.
利用热液气体的地球化学和惰性气体/稳定同位素分析，确定挥发分来源及运移过程。
Hydrothermal gas samples and isotopic measurements from the Changning–Menglian suture, Tengchong volcanic field, and Red River fault zone.
采集自青藏高原东南部昌宁-孟连缝合带、腾冲火山区和红河断裂带的热液气体样品及同位素数据。
H2 concentrations show strong regional contrasts, peaking at 190,000 ppm in the CMS due to serpentinization, compared to lower levels in TCV and RRF.
氢气浓度呈显著区域差异，CMS因蛇纹石化作用高达190,000 ppm，远超TCV和RRF。
The quantitative contribution of radiolysis versus fault-related mechanical processes in the Red River fault zone remains difficult to resolve precisely.
红河断裂带中辐射分解与断裂机械作用对氢气生成的定量贡献仍难以精确区分。
Establishes tectonic-scale controls on hydrogen generation and migration, linking serpentinization, magmatism, and faulting to distinct H2 signatures in a collision zone.
建立了构造尺度上氢气生成与运移的控制模式，将蛇纹石化、岩浆作用和断裂作用与不同氢气特征联系起来。

kc: Identified distinct regional origins of hydrothermal hydrogen (H2) across three major tectonic units in the southeastern Tibetan Plateau.
Demonstrated that serpentinization of remnant oceanic lithosphere drives exceptionally high H2 concentrations (up to 190,000 ppm) in the Changning–Menglian suture.
Elucidated the role of tectonic activity and faults as primary drivers and conduits for hydrogen release and migration.

识别了青藏高原东南部三个主要构造单元热液氢气的不同区域成因。
证实了残留洋壳岩石圈的蛇纹石化作用导致昌宁-孟连缝合带中出现极高的氢气浓度（高达 190,000 ppm）。

sum: This paper presents the first experimental validation of seismic resonant metamaterials (metabarriers) for protecting structures against vertically propagating horizontal shear waves under realistic soil stress conditions. Two dynamic centrifuge tests were conducted at 50 g in a laminar container filled with dense Hostun sand, comparing an unprotected single-degree-of-freedom (SDOF) structure to one flanked by six 3D-printed resonant unit cells tuned near the structure's fundamental frequency (~145–150 Hz model scale, ~3 Hz prototype). Using deconvoluted real earthquake ground motions (El Centro, Kalamata, Parkfield), dense accelerometer arrays, and in-flight high-speed digital image correlation (DIC), the authors show substantial reduction in structural acceleration frequency response at resonance. DIC directly visualizes the underlying inertial metamaterial–soil–structure interaction (meta-SSI) mechanism: unit-cell internal masses oscillate out of phase (~1.45 rad) relative to adjacent soil, with a lateral influence zone extending ~2.5 times the unit-cell height.
本文首次在真实土体应力条件下实验验证了用于抵御竖向传播水平剪切波的地震谐振超材料（超屏障）。研究在装有密实Hostun砂的层状模型箱内进行了两组50g动态离心机试验，对比了无保护单自由度（SDOF）结构与两侧埋设6个3D打印谐振单胞（调谐至接近结构基频约145 Hz）的响应。结合反演的实际地震动输入……

t: Two 50 g geotechnical centrifuge tests in a laminar box compare an SDOF structure with and without six 3D-printed Nylon/brass resonant metamaterial unit cells tuned to 150 Hz using laser vibrometry and analyzed via FRFs and high-speed stereo DIC.
在层状箱中开展两组50g离心机试验，结合FRF与高速双目DIC对比有无6个150Hz 3D打印谐振单胞的SDOF结构响应…

Dense Hostun sand models (Dr = 95–100%) excited by deconvoluted El Centro, Kalamata, and Parkfield earthquake records plus an Ormsby wavelet, recorded by 23 accelerometers at 2500 Hz and two high-speed DIC cameras at 2000 Hz.
密实Hostun砂模型受反演的3条真实地震动及Ormsby子波激励，由23个加速度计和2台高速相机同步采集。

Metamaterials shifted to 145 Hz in soil and substantially reduced the structure's base-to-top acceleration FRF peak at 145 Hz across all earthquakes via a 1.45 rad out-of-phase mass-soil oscillation, with a lateral influence zone of 2.5 unit-cell heights.
超材料在145Hz处通过与土体产生1.45rad反相振荡显著降低结构FRF峰值，横向影响区为单胞高度的2.5倍。
Proof-of-concept simplifications include an idealized SDOF structure, unidirectional SDOF unit cells, vertically propagating shear waves only, and a limited set of seismic excitations.
概念验证简化包括理想化SDOF结构、单向SDOF单胞、仅考虑竖向传播剪切波及有限的地震动数量。
First rigorous 50 g centrifuge experimental validation of seismic resonant metamaterials under vertically propagating horizontal shear waves, advancing the concept to TRL 3.
首次在50g离心机中实验验证了竖向传播水平剪切波下谐振超材料的结构保护效果，推进至TRL 3。

Direct frequency-domain demonstration of substantial structural FRF amplitude reduction around the 145 Hz resonant frequency across three real earthquake ground motions.
Direct in-flight optical visualization via stereo DIC of the ~1.45 rad out-of-phase oscillation between unit-cell masses and adjacent soil.
Experimental quantification of the lateral metamaterial influence zone to approximately 2.5 times the unit-cell height, plus open publication of the raw accelerometer dataset.
首次通过50g土工离心机实验完成了针对竖向传播水平剪切波的土体嵌入式谐振超材料概念验证（TRL 3）。
在三种真实地震动激励下，直接证实了超材料在145 Hz共振频率附近显著降低结构频响函数（FRF）幅值。
利用飞行中双目DIC技术直接光学可视化了单胞质量块与邻近土体之间约1.45 rad的反相振荡保护机理。
实验量化了超材料的横向影响区域约为单胞高度的2.5倍，并公开了全部原始加速度计数据集。

Selective laser sintering 3D printing (Nylon 12) of SDOF unit cells with brass internal masses, tuned via PSV-500-3D laser vibrometry.
1D equivalent-linear ground motion deconvolution in ProShake 2.0 to derive bedrock shaker inputs.
Frequency-domain transfer function (FRF) analysis and in-flight high-speed stereo Digital Image Correlation (DIC) for phase and displacement mapping.
采用20层低摩擦层状模型箱和Actidyn BC-5810地震振动台开展50g动态土工离心机物理模型试验。
采用选择性激光烧结3D打印（尼龙12）内置黄铜质量块的SDOF单胞，并通过PSV-500-3D激光测振仪进行精确调谐。

sum: Existing tsunami early warning systems (TEWS) struggle with high latency, scalability bottlenecks, and real-time multi-source data integration. This paper introduces RT-EDAP (Real-Time Event-Driven Data Aggregation and Processing), a novel framework integrating edge computing (NVIDIA Jetson Nano), distributed stream processing (Apache Kafka and Apache Flink), and Temporal Convolutional Networks (TCNs). The system processes heterogeneous data from seismic sensors, tide gauges, and GPS stations. Lightweight TCNs perform local noise filtering and anomaly detection at the edge, while event-driven prioritization dynamically allocates resources to critical events (e.g., M > 7) and synchronizes streams centrally. Trained on 1,800 events from the Global Historical Tsunami Database and validated with DART buoy, tide gauge, and UNAVCO GNSS time-series, RT-EDAP achieves 95.0% classification accuracy, 50–60 ms computational latency, and scales up to 5,000 events/sec across 50 nodes, significantly outperforming CNN-LSTM, CNN-RNN, and Random Forest baselines.

1,800 quality-filtered historical events from the Kaggle Global Historical Tsunami Database (split 70/15/15%), supplemented by real time-series validation data from DART buoys (21418, 21413), IOC tide gauges, and UNAVCO GNSS stations.

RT-EDAP achieves 95.0% classification accuracy (94.2% precision, 95.6% recall, 94.9% F1-score), 50–60 ms computational latency, and scales up to 5,000 events/sec across 50 nodes, outperforming CNN-LSTM (85%, ~100 ms).
