sum: This study employs physics-based ground-motion simulation on a supercomputer to re-evaluate seismic hazard for Hualien, Taiwan, a highly vulnerable region. It simulates four historical earthquakes (Mw 6.4-7.3) up to 8 Hz, incorporating realistic 3D velocity, topography, bathymetry, and calibrated finite-fault slip models. Waveform comparisons validate the simulations. The research investigates directivity effects by varying hypocenter locations and explores source modeling uncertainties with multiple finite-fault models. Results show physics-based simulations can exceed empirical ground-motion model predictions, highlighting significant site amplifications. The generated synthetic ground-motion database is valuable for seismic hazard and risk analysis in the Hualien area, offering a novel, high-frequency dataset.

sum: This study analyzes temperature data from over 3,000 nodal seismometers deployed in North Yorkshire during the July 2022 heatwave. The seismometers' embedded microcontroller sensors provided unprecedented spatial and temporal resolution, logging over 80 million temperature readings. Statistical corrections were applied using co-located meteorological data to account for sensor housing biases. The corrected dataset reveals significant microscale surface temperature heterogeneity, with mean differences up to 3.6°C over 100-200m and extreme contrasts exceeding 17°C. Variability was strongly modulated by meteorological forcing, with daytime heatwaves showing the most heterogeneity. Land-use classes showed modest differences. The findings highlight the importance of sub-kilometer temperature variability and the potential of repurposing geophysical arrays for microclimate characterization.
本研究分析了2022年7月热浪期间部署在英国北约克郡的3000多个节点地震仪的温度数据。地震仪嵌入式微控制器传感器提供了前所未有的时空分辨率，记录了超过8000万个温度读数。使用共置气象数据进行统计校正，以补偿传感器外壳偏差。校正后的数据集显示出显著的微尺度地表温度异质性，100-200米范围内平均……

sum: This study investigates the kinematic behavior and structural segmentation of the East Anatolian Fault System (EAFS) and Sürgü-Çardak Fault (SCF) in the context of the February 6, 2023 Türkiye-Syria earthquake sequence. The authors combine a 5-year (2018–2023) Sentinel-1A SBAS-InSAR surface displacement time series with TOPEX Bouguer gravity anomaly modeling (matched filtering, vertical and tilt derivatives). Fourteen fault-perpendicular line-of-sight displacement profiles reveal marked spatial heterogeneity, distinguishing creeping segments with sharp fault-core gradients from locked segments with negligible surface contrast where the 2023 mainshocks nucleated. Subsurface density boundaries derived from shallow (≤12 km) residual gravity derivatives correlate with surface kinematic transitions, supporting a revised segmentation model dividing the EAFS into five mechanically distinct segments. The novelty lies in physically linking multi-year InSAR interseismic kinematics with gravity-inferred subsurface structural boundaries in a region with sparse GNSS coverage.
本研究针对2023年土叙地震序列，结合2018–2023年Sentinel-1A数据的SBAS-InSAR地表形变时间序列与TOPEX布格重力异常（匹配滤波、垂向和倾斜导数），分析了东安纳托利亚断裂系（EAFS）及Sürgü-Çardak断裂（SCF）的运动学与构造分段。14条跨断层视线向位移剖面揭……

t: The authors integrate 5-year SBAS-InSAR surface deformation time series (processed with GMTSAR) with matched-filtered Bouguer gravity anomalies and their vertical and tilt derivatives to map fault kinematics and subsurface structural boundaries.
结合5年SBAS-InSAR形变时间序列与匹配滤波后的布格重力异常垂向和倾斜导数，划分断层运动学与地下边界。

267 Sentinel-1A descending SAR images (path 21, 1,390 interferograms) from January 2018 to January 2023, 1-arc-minute TOPEX free-air gravity and topography grids, plus USGS and GCMT earthquake catalogs.
2018至2023年267景Sentinel-1A降轨影像（1390幅干涉图）、1弧分TOPEX重力与地形数据及USGS…

Fourteen fault-perpendicular InSAR profiles and shallow (≤12 km) gravity derivatives divide the EAFS into five mechanically distinct segments, showing negligible pre-seismic surface displacement contrast across the locked 2023 Mw 7.8 and 7.7 epicentral zones.
14条InSAR剖面与浅部（≤12 km）重力导数将EAFS分为五个构造段，2023年主震震中区表现为闭锁特征。
The analysis lacks GNSS calibration data, omits dynamic rupture modeling, and relies on gravity data with ~10 km resolution that cannot independently resolve fine-scale fault features.
未结合GNSS数据校准，缺乏动力学破裂模拟，且重力分辨率（约10 km）难以独立分辨精细结构。
Links multi-year pre-seismic InSAR deformation profiles directly with gravity-derived subsurface density gradients to establish a physically grounded five-segment model of the EAFS.
将多年震前InSAR地表形变剖面与重力地下密度梯度直接结合，建立物理约束的EAFS五分段模型。

Extracted 14 fault-perpendicular displacement profiles that distinguish localized creep, distributed damage-zone deformation, and locked fault patches.
Separated shallow (≤12 km) and deep Bouguer gravity anomalies via matched filtering and mapped subsurface fault boundaries using vertical and tilt derivatives.
Proposed a revised five-segment structural model for the EAFS grounded in both surface kinematics and subsurface density contrasts.
利用Sentinel-1A数据生成了EAFS和SCF沿线五年（2018–2023年）震前SBAS-InSAR视线向形变时间序列。
提取了14条垂直于断层的位移剖面，区分了局部蠕滑、分布式损伤带形变和断层闭锁区。
通过匹配滤波分离了浅部（≤12 km）和深部布格重力异常，并利用垂向和倾斜导数绘制了地下断层边界。
基于地表运动学和地下密度对比，提出了EAFS修正的五分段构造模型。
me: Small Baseline Subset InSAR (SBAS-InSAR) processing via GMTSAR with SRTM DEM topographic correction, SNAPHU unwrapping, and Gaussian temporal filtering.
Radially averaged power spectrum analysis and matched filtering (85 km cutoff wavelength) of Bouguer gravity anomalies to isolate shallow (≤12 km) crustal structures.
Vertical derivative (Vzz) and tilt derivative (Tres) filtering of residual gravity anomalies to delineate buried geological contacts and fault boundaries.
Dual-temporal seismicity and focal mechanism comparison (pre-2023 vs. February–August 2023) using GCMT and USGS catalogs.

Lacks dynamic rupture modeling or formal geodetic slip-rate/locking-depth inversion, restricting quantitative insights into time-dependent fault coupling.

sum: This study establishes a causal link between seamount subduction and giant gold mineralization. By analyzing gold contents in mafic rocks of varying metamorphic grades from accretionary complexes, the authors show that plume-modified samples have higher gold contents, which decrease during metamorphism. They propose a three-step genetic model: first, a mantle plume enriches seamounts with gold; second, subduction of these seamounts releases and stores gold at the base of the overriding plate; third, magmatic flare-ups and fluid activity transport the gold to the shallow crust. This model successfully explains the global correlation between gold deposits and subducted seamounts over the past 600 million years, providing a novel geodynamic framework for ore deposit exploration.
本研究确立了海山俯冲与巨型金矿成矿之间的因果联系。通过分析增生杂岩中不同变质程度基性岩的金含量，研究发现受地幔柱改造的样品金含量更高，且金含量在变质作用过程中降低。据此，研究提出一个三阶段成矿模型：地幔柱将深部地幔的金注入海山；海山链俯冲将金释放并储存在上覆板块底部；岩浆大爆发期间的流体活动将金运移……

sum: Why subducted slabs stagnate in the mantle transition zone (MTZ) remains debated because the anhydrous post-spinel Clapeyron slope is too gentle to generate sufficient buoyancy. Using 65,655 P-wave receiver functions from 1,339 broadband seismic stations across China and 3-D dynamic ray-tracing migration corrected by tomographic models, the authors image MTZ discontinuities across stagnant Pacific and Mesozoic slabs. They discover two key features: (1) an excess depression (~10–15 km below the anhydrous Clapeyron limit) of the 660-km discontinuity at the slab front and stagnation center, attributed to ~0.7–2.0 wt% water in ringwoodite, and (2) a localized 400-km-wide double discontinuity at ~695 km depth matching the akimotoite-to-bridgmanite transition in a cold (~1000 K) dry basaltic assemblage (basalt fraction 0.6–0.9). Mineral physics modeling via Perple_X demonstrates that water-induced excess depression increases the positive-to-negative buoyancy ratio from ~27.5% to ~97.5%, predominantly initiating and sustaining long-term slab stagnation.
针对俯冲板片在地幔转换带滞留的动力学机制，本文利用中国及邻区1339个宽频带台站的65655条远震P波接收函数，结合三维射线追踪偏移和层析成像速度校正，对东北亚滞留板片进行了高分辨率成像。研究发现了两个关键特征：一是在滞留中心和太平洋板片前缘，660公里间断面比无水后尖晶石相变克拉伯龙斜率极限额外下……

t: P-wave receiver functions are migrated into a 3-D volume via dynamic ray tracing without a plane-wave assumption, corrected for 3-D velocity anomalies using tomographic models, and interpreted alongside Perple_X thermodynamic mineral physics modeling.
采用无平面波假设的三维动态射线追踪对P波接收函数进行空间偏移与三维层析速度校正，并结合Perple_X热力学矿物物理模拟…

The dataset comprises 65,655 high-quality teleseismic P-wave receiver functions (M > 5.0, 30°–90° epicentral distance) collected from 1,339 permanent and temporary broadband seismic stations across China and adjacent regions.
收集了中国及邻区1339个固定和流动宽频带台站记录的65655条高质量远震P波接收函数数据。

A 400-km-wide double discontinuity at ~670 and ~695 km indicates a 1000 K dry basaltic assemblage (f = 0.6–0.9), while ~10–15 km excess depressions of the 660-km boundary raise the slab buoyancy ratio from 27.5% to 97.5%.
发现670和695公里双震相（对应1000 K下0.6-0.9比例玄武岩），且660界面10-15公里超额下凹使正负浮力…

Full-waveform tomography models that include converted phases (like FWEA23) can map boundary depression delay times into velocity anomalies, leading to over-correction and shallower imaged discontinuities.
包含转换波的全波形层析模型（如FWEA23）可能将界面下凹走时异常映射为速度扰动，导致过度校正。

Demonstrates that slab stagnation is primarily sustained by water-induced excess depression of the 660-km discontinuity and aided locally by dry basaltic assemblages, resolving the gentle anhydrous post-spinel Clapeyron slope paradox.
揭示含水引起的660公里界面超额下凹与局部干玄武岩组合共同提供浮力以维持板片滞留，解决了无水相变斜率过缓的悖论。

kc: Imaged a localized 400-km-wide double seismic discontinuity at ~670 km and ~695 km near the center of the slab stagnation zone beneath East Asia.
Constrained basalt fraction (f = 0.6–0.9) and cold slab adiabatic temperature (~1000 K) from receiver function amplitude ratios of the akimotoite-to-bridgmanite and post-spinel transitions.
Identified ~10–15 km excess depressions of the 660-km discontinuity beyond the anhydrous Clapeyron limit, estimating ~0.7–2.0 wt% water near the base of the MTZ.

Demonstrated via thermodynamic modeling that water-induced excess depressions boost the positive-to-negative buoyancy ratio from ~27.5% to ~97.5%, sustaining slab stagnation without a widespread garnetite layer.
在东亚板片滞留区中心底部成像了约670公里和695公里深处、宽约400公里的局部双震相间断面。
利用秋本石-布里奇曼石相变与后尖晶石相变的接收函数振幅比，约束了局部玄武岩组分比例（0.6–0.9）和冷板片绝热温度（~1000 K）。
识别出660公里间断面超越无水克拉伯龙极限约10–15公里的超额下凹，推断地幔转换带底部含水量约为0.7–2.0 wt%。
通过热力学模拟证明含水超额下凹将板片正负浮力比从27.5%提升至97.5%，在无需广泛石榴石岩层的情况下维持了板片长期滞留。
me: Time-domain iterative deconvolution with Gaussian filter factor 2.0 to compute P-wave receiver functions from teleseismic waveforms.
3-D time-to-space receiver function migration using dynamic ray tracing in AK135 without plane-wave assumption.
3-D travel-time heterogeneity corrections tested across three independent tomographic models (TX2019slab, FWEA23, UU-P07).
Thermodynamic mineral physics modeling using Perple_X and Stixrude & Lithgow-Bertelloni database to compute phase equilibria, seismic velocities, density contrasts, and RF amplitude ratios.
采用高斯滤波因子为2.0的时间域迭代反褶积方法从远震波形计算P波接收函数。

Three 3-D mantle velocity models (TX2019slab, UU-P07, FWEA23) used for 3-D ray-path velocity corrections.
来自中国及邻区1339个宽频带地震台站（CDSN、ChinArray、NECsaids、NECESSArray、NETS）的65655条高质量远震P波接收函数（震级>5.0，震中距30°–90°）。

Full-waveform model FWEA23 may over-correct and artificially shallow phase '4' because delay-time anomalies from boundary depression can trade off with velocity perturbations during waveform inversion.
Adiabatic thermal expansion effects from downward displacement are ignored when computing density contrasts in Figs. 5c–e.
约700公里深处的次级震相（'7'和'8'）信号过弱或处于数据覆盖边缘，无法进行可靠解释。

The study investigates the thermal, chemical, and buoyancy mechanisms sustaining slab stagnation in the mantle transition zone beneath Northeast Asia using seismic observations and mineral physics modeling.

sum: This study investigates continental-scale lateral velocity gradients and azimuthal anisotropy beneath Australia using long-period teleseismic P-wave polarization anomalies from permanent and temporary seismic stations. Applying hierarchical Bayesian inference to back-azimuth-dependent polarization anomalies, the authors separate the 1φ (lateral heterogeneity) and 2φ (azimuthal anisotropy) harmonic terms while mitigating biases from uneven earthquake distributions. The inferred positive P-wave velocity gradients along continental margins generally point seaward, correlating with crustal thinning (Moho topography), whereas inland variations reflect complex Moho and lithosphere-asthenosphere boundary (LAB) topography. Fast-axis directions show distinct tectonic province dependencies: eastern Phanerozoic Australia and the southern North Australian Craton align with absolute plate motion, indicating present-day asthenospheric flow, whereas cratonic interiors reflect frozen lithospheric anisotropy from ancient tectonic processes. This work demonstrates the utility of P-wave polarization anomalies as an independent, complementary dataset to XKS splitting and surface-wave tomography.
本研究利用澳大利亚固定和流动台站记录的长周期远震P波极化异常，探讨了大陆尺度的横向速度梯度和方位各向异性。通过分层贝叶斯推断对随反方位角变化的极化异常进行谐波分析，有效分离了1φ（横向非均匀性）和2φ（方位各向异性）项，并量化了不确定性。结果显示，大陆边缘的正P波速度梯度多指向海洋，与地壳减薄一致；……

t: Binned P-wave polarization anomalies are modeled using a harmonic expansion with 1φ and 2φ back-azimuthal terms. Hierarchical Bayesian inference via PyMC estimates posterior distributions for lateral velocity gradient and fast-axis directions, weighted by bin-dependent standard errors.
对分箱后的P波极化异常进行1φ和2φ谐波展开，利用PyMC开展分层贝叶斯反演，估计横向速度梯度和快轴方向的后验分布。

Long-period teleseismic P-wave polarization anomalies across permanent and temporary Australian stations from Tarumi and Yoshizawa (2025c), corrected for station misorientation, filtered for ≥30 measurements per station, and binned into 20° back-azimuth intervals.
采用澳大利亚固定和流动台站的长周期远震P波极化异常数据，经台站方位校正，保留≥30条记录的台站并按20°反方位角分箱。

Directional uncertainties (IQR) are generally <20°. Positive velocity gradients point seaward along western and southern margins (crustal thinning). Fast-axis orientations align with NNE plate motion in eastern Phanerozoic Australia and southern NAC, but deviate across cratonic interiors.
方向四分位距不确定性多小于20°；大陆边缘速度梯度指向海侧；东澳大利亚快轴与板块运动一致，克拉通内部则发生偏离。

Teleseismic P-wave polarization anomalies have limited vertical resolution, yielding path-integrated constraints, and uneven earthquake back-azimuthal coverage causes larger uncertainties for southeastern to western back-azimuths (140° < φ < 280°).
远震P波极化异常垂向分辨率有限，仅提供路径积分约束；且东南至西侧反方位角事件稀少导致误差较大。

First continental-scale mapping of P-wave lateral velocity gradients and azimuthal anisotropy beneath Australia from teleseismic P-wave polarization anomalies using hierarchical Bayesian harmonic inference.
首次结合贝叶斯谐波推断与远震P波极化异常，在大陆尺度绘制了澳大利亚P波横向速度梯度与方位各向异性。

kc: First continental-scale mapping of both P-wave lateral velocity gradients and azimuthal anisotropy across Australia using teleseismic P-wave polarization anomalies.
Implementation of hierarchical Bayesian inference in harmonic analysis to account for uneven back-azimuthal event coverage and rigorously quantify parameter uncertainties.
Identification of seaward positive velocity gradients along continental margins linked to crustal thinning, contrasted with localized LAB-induced gradients.
Distinction between asthenospheric mantle flow-driven anisotropy in thin-lithosphere regions (eastern Australia, southern NAC) and frozen lithospheric anisotropy in thick cratons.
首次利用远震P波极化异常在大陆尺度上绘制了澳大利亚下方的P波横向速度梯度与方位各向异性分布。
在谐波分析中引入分层贝叶斯推断，以克服事件反方位角分布不均带来的偏差并严格量化参数不确定性。
识别出大陆边缘与地壳减薄相关的向海正速度梯度，以及受局部LAB地形控制的梯度异常。
区分了薄岩石圈区域（东澳大利亚、北澳大利亚克拉通南部）受软流圈地幔流控制的各向异性与厚克拉通内部的岩石圈冻结各向异性。
me: Pre-processing and 20-degree back-azimuthal binning of station-orientation-corrected teleseismic P-wave arrival angle anomalies.
Harmonic expansion modeling of back-azimuthal polarization variations into 1φ (cos φ, sin φ) and 2φ (cos 2φ, sin 2φ) sinusoidal terms.
Hierarchical Bayesian inversion using PyMC with bin-dependent standard error weighting to estimate posterior probability distributions of heterogeneity and anisotropy parameters.
对经过台站方位校正的远震P波到角异常进行预处理及20度反方位角分箱统计。
利用包含1φ（横向非均匀性）和2φ（方位各向异性）正余弦项的谐波展开模型拟合极化角随反方位角的变化。
使用PyMC框架进行分层贝叶斯反演，结合分箱标准误差加权，估计非均匀性和各向异性参数的后验概率分布。
de: Long-period teleseismic P-wave polarization anomaly measurements across permanent and temporary broadband stations in Australia from Tarumi and Yoshizawa (2025c).
Filtering criteria discarding stations with fewer than 30 measurements or posterior directional interquartile ranges (IQR) exceeding 40 degrees.
Comparative analysis against the AusMoho model, LAB depth models, absolute plate motion (APM) vectors, XKS splitting datasets, and surface-wave azimuthal anisotropy models.
采用Tarumi and Yoshizawa (2025c) 测量的澳大利亚固定和流动宽频带台站长周期远震P波极化异常数据集。
质量控制剔除了测量数据少于30条或后验方向四分位距（IQR）大于40度的台站。
将反演结果与AusMoho地壳模型、LAB深度模型、板块绝对运动（APM）方向、XKS分裂数据及面波方位各向异性模型进行对比。
li: Teleseismic P-wave polarization anomalies have limited vertical resolution, providing only path-integrated constraints down to ~250 km depth.
Uneven azimuthal distribution of teleseismic events (concentrated to the north, northwest, and east) results in larger data uncertainties for southeastern to western back-azimuths.
Temporary seismic stations have significantly fewer measurements than permanent stations, occasionally causing divergent gradient vectors between nearby stations.
远震P波极化异常的垂向分辨率有限，仅能提供地表至约250公里深度的路径积分约束。
远震事件反方位角分布不均（集中于北、西北和东侧），导致东南至西向反方位角区间的数据不确定性较大。
流动台站的观测数量明显少于固定台站，可能导致邻近台站间反演出的梯度方向存在显著差异。

tm.why: The paper directly estimates and maps azimuthal anisotropy fast-axis directions beneath Australia from teleseismic P-wave polarization anomalies.

The inferred velocity gradients and anisotropic patterns are interpreted in terms of crustal thinning, LAB topography, frozen lithospheric fabrics, and asthenospheric mantle flow across Australian tectonic provinces.
The authors apply hierarchical Bayesian inference via PyMC to solve the harmonic expansion equations and quantify directional uncertainties using interquartile ranges.

ev.notes: Full preprint PDF (29 pages including supplementary material) was analyzed in detail, including equations, Bayesian methodology, station examples, continental maps, and supplementary figures.

sum: This study investigates crustal seismic anisotropy across the Bhutan Himalaya using local earthquakes recorded by 44 broadband stations of the GANSSER network (2013–2014). Applying the Multiple Filter Automatic Splitting Technique (MFAST) and visual quality checks within the shear-wave window, the authors obtain 1527 high-quality splitting measurements from 353 crustal events. Delay times range from 0.02 to 0.7 s, with anisotropy increasing with depth from ~3% in the upper crust (0–20 km) to ~5% in the mid-crust (20–35 km) and >8% below 35 km. Upper-crustal fast polarization directions generally align with maximum horizontal compressive stress, contrasting with upper-mantle SKS trends. The results highlight strong along-strike heterogeneity over ~90 km: western Bhutan shows strong mid-crustal anisotropy linked to a ramp-flat Main Himalayan Thrust (MHT) and thicker crust, whereas eastern Bhutan exhibits depth-segregated deformation along a smoother MHT, reflecting uneven Indian plate underthrusting.
本研究利用GANSSER台网44个宽频带台站记录的近震波形，通过多滤波器自动分裂技术（MFAST）获取了不丹喜马拉雅地区1527个高质量横波分裂测量结果。分析表明，延迟时间随深度增加，地壳各向异性从上地壳（0-20 km）的约3%增至中地壳（20-35 km）的约5%及35 km以下的8%以上。上地……

t: The authors applied the Multiple Filter Automatic Splitting Technique (MFAST v2.0), which uses bandpass filter grid searches, Silver-Chan eigenvalue minimization, and cluster analysis, followed by shear-wave window filtering and visual checks.
采用MFAST v2.0软件包进行带通滤波网格搜索、特征值最小化与聚类分析，并结合横波窗口筛选和人工核查。

Local earthquake waveforms recorded by 44 three-component broadband stations of the GANSSER network in Bhutan (2013–2014), examining 9405 event-station pairs from 353 crustal events (Mw >= 2.5) to select 1527 SWW-qualified pairs.
使用不丹GANSSER台网44个宽频带台站记录的353个近震（Mw>=2.5），筛选出1527个横波窗口内的高质量分裂对…

Delay times span 0.02–0.7 s, with crustal anisotropy increasing from ~3% (0–20 km) to ~5% (20–35 km) and >8% (>35 km). Mid-crustal western Bhutan is more anisotropic (δt 0.1–0.3 s) than eastern Bhutan (0.02–0.2 s).
延迟时间介于0.02-0.7 s，各向异性从0-20 km的~3%增至20-35 km的~5%及35 km以下的>8%；…

Assuming a uniform Vs per depth interval ignores lateral velocity heterogeneity across Bhutan, and earthquake epicenters are unevenly distributed between eastern (mostly upper-crustal) and western (mostly mid-crustal) regions.
各深度层采用均匀横波速度假设忽略了横向速度变化，且东西部不同深度的震源分布不均匀。

Provides the first detailed 3D crustal shear-wave splitting mapping across the Bhutan Himalaya, linking rapid along-strike anisotropic variations (~90 km) to MHT geometry and uneven Indian slab subduction.
首次系统揭示不丹地壳三维横波分裂特征，将约90 km内的横向各向异性突变与MHT几何及板块不均匀俯冲相联系。

kc: Obtained over 1500 high-quality crustal shear-wave splitting measurements across the Bhutan Himalaya using the GANSSER seismic network.
Demonstrated depth-dependent crustal anisotropy increasing from ~3% in the upper crust (0–20 km) to ~5% in the mid-crust (20–35 km) and >8% below 35 km.
Revealed distinct along-strike variations between western Bhutan (thick crust, mid-crustal shear along a ramp-flat MHT) and eastern Bhutan (smoothly dipping MHT with bimodal depth seismicity).
利用GANSSER地震台网获取了不丹喜马拉雅地区超过1500个高质量地壳近震横波分裂测量数据。
证实了地壳各向异性随深度增加：上地壳（0-20 km）约为3%，中地壳（20-35 km）约为5%，35 km以下超过8%。
揭示了不丹西部（加厚地壳、沿断坪-断坡式MHT的中地壳剪切）与东部（平缓倾滑MHT及双深度簇地震活动）之间显著的沿走向差异。
me: Automated shear-wave splitting analysis using Multiple Filter Automatic Splitting Technique (MFAST v2.0) combining bandpass filtering, eigenvalue minimization, and cluster analysis.
Shear-wave window (SWW) incidence angle filtering and manual visual quality verification of waveforms and particle motions.
Depth-interval classification (upper, mid, and lower crust) and percentage anisotropy computation along western (A1–A2) and eastern (B1–B2) profiles.
采用多滤波器自动分裂技术（MFAST v2.0），结合带通滤波网格搜索、特征值最小化与聚类分析进行横波分裂测量。
基于横波窗口（SWW）入射角筛选及波形与质点运动的人工视觉质量核查。
按震源深度区间（上、中、下地壳）以及东西部两条南北向剖面（A1-A2与B1-B2）统计各向异性百分比与快波方向分布。
de: Three-component local earthquake waveforms from 44 broadband stations of the temporary GANSSER network in Bhutan (January 2013 to December 2014).
9405 earthquake-station pairs from 353 local crustal earthquakes (Mw >= 2.5), yielding 1527 qualified splitting measurements within the shear-wave window.
2013年1月至2014年12月部署在不丹的GANSSER临时台网44个三分量宽频带台站记录的近震波形数据。
来自353个地方地壳地震（Mw >= 2.5）的9405个事件-台站对，经横波窗口筛选出1527个合格分裂测量值。
li: Assumes a uniform average shear-wave velocity (Vs) within each depth layer when computing anisotropy percentage, neglecting 5–10% lateral velocity heterogeneity.
Uneven spatial distribution of hypocenters: upper-crustal events concentrate in eastern Bhutan, mid-crustal events in western Bhutan, and lower-crustal events (>35 km) are sparse (34 events).
计算各向异性百分比时在各深度层假设了均匀的平均横波速度（Vs），忽略了约5-10%的横向速度不均匀性。
震源空间分布不均：上地壳地震集中于东部，中地壳地震集中于西部，而下地壳（>35 km）地震稀少（仅34个事件）。

tm.why: The core of the study is determining fast polarization direction and delay time of shear-wave splitting from local crustal earthquakes to constrain crustal seismic anisotropy.
The paper links along-strike variations in crustal anisotropy to Main Himalayan Thrust geometry, crustal thickness, and Indian plate subduction dynamics beneath Bhutan.

ev.notes: Full 12-page PDF analyzed, including text, equations, and all 8 figures.

sum: Assessing seismic hazard in mature seismic gaps becomes challenging when anthropogenic stresses from massive reservoir impoundment overlap with tectonic loading. Using 200 days of continuous waveforms from 211 dense-array seismometers deployed during the peak impoundment of the Baihetan Reservoir over the Qiaojia-Dongchuan seismic gap, the authors construct a 5,219-event catalog via an ensemble deep-learning workflow (PhaseNet, EQTransformer, TranSeis), GAMMA, and HypoDD. Combining spatiotemporal b-value analysis with GNSS-constrained viscoelastic Coulomb Failure Stress (CFS) rate modeling, they uncover a vertical decoupling mechanism. Shallow seismicity (<15 km) shows high b-values (>1.0) and temporal alignment with water-level changes, indicating fluid-driven reservoir-triggered seismicity. Conversely, deep seismicity (15–20 km) outlines a locked asperity with low b-values (<0.8) and high CFS accumulation rates (7–10 kPa/yr, ~3 MPa since 1733), connected by a 50°–60° dipping structure. This demonstrates that shallow induced microseismicity can mask silent deep tectonic strain accumulation.
本研究利用白鹤滩水库蓄水高峰期在巧家-东川地震空区布设的211台密集台阵200天连续波形，结合集成深度学习流程（PhaseNet、EQTransformer、TranSeis）、GAMMA和HypoDD构建了包含5219个事件的高精度微震目录。综合b值时空分析与GNSS约束的粘弹性库仑破裂应力（CF……

t: An ensemble deep-learning workflow (PhaseNet, EQTransformer, TranSeis) picks phases, followed by GAMMA association and Hypoinverse/HypoDD relocations, integrated with ZMAP b-value analysis and GNSS-constrained Maxwell viscoelastic Coulomb stress rate modeling.
集成PhaseNet、EQTransformer与TranSeis拾取震相，结合GAMMA关联、HypoDD重定位、ZM…

200 continuous days of 100 Hz three-component waveforms recorded by 10 broadband and 201 short-period seismometers (~5 km spacing) in the Qiaojia-Dongchuan region from August 25, 2022 to March 13, 2023, plus regional GNSS velocities.
2022年8月至2023年3月巧家-东川地区10台宽频带和201台短周期地震仪记录的200天连续波形及区域GNSS速度场…

Detected 5,219 events (Mc 1.29, overall b-value 0.86±0.01), revealing shallow reservoir-triggered swarms (b > 1.0), a 50°–60° dipping structure (10–16 km), and a deep locked asperity (15–20 km, b < 0.8) with CFS rates of 7–10 kPa/yr.
检出5219个地震（Mc 1.29），揭示浅部水库触发震群（b>1.0）、10–16 km倾斜构造及深部高CFS率（7–…

Short catalog duration introduces statistical uncertainty in monthly b-value time series when subsets drop below 50–100 events, and formal r ~ sqrt(t) pore-pressure diffusion verification remains unperformed.
200天观测期使月度b值子样本偏小存在统计波动，且尚未开展r~sqrt(t)孔隙压力扩散定量验证。

First observation of vertical decoupling between shallow reservoir-triggered seismicity and deep tectonic locking in a mature seismic gap during peak impoundment of the world's second-largest hydropower station.
首次揭示特大水库蓄水期成熟地震空区内浅部水库触发地震与深部构造闭锁共存的垂向解耦机制。

kc: Constructed a high-resolution catalog of 5,219 seismic events (Mc 1.29) in the Qiaojia-Dongchuan seismic gap during Baihetan Reservoir impoundment, nearly 10 times the standard catalog.
Revealed a vertical decoupling mechanism between shallow fluid-driven reservoir-triggered seismicity (b > 1.0) and a deep locked tectonic asperity at 12–20 km depth (b < 0.8).
Imaged a previously unrecognized 50°–60° dipping fault structure at 10–16 km depth, indicating compound strike-slip and reverse-slip kinematics.
Quantified Coulomb failure stress accumulation rates of 7–10 kPa/yr (~3 MPa accumulated since 1733), showing the seismic gap is in a critical stress state.
构建了白鹤滩水库蓄水期巧家-东川地震空区包含5219个事件的高精度微震目录（完备震级1.29），数量接近标准目录的10倍。
揭示了浅部流体驱动的水库触发地震（b > 1.0）与深部12–20 km构造闭锁凹凸体（b < 0.8）之间的垂向解耦机制。
发现了10–16 km深度处此前未知的50°–60°倾斜断层结构，表明存在走滑与逆冲复合运动学特征。
量化了巧家-东川段7–10 kPa/yr的库仑破裂应力积累率（自1733年以来积累约3 MPa），表明该地震空区处于临界应力状态。
me: Ensemble deep-learning phase picking combining PhaseNet, EQTransformer, and TranSeis to maximize recall and precision without local retraining.
Bayesian Gaussian Mixture Model (GAMMA) for phase association, followed by Hypoinverse absolute location and HypoDD relative relocation in a 3D velocity model.
Spatiotemporal frequency-magnitude distribution (Mc and b-value) analysis using the Maximum Curvature method and bootstrap uncertainty estimation in ZMAP.
Layered Maxwell viscoelastic modeling constrained by GNSS velocity vectors to compute annual Coulomb Failure Stress (CFS) rates and rate-and-state triggering probabilities.
集成PhaseNet、EQTransformer和TranSeis三种深度学习模型进行震相拾取，无需重新训练即可兼顾高召回率与高精度。
使用贝叶斯高斯混合模型（GAMMA）进行震相关联，并在三维速度模型中通过Hypoinverse和HypoDD进行绝对与相对定位。
利用ZMAP中的最大曲率法和自助法（bootstrap）评估完备震级Mc和b值的时空演化及不确定性。
基于GNSS速度场约束的分层Maxwell粘弹性模型计算年均库仑破裂应力（CFS）积累率，并结合速率-状态摩擦模型估算触发概率。
de: 200 days of continuous 3-component waveforms (100 Hz) from 10 broadband and 201 short-period stations (~5 km minimum spacing) from August 25, 2022 to March 13, 2023.
Standard earthquake catalog (1970–2023) from the China Earthquake Networks Center for baseline comparison.
Water-level records at Menggu and Qiaojia Laodian wharfs during the peak impoundment of the Baihetan Reservoir.
Regional GNSS horizontal velocity vectors, dilatation rates, and 3D community velocity model V2.0 of southwest China.
2022年8月25日至2023年3月13日期间10台宽频带和201台短周期地震仪（最小台间距约5 km）记录的200天100 Hz连续三分量波形。
中国地震台网中心1970–2023年标准地震目录，用于基线对比。
白鹤滩水库蓄水高峰期蒙古码头和巧家老店码头的水位变化记录。
区域GNSS水平速度矢量、面膨胀率数据以及川滇地区高精度三维公共速度模型V2.0。
li: Formal pore-pressure diffusion verification via r ~ sqrt(t) migration analysis has not yet been performed for the Baihetan dataset.
Short 200-day observation window causes small sample sizes (sometimes <50–100 events) in monthly temporal b-value subsets, introducing statistical uncertainty.
Pore pressure in the CFS calculation relies on a simplified exponential decay model with a 5 km decay radius from the Menggu well.
Lack of dedicated high-resolution local seismic tomography to confirm whether the deep seismic asperity corresponds to a high-velocity block.
尚未对白鹤滩数据集开展r ~ sqrt(t)流体扩散迁移的正式定量验证。
200天的较短观测期导致月度b值时间序列子样本量偏小（有时低于50–100个事件），带来统计不确定性。
CFS计算中的孔隙压力采用了以蒙古井为中心、衰减半径5 km的简化指数衰减模型。
缺乏专门的高分辨率局地层析成像来证实深部凹凸体是否对应高速异常块体。

tm.why: The paper investigates reservoir-triggered seismicity from the Baihetan Hydropower Station superimposed on a tectonically locked seismic gap.
The authors build a high-resolution catalog of 5,219 microseismic events using an ensemble deep-learning workflow, GAMMA association, and HypoDD relocation.
The study analyzes fault locking, deep asperities, compound dipping fault kinematics, b-value variations, and Coulomb failure stress accumulation.

ev.notes: Full 40-page manuscript PDF (including text, 7 figures, and references) was analyzed in detail.

sum: This paper presents a fault-wide paleoseismic reconstruction of the Eskişehir Fault in northwestern Central Anatolia, Türkiye. By analyzing geological and paleoseismic evidence, the authors identify a mature, late-cycle seismic gap along this fault system. They evaluate the rupture potential and seismic hazard associated with this structure, providing critical constraints on future earthquake scenarios in this active tectonic region.
本文对土耳其安纳托利亚中部西北部的埃斯基谢希尔断裂带进行了全断裂古地震重建。通过分析古地震证据，研究人员在该断裂带上确定了一个处于地震周期晚期的成熟地震空区。他们评估了该结构的破裂潜力和地震危险性，为该活跃构造区未来的地震情景提供了关键约束。

t: Paleoseismic trenching, geological mapping, and empirical scaling relations to reconstruct fault rupture history.
利用古地震探槽、地质填图和经验标度关系重建断层破裂历史。
Geological trench observations, geochronological dating samples, and historical earthquake catalogs for the Eskişehir Fault.
埃斯基谢希尔断裂带的地质探槽观测、年代学测年样品和历史地震目录。
Identification of a late-cycle seismic gap on the Eskişehir Fault with high potential for a major future earthquake.
确定了埃斯基谢希尔断裂带上一个处于周期晚期的地震空区，具有发生未来大地震的高潜力。
Dating resolution limits and spatial coverage of paleoseismic trenches along the entire fault length.
古地震探槽在整条断层长度上的测年分辨率限制和空间覆盖范围。
First fault-wide paleoseismic reconstruction identifying a mature seismic gap on this specific Anatolian fault system.
首次对该特定安纳托利亚断裂系统进行全断裂古地震重建，并确定了一个成熟的地震空区。

kc: Reconstructed the paleoseismic history and earthquake recurrence intervals along the Eskişehir Fault.
Identified a mature (late-cycle) seismic gap with significant potential for a future large earthquake.
Assessed the rupture potential and seismic hazard for northwestern Central Anatolia.
重建了埃斯基谢希尔断裂带的古地震历史和地震复发间隔。

sum: This study develops a geospatial site amplification model for the Basin and Range Province of the western United States using 16,852 recordings from 433 stations in the NGA-West3 database. The base model uses mapped geospatial variables (sediment thickness, elevation, surficial geology) in a linear mixed-effects regression to predict site amplification residuals from the BSSA14 ground-motion model. This base model achieves an average 8.5% reduction in site-to-site variability. The model is further enhanced with local geotechnical data, including microtremor horizontal-to-vertical spectral ratio (mHVSR) and measured VS30 data, yielding additional variability reductions. This framework demonstrates how combining regional geospatial data with sparse site-specific geotechnical measurements can effectively characterize site amplification and uncertainty in data-sparse regions.
本研究利用NGA-West3数据库中433个台站的1.6万余条记录，为美西盆地与山脉区构建了空间场地放大模型。该模型利用沉积厚度、海拔和地表地质等空间变量进行线性混合效应回归，使场地间变率平均降低8.5%。进一步结合微震动H/V谱比和实测VS30数据进行局部调整，显著提升了预测精度。该方法为数据稀疏……

sum: floatCSEP is a Python-based software package developed to facilitate reproducible prospective earthquake forecasting experiments. As part of the Collaboratory for the Study of Earthquake Predictability (CSEP), floatCSEP automates the workflow of retrieving earthquake catalogs, running forecasting models (such as ETAS), and performing statistical evaluations (e.g., N-test, S-test). It provides a standardized, containerized, or local environment to ensure that forecasting experiments are fully reproducible, transparent, and easily deployable by the seismological community.
floatCSEP是一个基于Python的软件工具，旨在促进可重复的前瞻性地震预测实验。作为地震预测能力研究合作计划（CSEP）的一部分，floatCSEP实现了获取地震目录、运行预测模型（如ETAS）以及进行统计评估（如N检验、S检验）等工作流程的自动化。它提供了一个标准化的、容器化或本地的运行环……

sum: This study evaluates two real-time earthquake location algorithms, RTLoc and MParLoc, implemented within the QuakeUp Earthquake Early Warning System (EEWS) for the Ibero-Maghrebian Region (IMR). While RTLoc relies on absolute P-wave arrival times and non-triggered station constraints via the Equal Differential Time formulation, MParLoc uses an evolutionary Bayesian framework combining differential P-wave arrival times, P-peak amplitude ratios, and back-azimuth estimates. Using three-component broadband velocity waveforms from 30 Mw ≥ 4.0 earthquakes (2011–2026), including the 2016 Alboran Sea sequence, the authors calibrated an IMR-specific P-wave amplitude attenuation law and ran playback simulations. Results show MParLoc outperforms RTLoc in 77% of events at the first alert time (5 triggered stations), substantially reducing initial epicentral and depth errors. This early-stage accuracy directly improves Ground Motion Prediction Equation (GMPE) distance terms, preventing false or missed alerts in real-time Potential Damage Zone (PDZ) shakemaps.
本研究评估了QuakeUp地震预警系统中RTLoc和MParLoc两种实时定位算法在伊比利亚-马格里布地区（IMR）的表现。MParLoc采用演化贝叶斯方法，融合了P波到时差、峰值振幅比和反方位角。基于2011–2026年间30次Mw≥4.0地震（含2016年阿尔沃兰海序列）的62个宽频带台站波形数……

t: The study compares RTLoc (Equal Differential Time formulation) and MParLoc (evolutionary Bayesian combination of differential P-wave times, P-peak amplitude ratios, and back-azimuth) inside the QuakeUp EEWS software.
在QuakeUp预警软件中对比了基于等差时的RTLoc算法与融合P波到时差、振幅比和反方位角的演化贝叶斯MParLoc算…

Three-component velocity waveforms from 62 broadband stations (IGN, WM, IPMA networks) were analyzed for nine Mw ≥ 5 regional earthquakes (2011–2026) and 21 Mw ≥ 4 events from the 2016 Alboran Sea series.
使用IGN、WM和IPMA台网62个宽频带台站的三分量速度波形，分析了2011–2026年9次Mw≥5地震及2016年阿…
At TFIRST (5 stations), MParLoc outperforms RTLoc in 77% of events, reducing the 70th percentile epicentral error from 27 km to 11–13 km and depth error from 58 km to 28 km.
在TFIRST（5台站），MParLoc在77%事件中优于RTLoc，将震中误差第70百分位从27公里降至11–13公里…
The empirical Pv attenuation law assumes a 1D medium without site effects, and single-station BAZ estimates show large scatter (median error 69°, σ = 57°).
经验Pv衰减关系假设一维介质且未考虑场地效应，单台反方位角估计存在较大离散度（中位误差69°，σ=57°）。

First operational assessment of MParLoc in the Ibero-Maghrebian Region, demonstrating its impact on real-time Potential Damage Zone shakemap forecasts under sparse azimuthal coverage and offshore seismicity.
首次在台网稀疏且以近海地震为主的伊比利亚-马格里布地区评估MParLoc，揭示其对实时潜在破坏区震动图预测的改善作用。

kc: Calibrated a region-specific empirical P-wave peak velocity attenuation relationship for the Ibero-Maghrebian Region using 2,646 records from 28 earthquakes.
Demonstrated that MParLoc outperforms RTLoc in 77% of analyzed Mw ≥ 4 earthquakes at the earliest detection stage (TFIRST, 5 stations).
Quantified how early-stage hypocentral location errors propagate into GMPE-based Instrumental Intensity shakemaps and Potential Damage Zone (PDZ) delineation.
利用28次地震的2646条记录，标定了特定于伊比利亚-马格里布地区的P波峰值速度经验衰减关系。
证明在最早检测阶段（TFIRST，5个台站触发），MParLoc在77%的Mw≥4受测地震中定位表现优于RTLoc。
量化了早期震源定位误差如何传播并影响基于GMPE的仪器烈度震动图和潜在破坏区（PDZ）的划定。
me: Evolutionary Bayesian multiparameter location (MParLoc) combining conditional PDFs of differential P-wave arrival times (ΔTimes), P-peak velocity amplitude ratios (ΔAmp), and back-azimuth (BAZ).
Equal Differential Time (EDT) real-time location (RTLoc) utilizing triggered P-picks and non-triggered station constraints.
Least-squares regression to calibrate regional 2-s P-wave peak velocity (Pv) attenuation with hypocentral distance and magnitude.
Real-time playback simulation in QuakeUp generating continuous Instrumental Intensity (IMM) shakemaps and Potential Damage Zones via regional GMPEs.
演化贝叶斯多参数定位（MParLoc），融合P波到时差（ΔTimes）、P波峰值速度振幅比（ΔAmp）和反方位角（BAZ）的条件概率密度函数。
等差时（EDT）实时定位（RTLoc），综合利用已触发台站的P波拾取和未触发台站的约束。
采用最小二乘回归标定区域2秒P波峰值速度（Pv）随震源距和震级的衰减关系。
在QuakeUp中进行实时回放模拟，结合区域GMPE生成连续仪器烈度（IMM）震动图和潜在破坏区。
de: Playback dataset of 30 earthquakes (Mw ≥ 4.0) in the Ibero-Maghrebian Region between 2011 and 2026: 9 events with Mw ≥ 5.0 and 21 events (mainshock Mw 6.4, foreshock, 19 aftershocks) from the 2016 Alboran Sea series.
Three-component broadband velocity waveforms from 62 stations across the IGN, WM, and IPMA networks within 400 km of the first detecting station.
Calibration dataset of 2,646 three-component velocity records from 28 earthquakes (4.0 ≤ Mw ≤ 6.8, 2000–2024) at hypocentral distances of 40–700 km.
2011至2026年间伊比利亚-马格里布地区30次Mw≥4.0地震的回放数据集：包括9次Mw≥5.0事件以及2016年阿尔沃兰海序列的21次事件（Mw 6.4主震、前震及19次余震）。
来自IGN、WM和IPMA台网62个宽频带台站的三分量速度波形（限制在首个触发台站400公里范围内）。
用于标定经验关系的2000–2024年间28次地震（4.0 ≤ Mw ≤ 6.8，震源距40–700公里）的2646条三分量速度记录。
li: The empirical P-wave peak amplitude attenuation relationship assumes a 1D attenuation medium, leaving local site effects and small-scale heterogeneities unmodeled (σ = 0.43).
Back-azimuth estimates exhibit high uncertainty (median error of 69°, σ = 57°) and require event-specific bandpass filtering around the source corner frequency.
The advantage of incorporating ΔAmp and BAZ diminishes at later stages (TLAST) once a large number of P-wave picks already tightly constrain the hypocenter.
经验P波峰值振幅衰减关系假设了一维衰减介质，未建模局部场地效应和小尺度非均匀性（标准差σ = 0.43）。
反方位角估计具有较高的不确定性（中位误差69°，σ = 57°），且需要围绕震源拐角频率进行特定事件的带通滤波。
在后期阶段（TLAST），当大量P波拾取已经对震源形成强约束时，加入ΔAmp和BAZ的相对优势会减弱。

tm.why: The paper directly evaluates and compares two real-time earthquake location algorithms, RTLoc and MParLoc, for hypocentral determination in the Ibero-Maghrebian Region.
The study assesses how localization accuracy affects Ground Motion Prediction Equations (GMPEs), real-time shakemaps, and Potential Damage Zones (PDZs) within an Earthquake Early Warning System.
MParLoc employs an evolutionary Bayesian approach that combines conditional probability density functions of differential arrival times, amplitude ratios, and back-azimuth estimates.

sum: Estimating the Gutenberg-Richter b-value is crucial for seismic forecasting but is hindered by short-term aftershock incompleteness (STAI) and seismic network density incompleteness (SNDI). This study systematically compares traditional completeness-threshold estimators (MAXC, MBS, CV) and the b-positive method against the novel b-more-positive estimator, which analyzes positive magnitude differences between non-consecutive, spatially close earthquake pairs. Using synthetic ETAS catalogs incorporating both STAI and SNDI, the authors demonstrate that traditional methods and the standard b-positive method systematically underestimate the true b-value, whereas the b-more-positive estimator accurately recovers it. Applying the method to five instrumental catalogs (Japan, Italy, Southern California, Northern California, and New Zealand) confirms that conventional estimates are biased low. Furthermore, the b-more-positive estimator reveals statistically significant regional differences in b-values and an unexpected non-monotonic decrease at large magnitude difference thresholds, suggesting intrinsic magnitude correlations or spatial b-value heterogeneity.
准确估计古登堡-里克特b值对地震预测至关重要，但受短期余震不完整性（STAI）和台网密度不完整性（SNDI）的制约。本研究将传统完整性阈值方法及b-positive方法与新型b-more-positive估计器进行了系统对比，后者基于空间邻近地震对的正震级差统计。利用包含STAI和SNDI的合成ET……

t: The b-more-positive estimator calculates the b-value from positive magnitude differences between an earthquake and the closest subsequent earthquake in time that has a larger magnitude and occurs within a maximum epicentral distance d_R.
b-more-positive通过计算事件与震中距d_R内首个震级更大的后续事件间的正震级差来估计b值。

The study analyzes ten synthetic 25-year ETASI catalogs with artificial STAI and SNDI, alongside five shallow (depth < 50 km) instrumental catalogs from Japan, Italy, Southern California, Northern California, and New Zealand.
分析了包含STAI和SNDI的10个合成ETASI目录，以及日本、意大利、南北加州和新西兰5个浅源目录。

In synthetic tests (beta_true = 2.763), traditional estimators and b-positive underestimate beta, whereas b-more-positive accurately recovers it (2.71–2.75). In regional catalogs, b-more-positive consistently yields higher values than traditional methods and reveals regional differences.
合成测试中传统方法低估真值(2.763)，而新方法准确恢复(2.71–2.75)；实测目录中新方法估计值显著更高。
In regional catalogs, the estimator exhibits an unexpected non-monotonic decrease at large magnitude difference thresholds not captured by the ETASI model, and cannot be used on declustered catalogs.
实测目录在大震级差阈值下出现ETASI未捕捉到的非单调下降，且该方法不能用于去丛集后的目录。

First systematic benchmark of the b-more-positive estimator under simultaneous STAI and SNDI in synthetic ETAS catalogs and across five major regional catalogs, demonstrating significant regional b-value variations.
首次在同时存在STAI和SNDI的合成目录及五个主要区域目录中系统评估该估计器，揭示显著区域b值差异。

kc: Demonstrated via synthetic ETAS catalogs with both STAI and SNDI that traditional b-value estimators (MAXC, MBS, CV) and the standard b-positive estimator systematically underestimate the true b-value.

Validated that the b-more-positive estimator accurately recovers the true b-value by restricting positive magnitude differences to earthquake pairs within a characteristic distance d_R (e.g., 40 km) and above threshold delta M_th.

Revealed significant regional variations in b-values across Japan, Italy, Southern California, Northern California, and New Zealand, plus a genuine non-monotonic trend at large magnitude difference thresholds.
通过包含STAI和SNDI的合成ETAS目录证明，传统b值估计器（MAXC、MBS、CV）和标准b-positive估计器会系统性地低估真实b值。
验证了b-more-positive估计器通过限制特征距离d_R（如40 km）和震级差阈值delta M_th内的正震级差，能准确恢复真实b值。
揭示了日本、意大利、南加州、北加州和新西兰之间显著的区域b值差异，以及在大震级差阈值下真实的非单调下降趋势。
me: The b-more-positive estimator (beta_++), which computes the inverse mean of positive magnitude differences between an event i and the first subsequent event j within epicentral distance d_R that has a larger magnitude.

Comparison against traditional maximum likelihood b-value estimators using completeness thresholds derived from Maximum Curvature (MAXC), b-value stability (MBS), and Coefficient of Variation (CV) methods.
Synthetic catalog generation using the Epidemic-Type Aftershock Sequence (ETAS) model with history-dependent probabilistic thinning for STAI and spatially variable thresholds for SNDI.
Correction for 0.1-unit magnitude rounding bias by adding uniform random noise in (-0.05, 0.05) and analytical quantification of finite detection uncertainty (sigma).
b-more-positive估计器（beta_++），计算事件i与震中距d_R内首个震级更大的后续事件j之间正震级差均值的倒数。
与基于最大曲率法（MAXC）、b值稳定性法（MBS）和变异系数法（CV）确定完整性阈值的传统最大似然b值估计器进行对比。
利用传染型余震序列（ETAS）模型生成合成目录，结合历史依赖概率稀疏化模拟STAI，以及空间可变阈值模拟SNDI。
通过添加(-0.05, 0.05)均匀随机噪声校正0.1震级分箱舍入偏差，并解析量化有限检测不确定性（sigma）的影响。
de: Ten realizations of 25-year synthetic ETASI catalogs incorporating both STAI and SNDI, initialized with 5e6 to 1e7 events (b = 1.2, beta_true = 2.763) and thinned to 3e5–9e5 events.

Five regional instrumental catalogs restricted to shallow earthquakes (depth < 50 km, m > 0): Japan (JMA after 2000), Italy (Horus after 2005), Southern California (relocated 1981–2022), Northern California (relocated 1984–2021), and New Zealand (after 2000).
10组25年期合成ETASI地震目录（包含STAI和SNDI），初始包含5e6至1e7个事件（b = 1.2，beta_true = 2.763），稀疏化后保留3e5至9e5个事件。
五个区域的浅源（深度<50 km，m>0）实测地震目录：日本（2000年后JMA）、意大利（2005年后Horus）、南加州（1981–2022重定位）、北加州（1984–2021重定位）和新西兰（2000年后）。
li: Performance on real catalogs can still be affected by measurement uncertainties and catalog heterogeneities, especially in small or imperfect datasets.
The b-more-positive estimator displays an unexpected decrease at large magnitude difference thresholds (delta M_th) in most real catalogs that is not captured by standard ETAS models.
Declustering routines cannot be applied prior to estimation because removing events violates the consecutive-pair condition required by the estimator.
在实际目录中的表现仍可能受到测量不确定性和目录非均匀性的影响，特别是在小规模或不完善的数据集中。
在大多数实际目录中，b-more-positive估计值在大震级差阈值（delta M_th）下表现出标准ETAS模型无法解释的下降趋势。
估计前不能对地震目录进行去丛集处理，因为移除事件会破坏估计器所需的事件对“连续性”条件。

sum: This study constructs a high-resolution 3D P-wave velocity model of the upper mantle beneath the Pamir, Tianshan, and adjacent regions using teleseismic tomography from 353 stations and 3,321 events. The model reveals a subvertical boundary between the low-velocity central Tianshan and high-velocity Tarim lithosphere, indicating sub-horizontal compression and subsequent lithospheric delamination. In the Pamir-Hindu Kush region, the results show steep subduction of the Indian lithosphere beneath the Hindu Kush and sub-horizontal underthrusting beneath the Pamir, which likely triggers Tajik lithospheric delamination. Additionally, a large-scale high-velocity anomaly near the base of the mantle transition zone suggests detached Indian lithosphere from a ~20 Ma slab breakoff. These findings provide critical constraints on the deep mantle dynamics of the northwestern India-Asia collision zone.
本研究利用353个台站的远震数据，构建了帕米尔和天山地区上地幔三维P波速度模型。结果显示，塔里木岩石圈水平挤压天山并导致其拆沉；印度岩石圈在兴都库什陡峭俯冲，在帕米尔水平底辟并诱发塔吉克岩石圈拆沉；地幔过渡带底部的高速异常代表约20 Ma前断裂脱落的印度岩石圈。该研究揭示了西北印度-亚洲碰撞带的深部……

t: 3D teleseismic P-wave travel-time tomography using data from a dense regional seismic network to image upper mantle velocity perturbations.
利用区域密集地震台网的远震P波走时数据进行三维远震断层成像，以重建上地幔速度扰动。
Teleseismic waveform data recorded by 353 seismic stations from 3,321 teleseismic events across the Pamir, Tianshan, and adjacent regions.
由帕米尔、天山及邻区353个地震台站记录的3321个远震事件的远震波形数据。

Revealed contrasting lithospheric behaviors: Tarim compressing Tianshan causing delamination, steep Indian subduction under Hindu Kush, flat underthrusting under Pamir, and a detached slab at the MTZ base.
揭示了不同的岩石圈行为：塔里木挤压天山导致拆沉、印度板块在兴都库什陡俯冲与在帕米尔平铺底辟，以及过渡带底部的脱落板块。
Inherent resolution limits of teleseismic ray paths in the shallow crust and potential smearing along ray directions.
远震射线路径在浅部地壳中的固有分辨率限制，以及沿射线方向潜在的抹平效应。
Provides a unified, high-resolution 3D upper mantle model across both Pamir and Tianshan, clarifying the spatial transitions of subduction and delamination.
提供了跨越帕米尔和天山的统一、高分辨率三维上地幔模型，阐明了俯冲和拆沉的空间过渡。

Imaged a subvertical boundary indicating sub-horizontal compression of the central Tianshan by the Tarim lithosphere and subsequent delamination.

sum: This paper presents an adaptive local inverse-Hessian preconditioning approach for multiparameter elastic full-waveform inversion (FWI). Multiparameter elastic FWI often suffers from parameter coupling and unbalanced radiation sensitivities, leading to crosstalk and slow convergence. To address this, the authors construct a local inverse mapping between curvature responses (Hessian-vector products) and model perturbations using reference perturbations. This formulation captures both diagonal and off-diagonal inverse Hessian contributions, explicitly treating parameter coupling. The local systems are solved using singular value decomposition (SVD) with Tikhonov regularization. Synthetic tests, including a crosstalk-sensitive anomaly test and the Marmousi II model, demonstrate that the method produces update directions consistent with fully converged Gauss-Newton solutions at a fraction of the computational cost, outperforming block-diagonal pseudo-Hessian and truncated Gauss-Newton methods in crosstalk reduction and convergence speed.
提出一种用于多参数弹性全波形反演的自适应局部逆Hessian预条件方法。该方法利用参考扰动及其曲率响应构建局部逆映射，捕获逆Hessian的对角与非对角项以消除参数耦合，并采用SVD和Tikhonov正则化求解。合成模型测试表明，该方法能以极低成本获得接近高斯-牛顿法的更新方向，显著抑制串扰并加速收……

t: An adaptive local inverse-Hessian preconditioning approach that constructs a local mapping between curvature responses and model perturbations using reference perturbations and Hessian-vector products, solved via SVD with Tikhonov regularization.
利用参考扰动和Hessian-向量积构建局部逆映射，并通过SVD和Tikhonov正则化求解。
Synthetic numerical experiments including a crosstalk-sensitive anomaly test and the elastic Marmousi II model.
包含对串扰敏感的异常体测试和弹性Marmousi II模型的合成数值实验。
The proposed method yields update directions consistent with fully converged Gauss-Newton solutions at substantially lower cost, showing reduced crosstalk and faster misfit reduction.
以极低成本获得与完全收敛的高斯-牛顿法一致的更新方向，显著减少串扰并加速收敛。

该方法仅在合成数据集上进行了评估，尚未在实际野外数据上得到验证。
Formulating an adaptive local inverse Hessian mapping that captures both diagonal and off-diagonal coupling terms without solving the expensive global Gauss-Newton linear system.
通过局部逆Hessian映射捕获耦合项，无需求解全局方程组。

kc: Developed an adaptive local inverse-Hessian preconditioning method for elastic FWI that approximates Gauss-Newton updates without solving global linear systems.
Formulated a local mapping using reference perturbations and Hessian-vector products to capture both diagonal and off-diagonal inverse Hessian terms.
Demonstrated significant reduction in parameter crosstalk and faster convergence compared to block-diagonal pseudo-Hessian and truncated GN methods.
开发了一种用于弹性全波形反演的自适应局部逆Hessian预条件方法，无需求解全局线性方程组即可近似高斯-牛顿更新。
利用参考扰动和Hessian-向量积构建局部映射，捕获了逆Hessian的对角和非对角项。

Hessian-vector product formulation in the Gauss-Newton sense.
Singular value decomposition (SVD) with Tikhonov regularization for solving local systems.
通过局部逆映射进行高斯-牛顿近似。

Marmousi II elastic synthetic model test.

sum: This study simulates seismic wavefields for five moderate-to-large earthquakes in California to evaluate pseudospectral acceleration at periods of 2, 5, and 10 s. Using finite-difference calculations, the authors compare the USGS National Crustal Model with three established regional community velocity models (CVMS4.26.M01, CVMH15.1.0, and the USGS Bay Area CVM). The 3D models generally outperform ergodic ground-motion models. Crucially, the study demonstrates that averaging ground-motion predictions across all available velocity models yields better results than using any single model, suggesting that combining independent 3D velocity models can significantly improve seismic hazard and ground-motion estimations.
本研究利用有限差分方法模拟了加州五次中强地震的波场，评估了2、5和10秒周期的伪光谱加速度。对比了USGS国家地壳模型与三个区域速度模型，发现三维模型整体优于经验地面运动模型。最重要的是，平均所有可用速度模型的地面运动预测在多数情况下优于单一模型，表明结合多个独立三维模型可显著提升地震动估算精度。

t: 3D finite-difference wave propagation simulations resolving periods down to 1 s, evaluating pseudospectral acceleration at 2, 5, and 10 s.
采用三维有限差分波动方程模拟，分辨率达1秒，评估2、5和10秒周期的伪光谱加速度。
Simulated wavefields of five California earthquakes using USGS National Crustal Model and three regional community velocity models.
使用USGS国家地壳模型及三个区域群落速度模型，模拟加州五次地震的波场。
3D models outperform ergodic models, and averaging ground motions from all available velocity models outperforms any single model.

Simulation variability arises from source parameter uncertainties, signal-to-noise ratio, and lack of topography or fault damage zones.

sum: This study investigates seismic wave amplification in the thick Cenozoic Gilan and Qazvin sedimentary basins of northern Iran (>10 km thick) to assess seismic hazards for multi-story buildings. Analyzing waveforms from 350 local earthquakes (72 stations) and teleseismic shear waves from 189 events, the authors find significant amplification at 0.8–5.0 Hz (peak factors >5 at ~1.0 Hz) and long periods (1–10 s). Horizontal-to-Vertical Spectral Ratio (HVSR) analysis of earthquakes and ambient noise demonstrates that this amplification is driven by deep sedimentary layers rather than shallow soil. The study provides the first quantitative assessment of low-frequency basin amplification in Iran, highlighting its linear behavior at large magnitudes and the critical need to incorporate these deep basin effects into regional seismic hazard models.
本研究调查了伊朗北部新生代吉兰和加兹温厚沉积盆地（厚度超10公里）的地震波放大效应。利用72个台站记录的350个地方地震和189个远震剪切波数据，研究发现盆地在0.8-5.0 Hz（1.0 Hz处放大系数超5）和长周期（1-10秒）存在显著放大。地方地震和背景噪声的HVSR分析表明，该放大由深部沉积……

t: Spectral ratio method on teleseismic shear waves and Horizontal-to-Vertical Spectral Ratio (HVSR) analysis of local earthquakes and ambient noise.
对远震剪切波进行谱比法分析，并对地方地震和背景噪声进行水平与垂直谱比（HVSR）分析。
Waveforms from 350 local earthquakes and 189 teleseismic earthquakes recorded by 72 seismic stations in northern Iran, along with ambient noise.
伊朗北部72个台站记录的350个地方地震、189个远震波形及背景噪声数据。
Significant amplification at 0.8–5.0 Hz (peak >5 at 1.0 Hz) and 1–10 s periods, positively correlated with deep sedimentary basin depth.
在0.8-5.0 Hz（1 Hz处放大超5倍）和1-10秒周期存在显著放大，且与深部盆地深度正相关。

First quantitative assessment of low-frequency seismic amplification in Iran's thick (>10 km) Cenozoic basins, linking amplification to deep layers.
首次定量评估了伊朗厚达10公里以上新生代盆地的低频放大，并将其归因于深部地层。

Horizontal-to-Vertical Spectral Ratio (HVSR) analysis of local earthquake waveforms and ambient noise data.

对189个远震的剪切波应用谱比法进行分析。

对长周期放大系数与沉积盆地深度进行相关性分析。

Teleseismic shear waves from 189 teleseismic earthquakes.
Ambient noise data recorded at the same 72 seismic stations.
由伊朗北部72个地震台站网络记录的350个地方地震的波形数据。

sum: This paper investigates the physical mechanism behind breakdown work scaling in laboratory earthquakes. Using experimental observations and theoretical analysis, the authors demonstrate that the observed scaling of breakdown work with slip or rupture propagation is not primarily a reflection of local frictional or fracture processes at the rupture tip. Instead, it is governed by nonlocal elastic unloading of the surrounding experimental apparatus or host rock system. This finding challenges traditional interpretations of seismological fracture energy and provides a new framework for scaling laboratory-derived earthquake parameters to natural fault systems.
本文研究了实验室地震中破裂功标度律的物理机制。作者结合实验观测与理论分析，指出破裂功随位移或破裂传播的标度关系并非主要反映破裂尖端的局部摩擦或断裂过程，而是由周围实验装置或围岩系统的非局部弹性卸载所控制。这一发现挑战了传统地震学中关于断裂能的解释，为将实验室地震参数外推至自然断层系统提供了新的理论框……

t: Theoretical and experimental analysis of elastic unloading during laboratory stick-slip events.
对实验室粘滑事件期间弹性卸载的理论与实验分析。
Shear stress and slip data recorded during laboratory earthquake experiments.
实验室地震实验中记录的剪切应力和位移数据。
Breakdown work scaling is shown to reflect system-scale elastic unloading rather than local fracture processes.
表明破裂功标度反映的是系统尺度的弹性卸载，而非局部断裂过程。
Scaling laboratory-scale system stiffness to natural, highly heterogeneous fault zones is difficult.
将实验室尺度的系统刚度外推至自然界高度非均匀的断层带较为困难。

提出非局部弹性卸载是解释破裂功标度律的主要机制。

Challenges the conventional view that breakdown work scaling directly reflects local fracture energy or frictional weakening processes.
确定了非局部弹性卸载是实验室地震中破裂功标度的主要驱动因素。

sum: Following a December 2019 seismic crisis at Condor Seamount (Azores), five ocean-bottom seismometers were deployed for 102 days. Using the OBS-trained deep-learning picker PickBlue, REAL association, NonLinLoc, and HYPODD waveform cross-correlation relocation, the authors constructed a high-resolution catalog of 1,799 microearthquakes across four swarms. Combined with 6-year regional S-P time observations, the data reveal persistent, spatially stable volcano-tectonic seismicity at 14–18 km depth in the uppermost mantle beneath an aseismic middle-to-upper crust. This is interpreted as an inflating near-Moho magma reservoir that could feed future eruptions and propagate the ridge westward. Furthermore, waveform cross-correlation reveals reversed P-wave polarities primarily at the margin of the largest swarm, while three smaller swarms lack reversals. This novel observation supports a local stress rotation model where large magma intrusions induce adjacent compressive stresses exceeding background extensional stress.
针对2019年底亚速尔群岛Condor海山地震危机，研究布设了5台海底地震仪进行102天观测。结合深度学习拾取器PickBlue、REAL关联、NonLinLoc和HYPODD波形互相关重定位，构建了包含1799个微震的高分辨率目录。结合区域台站长期S-P到时差分析，发现海山西北端14–18 km上……

t: Phase arrivals were picked with the OBS-trained deep-learning model PickBlue, associated via REAL, located with NonLinLoc, and relatively relocated using HYPODD with waveform cross-correlation; P-wave polarities were measured via template cross-correlation.
使用PickBlue拾取震相，REAL关联，NonLinLoc和HYPODD波形互相关重定位，并通过模板互相关测量P波极…

Five four-component ocean-bottom seismometers recorded continuous data at 2,000 Hz for 102 days (18 February to 30 May 2020) around the tip of Condor Seamount, complemented by 6-year ISC regional catalog S-P times.
在Condor海山尖端布设5台四分量OBS连续记录102天，结合邻近陆地台站6年ISC目录S-P到时数据。

Relocated 1,799 earthquakes across four swarms at 14–18 km depth (Mw 1.0–3.2, b-value 1.92) with 20–75 m relative uncertainties; in Swarm A, 95 of 501 correlated events showed reversed P-wave polarities.
重定位了14–18 km深度的1799个微震（相對误差20–75 m）；主震群501个相关事件中有95个出现P波极性反转…

Small network aperture, limited azimuthal coverage, and only five OBS instruments prevented focal mechanism inversion; lack of offshore geodesy also prevented constraining vertical deformation or aseismic shallow intrusions.
台网孔径小、方位角覆盖有限且仅5台OBS，无法反演震源机制解；缺乏海底大地测量约束形变。

First high-resolution local OBS catalog of Condor Seamount revealing persistent uppermost-mantle seismicity from an inflating magma reservoir and swarm-dependent P-wave polarity reversals supporting local stress rotation.
首次获得Condor海山高分辨率OBS微震目录，揭示上地幔膨胀岩浆房及支持局部应力旋转的极性反转。

kc: Constructed the first high-resolution local microearthquake catalog (1,799 events) at Condor Seamount using OBS-trained deep-learning phase picking (PickBlue) and double-difference waveform relocation.
Identified persistent, spatially stable seismicity at 14–18 km depth in the uppermost mantle, providing evidence for an inflating near-Moho magma reservoir.

Detected reversed P-wave polarities at the margins of the main earthquake swarm (95 of 501 correlated events) but none in three smaller swarms, supporting a local stress rotation model driven by magma supply volume.
利用针对OBS训练的深度学习拾取器（PickBlue）和双差波形重定位，构建了Condor海山首个高分辨率局部微震目录（1799个事件）。
识别出14–18 km上地幔顶部长期且空间稳定的地震活动，为莫霍面附近正在膨胀的岩浆房提供了证据。
在主震群边缘检测到P波极性反转（501个相关事件中有95个），而在三个较小震群中未发现，支持了受岩浆供给量控制的局部应力旋转模型。
me: Machine-learning phase picking using PickBlue (transfer-learned from EQTransformer and PhaseNet on 4-component OBS data) and event association via REAL.
Nonlinear oct-tree grid-search absolute location (NonLinLoc) with station corrections followed by waveform cross-correlation double-difference relocation (HYPODD).
Ambient-noise cross-correlation and historical linear drift rates to correct unsynchronized OBS clocks.
Waveform cross-correlation polarity analysis against high-SNR template events to identify correlated and anti-correlated (polarity-reversed) P-wave first motions.
使用PickBlue（基于EQTransformer和PhaseNet在四分量OBS数据上迁移学习）进行机器学习震相拾取，并通过REAL进行事件关联。
采用含台站校正的非线性八叉树网格搜索绝对定位（NonLinLoc）及波形互相关双差相对重定位（HYPODD）。
利用背景噪声互相关和历史线性漂移率校正未同步的OBS时钟漂移。
通过与高信噪比模板事件进行波形互相关极性分析，识别正相关与反相关（极性反转）的P波初动。
de: 102-day continuous 4-component seismic recordings from 5 rapid-response short-period OBSs deployed around the northwestern tip of Condor Seamount (Feb–May 2020).
Six-year (2016–2022) P- and S-onset regional catalog data from the International Seismological Centre (ISC) at nearby land station PCED on Faial Island.
2020年2月至5月在Condor海山西北端布设的5台快速响应短周期四分量OBS连续102天的地震记录。
国际地震中心（ISC）提供的邻近法亚尔岛陆地台站PCED六年（2016–2022年）的P波和S波到时区域目录数据。
li: Small network aperture, limited azimuthal coverage, and only five OBS instruments prevented full focal mechanism inversions.
OBS clocks failed to synchronize upon recovery due to battery failure, requiring linear drift assumptions and ambient-noise corrections.
Absence of offshore geodetic observations prevents precise estimation of vertical seafloor deformation or ruling out small aseismic shallow intrusions.
台网孔径小、方位角覆盖有限且仅有5台OBS仪器，无法反演完整的震源机制解。
电池故障导致OBS回收时时钟未同步，需依赖线性漂移假设和背景噪声互相关进行校正。
缺乏海底大地测量观测，无法精确估计海底垂直形变或完全排除浅部小规模无震侵入。

tm.why: The paper investigates volcanic earthquake swarms and an inflating magma reservoir beneath the submarine Condor Seamount.
A high-resolution local earthquake catalog of 1,799 events is constructed using machine-learning phase picking, association, and double-difference relative relocation.
The study relies on a rapid-response deployment of five ocean-bottom seismometers (OBSs) with clock drift corrections via ambient noise.

ev.notes: Full 12-page PDF provided and analyzed, including all text sections, figures, and citations to supporting information.

sum: This study investigates the 3D propagation of seismo- and tsunami-traveling ionospheric disturbances (STIDs and TTIDs) triggered by the 29 July 2025 Mw8.8 Kamchatka earthquake. Using a multi-frequency CW-HF Doppler sounding network (5 frequencies, 9 stations) in Taiwan, five ionosondes across Japan and Taiwan, seismometers, and tide gauges, the authors analyze vertical and horizontal wave parameters. Rayleigh-wave-induced STIDs propagated horizontally at a supersonic speed of ~3.7 km/s (period 20 s, wavelength 74 km) and vertically upward at the local sound speed of ~405 m/s (period 40 s, true vertical wavelength ~16.2 km). For the first time, CW-HF Doppler systems also captured TTIDs traveling horizontally at ~111–270 m/s, leading coastal tsunami arrival by 9–14 minutes. Due to upward atmospheric density decrease, ionospheric Doppler velocity fluctuations are amplified by tens of thousands of times compared to ground seismic and sea-level tsunami vertical velocities.
本研究利用台湾多频连续波高频（CW-HF）多普勒探测网（5个频率、9个接收站）、日台5部电离层测高仪、地震仪及验潮站数据，三维研究了2025年7月29日堪察加Mw8.8地震引发的震源和海啸行进式电离层扰动（STIDs和TTIDs）。结果显示，瑞利波激发的STIDs以3.7 km/s的超音速水平传播（……

t: Horizontal speeds are estimated using great-circle travel times, plane-wave slope fitting, and least-squares time-difference-of-arrival (TDOA) inversion across nine receiving stations and five sounding frequencies, while vertical speeds are derived from arrival-time slopes across reflection true heights.
通过大圆走时、平面波拟合和TDOA最小二乘反演计算水平速度，由不同反射真实高度的到时斜率推导垂直速度。

Observations use a CW-HF Doppler network in Taiwan (one transmitter at 3.9–6.1 MHz, nine receivers), five ionosondes in Taiwan and Japan, a broadband seismometer at NST, and four coastal tide gauges during the 2025 Mw8.8 Kamchatka earthquake.
使用台湾1发9收5频段CW-HF多普勒网、日台5部电离层测高仪、NST地震仪及4个海岸验潮站记录。

STIDs propagate horizontally at 3.7 km/s (period 20 s, wavelength 74 km) and vertically at 405 m/s (period 40 s, true wavelength 16.2 km). TTIDs travel at 111–270 m/s. Ionospheric velocity amplitudes are amplified by ~2.1–5.4 × 10^4.
STIDs水平速度3.7 km/s，垂直速度405 m/s（真实波长16.2 km）；TTIDs水平速度111–270 …

Sporadic-E blanking at 3.9 MHz and simultaneous arrivals across remaining frequencies prevent estimating the vertical speed and period of TTIDs; ionograms also show no clear tsunami-induced cusp changes.
受偶发E层遮蔽且各频率到时无明显差异，无法估算TTIDs的垂直速度和周期。

This work reports the first observation of tsunami-traveling ionospheric disturbances (TTIDs) using continuous wave-high frequency (CW-HF) Doppler sounding systems alongside 3D STID tracking for the 2025 Mw8.8 Kamchatka earthquake.
首次利用CW-HF多普勒探测系统观测到海啸行进式电离层扰动（TTIDs）并实现三维追踪。

kc: First observation of tsunami-traveling ionospheric disturbances (TTIDs) using continuous wave-high frequency (CW-HF) Doppler sounding systems.
Three-dimensional characterization of STIDs from the 2025 Mw8.8 Kamchatka earthquake, resolving a 3.7 km/s horizontal speed and 405 m/s upward acoustic speed.
Quantification of ground-to-ionosphere wave amplification factors (~2.4–5.4 × 10^4 for STIDs and ~2.1 × 10^4 for TTIDs), validating energy conservation scaling with atmospheric density.
首次利用连续波高频（CW-HF）多普勒探测系统观测到海啸行进式电离层扰动（TTIDs）。
对2025年堪察加Mw8.8地震的STIDs进行了三维特征刻画，测得其水平速度为3.7 km/s，垂直向上声速为405 m/s。
量化了地表至电离层的波振幅放大因子（STIDs约为2.4–5.4 × 10^4，TTIDs约为2.1 × 10^4），验证了与大气密度相关的能量守恒关系。
me: Multi-frequency CW-HF Doppler frequency shift (DFS) analysis across five reflection altitudes (153–195 km true height).
Ionosonde virtual-to-true height profile inversion and multi-cusp separation analysis to determine vertical wavelengths.
Horizontal phase velocity estimation using great-circle travel times, plane-wave slope fitting, and least-squares Time-Difference-of-Arrival (TDOA) array inversion.
跨五个反射高度（真实高度153–195 km）的多频CW-HF多普勒频移（DFS）分析。
电离层测高仪虚高到真实高度剖面反演及多尖点（multi-cusp）间距分析以确定垂直波长。
利用大圆路径走时、平面波斜率拟合以及最小二乘到达时间差（TDOA）台阵反演估算水平相速度。
de: CW-HF Doppler sounding network in Taiwan (1 transmitter with 5 frequencies from 3.9 to 6.1 MHz, 9 receiving stations sampled at 512 Hz).
Ionograms from 5 ionosondes (4 in Japan: WK, TO, YG, OK; 1 in Taiwan: TW) recorded at 5- and 6-minute cadences.
Broadband vertical-component seismogram at station NST and sea-level records from 4 east-coast tide gauges in Taiwan.
台湾CW-HF多普勒探测网（1个发射站发射3.9至6.1 MHz共5个频率，9个接收站以512 Hz采样）。
来自日本（WK、TO、YG、OK）和台湾（TW）共5个电离层测高仪的频高图（采样间隔分别为5分钟和6分钟）。
台湾NST台站的宽频带垂直分量地震记录以及台湾东海岸4个验潮站的海平面记录。
li: Vertical phase speed and period of TTIDs could not be reliably estimated due to sporadic-E layer blanking at 3.9 MHz and negligible arrival-time differences across frequencies.
No clear multiple-cusp features were distinguishable in ionograms during the tsunami arrival due to short TTID wavelengths.
由于3.9 MHz频段受偶发E层遮蔽，且其余频率间无明显到时差，无法可靠估算TTIDs的垂直相速度和周期。
由于TTIDs波长很短，海啸到达期间的电离层频高图中未观察到明显的尖点特征变化。

tm.why: The paper investigates lithosphere-ocean-atmosphere-ionosphere coupling by tracking ionospheric disturbances (STIDs and TTIDs) generated by Rayleigh and tsunami waves from the 2025 Mw8.8 Kamchatka earthquake.
The study uses a multi-frequency, multi-station continuous wave-high frequency (CW-HF) Doppler sounding array and ionosondes alongside seismometers and tide gauges to perform 3D wave tracking.

ev.notes: Full 11-page PDF of the GRL article was analyzed, including all 5 figures, mathematical equations, and section texts.

sum: This paper introduces EKI-MultiCMT, a novel framework for Multiple Centroid Moment Tensor (Multi-CMT) inversion of complex earthquakes. Traditional joint inversions using Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) are computationally prohibitive, requiring over 10^5 forward simulations. EKI-MultiCMT leverages Ensemble Kalman Inversion (EKI), a derivative-free, ensemble-based optimization method, to update all subevent parameters collectively. The framework incorporates physical priors via Tikhonov regularization and augmented observations, including aftershock-derived kernel-density location estimates, cross-correlation similarity, and lag-time measurements. Using a randomize-then-optimize strategy, it generates an ensemble of solutions to characterize uncertainty. EKI-MultiCMT reduces the required forward simulations by two to three orders of magnitude compared to MCMC, making joint Multi-CMT inversion computationally feasible for complex, multi-segment rupture events.
本文提出了一种用于复杂地震多质心矩张量（Multi-CMT）反演的新框架 EKI-MultiCMT。传统的MCMC联合反演计算成本极高，需要超过10^5次前向模拟。该框架利用无导数、基于集合的优化方法——集合卡尔曼反演（EKI），集体更新所有子事件参数。通过吉洪诺夫正则化和增强观测（包括余震核密度估……

t: EKI-MultiCMT uses Ensemble Kalman Inversion (EKI) and a randomize-then-optimize strategy to collectively update all subevent parameters in a derivative-free, iterative manner.
EKI-MultiCMT利用集合卡尔曼反演（EKI）和随机化-优化策略，以无导数、迭代的方式集体更新所有子事件参数。
Augmented observations including seismic waveforms, cross-correlation similarity, lag-time measurements, and aftershock catalog kernel-density estimates for spatial priors.
增强的观测数据，包括地震波形、互相关相似度、滞后时间测量以及用于空间先验的余震目录核密度估计。
The framework resolves complex subevents jointly while reducing the number of forward simulations by two to three orders of magnitude compared to MCMC sampling.
该框架能够联合解析复杂的子事件，同时将前向模拟的次数比MCMC采样减少两到三个数量级。
Performance depends on the quality of prior constraints (e.g., aftershock catalogs) and the assumption of independent subevents without explicit physical rupture dynamics.
性能依赖于先验约束（如余震目录）的质量，且假设子事件相互独立，未考虑显式的物理破裂动力学。
First application of Ensemble Kalman Inversion to joint Multi-CMT source inversion, significantly accelerating uncertainty-aware complex earthquake characterization.
首次将集合卡尔曼反演应用于联合Multi-CMT震源反演，显著加速了具不确定性表征的复杂地震刻画。

kc: Developed EKI-MultiCMT, a derivative-free, ensemble-based optimization framework for joint Multi-CMT inversion.
Reduced the computational cost of joint subevent inversion by two to three orders of magnitude compared to traditional MCMC methods.
Integrated physical priors and augmented observations (aftershock kernel-density, cross-correlation, lag-time) to regularize the ill-posed inversion.
Implemented a randomize-then-optimize strategy to provide ensemble-based uncertainty quantification of the rupture process.
开发了EKI-MultiCMT，一种用于联合Multi-CMT反演的无导数、基于集合的优化框架。
与传统MCMC方法相比，将联合子事件反演的计算成本降低了两到三个数量级。
整合了物理先验和增强观测（余震核密度、互相关、滞后时间）以正则化病态反演问题。
实现了“随机化-优化”策略，以提供破裂过程基于集合的不确定性量化。
me: Ensemble Kalman Inversion (EKI) for derivative-free, collective parameter updates.
Tikhonov regularization for incorporating physical priors.
Randomize-then-optimize (RTO) strategy for generating posterior ensembles.
Augmented observations using aftershock catalog kernel-density estimation, waveform cross-correlation, and lag-time measurements.
集合卡尔曼反演（EKI），用于无导数的集体参数更新。
吉洪诺夫（Tikhonov）正则化，用于引入物理先验。
随机化-优化（RTO）策略，用于生成后验集合。
利用余震目录核密度估计、波形互相关和滞后时间测量的增强观测。
de: Synthetic tests and/or real earthquake waveform datasets (implied by the Multi-CMT application to complex earthquakes).
Aftershock catalogs used to construct spatial kernel-density prior estimates.
合成测试和/或真实地震波形数据集（由复杂地震的Multi-CMT应用所暗示）。
用于构建空间核密度先验估计的余震目录。
li: The inversion's success relies heavily on the quality of prior constraints, such as aftershock catalogs.
Assumes independent subevents, which may not fully capture continuous, complex physical rupture dynamics.
反演的成功在很大程度上依赖于先验约束（如余震目录）的质量。
假设子事件相互独立，这可能无法完全捕获连续、复杂的物理破裂动力学。

tm.why: The paper focuses on Multi-CMT inversion to resolve the complex spatiotemporal rupture history of large earthquakes.
It utilizes Ensemble Kalman Inversion and a randomize-then-optimize strategy to generate an ensemble of solutions for uncertainty characterization.
It introduces EKI-MultiCMT, a derivative-free, ensemble-based optimization framework for solving nonlinear and ill-posed source inversion problems.

sum: Rock bridges control the initiation of tectonic earthquakes and locked-type landslides, yet conventional direct shear tests obscure full-field deformation and impose idealized stress paths. This study proposes a novel uniaxial compression testing method using cylindrical granite specimens with prefabricated discontinuous joints at rock bridge angles of 5°, 15°, and 30° to naturally induce compressive-shear stress states. Deformation and failure mechanisms were analyzed by integrating mechanical testing, acoustic emission (AE) monitoring, and two-dimensional digital image correlation (DIC). Results show that peak strength decreases while peak vertical displacement increases (from 1.2 mm to 3.8 mm) with increasing rock bridge angle. AE energy exhibits a characteristic valley-shaped pattern between two high-energy events, and AF/RA ratios confirm shear-dominated cracking. Furthermore, DIC reveals nearly circular vertical displacement contours prior to failure, providing experimental evidence for the formation mechanism of arc-shaped slip surfaces in three-stage locked-segment landslides.
岩桥控制着构造地震与锁固型滑坡的演化，但传统直剪试验难以观测全场变形。本文提出一种含预制非贯通裂隙花岗岩试样的单轴压缩试验方法（岩桥倾角为5°、15°和30°），结合力学响应、声发射（AE）监测与二维数字图像相关（DIC）技术研究岩桥压剪破坏机制。结果表明，随岩桥角度增大，峰值强度降低而峰值垂直位移……

t: Uniaxial compression tests were performed on cylindrical granite specimens with prefabricated discontinuous joints at 5°, 15°, and 30° angles, monitored simultaneously via 2D digital image correlation, strain gauges, and a six-sensor acoustic emission system.
对含5°、15°、30°预制非贯通裂隙的花岗岩圆柱样进行单轴压缩，同步开展2D DIC、应变片和声发射监测。

Fifteen cylindrical granite samples (100 mm height, 50 mm diameter) from Laizhou City were cut with a high-pressure water jet to create 38 mm rock bridges at 5°, 15°, and 30° inclination angles, loaded at 0.1 mm/min.
采用山东莱州15个花岗岩圆柱样（100×50 mm），水刀预制长38 mm、倾角5°/15°/30°的岩桥，以0.1 m…

Peak vertical displacement increased from 1.2 mm (5°) to 2.4 mm (15°) and 3.8 mm (30°), forming near-circular displacement contours; AE energy showed a valley-shaped pattern reaching 1750 mV·ms at 30°, with AF/RA confirming shear-dominated failure.
峰值垂直位移随倾角从1.2 mm增至3.8 mm并呈近似圆形等值线；30°最大AE能量达1750 mV·ms且呈谷型演化…

High-strength granite caused rapid brittle fracture hard to capture temporally, 2D DIC on cylindrical samples introduced curvature/out-of-plane effects, and cylindrical geometry caused uneven rock bridge widths.
高强花岗岩脆性破裂过快难以精细捕捉，圆柱样2D DIC存在曲率与面外变形误差且岩桥有效宽度不均。

Induces a realistic compressive-shear stress state in rock bridges under simple uniaxial compression without a shear box, enabling continuous full-field DIC observation of arc-shaped slip surface formation.
无需剪切盒即可在单轴压缩下自然诱导岩桥压剪应力，实现了圆弧形滑面演化全过程的DIC全场连续观测。

kc: Proposed a novel uniaxial compression specimen configuration with prefabricated discontinuous joints to induce realistic compressive-shear stress states in rock bridges while allowing full-field optical observation.

Demonstrated that rock bridge failure under compressive-shear loading exhibits a characteristic valley-shaped acoustic emission energy evolution and is predominantly governed by shear cracking based on AF/RA analysis.

Provided experimental DIC evidence of near-circular vertical displacement contours and steep displacement gradients prior to failure, explaining the formation of arc-shaped slip surfaces in three-stage locked-type landslides.
提出了一种含预制非贯通节理的单轴压缩试样构型，在诱导真实压剪应力状态的同时实现了全场光学变形观测。
结合声发射能量演化与AF/RA参数分析，证实压剪作用下岩桥破坏具有典型的“谷型”声发射特征且由剪切破裂主导。
利用DIC观测到破坏前近似圆弧形的垂直位移等值线及高位移梯度区，揭示了三段式锁固型滑坡弧形滑面的形成机制。
me: Uniaxial compression testing of cylindrical granite specimens with water-jet prefabricated discontinuous joints to induce compressive-shear stress.
Two-dimensional Digital Image Correlation (2D DIC) validated by central strain gauges to monitor full-field horizontal and vertical displacement evolution.
Acoustic emission (AE) monitoring using six lateral sensors to track energy release, cumulative counts, and fracture mode classification via Average Frequency (AF) and Rise Angle (RA) ratios.
对高压水刀预制非贯通裂隙的圆柱形花岗岩试样进行单轴压缩试验以诱导压剪应力状态。
采用二维数字图像相关技术（2D DIC）并结合中部应变片校验，连续监测全场水平和垂直位移演化。
利用6个侧面声发射传感器监测能量释放与累计振铃计数，并通过平均频率（AF）与上升角（RA）比值判别裂纹破裂类型。
de: Fifteen standard cylindrical granite specimens (100 mm height, 50 mm diameter) collected from Laizhou City, Shandong Province.
Three rock bridge inclination angles (5°, 15°, and 30°) with a constant rock bridge length of 38 mm, tested with three parallel samples per configuration.
Displacement-controlled uniaxial loading at 0.1 mm/min (strain rate 1.7 × 10⁻⁵ s⁻¹) using the TAW-2000 triaxial rock testing system.
采集自山东省莱州市的15个标准圆柱形花岗岩试样（高100 mm，直径50 mm）。
固定岩桥长度为38 mm，设置5°、15°和30°三种岩桥倾角，每种倾角配置3个平行试样。
使用TAW-2000岩石三轴试验机，以0.1 mm/min的位移控制速率（应变率1.7 × 10⁻⁵ s⁻¹）进行准静态单轴加载。
li: High-strength granite experienced rapid brittle failure during the final stage, making it difficult to capture detailed crack propagation at current imaging frame rates.
Two-dimensional DIC (2D DIC) on cylindrical specimens cannot completely eliminate the effects of surface curvature and out-of-plane deformation.
Cylindrical geometry causes the effective width of the prefabricated rock bridge to vary across different locations.
花岗岩强度较高导致临近破坏时发生快速脆性断裂，现有成像帧率难以完整捕捉极短时间内的裂纹扩展细节。
对圆柱形试样采用二维DIC（2D DIC）监测无法完全消除表面曲率和面外位移的影响。
圆柱形试样几何约束导致预制岩桥在不同位置的有效宽度不一致，影响局部应力分布均匀性。

tm.why: The study investigates the macroscopic deformation, acoustic emission activity, and shear failure mechanisms of rock bridges (locked segments), which directly relate to tectonic fault locking and landslide initiation.

Acoustic emission waveform parameters (average frequency and rise angle) and energy evolution are analyzed to characterize micro-fracture transition from tensile to shear cracking during rock bridge rupture.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete Accepted Manuscript PDF (23 pages), including abstract, full text, 2 tables, and 16 figures.

sum: This paper proposes the Unified Theory of Lithosphere-Atmosphere-Ionosphere Coupling via Acoustic-Gravity Waves (LAIC-AGW). Utilizing real-time time-series data (pressure, temperature, relative humidity) from an ultra-dense Netatmo IoT weather station array across Japan, the author monitors pre-seismic thermodynamic anomalies and post-seismic atmospheric wave propagation. By calculating equivalent potential temperature (\theta_e) via Bolton's equations, the study identifies a pre-seismic thermal spike (\Delta \theta_e = 27.99 K) hours before the M7.1 Kumamoto earthquake. Applying Continuous Wavelet Transform and delay-and-sum beamforming, the study validates the coupling theory across four major Japanese earthquakes, satisfying three pre-registered falsifiability gates (SNR, phase velocity, and focal radiation correlation). This work advances proactive earthquake risk management.
本文提出了基于声重力波的岩石圈-大气圈-电离层耦合（LAIC-AGW）统一理论。利用日本超密集Netatmo物联网气象站的实时气压、温度和湿度数据，定量捕捉震前热力学异常与震后大气波传播。通过Bolton热力学方程计算等效位温，在熊本地震前数小时检测到显著的温度激增（27.99 K）。结合连续小波变……

结合Bolton热力学方程计算等效位温，并采用连续小波变换与延迟叠加波束形成算法。
Real-time time-series data consisting of 28,879 records of barometric pressure, temperature, and relative humidity from a dense crowdsourced Netatmo IoT weather station array in Japan.

Detection of a pre-seismic thermal spike of 27.99 K prior to the M7.1 Kumamoto event and 100% satisfaction of three pre-registered falsifiability gates across four major earthquakes.
在熊本地震前数小时检测到27.99 K的等效位温异常，且完全满足三项可证伪性检验指标。
The analysis is constrained by the spatial distribution of crowdsourced IoT sensors and potential local non-seismic meteorological noise.

First quantitative unification of LAIC-AGW theory using ultra-dense crowdsourced IoT weather networks and thermodynamic state equations for pre-seismic anomaly verification.
