sum: This study investigates subsurface structure, gas migration, and submarine slope instability in the S2 canyon area of the Danube Fan, northwestern Black Sea. The authors integrate two high-resolution 2-D multichannel seismic (MCS) profiles with 4-component ocean-bottom seismometer (OBS) datasets, correlated with MeBo200 borehole data. Using 2-D ray-tracing forward modelling (RAYINVR) of P-wave and P-to-S converted reflections, they derive P- and S-wave velocity models and Vp/Vs ratios down to 1.2 km depth. Results reveal persistently low P- and S-wave velocities and high Vp/Vs ratios (up to 10.6 in shallow units), indicating weak, under-consolidated clay-rich levee deposits interspersed with mass-transport deposits. Seismic chimneys, polarity reversals, and local Vp drops (80–190 m/s) below bottom-simulating reflectors (BSRs) demonstrate focused free-gas accumulations. The absence of Vs anomalies indicates sparse, non-cementing pore-filling hydrates, establishing the Danube Fan as a hydrate-poor, gas-active endmember where slope failure is controlled by under-consolidation and gas overpressure.
本研究利用高分辨率二维多道地震（MCS）和四分量海底地震仪（OBS）数据，结合MeBo200钻井约束，研究了黑海西北部多瑙河扇S2峡谷斜坡失稳区的地下结构与流体运移。通过拾取P波及P-S转换波反射走时并进行二维射线追踪正演模拟（RAYINVR），构建了1.2 km深度内的Vp、Vs及Vp/Vs模型。……

t: P-wave and P-to-S converted reflections were correlated between zero-offset aligned OBS and MCS records, then jointly forward-modelled via 2-D ray-tracing (RAYINVR) to determine layer geometries, Vp, Vs, and Vp/Vs ratios.
将零偏移距对齐的OBS和MCS记录关联拾取P波与P-S转换波，利用二维射线追踪（RAYINVR）正演模拟获取Vp、Vs及…
Two 2-D high-resolution MCS profiles (GI airgun ~130 Hz, 144-channel streamer) and eight 4-component OBS stations acquired during cruise MSM-34 on the western flank of the S2 canyon, Danube Fan.
MSM-34航次在多瑙河扇S2峡谷西翼采集的2条高分辨率二维MCS剖面（144道）与8台四分量OBS记录。

Vp increases from 1510 m/s at the seafloor to 1900 m/s at ~1.2 km depth, while Vs increases from 140 to 810–860 m/s (Vp/Vs decreasing from 10.6 to 2.2), with local Vp drops of 80–190 m/s at gas anomalies.
海底至1.2 km深处Vp从1510增至1900 m/s，Vs从140增至860 m/s（Vp/Vs从10.6降至2.2…

Absence of refracted arrivals and limited offset range (~0.9 km) of converted S-waves restrict velocity analysis to localized zones beneath each OBS and reduce sensitivity to vertical velocity gradients.
缺乏清晰折射波且转换S波偏移距有限（约0.9 km），限制了垂向梯度灵敏度及台站间的横向分辨率。

Establishes the Danube Fan as a hydrate-poor, gas-active endmember where non-cementing pore-filling hydrates lack Vs anomalies and slope instability is driven by under-consolidation and free-gas overpressure.
揭示多瑙河扇为“贫水合物、富游离气”端元，无Vs异常证实水合物非胶结，斜坡失稳由欠压实与气体超压主导。

kc: Derived joint 2-D P- and S-wave velocity and Vp/Vs models down to 1.2 km depth across the S2 slope failure zone in the Danube Fan using integrated OBS and MCS data.

Demonstrated that shallow sediments are persistently under-consolidated with high Vp/Vs ratios (up to 10.6) and low shear wave velocities (140 m/s at the seafloor), preconditioning the slope for failure.

Showed that gas hydrates lack S-wave velocity anomalies and occur as sparse, non-cementing pore-filling accumulations (<10% saturation), whereas free gas trapped beneath BSRs and seals causes 80–190 m/s Vp reductions and drives localized overpressure.
利用联合OBS和MCS数据，构建了横跨多瑙河扇S2斜坡失稳区深达1.2 km的二维P波、S波速度及Vp/Vs比值模型。
证实浅表沉积物持续处于欠压实状态，具有高Vp/Vs比值（最高10.6）和低剪切波速（海底处140 m/s），为斜坡失稳提供了先决条件。
阐明天然气水合物无S波速度异常，仅呈稀疏非胶结孔隙充填（饱和度<10%），而BSR和低渗盖层下圈闭的游离气引起80–190 m/s的Vp下降并驱动局部超压。
me: 4-component OBS data processing including clock drift correction, direct-wave seafloor relocation, horizontal geophone rotation into radial/transverse components, and frequency filtering (20–40 Hz for P, <20 Hz for S).

2-D high-resolution MCS processing including crooked-line CMP binning, Radon filtering, deconvolution, water-velocity Stolt migration, residual finite-difference migration, and OBS-guided depth conversion.
Zero-offset time alignment between OBS hydrophone records and MCS reflection horizons to correlate P-wave and P-to-S converted reflections.
Iterative 2-D ray-tracing travel-time forward modelling using PASTEUP and RAYINVR to jointly constrain layer geometries, Vp, Vs, and layer-constant Vp/Vs ratios.
四分量OBS数据处理，包括钟差校正、直达波海底重定位、水平检波器旋转至径向/切向分量以及分频滤波（P波20–40 Hz，S波<20 Hz）。
二维高分辨率MCS处理，包括弯线CMP道集抽取、Radon滤波、反褶积、水速Stolt偏移、剩余有限差分偏移以及基于OBS速度模型的深度转换。
OBS水听器记录与MCS反射同相轴的零偏移距时间对齐，以关联P波与P-S转换波反射相位。
使用PASTEUP和RAYINVR进行迭代二维射线追踪走时正演模拟，联合约束层界面几何形态、Vp、Vs及层内常Vp/Vs比值。
de: Two 2-D high-resolution MCS profiles (Profiles A and B) acquired during cruise MSM-34 using a 0.74 L / 0.74 L GI airgun (~130 Hz center frequency) and a 144-channel, 237.5 m active-length streamer.
Eight 4-component OBS deployments (four per profile, 4.5 Hz 3C geophones and hydrophone, 1000 Hz sampling rate) at water depths of ~600–800 m on the western flank of the S2 canyon.
Shipboard multibeam bathymetry (EM 122, 12 kHz, 25 m x 25 m grid) and lithological/petrophysical ground-truth constraints from nearby MeBo200 boreholes (MeBo-17/19, up to 147 mbsf).
MSM-34航次采集的两条二维高分辨率MCS剖面（剖面A和B），使用0.74 L / 0.74 L GI气枪（中心频率约130 Hz）和144道、有效长度237.5 m的拖缆。
S2峡谷西翼水深约600–800 m处布设的8台四分量OBS台站（每条剖面4台，配4.5 Hz三分量检波器和水听器，采样率1000 Hz）。
船载多波束测深数据（EM 122，12 kHz，25 m × 25 m网格）以及邻近MeBo200钻孔（MeBo-17/19，深达海底以下147 m）的岩性与岩石物理实测约束。
li: Absence of clear refracted phases across the OBS array and limited S-wave offset range (~0.9 km) restrict velocity resolution to localized zones beneath stations and prevent resolving vertical Vp/Vs gradients within layers.
One station (OBS 3002) had to be excluded from S-wave analysis due to poor seafloor coupling, and several stations drifted ~30 m offline during deployment.
Small-scale lateral heterogeneities (such as the velocity pull-down in the seismic chimney or velocities at the deeper BSR2) are poorly constrained by sparse OBS spacing and ray coverage.
OBS台阵缺乏清晰折射波且转换S波偏移距有限（约0.9 km），使速度分辨率局限于台站下方局部区域，无法分辨层内垂向Vp/Vs梯度。
OBS 3002台站因海底耦合不良被排除在S波分析之外，且部分台站在投放时偏离测线约30 m。
受限于稀疏的OBS台站间距和射线覆盖，小尺度横向非均质性（如气烟囱内的速度下拉或深部BSR2处的速度）约束较弱。

tm.why: Derives 2-D P- and S-wave velocity models and Vp/Vs ratios of marine sediments using travel-time ray-tracing forward modelling of OBS reflections.
Integrates 4-component ocean-bottom seismometer (OBS) records with high-resolution 2-D multichannel seismic (MCS) streamer data.
Investigates submarine slope instability, marine geohazards, and gas hydrate dynamics in a continental margin deep-sea fan.

ev.notes: Full 24-page PDF of the published Solid Earth article used, including all sections, equations, references, and 10 figures.

sum: This Zenodo repository contains the model input files, geometry, frictional parameters, and simulated event catalogues (time, magnitude, location) associated with the paper 'Single Fault Earthquake Cycle Complexity' by Sun and Becker (2026). The simulations were conducted using the quasi-dynamic boundary element code HBI. The dataset includes a summary spreadsheet mapping each model run to its corresponding figure, frictional parameters, analysis window, and recurrence statistics, enabling full reproducibility of the study's findings on fault complexity.

sum: This study investigates the 2009 L'Aquila seismic sequence to understand the mechanisms driving aftershock distribution. By analyzing the fault-zone architecture and seismicity patterns, the authors demonstrate that the spatial and temporal evolution of aftershocks is highly controlled by both the structural complexity of the fault zone and fluid migration processes. The findings highlight that seismicity patterns closely mirror the underlying fault network and are modulated by fluid-driven pore pressure changes, providing key insights into fault mechanics and post-seismic relaxation processes in carbonate environments.
本研究以2009年意大利拉奎拉地震序列为对象，探讨了控制余震分布的物理机制。通过分析断层带几何结构与地震活动性模式，研究表明余震的时空演化受断层带复杂结构与流体运移过程的共同控制。研究指出，地震活动空间分布反映了深部断层网络的复杂性，而流体扩散导致的孔隙压变化则调制了余震的时间演化。该成果为理解碳酸……

t: High-resolution earthquake relocation and spatial-temporal analysis of aftershocks combined with structural mapping to resolve fault-zone geometry and fluid diffusion pathways.
结合高精度地震重定位、余震时空分析与断层结构制图，解析断层带几何形态及流体扩散路径。
Seismic catalog and waveform data from the 2009 L'Aquila (Italy) earthquake sequence.
2009年意大利拉奎拉（L'Aquila）地震序列的地震目录及波形数据。
Aftershock distribution is highly controlled by fault-zone architecture, with fluid migration modulating the temporal evolution of seismicity along complex fault networks.
余震分布高度受断层带结构控制，流体运移调制了复杂断层网络上地震活动的时间演化。
Fluid migration pathways are inferred indirectly from seismicity spatiotemporal evolution, lacking direct in-situ fluid pressure measurements.

Integrates detailed fault-zone structural architecture with fluid diffusion modeling to explain the fine-scale spatial-temporal distribution of aftershocks.
将详细的断层带结构几何与流体扩散模拟相结合，解释了余震的精细时空分布特征。

kc: Demonstrated the joint control of fault-zone architecture and fluid migration on aftershock distribution.
Mapped the relationship between seismicity patterns and the underlying fault network for the 2009 L'Aquila sequence.
证明了断层带结构与流体运移对余震分布的联合控制作用。
厘清了2009年拉奎拉序列中地震活动模式与深部断层网络之间的关系。
me: High-resolution earthquake relocation and spatial-temporal analysis of the aftershock catalog.
Structural characterization of the fault zone and modeling of fluid diffusion processes.
余震目录的高精度地震重定位与时空特征分析。

sum: This study investigates the 3D seismic structure and mantle flow dynamics beneath the curved Calabrian subduction zone in the Mediterranean. Using seismic travel-time tomography, the authors image the geometry of the subducting Calabrian slab and the surrounding mantle flow patterns. The results reveal complex mantle flow controlled by slab rollback and tearing, shedding light on the geodynamic evolution and formation mechanism of the highly curved Calabrian arc.
本研究利用地震走时层析成像技术，系统研究了地中海卡拉布里亚弯曲俯冲带的三维地震波速度与各向异性结构。研究揭示了俯冲卡拉布里亚板块的几何形态及其周围的地幔流模式，表明地幔流受到板块后撤和撕裂的强烈控制。这些发现为理解该地区高度弯曲弧形构造的形成机制与动力学演化提供了关键的深部地球物理证据。

t: Seismic travel-time tomography imaging 3D velocity and anisotropy structures beneath the Calabrian arc.
利用地震走时层析成像反演卡拉布里亚弧下方的三维速度与各向异性结构。
Seismic arrival-time data from regional and teleseismic earthquakes recorded by stations in Italy and surrounding regions.
利用意大利及周边地区台站记录的区域和远震地震走时数据。
Detailed 3D images showing slab geometry, slab tears, and toroidal mantle flow around the edges of the Calabrian slab.
获得了显示板块几何形态、板块撕裂及卡拉布里亚板块边缘环流的高分辨率三维图像。
Resolution is lower in marine areas due to the lack of ocean-bottom seismic stations.
由于缺乏海底地震台站，海洋区域的成像分辨率较低。
First high-resolution anisotropic tomography revealing the detailed coupling between slab rollback and toroidal mantle flow in Calabria.
首次通过高分辨率各向异性层析成像揭示了板块后撤与环向地幔流之间的耦合关系。

kc: Imaged the high-resolution 3D seismic structure and anisotropy of the Calabrian subduction zone.
Revealed the detailed geometry and potential tearing of the subducting Calabrian slab.
Elucidated the mantle flow patterns driven by slab rollback and their role in shaping the curved arc.
获得了卡拉布里亚俯冲带高分辨率的三维地震波速度与各向异性图像。
揭示了俯冲卡拉布里亚板块的详细几何形态及潜在的板块撕裂。
阐明了板块后撤驱动的地幔流模式及其在塑造弯曲弧形构造中的作用。

sum: This study investigates the 3D P-wave velocity structure down to 700 km depth beneath the Izu-Bonin-Mariana (IBM) subduction zone using seismic tomography. The results reveal distinct low-velocity anomalies representing deep mantle upwelling (DMU) triggered by devolatilization and melting of the subducted Pacific slab. Beneath the Izu-Bonin arc, the DMU tilts upward from the upper mantle bottom, whereas beneath the central Mariana Trough, it extends subvertically from the mantle transition zone. The authors propose that these distinct DMU morphologies control the different stages of arc rifting and back-arc spreading in the IBM system, providing crucial seismological evidence for deep-mantle-driven surface tectonics.
本研究利用地震断层成像技术，获得了伊豆-小笠原-马里亚纳（IBM）俯冲带深至700公里的三维P波速度结构。结果显示，在伊豆-小笠原和马里亚纳中部下方存在显著的低速异常，代表由太平洋俯冲板块脱水和熔融触发的深部地幔上涌（DMU）。伊豆-小笠原下方的DMU自上地幔底部向上倾斜延伸，而马里亚纳中部下方的D……

利用三维P波走时地震断层成像方法，获得了伊豆-小笠原-马里亚纳俯冲带深至700公里的速度结构。
P-wave arrival times from local, regional, and teleseismic earthquakes recorded by seismic networks in the Izu-Bonin-Mariana region.
使用伊豆-小笠原-马里亚纳地区地震台网记录到的局部、区域及远震P波走时数据。
Distinct low-velocity anomalies representing deep mantle upwelling are imaged, tilting upward beneath Izu-Bonin and extending subvertically beneath central Mariana.
揭示了代表深部地幔上涌的低速异常：伊豆-小笠原下方呈倾斜向上，而马里亚纳中部下方呈近垂直延伸。
Resolution may be limited by the distribution of seismic stations and earthquakes in the oceanic region.
由于海洋区域地震台站和地震分布的限制，部分区域的分辨率可能受限。
Provides seismological evidence linking distinct deep mantle upwelling morphologies to different stages of arc rifting and back-arc spreading.

Identified distinct morphologies of deep mantle upwelling (tilted beneath Izu-Bonin vs. subvertical beneath central Mariana).

sum: This paper (Part I) presents a systematic analysis of newly-detected small seismic events in and near the Northern Korean Peninsula from 2004 to 2010. By applying waveform cross-correlation and template-matching techniques to regional seismic data, the authors identify previously uncataloged low-magnitude earthquakes and explosions. They perform high-precision relative relocation of these events, significantly improving the completeness and spatial resolution of the regional seismic catalog. This work helps delineate active fault structures and provides critical data for distinguishing between natural tectonic events and anthropogenic seismic sources in a geophysically and politically significant region.
本文（第一部分）系统分析了2004至2010年间朝鲜半岛北部及其周边新检测到的微小地震事件。作者利用波形互相关和模板匹配技术处理区域地震数据，识别出此前未被编目的低震级地震和爆炸事件。通过高精度相对重定位，显著提高了区域地震目录的完整性和空间分辨率。该研究有助于揭示活动断裂构造，并为区分该敏感区域的……

t: Waveform cross-correlation and template matching are used to detect small seismic events, followed by relative relocation to improve spatial resolution.
利用波形互相关和模板匹配检测微小地震，并进行相对重定位以提高空间分辨率。
Regional seismic waveform data recorded in and around the Northern Korean Peninsula from 2004 to 2010.
2004至2010年间在朝鲜半岛北部及其周边记录的区域地震波形数据。
Successful detection of numerous small, previously uncataloged seismic events and high-precision relative locations that delineate fine-scale structures.
成功检测到大量此前未编目的微小地震事件，并通过高精度相对定位描绘了微细构造。
Detection threshold and location accuracy are constrained by the historical regional station coverage between 2004 and 2010.
检测阈值和定位精度受限于2004至2010年间历史区域台站的覆盖范围。
First systematic application of advanced correlation-based detection and relocation to a multi-year dataset in the Northern Korean Peninsula.
首次将先进的基于互相关的检测和重定位技术系统应用于朝鲜半岛北部的多年数据集。

Achieved high-precision relative relocation of these events using waveform cross-correlation.
Improved the completeness and spatial resolution of the regional seismic catalog for monitoring purposes.

sum: Mineral precipitation and dissolution alter rock pore structure, stress, and hydraulic properties, but existing continuum simulators lack physically grounded chemo-mechanics formulations. This paper introduces a poromechanics-based framework integrated into the open-source GEOS simulator, coupling finite-volume reactive transport with finite-element geomechanics and phase-field fracture modeling via a fixed-strain sequential scheme. Unlike classical inelastic-strain (eigenstrain) methods that lump host rock and pore minerals into a single solid phase with identical stiffness, the proposed formulation explicitly distinguishes host-rock effective stress, pore fluid pressure, and pore mineral pressure while accounting for mineral compressibility. Analytical and numerical comparisons on serpentinization and calcite carbonation demonstrate that the inelastic-strain approach overestimates expansion and fails to generate local tensile effective stress under confinement. Conversely, the poromechanics-based framework translates pore-scale mineral growth into mineralization pressure, successfully capturing tensile effective stress evolution, crack nucleation, and positive feedbacks with permeability and reactive transport at the continuum scale.
针对岩石矿物沉淀与溶解引起的化-水-力耦合过程，本文提出了一种基于孔隙力学的理论与数值框架，并集成至开源模拟器GEOS中，采用固定应变顺序格式耦合有限体积反应输运、有限元地质力学与相场断裂模型。相较于将基质与孔隙矿物视为同一固相的非弹性应变法，该方法明确区分基质有效应力、孔隙流体压力与矿物结晶压力，……

t: A poromechanics-based chemo-hydro-mechanical formulation implemented in GEOS via mixed finite-element/finite-volume discretization and a fixed-strain sequential split, resolving separate host-rock effective stress, pore fluid pressure, and pore mineral pressure.
在GEOS中采用混合有限元/有限体积与固定应变分裂，分别求解基质有效应力、流体压力与矿物压力。

Three synthetic 1D and 2D numerical benchmarks of olivine serpentinization and calcite carbonation coupled with phase-field fracture propagation, including qualitative comparison to laboratory core-expansion cracking.
三个一维和二维橄榄石蛇纹石化与方解石碳化数值算例，结合相场断裂并与实验室岩心开裂定性对比。

The poromechanics-based method predicts smaller, compressibility-dependent expansion than the inelastic-strain method and uniquely captures tensile effective stress (up to ~25 kPa in the carbonation test) that nucleates fractures under full confinement.
孔隙力学法预测的膨胀受矿物可压缩性调节，且能唯一捕捉全约束下诱发裂纹萌生的拉伸有效应力。

The current implementation assumes isotropic material behavior, identical stiffness for all pore minerals, constant skeleton elastic moduli during porosity evolution, and a conditionally stable semi-implicit reaction-strain update.
当前实现假设材料各向同性、孔隙矿物刚度相同、骨架模量恒定，且半隐式更新仅条件稳定。

Distinguishes host-rock effective stress from pore mineral pressure and fluid pressure within a continuum reactive-transport framework, enabling reaction-driven fracture simulation without explicitly resolving pore microstructure.
在连续介质反应输运框架中区分基质有效应力与孔隙矿物压力，无需解析微观孔隙即可模拟反应致裂。

kc: Formulated a continuum poromechanics-based chemo-mechanical coupling model that explicitly separates host-rock effective stress, pore fluid pressure, and pore mineral pressure.
Implemented the coupled finite-volume reactive transport, finite-element geomechanics, and phase-field fracture solver in GEOS using a fixed-strain sequential split and GPU-callable HPCReact.

Demonstrated via analytical and numerical comparisons against the inelastic-strain method that accounting for mineral compressibility prevents overestimation of volumetric expansion and captures local tension-driven reaction cracking under confinement.
建立了基于连续介质孔隙力学的化-力耦合模型，明确区分了主岩有效应力、孔隙流体压力和孔隙矿物压力。
在GEOS中采用固定应变顺序分裂算法和GPU可调用的HPCReact库，实现了有限体积反应输运、有限元地质力学与相场断裂的耦合求解。
通过与非弹性应变法的解析和数值对比，证明计入矿物可压缩性可避免高估体积膨胀，并能捕捉全约束条件下由局部拉伸有效应力驱动的反应致裂。
me: Poromechanics-based constitutive formulation distinguishing host rock skeleton stiffness, solid grain stiffness, fluid compressibility, and pore mineral bulk modulus.
Mixed finite element (Q1 continuous nodal displacements) and finite volume (P0 cell-centered pressure and log-concentrations with TPFA) discretization in GEOS.
Iterative fixed-strain sequential splitting scheme coupling reactive transport and geomechanics, combined with AT1 phase-field fracture modeling and damage-dependent permeability/diffusivity.
区分主岩骨架刚度、固体颗粒刚度、流体可压缩性及孔隙矿物バル克模量的孔隙力学本构方程。
在GEOS中采用混合有限元（Q1连续节点位移）与有限体积（P0网格中心压力与对数浓度，两点通量近似）离散格式。
耦合反应输运与地质力学的迭代固定应变顺序分裂格式，结合AT1相场断裂模型及依赖于损伤的渗透率/扩散率演化。
de: 1D serpentinization simulation (forsterite, serpentine, brucite) with an exponential mineral surface area gradient comparing displacement and stress across methods and mineral bulk moduli.
2D quarter-cylinder radial core expansion and phase-field cracking simulation of serpentinization, qualitatively compared against laboratory radial cracking patterns from Zheng et al. (2019).

2D confined rectangular strip simulation of CO2-driven calcite carbonation with spatially heterogeneous critical fracture energy to test continuum-scale crack nucleation from pore-scale mineral growth.
具有指数矿物比表面积梯度的一维蛇纹石化模拟（镁橄榄石、蛇纹石、水镁石），对比不同方法及矿物模量下的位移与应力响应。
蛇纹石化引起的二维四分之一圆柱岩心径向膨胀与相场开裂模拟，并与Zheng等（2019）的实验室径向裂纹形态进行定性对比。
全约束二维矩形条带中CO2驱动方解石碳化模拟，引入空间非均质临界断裂能，测试孔隙尺度矿物生长在连续介质尺度诱发的裂纹萌生与扩展。
li: Numerical implementation assumes isotropic material behavior, isotropic mineral stress and porosity, and identical elastic stiffness for all coexisting pore mineral phases.
Elastic stiffness tensor of the rock skeleton is held constant as porosity evolves, neglecting microscopic pore adaptivity effects.
Semi-implicit porosity update uses reaction rates from the previous converged timestep, making the sequential scheme only conditionally stable.
数值实现假设材料各向同性、矿物应力与孔隙度各向同性，且假设孔隙内所有共存矿物相具有相同的弹性刚度。
假设岩石骨架弹性刚度张量在孔隙度演化过程中保持恒定，忽略了微观孔隙自适应效应。
半隐式孔隙度更新使用上一收敛时间步的反应速率，使得顺序求解格式仅具有条件稳定性。

tm.why: The paper develops a continuum-scale coupled chemo-hydro-mechanical framework in GEOS aimed at reservoir-scale analyses of engineered subsurface systems like geologic carbon storage and geothermal reservoirs.
The study models rock deformation, effective stress evolution, and reaction-driven fracture nucleation and propagation in porous rocks using phase-field fracture mechanics.

ev.notes: Full 54-page PDF read and analyzed, including mathematical derivations in Sections 2-4, Algorithm 1, three numerical benchmarks in Section 5 (Figs. 1-20, Tables 1-6), and Appendix A.

sum: This study utilizes autonomous hydrophone records (2010–2022) to relocate 2,356 mid-ocean ridge earthquakes along the Southwest, Central, and Southeast Indian Ridges. By classifying segments into magmatic and tectonic types and propagating uncertainties via a Monte Carlo workflow, the authors calculate seismic moment budgets. They find that tectonic segments consistently release more seismic moment per unit length than magmatic ones. Relocated seismicity is tightly focused near the ridge axis (≤15 km) on the CIR and SEIR, but broader (≤30 km) on the SWIR. Fitting a tapered Gutenberg-Richter law reveals that coupled seismogenic thickness decreases from 1300 m to 70 m as spreading rate and magma supply increase. This supports a general model where mid-ocean ridge normal faulting is accommodated by a mix of seismic and aseismic slip modulated by local magma supply.
本研究利用自主水听器记录（2010-2022年）对印度洋西南、中印度和东南洋脊的2356个地震进行了重定位。通过将洋脊段分类为岩浆型和构造型，并利用蒙特卡洛工作流传播不确定性，计算了地震矩收支。结果表明，构造段单位长度释放的地震矩显著高于岩浆段。重定位地震在CIR和SEIR上更集中于脊轴（≤15 k……

t: Relocation of teleseismic events using autonomous hydrophone networks combined with a Monte-Carlo workflow to propagate location, magnitude, and focal-mechanism uncertainties to estimate seismic moment budgets.
利用自主水听器网络对远震事件进行重定位，并结合蒙特卡洛工作流传播定位、震级和震源机制不确定性以估算地震矩收支。
Autonomous hydrophone records from the OHA-SIS-BIO and IMS networks (2010–2022) combined with teleseismic catalogs from ISC and GCMT, yielding 2,356 well-relocated mid-ocean ridge earthquakes.
2010-2022年OHA-SIS-BIO和IMS网络的自主水听器记录，结合ISC和GCMT远震目录，获得2356个重定…
Tectonic segments release more seismic moment per unit length than magmatic segments. Seismogenic thickness decreases from 1300 m to 70 m with increasing spreading rate and magma supply.
构造段单位长度释放的地震矩高于岩浆段。耦合地震发生层厚度随扩张速率和岩浆供应增加从1300米减少至70米。
Hydrophone records provide high location accuracy but limited direct information on earthquake source mechanisms.

First systematic comparison of seismic moment budgets between magmatic and tectonic segments across multiple Indian Ocean ridges using high-resolution hydrophone relocations.

Monte-Carlo workflow for propagating location, magnitude, and focal-mechanism uncertainties.

对扩张洋脊段进行形态学分类（岩浆型 vs. 构造型）。
利用蒙特卡洛工作流传播定位、震级和震源机制的不确定性。

sum: This study presents NWCH, a 3D radially anisotropic seismic velocity model of the lithosphere beneath northwestern China, western Mongolia, and eastern Kazakhstan derived via multiscale full-waveform inversion (FWI). To test whether FWI requires a complex 3D starting model, the author constructed a simple isotropic starting model (Asia1D) featuring a linear crustal velocity gradient and ak135-f mantle properties, while honoring 3D CRUST1.0 crustal thickness variations and surface topography. Using the Salvus spectral-element solver and trust-region L-BFGS optimization, broadband waveforms from 90 regional earthquakes were inverted across 8 stages from 50–100 s down to 16–80 s over 106 iterations. The NWCH model significantly improves waveform fits and yields higher time-bandwidth products than Asia1D, SPiRaL, and SinoScope1.0. It clearly images major tectonic features—such as the low-velocity Tarim, Junggar, and Qaidam basins, fast Tarim and North China cratons, and slow Tibetan Plateau—and strong radial anisotropy.
本研究利用多尺度全波形反演（FWI）构建了中国西北、蒙古西部及哈萨克斯坦东部岩石圈三维径向各向异性波速模型（NWCH）。为检验FWI对复杂三维初始模型的依赖性，作者采用包含线性地壳梯度和ak135-f地幔属性、但融合CRUST1.0三维地壳厚度变化和地表起伏的简单各向同性初始模型（Asia1D）。基……

t: Multiscale full-waveform inversion using Salvus spectral-element simulations and trust-region L-BFGS optimization of time-frequency phase misfits across 8 stages (50–100 s to 16–80 s) for radially anisotropic wavespeeds.
基于Salvus谱元模拟与信赖域L-BFGS算法，在8个阶段（50-100 s至16-80 s）开展时频相位残差多尺度径…
Openly available broadband seismic waveforms from 90 regional GCMT earthquakes recorded across northwestern China and surrounding regions.
从200多个GCMT地震中筛选出的90个区域地震在西北及邻区公开台网记录的宽频带波形。

The 106-iteration FWI reduces misfit by >40% in stage 0 and 11–23% in subsequent stages, yielding superior time-bandwidth products down to 16 s and resolving key lithospheric velocity and anisotropy structures.
经106次迭代，首阶段残差下降超40%，后续阶段降11-23%，TBP显著优于已有三维模型并清晰成像岩石圈与各向异性。
Broadband seismic networks provide uneven spatial coverage across the study region, and inversion resolution is limited to a minimum period of 16 seconds.
研究区宽频带台网空间覆盖不均，且反演最短周期止于16秒。

Demonstrates that multiscale FWI can recover complex 3D radially anisotropic lithospheric structure in Central Asia starting from a simple isotropic 1D-gradient model that honors 3D Moho and topography.
证实仅依靠引入三维地壳厚度和地形的简单各向同性初始模型，多尺度FWI即可重建复杂三维各向异性结构。

kc: Developed a new 3D radially anisotropic lithospheric model (NWCH) for Northwest China and surrounding regions down to 16 s minimum period.
Demonstrated that multiscale FWI can converge to realistic 3D tectonic structures from a simple 1D-gradient starting model if 3D crustal thickness and topography are honored.
Quantified model performance using time-bandwidth products (TBP), showing NWCH outperforms Asia1D, SPiRaL, and SinoScope1.0 in regional waveform fitting.
构建了中国西北及邻区最短周期达16秒的新型三维径向各向异性岩石圈波速模型（NWCH）。
证明只要准确引入三维地壳厚度与地表地形变化，多尺度全波形反演即可从简单的准一维初始模型收敛出真实的三维构造。
利用时间带宽积（TBP）量化评估了模型表现，证实NWCH在区域波形拟合上优于Asia1D、SPiRaL和SinoScope1.0模型。

Forward and adjoint spectral-element wavefield simulations using Salvus software.
Time-frequency phase misfit minimization via a trust-region L-BFGS optimization algorithm solving for radially anisotropic parameters (vSV, vSH, vPV, vPH).
Automated waveform window selection and model evaluation using time-bandwidth product (TBP) metrics.
在8个周期频段（从50–100秒逐步过渡至16–80秒，共106次迭代）开展多尺度迭代全波形反演。
使用Salvus软件进行谱元法正演与伴随波场模拟。
基于信赖域L-BFGS优化算法极小化时频相位走时残差，反演径向各向异性波速参数（vSV, vSH, vPV, vPH）。

90 well-recorded regional earthquakes selected from a pool of over 200 GCMT events.
Starting model (Asia1D) combining CRUST1.0 Moho depth, surface topography, a linear crustal velocity gradient, and ak135-f mantle structure.
Benchmark waveform comparisons against global/regional 3D models SPiRaL and SinoScope1.0.

Density and attenuation are not inverted directly during the FWI updates.

The resulting NWCH model resolves major tectonic provinces including sedimentary basins, cratons, and the Tibetan Plateau across the crust and upper mantle.
The inversion solves for radially anisotropic shear and compressional wavespeeds, revealing strong crustal and upper-mantle radial anisotropy.

sum: Large-scale linear inverse problems ($Gm = d$) face high $O(N^3)$ computational and storage costs when solved via general Tikhonov regularization or numerical Singular Value Decomposition (SVD). This paper establishes a spectral-domain pseudo-inverse construction method for square kernel matrices diagonalizable by unitary transforms ($G = T^H \Lambda T$). The author derives an explicit analytical SVD by introducing a phase diagonal matrix $P$, avoiding numerical SVD computation. Using spectral-domain regularization filter factors $q_\alpha(\lambda_k) = \overline{\lambda_k}/(|\lambda_k|^2 + \alpha)$, a pseudo-inverse operator $G_\alpha^{\#} = T^H Q_\alpha T$ is constructed. Mathematical proofs confirm its bounded stability ($\|G_\alpha^{\#}\|_2 \le 1/(2\sqrt{\alpha})$) and convergence to the Moore–Penrose generalized inverse as $\alpha \to 0^+$. Although numerically equivalent to zeroth-order Tikhonov regularization, this approach directly exploits matrix spectral structure, unifying frequency-domain deconvolution under the discrete Fourier transform into a broader unitary transform framework.

Purely analytical study without numerical experiments; illustrates the theory using the discrete Fourier transform special case ($T = F$) for circulant convolution matrices and frequency-domain deconvolution.

Restricted to square matrices that are diagonalizable by a unitary transform ($G = T^H \Lambda T$), requiring extensions for spatially varying or nonlinear inverse problems.
要求核矩阵为方阵且严格满足酉可对角化结构，空间变化或非线性问题需额外近似扩展。

Establishes an explicit analytical SVD and direct transform-domain pseudo-inverse construction for general unitary diagonalizable matrices, clarifying its methodological distinction from Tikhonov regularization.
给出了一般酉可对角化矩阵的显式解析SVD及谱域伪逆直接构造方法，阐明了与Tikhonov正则化的方法论差异。

kc: Derives an explicit analytical SVD for unitary diagonalizable matrices ($G = T^H \Lambda T$) using a phase diagonal matrix $P$, bypassing numerical SVD bottlenecks.
Constructs a spectral-domain pseudo-inverse operator $G_\alpha^{\#}$ and proves its bounded stability and consistent convergence to the Moore–Penrose generalized inverse.
Clarifies the numerical equivalence and methodological independence between the proposed spectral-domain construction and zeroth-order Tikhonov regularization, generalizing Fourier deconvolution.
利用相位对角矩阵$P$推导了酉可对角化矩阵（$G = T^H \Lambda T$）的解析显式SVD，绕过了数值SVD的计算瓶颈。
构建了谱域伪逆算子$G_\alpha^{\#}$，并严格证明了其有界稳定性及向Moore–Penrose广义逆收敛的一致性。

me: Analytical Singular Value Decomposition for unitary diagonalizable matrices incorporating a complex phase diagonal matrix.
Spectral-domain regularization filtering with continuous attenuation factor $q_\alpha(\lambda_k) = \overline{\lambda_k}/(|\lambda_k|^2 + \alpha)$.
Theoretical proof of operator norm bounds ($\|G_\alpha^{\#}\|_2 \le 1/(2\sqrt{\alpha})$) and asymptotic consistency ($\alpha \to 0^+$).
结合复相位对角矩阵的酉可对角化矩阵解析奇异值分解。
采用连续衰减因子$q_\alpha(\lambda_k) = \overline{\lambda_k}/(|\lambda_k|^2 + \alpha)$的谱域正则化滤波。
算子范数有界性（$\|G_\alpha^{\#}\|_2 \le 1/(2\sqrt{\alpha})$）与渐近一致性（$\alpha \to 0^+$）的理论证明。
de: Purely theoretical and mathematical derivations; no numerical datasets or experimental figures are presented in this manuscript.
Discusses the special case of the discrete Fourier transform ($T = F$) corresponding to circulant convolution and geophysical wavenumber-domain downward continuation.
纯理论与数学推导研究，正文中未包含数值数据集或实验图表。
讨论了离散傅里叶变换（$T = F$）特例，对应于循环褶积反演及地球物理位场波数域向下延拓。
li: Strictly requires the kernel matrix to be square and unitary diagonalizable ($G = T^H \Lambda T$), corresponding to spatially invariant or structured systems.
Directly handles only linear inverse problems without immediate applicability to general non-square or strongly nonlinear systems.
严格要求核矩阵为方阵且可被酉矩阵对角化（$G = T^H \Lambda T$），仅直接适用于空间不变或特定结构化系统。
仅直接处理线性反问题，无法直接应用于一般非方阵或强非线性系统。

tm.why: The paper establishes a mathematical spectral-domain pseudo-inverse construction method for unitary diagonalizable linear inverse problems.

sum: This study presents the first 2D scattering and intrinsic absorption maps of Metropolitan France across seven frequency bands from 0.375 to 24 Hz. Using ~20,802 regional earthquake waveforms (ML 2.0–5.9, hypocentral distance <250 km) from the EPOS-FR and CEA networks, the authors invert S-wave energy envelopes using a hybrid grid-search (for scattering anisotropy) and Levenberg-Marquardt linearized inversion. Forward envelopes and partial derivatives are computed via differential Monte Carlo simulations of 3D elastic radiative transfer in a crustal waveguide with P-S mode conversions and Moho energy leakage. Path-averaged attenuation estimates are then mapped onto a 40×40 km grid using ray-based least-squares tomography with second-order Tikhonov regularization. Results show scattering dominates below 1 Hz while absorption dominates above 1 Hz. Spatial variations reach factors of ~10 for scattering and ~4 for absorption, correlating strongly with Cenozoic/Mesozoic sedimentary basins, Variscan massifs, and alpine ranges, offering key inputs for non-ergodic ground-motion models.
本研究首次给出了法国本土0.375–24 Hz七个频段的二维地壳散射与吸收衰减分布图。研究利用EPOS-FR和CEA台网记录的约2.1万条地方震波形（ML 2.0–5.9，震源距<250 km），采用微分蒙特卡洛方法模拟考虑地壳波导效应、P-S波耦合及散射各向异性的三维弹性辐射传输过程，通过网格搜索……

t: A two-step method combining single-path Monte Carlo elastic radiative transfer envelope inversion (grid search on scattering anisotropy plus Levenberg-Marquardt optimization of scattering/absorption) with 2D ray-based least-squares tomography using second-order Tikhonov regularization.
结合单路径蒙特卡洛弹性辐射传输包络反演与二阶Tikhonov正则化二维射线最小二乘层析成像。

20,802 waveforms (yielding 67,936 selected energy envelopes across 7 frequency bands from 0.375 to 24 Hz) from 2,144 crustal earthquakes (ML 2.0–5.9, distance <250 km) recorded by 622 EPOS-FR and 67 CEA stations.
622个EPOS-FR和67个CEA台站记录的2144次地壳地震的20,802条波形（0.375–24 Hz共67,93…

Scattering attenuation decreases by two orders of magnitude from 0.375 to 24 Hz (mean Q*sc from 44 to 4772) while absorption decreases by one order (mean Qi from 225 to 2227), with spatial variations up to factors of ~10 and ~4.
0.375至24 Hz间散射衰减下降两个数量级，吸收下降一个数量级，空间变化分别达约10倍和4倍。

Path inversions assume uniform properties along each path and known exponential random correlation, while 2D mapping relies on a simplified narrow-ray approximation rather than full coda sensitivity kernels.
单路径反演假设路径属性均匀，二维成像采用窄射线近似而非完整尾波敏感度核。

First 2D scattering and absorption maps of Metropolitan France (0.375–24 Hz) incorporating crustal waveguide leakage, elastic P-S coupling, and anisotropic scattering via differential Monte Carlo envelope inversion.
结合波导泄漏、P-S耦合与微分蒙特卡洛反演，首次构建法国0.375–24 Hz二维散射与吸收图。

kc: Produced the first comprehensive 2D maps of crustal scattering, intrinsic absorption, total attenuation, and seismic albedo for Metropolitan France across seven frequency bands (0.375–24 Hz).
Applied a physically realistic 3D elastic radiative transfer Monte Carlo envelope inversion accounting for crustal waveguide leakage at the Moho, P/S wave coupling, and forward scattering anisotropy.
Demonstrated that scattering dominates attenuation below 1 Hz (albedo 0.5–0.8) while absorption prevails above 1 Hz (albedo ~0.24–0.31), and neither follows a simple power-law frequency dependence.

Established clear correlations between spatial attenuation anomalies and surface geological units (e.g., strong low-frequency scattering in Quaternary/Cenozoic basins, weak attenuation in the Armorican Massif, strong absorption in the Alps and Western Pyrenees).
首次绘制了法国本土在0.375–24 Hz七个频段内的二维地壳散射、本征吸收、总衰减及地震反照率综合分布图。
应用了物理真实的3D弹性辐射传输蒙特卡洛包络反演方法，全面考虑了莫霍面地壳波导能量泄漏、P/S波耦合以及前向散射各向异性。
证实了1 Hz以下散射衰减占主导（反照率0.5–0.8），而1 Hz以上吸收占主导（反照率约0.24–0.31），且两者均不遵循简单的幂律频率依赖关系。
揭示了空间衰减异常与地表地质单元之间的明确关联（如第四纪/新生代盆地呈强低频散射，阿莫里坎地块呈弱衰减，阿尔卑斯山和西比利牛斯山呈强吸收）。
me: 3D elastic radiative transfer modeling in a flat-layered crustal waveguide (adapting crustal thickness per path) with P/S mode conversions and exponential random medium correlation.

Differential Monte Carlo simulations (5 million phonons per source-station pair) to compute synthetic energy envelopes and sensitivity kernels (partial derivatives) with respect to scattering and absorption.

Two-step inversion: (1) Single-envelope hybrid grid search over scattering anisotropy (l*S/lS = 1, 3, 10) and Levenberg-Marquardt optimization of scattering Q, intrinsic Q, and source-site amplitude product (WR)ij.
2D ray-based attenuation tomography on a 40×40 km grid solved via the LSMR algorithm with second-order Tikhonov (Laplacian) regularization (optimal lambda = 2 from L-curve analysis).
在平层状地壳波导（按路径调整地壳厚度）中进行三维弹性辐射传输建模，包含P/S波模式转换与指数型随机介质相关函数。
利用微分蒙特卡洛模拟（每对震源-台站发射500万个声子）计算合成能量包络及其对散射和吸收强度的敏感度核（偏导数）。
两步反演法：(1) 单包络混合反演，对散射各向异性（l*S/lS = 1, 3, 10）进行网格搜索，并利用Levenberg-Marquardt算法优化散射Q值、本征Q值及震源-场地振幅乘积项(WR)ij。
在40×40 km网格上进行基于射线的二维衰减层析成像，结合二阶Tikhonov（拉普拉斯）正则化（通过L曲线确定最优参数λ=2）并使用LSMR算法求解。
de: 20,802 broadband, short-period, and accelerometric waveforms from 2,144 crustal earthquakes (2.0 <= ML <= 5.9) recorded at 622 EPOS-FR and 67 CEA stations (1996–2023) at hypocentral distances of 15–250 km.

67,936 filtered velocity-squared energy envelopes across 7 octave-wide frequency bands centered at 0.375, 0.75, 1.5, 3, 6, 12, and 24 Hz meeting strict S/N (>10 peak, >40 s coda duration above S/N=4) and crustal phase criteria.
Checkerboard resolution tests and posterior covariance uncertainty mapping across Metropolitan France.
收集了1996–2023年间622个EPOS-FR台站和67个CEA台站记录的2144次地壳地震（2.0 <= ML <= 5.9，震源距15–250 km）的20,802条宽频带、短周期和强震加速度波形。
在中心频率为0.375、0.75、1.5、3、6、12和24 Hz的7个倍频程频段内提取并筛选出67,936条满足严格信噪比（峰值S/N>10，S/N>4的尾波持续时间>40 s）及地壳震相标准的能量包络。
开展了法国本土的检测板分辨率测试以及基于后验协方差矩阵的参数不确定性制图。
li: The 1D path-averaged envelope inversion assumes uniform attenuation and a single flat-layered crustal waveguide without depth stratification in velocity or attenuation, and neglects surface waves (causing minor low-frequency misfits for shallow events).
Scattering anisotropy (l*S/lS) is poorly resolved on individual paths because forward-scattering signatures rapidly wash out with distance.

The 2D tomographic mapping approximates spatial sensitivity as a narrow direct ray path rather than using full 2D/3D radiative transfer sensitivity kernels, losing information on sign-changing scattering sensitivity.

Spatial resolution is highly non-uniform due to seismicity and station distribution, ranging from 80×80 km in the Alps/Pyrenees to >=320×320 km in the Paris Basin and Western France at low frequencies.
一维路径平均包络反演假设沿路径衰减均匀且为单一平层状地壳波导，忽略了速度或衰减的深度分层以及面波影响（导致浅源事件在低频段存在轻微拟合偏差）。
由于前向散射特征随震源距增加迅速消失，单条路径上的散射各向异性参数（l*S/lS）分辨率较低。
二维层析成像将空间敏感度近似为连接震源与台站的窄射线路径，而未采用完整的2D/3D辐射传输敏感度核，损失了散射敏感度正负号变化的信息。
受地震活动性和台站分布不均影响，空间分辨率极不均匀：阿尔卑斯和比利牛斯地区可达80×80 km，而巴黎盆地和法国西部低频段仅为320×320 km或更差。

tm.why: The core objective of the paper is separating and mapping seismic scattering and intrinsic absorption quality factors from seismogram envelopes using elastic radiative transfer theory.

The study produces 2D crustal attenuation maps across Metropolitan France and correlates the spatial anomalies with major geological units such as sedimentary basins, Variscan massifs, and alpine orogens.
The attenuation maps are explicitly motivated by and intended to provide spatial constraints for regionalized, non-ergodic ground-motion models (GMMs) in seismic hazard assessment.

ev.notes: Full 30-page BSSA manuscript PDF (HAL preprint version hal-05750119v1) including all text, equations, 3 tables, and 11 figures was read and analyzed.

sum: Estimating source parameters for small-to-moderate earthquakes is challenging due to high-frequency path and site effects. Following a companion paper that removes path attenuation using elastic radiative transfer theory in a crustal waveguide, this study applies a generalized inversion technique (GIT) to ~21,000 waveforms from Metropolitan France (ML 2.0–5.9, <250 km) to separate source and site spectra across 0.375–24 Hz. Normalizing site amplification against 57 reference stations with flat coda H/V ratios yields 1279 source displacement spectra (down to Mw ~2.5) and 577 site responses. Derived Mw values agree excellently with the unified Euro-Mediterranean catalog while exposing attenuation biases in the SI-Hex catalog. Apparent stress increases moderately with seismic moment (scaling exponent 0.24 ± 0.08) without regional dependence. Crucially, the authors demonstrate that single-event inversions or unselective reference station choices introduce severe regional and scaling biases due to uncompensated high-frequency site amplifications.
针对中小地震高频路径与场地效应导致的震源参数偏差，本文结合弹性辐射传输理论（第一步去除路径衰减）与广义反演技术（GIT），处理了法国本土约2.1万条波形数据（0.375–24 Hz），利用57个平坦尾波H/V比参考台站约束，成功分离出1279个震源位移谱（低至Mw 2.5）和577个台站场地放大谱。……

t: A two-step inversion first removes path attenuation from 0.375–24 Hz seismogram envelopes via crustal waveguide elastic radiative transfer theory, then separates source and site spectra via SLSQP generalized inversion normalized on 57 flat-H/V reference stations.
采用两步反演：先用波导弹性辐射传输理论去除0.375–24 Hz包络路径衰减，再以57个平坦H/V台站为参考通过SLSQ…

The dataset comprises 20,802 waveforms (67,936 envelopes across 7 frequency bands) from 2,144 earthquakes (ML 2.0–5.9) at hypocentral distances ≤ 250 km recorded by 622 EPOS-FR and 67 CEA stations in France (1996–2023).
使用1996–2023年法国622个EPOS-FR和67个CEA台站记录的2144次地震（ML 2.0–5.9，震源距≤…

Extracted 1279 source spectra (down to Mw 2.5) and 577 site responses. Apparent stress scales with M0 (exponent 0.24 ± 0.08) without regional variations. All-station references overestimate Mw by 0.1–0.2 units; single-event inversions artificially inflate western France stress parameters.
提取1279个震源谱和577个场地响应；视应力随地震矩增加（指数0.24±0.08）且无区域差异；全台站参考高估震级0.…
Low coda SNR below 1.5 Hz limits small-event windows, and implementing a stratified velocity/attenuation crust model is currently computationally unfeasible for large datasets.
小震低于1.5 Hz尾波信噪比低；受计算量限制正演模型暂未考虑地壳内部分层结构与面波。

Combines waveguide elastic radiative transfer path corrections with flat-H/V reference GIT across France, eliminating regionalization needs and exposing regional site-effect biases in single-event source inversions.
结合波导弹性辐射传输路径校正与参考台站GIT反演，无需区域划分并揭示了单事件反演中的区域场地偏差。

kc: Developed a two-step inversion combining elastic radiative transfer envelope modeling with generalized inversion (GIT-ref) anchored on 57 flat-H/V reference stations.
Produced a new catalog of 1279 source displacement spectra (Mw, M0, fc, stress drop, apparent stress) and 577 site amplification spectra for Metropolitan France.
Demonstrated a moderate breakdown of earthquake self-similarity (apparent stress scaling exponent 0.24 ± 0.08) with no regional variations across France.
Proved that single-event inversions and non-selective station references fail to remove regional high-frequency site effects, artificially biasing corner frequencies and stress drops.
建立了结合地壳波导弹性辐射传输包络建模与基于57个平坦H/V参考台站的广义反演（GIT-ref）两步反演流程。
构建了法国本土包含1279个地震震源谱参数（Mw、M0、fc、应力降、视应力）及577个台站场地放大谱的新目录。
证实了法国地震存在温和的自相似性破缺（视应力标度指数为0.24 ± 0.08），且各区域间无显著差异。
证明单事件反演或全网台站参考无法消除区域性高频场地效应，会导致角频率和应力降的系统性高估。
me: Step 1: Path attenuation correction in 7 frequency bands (0.375–24 Hz) using elastic radiative transfer theory in a crustal waveguide with anisotropic scattering.
Step 2: Generalized inversion technique (GIT) solved via sequential least-squares programming (SLSQP) to separate source and site spectral energies.
Site reference normalization comparing three strategies: single-event average (SE), all-station network average (GIT-all), and 57 flat coda H/V reference stations (GIT-ref).

Non-linear least-squares Brune model fitting to extract seismic moment (M0) and corner frequency (fc), with bootstrap resampling (N=100) for uncertainties and orthogonal distance regression (ODR) for scaling laws.
第一步：在7个频带（0.375–24 Hz）内利用考虑各向异性散射的地壳波导弹性辐射传输理论去除路径衰减效应。
第二步：利用序列最小二乘规划（SLSQP）求解广义反演（GIT）方程组，分离震源谱能量与场地放大项。
对比三种场地参考约束策略：单事件台站平均（SE）、全网台站平均（GIT-all）以及57个平坦尾波H/V比参考台站平均（GIT-ref）。
应用非线性最小二乘拟合Brune震源模型提取地震矩（M0）和角频率（fc），结合自助法重采样（N=100）评估不确定性，并采用正交距离回归（ODR）分析标度关系。
de: 20,802 waveforms (67,936 filtered envelopes) from 2,144 earthquakes (ML 2.0–5.9) recorded at hypocentral distances ≤ 250 km between 1996 and 2023.
689 seismic stations across Metropolitan France (622 from EPOS-FR broadband/accelerometric network and 67 from CEA short-period/broadband network).
Systematic cross-catalog validation of Mw and fc against SI-Hex, Unified Euro-Mediterranean, Drouet et al. (2010), and SourceSpecHex catalogs.
1996至2023年间震源距≤250 km的2144次地震（ML 2.0–5.9）的20,802条波形记录（共反演67,936条滤波能量包络）。
法国本土689个地震台站数据（包括622个EPOS-FR宽频带/强震台站和67个CEA短周期/宽频带台站）。
与SI-Hex、欧洲-地中海统一目录、Drouet et al. (2010)及SourceSpecHex四个独立目录进行Mw和fc的系统对比验证。
li: Low-frequency signals (< 1.5 Hz) are often inaccessible for small earthquakes (Mw ≈ 2.5) due to low coda SNR, limiting the inversion time window.
The propagation model assumes a single-layer crust without internal stratification or surface waves, which is currently computationally too expensive to invert for large datasets.
Additional degrees of freedom in source spectral fall-off (generalized Brune model) cause strong parameter trade-offs for small earthquakes (Mw ≲ 3.5) with narrow bandwidths.
由于小地震（Mw ≈ 2.5）尾波信噪比低，通常无法获取低于1.5 Hz的低频信号，限制了反演时间窗长度。
正演传播模型假设单层均匀地壳，未包含地壳内部分层结构及面波耦合，目前对大数据集反演多层模型计算量过大。
在震源模型中引入自由高频衰减指数会与角频率和地震矩产生强烈折衷（特别是可用频带较窄的Mw ≲ 3.5小震）。

The core objective is extracting source displacement spectra, moment magnitudes, corner frequencies, stress drops, and apparent stresses to evaluate earthquake self-similarity scaling.
The studyInvert site amplification spectra across 577 stations and builds a homogeneous moment magnitude and stress parameter catalog essential for probabilistic seismic hazard assessment in France.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 26-page manuscript PDF (HAL preprint of BSSA 2026 article), including all equations, 7 figures, and 2 tables.

sum: This comment critically evaluates 67 low-frequency teleseismic marsquakes recently proposed by Huang et al. (2025), who applied a deep learning phase picker trained on terrestrial earthquakes to narrow-bandpass filtered (0.1–0.8 Hz) InSight seismic data. The authors re-examine all 67 candidate detections using broad-band spectrograms, auxiliary wind speed and atmospheric pressure logs, wind-sensitive lander resonance modes (~4.1 Hz), subsurface resonance excitation (2.4 Hz), and 3-D polarization analysis. They demonstrate that every proposed detection occurs during noisy periods and coincides precisely with atmospheric disturbances—typically a small wind gust followed by a stronger gust misidentified as P and S arrivals. Furthermore, the polarization matches pre-event noise, and the inferred distances (~20 degrees) and high magnitudes (Mb,s 3.3–5.4) contradict established Martian seismicity. This work highlights the necessity of domain-specific noise validation when applying deep learning pickers to planetary seismic data.
本文对Huang等(2025)利用陆地地震训练的深度学习拾取器在InSight窄带滤波(0.1-0.8 Hz)数据中检测到的67个远震火星震进行了全面核查。作者结合宽频带时频谱、风速与气压辅助数据、对风敏感的着陆器模态(约4.1 Hz)、2.4 Hz地下共振特征及三维偏振分析对所有候选事件进行了评估……

t: The authors review all 67 proposed detections using broad-band spectrograms, co-located wind and pressure records, 4.1 Hz lander-mode wind proxies, 2.4 Hz subsurface resonance, 3-D polarization analysis, and MarsQuakeNet.
利用宽频带时频谱、风速与气压数据、4.1 Hz着陆器模态、2.4 Hz共振和偏振分析核查67个候选事件。

Seismic, wind speed, and atmospheric pressure recordings from NASA's 4-year InSight mission on Mars, alongside the Marsquake Service (MQS) catalogue v14 and the 67 candidate events from Huang et al. (2025).
NASA洞察号4年连续地震与气象记录、MQS第14版目录及Huang等(2025)报告的67个检测事件。

All 67 detections coincide with atmospheric wind bursts rather than seismic events, showing noise polarization and implausible epicentral distances (clustering near 20 degrees) and high magnitudes (Mb,s 3.3–5.4).
全部67个检测结果均由大气阵风引起，偏振与背景噪声一致，且推算震中距(约20°)和震级(3.3-5.4)不合理。
The comment does not review the phase pick timing discrepancies on known MQS events, and uses a single 1-D velocity model with fixed 30 km depth for distance calculation.
未系统复核已知MQS事件的震相拾取差异，且仅使用单一速度模型和固定30 km深度计算震中距。

Refutes 67 claimed deep-learning marsquake detections and establishes a rigorous multi-observable verification protocol combining meteorological data, lander modes, and polarization to prevent false positives in planetary seismology.
证伪了67个深度学习火星震检测结果，建立了结合气象、着陆器模态和偏振特征的行星地震验证范式。

kc: Demonstrates that all 67 marsquake detections proposed by Huang et al. (2025) are false positives caused by atmospheric wind gusts.
Shows through 3-D polarization analysis that the proposed P and S arrivals share identical azimuth and inclination with pre-event background noise.
Proves that the inferred magnitude-distance distribution (clustering around 20 degrees with Mb,s 3.3–5.4) is incompatible with known Martian tectonics and quieter evening observations.
证实了Huang等(2025)提出的全部67个火星震检测结果均为由大气阵风引起的假阳性噪声。
通过三维偏振分析表明，所提议的P波和S波初至与事件前背景噪声具有相同的方位角和倾角。
证明了推算的震级-距离分布（集中在20°附近，震级达Mb,s 3.3–5.4）与已知的火星构造及安静傍晚时段的观测结果不符。
me: Cross-checking seismic phase picks against auxiliary wind speed and pressure sensor recordings.
Using the 4.1 Hz horizontal lander mode amplitude envelope as a seismic proxy for wind speed when meteorological sensors were inactive.
Evaluating excitation of the ambient 2.4 Hz subsurface resonance and broad-band spectrogram characteristics.
Three-component time-frequency polarization analysis (rectilinearity, azimuth, inclination) and verification with the MarsQuakeNet denoising model.
将地震震相拾取结果与辅助风速和压力传感器记录进行交叉比对。
在气象传感器未工作期间，利用4.1 Hz水平着陆器模态振幅包络作为风速的地震代理指标。
评估2.4 Hz环境地下共振的激发情况以及宽频带时频谱特征。
三分量时频偏振分析（线性度、方位角、倾角）以及利用MarsQuakeNet去噪模型进行验证。

Marsquake Service (MQS) catalogue version 14 and the 67 candidate detections reported by Huang et al. (2025).
NASA洞察号（InSight）火星任务长达4年的连续宽频带地震数据集（SEIS）及辅助气象数据（风速和气压）。
火星震服务（MQS）第14版目录以及Huang等(2025)报告的67个候选检测事件。

Uses a simplified single 1-D velocity model and fixed 30 km depth rather than MQS's probabilistic multi-model approach to estimate candidate distances.
未对Huang等人在已编目MQS事件上的震相拾取时间差异进行系统性复核。

tm.why: The paper evaluates proposed marsquake detections from NASA's InSight mission on Mars against atmospheric wind and pressure data.
The study critically reviews 67 proposed seismic event detections and their inferred epicentral distances and magnitudes relative to the Marsquake Service catalogue.
The comment assesses the performance and false-positive pitfalls of a deep learning phase picker applied to planetary seismic records and cross-checks it with MarsQuakeNet.

sum: InSight RISE radio-tracking detected Mars's Free Core Nutation (FCN) but not the Free Inner Core Nutation (FICN), whereas seismic analysis subsequently proposed a 613 ± 67 km solid inner core. This prospectively specified reanalysis tests whether the published RISE rotation products can resolve that proposed inner-core family using three archived analyses. Analysis A conducts a forward detectability sweep across a 45-cell grid (radii, density contrasts, couplings) using the Sasao–Okubo–Saito rotational formalism, finding all 27 evaluated cells below the measurement floor (maximum reduced χ² = 0.2921, peak single-term diagnostic 2.105 σ). Analysis B projects the family onto the published fixed-period FICN-strength scan, showing no evaluated model is both representable and recoverable. Analysis C performs a nested-sampling Bayesian inversion against 16 nutation terms, yielding a prior-dominated posterior (90% width ratios 0.884 and 0.926). Thus, the RISE FICN non-detection is uninformative regarding the seismically proposed Martian inner core.
针对InSight RISE未检测到自由内核章动（FICN）与地震学提出613±67 km火星固态内核之间的潜在矛盾，本文采用预先注册的三项分析重评估了RISE自转数据对该内核模型族的灵敏度。基于Sasao–Okubo–Saito自转理论对45个网格模型进行正演检测（分析A）、固定周期扫描投影（分析……

t: Implements the Sasao–Okubo–Saito rotational formalism using exact twin-subtracted nutation transfer functions, template projection onto the fixed-period FICN scan, and nested-sampling Bayesian inference over inner-core radius and density contrast.
基于Sasao–Okubo–Saito自转形式体系，结合精确孪生相减传递函数、FICN扫描模板投影及嵌套抽样贝叶斯反演。

Uses published InSight RISE Mars orientation uncertainties across 16 nutation terms, the fixed-period FICN scan (F* = 4×10⁻⁵ ± 0.007 over 200–575 d), and Bi et al. (2025) seismic inner-core parameters.
使用已发表的InSight RISE 16个章动项不确定度、固定周期FICN扫描结果及Bi等（2025）地震学内核参数。

All 27 evaluated grid cells lie below the RISE measurement floor (max reduced χ² = 0.2921, peak term 2.105 σ); none is representable and recoverable in the F* scan; Bayesian posteriors remain prior-dominated (width ratios 0.884, 0.926).
27个评估单元均低于测量下限（最大约化χ²=0.2921）；扫描中无模型可恢复；贝叶斯后验受先验主导（宽度比0.884、…
Inferred FICN properties depend on Earth-anchored first-order gravitational coupling and zero-defaulted Mars compliances; 18 cells are gate-withheld and full RISE covariance matrices are unavailable.
依赖锚定地球的一阶引力耦合和置零的火星柔度；18个单元被门控搁置且缺乏完整RISE协方差。
First quantitative, prospectively registered confrontation of the seismically proposed Martian solid inner core against measured InSight RISE nutation uncertainties and FICN scan products.
首次在预先注册框架下将地震学提出的火星固态内核模型与RISE章动不确定度及FICN扫描进行定量对质。

kc: Quantitatively confronts the Bi et al. (2025) seismically proposed Martian inner-core family (613 ± 67 km) with published InSight RISE rotation products under prospectively registered statistical protocols.
Demonstrates via forward exact-transfer modeling (Analysis A) that all 27 evaluated inner-core cells lie below the RISE nutation measurement floor (max reduced χ² = 0.2921).
Shows via template projection (Analysis B) that no evaluated inner-core model is both representable and recoverable in the published fixed-period FICN-strength scan.

Establishes through simulation-calibrated Bayesian nested sampling (Analysis C) that the joint core posterior (R_IC = 589 ± 41 km, δρ = 0.077 ± 0.040) is consistent with rotation data and prior-dominated.
在预先注册的统计规程下，首次将Bi等（2025）地震学提出的火星固态内核模型族（613±67 km）与已发表的InSight RISE自转产品进行定量对质。
通过精确传递正演模拟（分析A）证明全部27个有效内核网格模型的响应均低于RISE章动测量下限（最大约化χ² = 0.2921）。
通过模板投影（分析B）证明在已发表的固定周期FICN强度扫描中，没有任何评估模型同时具备可表征性和可恢复性。
通过经过模拟校准的贝叶斯嵌套抽样（分析C）确立联合内核后验分布（R_IC = 589 ± 41 km，δρ = 0.077 ± 0.040）与自转数据一致且受先验主导。
me: Exact twin-subtracted nutation transfer function evaluation using the Sasao–Okubo–Saito / Mathews et al. rotational formalism.
Template projection, interval support hull construction across flattening and damping branches, and representability/recoverability gating against the fixed-period FICN scan.
Bayesian inference via dynamic nested sampling (dynesty) validated with simulation-based calibration (SBC) over a 32-DoF diagonal Gaussian nutation likelihood.
采用Sasao–Okubo–Saito / Mathews等自转理论计算精确孪生相减章动传递函数。
针对固定周期FICN扫描进行模板投影、跨扁率与阻尼分支的周期支撑包络构建以及可表征性/可恢复性门控分析。
基于32自由度对角高斯章动似然函数，使用经模拟校准（SBC）验证的动态嵌套抽样（dynesty）进行贝叶斯推断。
de: Published InSight RISE Mars orientation products (Le Maistre et al. 2023): 16 nutation-term amplitude uncertainties and the fixed-period FICN-strength scan summary (F* = 4×10⁻⁵ ± 0.007 over [200, 575] d).
Published rigid-Mars nutation baseline amplitudes (Baland et al. 2020) and Earth MHB2002 benchmark values.
Published Martian solid inner-core seismic constraints (Bi et al. 2025): radius R_IC = 613 ± 67 km (85% CI) and inner-core-boundary density contrast δρ ≈ 7 ± 5%.
已发表的InSight RISE火星定向产品（Le Maistre et al. 2023）：16个章动项振幅不确定度及[200, 575]天窗口内的固定周期FICN强度扫描摘要（F* = 4×10⁻⁵ ± 0.007）。
已发表的刚性火星章动基线振幅（Baland et al. 2020）及地球MHB2002基准值。
已发表的火星固态内核地震学约束（Bi et al. 2025）：半径R_IC = 613 ± 67 km（85%置信区间）及内核边界密度差δρ ≈ 7 ± 5%。

Of the 45 registered grid cells, 18 failed numerical validity gates and were conservatively withheld without interpolation across discrete radii.
Published covariance matrices and design cross-products for RISE are unavailable, restricting Analysis C to a diagonal Gaussian likelihood omitting FCN period, k2, and Phobos secular acceleration.

在45个注册网格单元中，18个因未通过数值有效性门控而被保守搁置，且未在离散半径间进行插值。
由于缺乏已发表的RISE协方差矩阵和设计交叉项，分析C仅限于对角高斯似然，未纳入FCN周期、k2和火卫一长期加速度。

sum: This study investigates the structural drivers of vertical uplift and exhumation in the western Nepal Himalaya. By integrating new and published cooling ages (apatite fission track, (U-Th)/He, and muscovite 40Ar/39Ar), basin accumulation data, and geomorphic uplift indicators, the authors evaluate variations in ramp geometry and kinematic sequences. They employ thermokinematic and landscape evolution modeling across three balanced cross-sections along the Simikot transect. The results demonstrate that the northern zone of high relief and young exhumation is driven by a combination of displacement over a mid-crustal ramp in the basal décollement and out-of-sequence faulting, resolving long-standing uncertainties regarding Himalayan uplift mechanisms.
本研究探讨了尼泊尔西部喜马拉雅造山带垂直抬升与剥露的构造驱动机制。通过整合新旧冷却年龄（磷灰石裂变径迹、(U-Th)/He和白云母40Ar/39Ar）、盆地堆积数据及地貌抬升指标，作者评估了断层坡折几何形状和运动学序列的变化。研究利用Simikot剖面的三个平衡剖面进行了热运动学和景观演化模拟。结果……

结合热年代学与地貌指标，对三个平衡剖面进行热运动学和景观演化模拟。
New and published cooling ages (apatite fission track, (U-Th)/He, muscovite 40Ar/39Ar), basin accumulation data, and geomorphic uplift indicators.
新发表与已有的冷却年龄（磷灰石裂变径迹、(U-Th)/He、白云母40Ar/39Ar）、盆地堆积及地貌数据。
The northern zone of high relief and young exhumation is driven by a combination of mid-crustal ramp displacement and out-of-sequence faulting.
北部高起伏和年轻剥露区是由中地壳坡折位移与序列外断层活动共同驱动的。
The resolution and non-uniqueness of thermokinematic models depend on the density of thermochronological data and parameter assumptions.

First study to integrate thermokinematic and landscape evolution models with multi-method thermochronology to resolve exhumation drivers in western Nepal.
首次结合热运动学与景观演化模拟及多方法热年代学，揭示尼泊尔西部的剥露驱动机制。

Integrates thermochronology, geomorphology, and thermokinematic modeling along the Simikot transect in western Nepal.
Demonstrates that the northern high-relief zone results from a combination of ramp displacement and out-of-sequence faulting.

sum: This study presents a novel method integrating infrared thermal imaging with numerical heat-conduction modeling to estimate coseismic temperatures on fault surfaces during laboratory earthquakes. By accounting for spatial resolution, experimental geometry, and real-to-nominal contact area ratios, the framework is applied to high-velocity rotary shear experiments on limestone. The results constrain the distribution of frictional heat sources, showing that flash heating was likely absent, and pointing to thermal softening or powder lubrication as the primary weakening mechanisms.
本研究开发了一种结合红外热成像与数值热传导模拟的新方法，用于推断实验室模拟地震中断层表面的同震温度。该方法考虑了空间分辨率、实验几何形状及实际接触面积比。应用于石灰岩的高速旋转剪切实验表明，摩擦热源的分布排除了闪速加热弱化机制，表明热软化或粉末润滑是导致剪切弱化的主导机制。

t: Integrates infrared thermal imaging with numerical heat-conduction modeling to infer fault-surface temperatures during laboratory earthquakes, accounting for camera resolution and contact area.
结合红外热成像与数值热传导模拟，并考虑相机分辨率和接触面积，推断实验室断层表面温度。
High-velocity rotary shear experiments on limestone (carbonates) generating time-dependent temperature fields captured by thermal imagery.
在石灰岩上进行的高速旋转剪切实验，利用热成像捕获随时间变化的温度场。
Constrained frictional heat sources and ruled out flash-heating-induced weakening, suggesting thermal softening or powder lubrication caused the observed velocity weakening.
约束了摩擦热源并排除了闪速加热弱化，表明热软化或粉末润滑导致了速度弱化。
The temperature estimation is sensitive to the assumed real-to-nominal contact area ratio and is restricted to laboratory-scale setups.
温度估算对实际与名义接触面积比的假设较为敏感，且受限于实验室尺度。
First framework to explicitly combine thermal imaging with numerical heat conduction to resolve sub-resolution coseismic temperatures on experimental fault surfaces.

Constrained the distribution and magnitude of frictional heat sources during high-velocity rotary shear experiments on limestone.

排除了碳酸盐岩实验中的闪速加热弱化机制，指出热软化或粉末润滑是主要原因。

High-velocity rotary shear experiments

sum: This paper presents a theoretical 'two-interface driving model' for horizontal asthenospheric flow, utilizing an equivalent friction framework and an interface-selection principle. The model predicts a continuous velocity profile consisting of an upper drag layer (~30 km) and a return-flow zone (~150 km). It estimates effective friction coefficients at the lithosphere-asthenosphere boundary (LAB) and the mantle transition zone. Crucially, the model links macroscopic shear stress to microscopic olivine lattice-preferred orientation (LPO), predicting 3-D a-axis tilting testable by SKS splitting. Additionally, it unifies fluid, partial-melt, and solid friction by showing how melt fraction controls shear-creep thickness via grain size. This framework provides a physical mechanism for asthenospheric kinematics and seismic anisotropy.
本文提出软流圈水平流动的双界面驱动模型。基于等效摩擦框架和界面选择原理，预测了由上部拖拽层和回流区组成的连续速度剖面。模型将宏观剪切应力与微观橄榄石LPO联系起来，预测了可由SKS分裂检验的3D a轴倾角。此外，它通过熔体体积分数控制变形厚度，将流体、部分熔融和固体摩擦统一，为软流圈运动学和各向异性……

t: Analytical modeling using an equivalent friction framework and an interface-selection principle to simulate asthenospheric velocity profiles.
利用等效摩擦框架和界面选择原理进行解析建模，以模拟软流圈速度剖面。
Synthetic physical parameters representing the lithosphere-asthenosphere boundary (LAB) and mantle transition zone.
代表岩石圈-软流圈边界（LAB）和地幔过渡带的合成物理参数。
Predicts a ~30 km drag layer and a ~150 km return-flow zone with average velocity ~0.5v_L, and LAB friction coefficient of ~0.0067.
预测了~30 km的拖拽层和平均速度约为0.5v_L的~150 km回流区，LAB摩擦力约0.0067。
Simplified 1D analytical formulation that may not capture complex 3D mantle flow heterogeneities.
简化的一维解析公式，可能无法捕捉复杂的三维地幔流非均匀性。
Unifies fluid, partial-melt, and solid friction into one continuum and links macroscopic flow to microscopic LPO fabric.
将流体、部分熔融和固体摩擦统一在单个连续介质中，并将宏观流动与微观LPO织构联系起来。

kc: Proposed a unified two-interface driving model for horizontal asthenospheric flow.
Established a macroscopic-to-microscopic link between depth-dependent shear stress and olivine LPO fabric (3-D a-axis tilting).
Unified fluid, partial-melt, and solid friction within a single continuum controlled by melt fraction and grain size.
提出了用于软流圈水平流动的统一双界面驱动模型。
建立了深度相关剪切应力与微观橄榄石LPO织构（3D a轴倾斜）之间的宏观-微观联系。
将流体、部分熔融和固体摩擦统一在由熔体体积分数和晶粒尺寸控制的单一连续介质中。
me: Equivalent friction framework (friction proportional to velocity over thickness) and interface-selection principle.
Analytical modeling of velocity profiles (drag layer and return-flow zone) under mass conservation.
Dislocation creep and olivine-lattice rotation modeling to predict seismic anisotropy.

de: Theoretical/synthetic modeling based on physical parameters of the LAB and mantle transition zone.
Comparison of predicted return-flow velocity (~0.5 v_L) with force-balance constraints and rheological inversions.
基于LAB和地幔过渡带物理参数的理论/合成建模。
将预测的回流速度（~0.5 v_L）与力平衡约束和流变学反演进行对比。

Relies on simplified assumptions of melt distribution and grain size relationships.
该模型主要是一维解析和简化的，可能忽略了地幔粘度的三维横向非均匀性。
依赖于熔体分布和晶粒尺寸关系的简化假设。

tm.why: The paper proposes a physical framework for horizontal asthenospheric flow, LAB kinematics, and mantle transition zone dynamics.
The model links depth-dependent shear stress to olivine lattice-preferred orientation (LPO) and predicts 3-D a-axis tilting testable by SKS splitting.

sum: Three-dimensional Bayesian inversion of airborne electromagnetic (AEM) surveys is computationally infeasible with traditional finite-volume solvers because millions of soundings require billions of forward evaluations. This paper introduces a continually learning neural-operator surrogate combining a 3D Fourier Neural Operator branch, a DeepSets prior embedding with FiLM modulation, and a query trunk network (DeepONet architecture). Because Maxwell's equations remain invariant across geological settings, the surrogate learns sequentially across five distinct geostatistical priors using experience replay and function-space distillation without catastrophic forgetting. An ensemble-disagreement validity check flags out-of-distribution soundings and routes them to the full solver. Embedded in a probability-perturbation Markov chain Monte Carlo sampler, the surrogate reproduces the full-solver posterior with calibrated credible intervals (within 2.6 percentage points). Applied to the 2013 Capricorn TEMPEST survey in Western Australia, it inverts 2.13 million soundings in 24.9 seconds and enables rapid survey-scale prior falsification and revision.
三维航空电磁（AEM）数据的贝叶斯反演受限于正演计算成本。本文开发了一种结合三维傅里叶神经算子（FNO）、DeepSets先验嵌入与DeepONet架构的持续学习神经算子正演代理模型。基于麦克斯韦方程组在不同地质先验下的不变性，利用经验回放和函数空间蒸馏，使单算子顺序学习五个区域的地质先验而不发生灾……

t: A 3D Fourier Neural Operator branch encoder, DeepSets prior embedding, and DeepONet query trunk learn the 3D AEM forward map continually via experience replay and function-space distillation, driving a PPM-MCMC Bayesian sampler.
结合3D FNO编码器、DeepSets先验嵌入和DeepONet查询网络，通过经验回放与函数蒸馏持续学习正演映射并驱动…

The 2013 Capricorn TEMPEST survey in Western Australia (2,155,272 soundings, 191 lines, 15 gates from 0.013 to 16.2 ms) plus synthetic 3D SimPEG models across five regional Gaussian process geological priors.
西澳2013年Capricorn调查的215.5万个时域AEM测点数据，以及5个地质统计先验生成的SimPEG三维合成模…

Continual learning reduces prior error by 0.6 percentage points on average (negative forgetting), reproduces full-solver posteriors with credible intervals within 2.6 percentage points, and inverts 2,131,667 soundings in 24.9 s on one GPU.
持续学习实现负遗忘（平均误差降0.6%），置信区间偏差在2.6%以内，单GPU上24.9秒反演213万测点。
As ensemble members become more accurate, they become more similar, degrading the partial correlation between the ensemble disagreement score and prediction error from +0.485 to -0.014.
随集成成员精度提高，预测趋同，导致不一致性评分与误差的偏相关性从+0.485退化至-0.014。

First continually learning 3D AEM neural-operator surrogate that accumulates sequential geological priors without forgetting, paired with an out-of-distribution solver fallback and survey-scale prior falsification.
首创跨地质先验持续学习的三维AEM神经算子代理，兼具分布外求解器回退机制与全测区先验证伪更新。

kc: Developed a 3D neural operator (FNO + DeepSets + DeepONet) that continually learns the AEM forward map across multiple geostatistical priors without forgetting.
Implemented an ensemble-disagreement validity check at inference to flag out-of-distribution soundings and route them to the numerical solver.
Demonstrated posterior equivalence between the surrogate-driven and solver-driven PPM-MCMC samplers with calibrated uncertainty intervals.
Inverted over 2.13 million soundings from the Capricorn TEMPEST survey in 24.9 seconds on a single GPU and performed survey-wide prior falsification and updating.
开发了结合3D FNO、DeepSets和DeepONet的神经算子，跨多个地质统计先验持续学习三维AEM正演映射且无灾难性遗忘。
提出了基于深度集成不一致性的推理有效性检验，自动识别分布外测点并交由数值求解器计算。
证明了代理模型与数值求解器驱动的PPM-MCMC采样后验分布等价，且不确定性置信区间经过良好校准。
在单GPU上仅用24.9秒完成了Capricorn调查213万余个测点的全测区反演，并实现了全测区地质先验证伪与更新。
me: 3D Fourier Neural Operator (FNO) model encoder coupled with a DeepSets prior fingerprint embedding (via FiLM) and a DeepONet query trunk network.
Continual learning loss combining current-prior data misfit, experience replay buffer, function-space distillation, and physical monotonicity/concavity constraints.
Deep ensemble disagreement scoring (5 members) calibrated at the 95th validation percentile to route out-of-support models to the SimPEG finite-volume solver.
Probability perturbation method (PPM) Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) with delayed rejection and Robbins-Monro temperature adaptation, plus Mahalanobis-distance prior falsification.
结合3D傅里叶神经算子（FNO）编码器、DeepSets先验指纹嵌入（通过FiLM调制）及DeepONet查询主干网络的神经算子架构。
融合当前先验数据拟合、经验回放缓冲、函数空间蒸馏以及物理单调性/凹性约束的持续学习损失函数。
基于5个成员的深度集成不一致性评分（以验证集95%分位数为阈值），将超出训练支持的模型路由至SimPEG有限体积求解器。
结合延迟拒绝和Robbins-Monro温度自适应的概率扰动法（PPM）MCMC采样，以及基于马氏距离的先验证伪测试。
de: 2013 Capricorn TEMPEST time-domain AEM survey over the Turee Creek area, Western Australia (2,155,272 soundings on 191 flight lines, 25 Hz, 15 time gates from 0.013 to 16.2 ms).

Synthetic 3D conductivity realizations drawn from Gaussian process priors representing five regions: Capricorn (WA), Seward Peninsula (Alaska), Denmark, Zeeland (Netherlands), and NE Wisconsin, modeled on 32x32x24 local voxel crops in SimPEG.
西澳大利亚Turee Creek地区2013年Capricorn TEMPEST时域航空电磁调查数据（191条测线共2,155,272个测点，25 Hz，0.013至16.2 ms共15个时间道）。
由高斯过程先验生成的代表五个地区（Capricorn、阿拉斯加Seward半岛、丹麦、荷兰Zeeland、威斯康星州东北部）的合成三维电导率模型，使用SimPEG在32×32×24局部体素网格上进行有限体积正演。
li: As ensemble members become individually more accurate, they become more similar, causing the partial correlation between ensemble disagreement score and error to degrade.
Surrogate accuracy is currently bounded by the number of solver-labeled training soundings and is only valid within the trained transmitter clearance band (up to 180 m).
随着集成成员个体精度提高，成员间预测趋于一致，导致集成不一致性评分与预测误差之间的偏相关性下降（检测能力退化）。
代理模型的精度受限于求解器标记的训练样本数量，且仅在训练涵盖的发射机离地高度范围（180米以内）有效。

tm.why: The paper develops a fast surrogate-driven Markov chain Monte Carlo framework for three-dimensional probabilistic Bayesian inversion and uncertainty quantification of airborne electromagnetic data.
The study formulates a general surrogate-accelerated geophysical inverse problem with prior falsification, prior updating, and ensemble-based out-of-distribution routing.

Although applied to airborne electromagnetics rather than seismology, the core contribution is a continually learning 3D Fourier Neural Operator and DeepONet surrogate for geophysical PDE forward modeling.

ev.notes: Full 26-page manuscript PDF including all equations, 11 figures, and 2 tables was analyzed.

sum: Regional landslide debris inundation hazard assessments usually rely on discrete scenario enumeration, which is computationally expensive and sensitive to incomplete inventories. This paper introduces the Landslide Source-to-Inundation Process Model (LS-IPM), a reduced-complexity, process-based framework that reframes inundation hazard as a continuous debris-flux problem. LS-IPM links statistical source susceptibility (rainfall and earthquake triggers), geomorphologically constrained sediment production, kinematic source volume bounds, and Gravitational Path Process (GPP) mass-conservative routing. Applied at 25 m resolution across the ~25,000 km² West Coast region of New Zealand, the model evaluates present-day conditions, future climate (RCP6, 2081–2100), and an Alpine Fault Mw 8.0 earthquake scenario. Results show ~80% of the region faces debris inundation hazard, with future climate increasing mean annual debris flux by ~50%. The key novelty is enforcing mass balance between landslide frequency and magnitude via long-term erosion rates, bridging landscape evolution models and regional probabilistic risk assessment.
针对区域滑坡碎屑淹没危险性评估依赖离散情景构建的局限，本文提出滑坡源-淹没过程模型（LS-IPM）。该方法耦合滑坡源易发性、受长期侵蚀率约束的泥沙生成量、运动学体积上限与引力路径过程（GPP）质量守恒演进模型，生成连续的碎屑通量场。研究利用新西兰西海岸约25,000 km²区域的25 m分辨率地形、……

t: LS-IPM couples three components: Landslide Source Susceptibility (LSS), Landslide Sediment Production (LSP) constrained by long-term erosion and kinematic volume bounds, and Landslide Sediment Distribution (LSD) using reduced-complexity Gravitational Path Process routing.
耦合源区易发性（LSS）、受侵蚀率和运动学约束的泥沙生产（LSP）及简化复杂度GPP路径演进（LSD）。

Applied at 25 m resolution across ~25,000 km² of New Zealand's West Coast using HIRDS V4 rainfall, 2022 NSHM and AlpineF2K Mw 8.0 seismic shaking, suspended-sediment erosion rates, and 13,628 mapped landslides.
采用新西兰西海岸25,000 km²的25 m DEM、降雨与地震危险性模型、泥沙产率及万余处滑坡编目。

Approximately 80% of the study area experiences landslide debris inundation hazard; RCP6 climate projections increase mean annual debris flux by ~50%, and over half of Alpine Fault Mw 8.0 inundated cells exceed 100 m³/m²/event.
约80%区域受碎屑淹没影响；RCP6气候下年均通量增约50%；Mw 8.0地震下半数淹没区通量超100 m³/m²。

Reduced-complexity routing omits momentum, internal deformation, fragmentation, and barrier run-up, while mean annual debris flux cannot uniquely separate event frequency from magnitude without further probabilistic disaggregation.
未解析动量、内部变形及越顶过程，且年均碎屑通量需进一步分解才能区分发生频度与单次规模。

Reframes regional landslide runout hazard as a rate-limited debris flux problem where magnitude and frequency are implicitly constrained by long-term geomorphic sediment production rather than discrete scenario enumeration.
将区域滑坡淹没危险性重构为受地貌侵蚀泥沙产率约束的连续通量问题，无需枚举离散滑坡情景。

kc: Develops the Landslide Source-to-Inundation Process Model (LS-IPM) coupling source susceptibility, erosion-constrained sediment production, and reduced-complexity debris routing.
Introduces a kinematic source screening model combining excess topography and mechanical area-volume scaling to bound maximum local landslide volumes.
Applies LS-IPM across 25,000 km² of New Zealand's West Coast at 25 m resolution for present-day, RCP6 future climate, and Alpine Fault Mw 8.0 earthquake scenarios.
开发了耦合源区易发性、侵蚀率约束的泥沙生产与简化复杂度碎屑路径演进的滑坡源-淹没过程模型（LS-IPM）。
提出了结合超额地形与力学面积-体积标度律的运动学源区筛选模型，以约束局部最大可行滑坡体积。
以25 m分辨率在新西兰西海岸25,000 km²区域应用该框架，量化了当前、RCP6未来气候及阿尔卑斯断层Mw 8.0地震情景下的碎屑通量。
me: Coupled three-stage workflow: Landslide Source Susceptibility (LSS), Landslide Sediment Production (LSP), and Landslide Sediment Distribution (LSD).
Kinematic source depth bounding using excess topography above a 20° threshold basal angle and mechanical area-volume scaling.
Partitioning of long-term erosion-derived sediment supply across log-normal landslide volume classes, triggers, and return periods.
Ensemble downslope routing via the Gravitational Path Process (GPP) model combining fahrböschung (avalanche-type) and two-parameter PCM (flow-type) mobility rules.
三阶段耦合工作流：滑坡源易发性模型（LSS）、滑坡泥沙生产模型（LSP）与滑坡泥沙分布模型（LSD）。
基于20°基底阈值角的超额地形与力学面积-体积标度关系，计算运动学滑坡源区极限深度。
在可行对数正态滑坡体积等级、触发因素和重现期区间内分配由长期侵蚀率确定的泥沙供应量。
利用引力路径过程（GPP）模型集成能量线（碎屑崩塌型）和双参数PCM（碎屑流型）运动规则进行下坡路径模拟。
de: 25 m and 8 m Digital Elevation Models (LINZ) across the ~25,000 km² West Coast region of the South Island, New Zealand.
Rainfall-induced susceptibility from NIWA HIRDS V4 (50-, 100-, 250-yr ARIs and RCP6 2081–2100 projections) and earthquake susceptibility from the 2022 NZ NSHM (100–1000-yr ARIs).
AlpineF2K Mw 8.0 earthquake rupture PGA scenario field and regional inventories of 6,359 earthquake-induced and 7,269 rainfall-induced landslide polygons.
Nationally consistent suspended-sediment-yield dataset scaled by 1.5 with mapped rock densities to constrain long-term erosion rates.
新西兰南岛西海岸约25,000 km²区域的25 m和8 m数字高程模型（DEM）。
基于NIWA HIRDS V4（50、100、250年重现期及RCP6预测）的降雨滑坡易发性与基于2022新西兰国家地震危险性模型（100-1000年重现期）的地震滑坡易发性。
AlpineF2K Mw 8.0地震破裂情景PGA场，以及包含6359个地震诱发和7269个降雨诱发滑坡多边形的区域编目。
结合岩石密度图并乘以1.5倍系数的全国悬浮泥沙产率数据集，用于约束长期侵蚀率。
li: Mean annual debris flux integrates magnitude and frequency, so it cannot uniquely distinguish between many small failures and few large events without secondary disaggregation.
Reduced-complexity GPP routing does not resolve full flow momentum, internal deformation, entrainment, or topographic barrier run-up and overtopping.
Regional parameterization uses uniform material strength (50 kPa cohesion, 20° basal angle) and uncalibrated Swiss debris-flow PCM parameters.
年均碎屑通量综合了震级与频度，若不进行后续概率分解，无法唯一区分多次小型滑坡与少数大型事件。
简化复杂度的GPP演进模型未解析完整动量、内部变形、沿程刮铲以及地形障碍物的爬高与越顶过程。
区域参数化采用了均一的材料强度（50 kPa粘聚力、20°基底角）以及借自瑞士泥石流模拟的经验PCM参数。

tm.why: Evaluates regional earthquake-induced landslide debris inundation hazard using peak ground acceleration fields from the New Zealand National Seismic Hazard Model and an Alpine Fault Mw 8.0 rupture simulation.
Focuses on surface environmental hazards—specifically landslide sediment production, mass wasting, and debris runout routing across mountain landscapes under seismic and climatic forcing.

ev.notes: Full 41-page preprint PDF analyzed, including equations (1)-(23), all 7 figures, and West Coast case study results.

sum: This study reanalyzes legacy passive seismic data from the 53-station MINQ network to construct the first 3D crustal shear-wave velocity (Vs) model (down to ~22 km) of the Proterozoic Mount Isa Province in northern Australia. Using NoisePy for cross-correlations, FTANos for Rayleigh wave group dispersion picking (1–12 s), and DSurfTomo for direct 3D inversion, the authors integrate their Vs model with deep seismic reflection profiles, gravity, magnetic, and magnetotelluric data. Results reveal strong velocity contrasts across major faults and the Gidyea Suture Zone. Upper-crustal magmatic intrusions mapped on reflection profiles cluster around high-velocity anomalies at ~5 km depth, connecting to a prominent ~250 km wide 'donut-shaped' high-velocity zone (Vs > 3.8 km/s) at 12–20 km depth. Interpreted as a frozen mantle-plume magmatic plumbing system, its edges spatially correlate with world-class IOCG and base-metal deposits, demonstrating how passive seismic imaging illuminates deep mineral system architecture.
本研究重新分析了澳大利亚北部元古代芒特艾萨省53个MINQ台站的被动源地震数据，利用NoisePy计算互相关、FTANos提取1-12秒瑞利波群速度频散，并通过DSurfTomo直接反演构建了该区首个上中地壳三维横波速度模型（深达22 km）。结合深反射地震、重磁及大地电磁数据，模型揭示了吉迪亚缝合……

t: Cross-correlations of 1-month ambient noise records were computed via NoisePy, fundamental-mode Rayleigh group dispersion curves (1–12 s) were picked with FTANos, and a 3D Vs model was inverted directly using DSurfTomo.
利用NoisePy计算1个月噪声互相关，FTANos提取1-12秒瑞利波群速度频散，并用DSurfTomo直接反演三维横…

Passive seismic data from 53 short-period (25 Hz) three-component stations of the MINQ array deployed across Mount Isa from 2009 to 2011 with ~50 km spacing, yielding 640 stacked vertical-component cross-correlations.
2009-2011年MINQ台网53个短周期（25 Hz）三分量台站（间距约50 km）数据，获得640条叠加垂直分量互…

The 3D Vs model (2–22 km) resolves shallow basins (Vs < 3.3 km/s), upper-crustal fast zones (~5 km) matching mapped intrusions, and a 250-km wide donut-shaped high-velocity body (Vs > 3.8 km/s, 403,426 km³) at 12–20 km depth.
揭示浅部盆地（Vs<3.3 km/s）、5 km深处高速侵入体，以及12-20 km深处宽250 km的环状高速体（Vs…
Short-period (1 Hz) sensors restrict dispersion picks to ≤12 s and model depth to 20–22 km, while 1-month data segments and ~50 km station spacing limit lateral resolution to 60–70 km.
1 Hz短周期仪器将频散限制在12秒内（深度20-22 km），50 km台间距使横向分辨率限于60-70 km。

First 3D crustal shear-wave velocity model of the entire Mount Isa Province, integrating ambient noise tomography with reflection seismic transects to link deep plume-related mafic intrusions with surface mineral deposits.

揭示了深部基性岩体、浅部（~5 km）高速停滞体、反射地震断层构造与地表世界级矿床（IOCG和铅锌矿）之间的空间连续性。

Rayleigh wave fundamental-mode group velocity dispersion measurement (1–12 s) using Python-based FTANos and CPS validation.

Checkerboard resolution tests with 1° x 1° (±0.4 km/s) anomalies confirming 60–70 km lateral resolution at depths of 2–20 km.
Legacy deep crustal seismic reflection profiles (07GA-IG1, 94MTI-01) and potential field (Bouguer gravity and magnetic intensity) maps.

sum: This study utilizes detrital zircon U-Pb geochronology on dredged schists and sandstones from Bruce Bank and Discovery Bank in the southern Scotia Sea to constrain their tectonic provenance. Bruce Bank yielded Triassic schists (max sedimentation age ~216.2 Ma) correlating with the South Orkney accretionary complex. Sandstones from both banks and the South Orkney microcontinent yielded Permian-Triassic (258–224 Ma) and Cretaceous (140–110 Ma) maximum sedimentation ages. These findings suggest Bruce and Discovery banks were joined in the mid-Cretaceous and situated near the South Orkney Islands along the paleo-Pacific margin of Gondwana before undergoing Late Cretaceous-Cenozoic rifting and translation during the formation of the Scotia Sea.
本研究对南斯科舍海布鲁斯和发现海岭的疏浚样品进行碎屑锆石U-Pb定年。结果表明，布鲁斯海岭片岩最大沉积年龄为三叠纪（~216.2 Ma），与南奥克尼增生杂岩相当；两海岭砂岩具有二叠-三叠纪及白垩纪最大沉积年龄。这证实两海岭在白垩纪中期相连，并在裂解前位于冈瓦纳古太平洋边缘，为斯科舍海演化提供了关键约……

t: Detrital zircon U-Pb geochronology of dredged schist and sandstone samples to determine maximum sedimentation ages and provenance.
对疏浚的片岩和砂岩样品进行碎屑锆石U-Pb年代学分析，以确定最大沉积年龄和物源。
Dredged metamorphic and sedimentary rock samples from Bruce Bank, Discovery Bank, and the South Orkney microcontinent.
来自布鲁斯海岭、发现海岭和南奥克尼微陆块的疏浚变质岩和沉积岩样品。
Bruce Bank schist yielded a Triassic age of 216.2 Ma; sandstones from both banks yielded Permian-Triassic (258-224 Ma) and Cretaceous (140-110 Ma) ages.
布鲁斯海岭片岩显示三叠纪年龄（216.2 Ma）；两海岭砂岩显示二叠-三叠纪及白垩纪年龄。
Geological interpretations are constrained by the sparse spatial distribution of marine dredged samples rather than continuous onshore outcrops.

First detrital zircon U-Pb ages from Bruce and Discovery banks, confirming their mid-Cretaceous connection and paleo-Pacific Gondwana margin origin.
首次获得布鲁斯和发现海岭的碎屑锆石年龄，证实了其白垩纪中期的连接及冈瓦纳边缘起源。

Establishes a Triassic maximum sedimentation age (~216.2 Ma) for Bruce Bank schists, correlating them with the South Orkney accretionary complex.
Identifies Permian-Triassic and Cretaceous sedimentary units on both banks, supporting a mid-Cretaceous connection and a paleo-Pacific Gondwana margin origin.
