sum: This study analyzes CCTV video recordings of the 2026 Mw 6.8 Kumamoto and 2018 Mw 6.4 Hualien earthquakes to directly constrain fault slip-pulse characteristics. For the Kumamoto earthquake, the video resolves a 1.6-s slip pulse with a peak velocity of ~1.3 m/s, an estimated slip-weakening distance of ~0.7 m, and an average rupture speed of ~2.1 km/s. This short duration is remarkably similar to that of the much larger 2025 Mw 7.7 Myanmar earthquake, suggesting slip duration is controlled by local rupture geometry rather than magnitude alone. Conversely, the Hualien case demonstrates that distributed near-surface deformation can obscure slip-pulse signatures. The study highlights both the high potential and the limitations of optical video data for earthquake source physics.

CCTV video recordings of the 2026 Mw 6.8 Kumamoto and 2018 Mw 6.4 Hualien earthquakes, along with nearby seismic waveforms.

sum: How neighbouring mantle plumes interact and influence upper-mantle flow remains poorly constrained. Using data from the unprecedented UPFLOW ocean-bottom seismometer deployment (43 OBS and 418 land stations), this study applies multimode partitioned waveform inversion tomography to image 3D isotropic shear-wave velocity and radial anisotropy across the Azores–Madeira–Canaries region. The model reveals two distinct upwellings rising through the transition zone and spreading laterally between ~230 and 400 km depth, forming a ~1.34×10^17 m^3 low-velocity reservoir consistent with ponded dense eclogitic material below the coesite-stishovite transition. Radial anisotropy indicates vertical flow within water-rich C-type olivine conduits, transitioning to lateral spreading beneath the lithosphere. Crucially, where lateral flows from the Azores and Canaries plumes converge beneath the Madeira Abyssal Plain, fast-SV radial anisotropy reveals localized downwelling. This provides direct observational evidence that adjacent thermochemical plumes dynamically interact, driving return flow and filtering deep-mantle geochemical heterogeneity before surface volcanism.
相邻地幔柱如何相互作用并影响上地幔流动尚不清楚。本研究利用UPFLOW海底地震仪阵列及周边陆地台站的三分量波形数据，采用多模态分区波形反演层析成像，构建了亚速尔-马德拉-加那利群岛区域的三维各向同性剪切波速度和径向各向异性模型。结果显示两个地幔上涌流穿过转换带并在约230-400 km深度发生广泛横……

t: Two-stage partitioned waveform inversion (PWI) fitting fundamental and multimode (n=0–20) surface-wave time-frequency windows (T~20–210 s) for 1D path perturbations, followed by regularized LSQR inversion for 3D isotropic Vs and radial anisotropy.
采用两阶段分区波形反演拟合基阶和多模态面波时频窗，并通过正则化LSQR反演三维各向同性Vs和径向各向异性。

Three-component waveforms from ~43 UPFLOW ocean-bottom seismometers and ~418 regional land stations recording 435 earthquakes (Mw 4.5–8.0), yielding 20,491 fundamental-mode and 125,854 full-waveform windows across ~6,959 ray paths.
使用UPFLOW海底地震仪及周边陆地台站记录的435次地震三分量波形，提取了20,491个基阶窗和125,854个全波形…

Imaged two mantle upwellings that spread laterally at ~230–400 km depth into a 1.34×10^17 m^3 low-Vs eclogitic pond (buoyancy flux 0.98×10^6 g/s), with fast-SV radial anisotropy midway between hotspots indicating localized return downwelling.
发现两个地幔上涌流在250-400 km深度横向扩展形成体积约1.34×10^17 m^3的低速榴辉岩池，且热点间快SV…

Azimuthal ray coverage is uneven, vertical smearing may offset the pond's upper depth limit, and testing the longevity and deflection mechanics of eclogitic reservoirs requires targeted geodynamic modelling.
射线方位角分布不均且存在垂向涂抹，榴辉岩储层偏转上涌流的机制仍需针对性地球动力学模拟检验。

First high-resolution 3D isotropic and radially anisotropic seismic imaging across the entire Azores–Madeira–Canaries oceanic corridor using UPFLOW OBS data, revealing dynamic plume-plume interaction and return downwelling.
首次利用UPFLOW海底地震阵列对亚速尔-加那利走廊进行三维各向异性成像，揭示了相邻地幔柱动力学相互作用及回流。

kc: Imaged 3D isotropic Vs and radial anisotropy across the Azores–Madeira–Canaries region using the novel UPFLOW ocean-bottom seismometer array.
Identified a broad low-velocity reservoir at ~230–400 km depth (volume ~1.34×10^17 m^3) interpreted as a ponded eclogitic pool fed by the Azores and Canaries plumes.

Resolved a fast-SV radial anisotropy anomaly midway between the Azores and Canaries hotspots, providing observational evidence for localized return downwelling induced by converging lateral plume flows.
利用新型UPFLOW海底地震仪阵列，对亚速尔-马德拉-加那利区域进行了三维各向同性Vs和径向各向异性成像。
在约230-400 km深度识别出一个广泛的低速储层（体积约1.34×10^17 m^3），解释为由亚速尔和加那利地幔柱供源的榴辉岩池。
在亚速尔和加那利热点之间解析出快SV径向各向异性异常，为地幔柱横向扩展汇聚引发的局部回流下沉提供了观测证据。
me: Two-stage partitioned waveform inversion (PWI) tomography following Witek et al. (2022).
Stage 1 fits fundamental-mode and multimode (summed over modes n=0 to 20) waveforms in time-frequency windows (T~20–210 s) to obtain path-averaged 1D isotropic Vs and radial anisotropy perturbations.
Stage 2 combines 1D path perturbations into a regularized 3D LSQR inversion using SGLOBE-rani as the 3D starting model, with ray clustering to mitigate azimuthal smearing.
采用Witek等人（2022）的两阶段分区波形反演（PWI）层析成像方法。
第一阶段在时频窗（周期约20-210秒）内拟合基阶和多模态（n=0至20叠加）波形，获取路径平均的一维各向同性Vs和径向各向异性扰动。
第二阶段以SGLOBE-rani为三维初始模型，通过射线聚类减轻方位角涂抹效应，利用正则化LSQR反演将一维路径扰动合成为三维模型。
de: Three-component earthquake waveforms from the UPFLOW OBS array (43–50 stations deployed across a 1,000 × 2,000 km region) combined with ~418 surrounding land stations from 435 earthquakes (Mw 4.5–8.0).
20,491 fundamental-mode and 125,854 full-waveform time-frequency windows across ~6,959 ray paths.
Extensive synthetic resolution tests including 2° sparse checkerboards, Gaussian plume-column tests, isotropic-anisotropic leakage evaluations, and realistic structure recovery with Gaussian noise.
结合UPFLOW海底地震仪阵列（部署在1,000 × 2,000 km区域的43-50个台站）与周边约418个陆地台站记录的435次地震（Mw 4.5-8.0）三分量波形数据。
来自约6,959条射线路径的20,491个基阶时频窗和125,854个全波形时频窗。
广泛的合成分辨率测试，包括2°稀疏棋盘测试、高斯地幔柱模型测试、各向同性与各向异性串扰评估以及加入高斯噪声的真实模型恢复测试。
li: Uneven azimuthal ray distribution, with paths predominantly trending from Central and South America towards the study region.
Vertical smearing and reduced amplitude recovery beneath the Canary Islands, potentially offsetting the upper limit of the imaged eclogitic pond by ~50 km.
Interpretations of eclogitic pond longevity and olivine fabric transitions (A-, C-, and E-type) lack targeted 3D geodynamic and mineral-physics fabric modelling.
射线方位角分布不均，射线路径主要从中美洲和南美洲指向研究区。
加那利群岛下方的振幅恢复有所降低且存在垂向涂抹效应，可能使成像的榴辉岩池上限深度偏移约50 km。
关于榴辉岩池寿命及橄榄石组构转变（A型、C型和E型）的解释尚缺乏针对性的三维地球动力学和矿物物理组构数值模拟。

tm.why: The paper applies multimode partitioned waveform inversion tomography to image 3D shear-wave velocity structure beneath the Azores-Madeira-Canaries region.
The study jointly inverts for 3D radial anisotropy to constrain vertical and horizontal mantle flow and localized downwelling between the plumes.
The primary scientific focus is imaging thermochemical mantle plumes, upper-mantle eclogitic ponding, and dynamic plume-plume interactions.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 55-page EarthArXiv preprint PDF, including the main manuscript (pp. 1–17) and the attached Supplementary Information (pp. 18–55, containing Figs. S1–S26 and Table 1).

sum: The China–Western Australia Seismic Survey (CWAS), conducted from 2017 to 2019, deployed 56 broadband land stations along a 900 km transect and 8 ocean-bottom seismometers along a 500 km offshore line. This represents the first integrated land–ocean passive-source seismic array in northwestern Australia, aimed at overcoming thick sedimentary cover and sparse observations to image the region's Precambrian craton and passive-margin lithospheric structure. The dataset (FDSN network code 4N) is openly available. Example data products, including receiver functions, ambient-noise cross-correlations, and earthquake waveforms, demonstrate its high quality and suitability for crustal and lithospheric imaging. The newly documented offshore component extends coverage across the ocean–continent transition, providing a valuable resource for studying passive-margin evolution.
中国-西澳大利亚地震观测计划（CWAS）于2017至2019年间部署了56个陆地宽频带地震台站（长约900公里）和8个海底地震仪（长约500公里），构成了该地区首个陆海联测被动源地震台阵。该数据集（FDSN代码4N）已公开，旨在解决西北澳沉积层厚、观测稀疏的问题，以精细成像前寒武纪克拉通与被动大陆边……

t: Deployment of a dense land-ocean passive-source seismic array, utilizing receiver functions, ambient-noise cross-correlations, and earthquake waveforms to image lithospheric structure.

sum: Conventional seismic tomography relies on pixel-based regularizations that only indirectly encode geological structures. This paper introduces an inference-mode Bayesian framework for ambient noise tomography (ANT) that explicitly tests structural hypotheses with quantified uncertainty. The prior combines a Whittle–Matérn latent Gaussian field solved via a Fourier spectral SPDE approach, spectral dimensionality reduction via a truncated Karhunen–Loève (KL) expansion, and a differentiable sigmoid pushforward mapping that promotes piecewise-constant velocity structures. Hyperparameters directly control lateral scale, boundary roughness, and velocity bounds. Dimensionality reduction by over 98% makes gradient-based maximum a posteriori (MAP) estimation (via L-BFGS) and No-U-Turn Sampler (NUTS) Hamiltonian Monte Carlo sampling computationally tractable. Validated on synthetic tests and 6 Hz Rayleigh-wave phase-velocity measurements from a 994-station array at the Kylylahti mine in Finland, the method recovers sharp lithological boundaries and delivers spatially resolved uncertainty maps reflecting ray coverage and transition ambiguity.
针对传统网格正则化难以直接表达地质假设的问题，本文提出一种面向推断模式的贝叶斯背景噪声层析成像（ANT）与不确定性量化框架。该方法利用Whittle-Matérn潜高斯场、截断Karhunen-Loève（KL）展开降维及可微Sigmoid前推映射构建分片常数速度先验，降低了98%以上的随机维度，使……

sum: This study constructs a high-resolution crustal strain rate model for the Southeastern Tibetan Plateau (SETP) using an expanded GNSS dataset of 997 vectors. The model reveals a prominent J-shaped high-strain zone along the Xianshuihe-Xiaojiang fault system (XXFS) extending 600 km southwestward. Combined with unsupervised Euler pole clustering machine learning, the results suggest a mid-to-lower crustal linkage between the XXFS and faults southwest of the Red River fault, indicating active fault propagation across this ancient boundary. The interior of the SETP exhibits widespread extensional deformation with clockwise rotation of principal axes and fault-bounded rotational domains. The strong correlation between high-strain zones and historical M >= 6 earthquakes provides a refined, physically-based framework for regional seismic hazard assessment.
本研究利用997个GNSS速度矢量构建了川滇地区高分辨率地壳应变率模型。结果揭示了沿鲜水河-小江断裂带向西南延伸的J型高应变带。结合无监督欧拉极聚类，发现该断裂带与红河断裂带西南侧断裂存在中下地壳深部关联。川滇内部呈现拉张变形及主轴顺时针旋转。高应变带与历史强震的关联为地震危险性评估提供了物理依据。

sum: This study introduces DTSEC (DiTing Seismic Event Classifier), a model fine-tuned from a pretrained seismogram foundation model with over 100 million parameters to classify earthquakes, explosions, and collapses. DTSEC achieves an overall accuracy of 92.83% on the test set, showing superior sample efficiency by matching scratch-trained models using only 20% of the training data. To address regional performance drops, the authors apply joint fine-tuning with a small number of local samples from the Henan Seismic Network, China. This approach successfully adapts the model to local geological features while retaining global generalization. DTSEC offers a practical, deployable solution for seismic event classification, particularly in data-scarce regions.
本研究提出基于超亿参数预训练地震大模型微调的分类器DTSEC，用于分类地震、爆炸和塌陷。DTSEC测试集准确率达92.83%，仅需20%数据即可匹配从头训练模型，样本效率极高。在河南台网的测试表明，通过少量本地样本联合微调可显著提升区域适应性，为数据匮乏地区提供了实用的地震事件分类方案。

First application of fine-tuning a 100M+ parameter seismogram foundation model for event classification with high sample efficiency and regional adaptability.

sum: Modeling thermo-chemical processes and seismic discontinuities in planetary mantles requires phase equilibrium calculations, but traditional Gibbs free energy minimizers (GEM) are computationally expensive. This paper presents a fast, scalable, and differentiable machine-learning surrogate that predicts stable mineral phase fractions and solid-solution compositions across upper- to transition-zone mantle conditions (1–40 GPa, 500–2500°C) in a six-oxide chemical system. Calibrated on 2,000,000 synthetic data points generated with MAGEMin along a basalt–harzburgite mixing line, the neural network combines a phase-stability classifier head with a regression head constrained by closure and mass-balance penalties. The surrogate achieves uncertainties under ±0.01 mol/mol for phase fractions and ±0.005 mol/mol for solid-solution compositions, while achieving a 10,000x speedup on GPUs (35.3 ns per point). Furthermore, automatic differentiation enables quantitative Jacobian sensitivity analysis, revealing how peridotite fertility controls the 520-km and 660-km seismic discontinuities.
行星地幔热化学过程与地震不连续面模拟依赖相平衡计算，但传统吉布斯自由能最小化（GEM）计算成本高昂。本文提出一种快速、可扩展且可微的机器学习代理模型，用于预测上地幔至转换带条件下（1–40 GPa，500–2500°C）六氧化物体系的稳定矿物相比例与固溶体成分。该模型基于MAGEMin生成的200万……

t: A two-head fully connected neural network predicts phase stability probabilities with a sigmoid classifier head and multiplies them elementwise with a regression head predicting phase fractions and solid-solution compositions, trained with L2, closure, and mass-balance losses.
采用双头全连接神经网络，将Sigmoid分类头预测的相稳定概率与回归头预测的相比例及固溶体成分逐元素相乘，并结合质量平衡…

2,000,000 synthetic P–T–composition samples (plus 100,000 validation and 100,000 test points) generated via MAGEMin across 1–40 GPa and 500–2500°C, sampling six-oxide bulk compositions from a Dirichlet distribution along a basalt–harzburgite mixing line.
利用MAGEMin在1–40 GPa和500–2500°C范围内沿玄武岩-方辉橄榄岩混合线生成200万个六氧化物合成样本…

On 100,000 test points, phase stability accuracy exceeds 95%, phase fraction errors are within ±0.01 mol/mol, solid-solution composition errors are within ±0.005 mol/mol, and GPU execution reaches 35.3 ns per point (four orders of magnitude faster than MAGEMin).
相稳定分类准确率超95%，相比例误差<±0.01 mol/mol，固溶体成分误差<±0.005 mol/mol，GPU单…

The model systematically underestimates plagioclase phase fractions and exhibits high relative errors for rare low-abundance phases, limiting its reliability in the uppermost 30 km of the mantle without domain-specific fine-tuning.
系统性低估斜长石比例，且稀有低丰度相相对误差较高，限制了地幔顶部30公里内的直接应用。

First machine-learning surrogate to predict phase-specific fractions and multi-component solid-solution compositions across 20 mantle phases via a mass-balanced classifier–regressor architecture, enabling analytic gradient sensitivity analysis across P–T–composition space.
首次通过物理约束的分类-回归架构预测20种地幔相的特定比例与固溶体成分，并实现温度-压力-成分空间的解析梯度敏感度分析。

kc: Developed a dual-head classifier–regressor neural network surrogate with closure and mass-balance constraints to predict phase-specific mineral fractions and compositions.
Achieved a computational speedup of up to four orders of magnitude on GPUs (35.3 ns/point) compared to Gibbs energy minimization while keeping compositional errors below ±0.01 mol/mol.

Performed automatic-differentiation sensitivity analysis across P–T–composition space, demonstrating how mantle fertility affects wadsleyite–ringwoodite (520 km) and akimotoite–perovskite (660 km) transitions.
开发了结合分类头与回归头的双头神经网络代理模型，并引入闭合与质量平衡物理约束来预测特定相的矿物比例与成分。
在保持成分预测误差低于±0.01 mol/mol的同时，在GPU上实现了比吉布斯自由能最小化快四个数量级的计算加速（35.3纳秒/点）。
利用自动微分在温度-压力-成分空间进行敏感度分析，揭示了地幔肥力如何影响520公里（瓦兹利石-林伍德石）和660公里（秋本石-钙钛矿）相变。

Physics-informed loss function combining quadratic L2 misfit with component closure penalties and bulk mass-balance constraints.
Automatic differentiation (Zygote.jl) to compute Jacobian-vector products and directional derivatives along temperature, pressure, and basalt–harzburgite compositional vectors.
在Julia（Flux.jl）中实现结合分类器与回归器的全连接神经网络，利用二元相稳定性概率对预测的相比例与成分进行门控。
采用结合二次L2误差、组分闭合惩罚项和总体质量守恒约束的物理信息损失函数。
利用自动微分（Zygote.jl）计算沿温度、压力及玄武岩-方辉橄榄岩成分向量方向的雅可比向量积和方向导数。
de: Synthetic training dataset of 2,000,000 P–T–x_bulk triplets (plus 100,000 validation and 100,000 test points) generated using MAGEMin v1.8.5 and the Stixrude & Lithgow-Bertelloni (2022) database.
Sampling across 1–40 GPa and 500–2500°C, with 6-component bulk compositions (SiO2–CaO–Al2O3–FeO–MgO–Na2O) drawn from a Dirichlet distribution along the basalt–harzburgite mixing line.
Out-of-distribution generalization test on altered oceanic crust composition and computational scaling benchmarks on CPU (12 threads) and GPU (Nvidia GTX TITAN X).
使用MAGEMin v1.8.5和Stixrude & Lithgow-Bertelloni (2022)热力学数据库生成的200万个P-T-x_bulk合成训练样本（另含各10万个验证和测试样本）。
压力采样范围1–40 GPa，温度500–2500°C，六组分岩石化学成分（SiO2–CaO–Al2O3–FeO–MgO–Na2O）沿玄武岩-方辉橄榄岩混合线通过狄利克雷分布采样。
在蚀变洋壳成分上进行分布外泛化测试，并在CPU（12线程）和GPU（Nvidia GTX TITAN X）上进行计算扩展性基准测试。

Predicts only mineral fractions and compositions (v and X) within a 6-oxide sub-solidus space, whereas full GEM solvers simultaneously output mechanical moduli, heat capacities, and entropy.
系统性低估斜长石丰度，且对稀有低丰度相（斜长石、蓝晶石、霞石、尖晶石）相对误差较大，限制了在地幔最上部30公里内的应用精度。
仅能预测六氧化物亚固相线空间内的矿物比例和成分（v和X），而传统GEM求解器可同时输出力学模量、热容和熵等热力学量。

tm.why: The paper develops a thermodynamic phase equilibrium surrogate for upper to transition-zone mantle rocks to study mantle convection, buoyancy contrasts, and 410/520/660-km seismic discontinuities.
It introduces a dual-head neural network surrogate trained on 2 million synthetic samples to predict mantle mineral assemblages and solid-solution compositions with GPU acceleration.
The neural surrogate is fully differentiable via automatic differentiation, enabling analytic Jacobian sensitivity analysis and future gradient-based geophysical and petrological inversions.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 15-page PDF manuscript including all equations, 6 figures, methods, accuracy evaluations, sensitivity analyses, and computational benchmarks.

sum: This study addresses the limitation of ambient noise HVSR (HVSRN) at ocean-bottom seismometer (OBS) stations, which is typically unstable below 0.1 Hz due to oceanic noise. The authors propose using earthquake coda waves (HVSRC) from multiple events with long-duration coda (>=200 s) to obtain stable HVSR curves in the 0.05–10 Hz range. By inverting these curves using the 'hvgeneralized' algorithm under the diffuse field assumption, they construct 1D shear-wave velocity models down to ~10 km depth offshore Fukushima. The resulting models align with known sedimentary and crustal structures and successfully image a low-velocity zone associated with the Japan Trench plate interface at ~7 km depth. This demonstrates that HVSRC can effectively mitigate low-frequency instability in marine environments, extending HVSR applicability to deep crustal imaging.

t: Estimating horizontal-to-vertical spectral ratios from earthquake coda waves (HVSRC) and inverting them using the 'hvgeneralized' algorithm under the diffuse field assumption, accounting for the seawater layer.
利用地震尾波估算水平与垂直谱比（HVSRC），并在弥散场假设下使用考虑海水层的'hvgeneralized'算法进行反演…
Passive seismic recordings from three broadband ocean-bottom seismometer (OBS) stations offshore Fukushima, capturing multiple earthquakes with long-duration coda (>=200 s).
福岛近海三个宽频带海底地震仪（OBS）台站记录的多个具有长尾波（≥200秒）的地震波形数据。
Stable HVSRC curves in the 0.05–10 Hz range and 1D shear-wave velocity models down to ~10 km depth, including a plate-interface low-velocity zone at ~7 km.
获得了0.05–10 Hz范围内稳定的HVSRC曲线，以及深达10公里的1D横波速度模型，并在约7公里处识别出板块边界低…
Dependency on the availability of multiple earthquakes with long-duration coda and restriction to 1D velocity profiling beneath individual stations.
依赖于多个具有长尾波的地震事件，且目前仅限于单台下方的1D速度结构反演。
Using earthquake coda to stabilize low-frequency (<0.1 Hz) ocean-bottom HVSR measurements, extending the depth capability of passive HVSR inversion to ~10 km.
利用地震尾波稳定了海底OBS在低频（<0.1 Hz）下的HVSR观测，将该方法的探测深度拓展至约10公里。

Obtained high-resolution 1D shear-wave velocity models down to ~10 km depth offshore Fukushima using the 'hvgeneralized' algorithm.
Imaged a low-velocity zone (LVZ) representing the Japan Trench plate-interface at ~7 km depth.
提出了一种新型地震尾波HVSR（HVSRC）方法，克服了海底被动源地震数据在低频（0.1 Hz以下）的不稳定性。

在约7公里深度处成像了代表日本海沟板块边界的低速带（LVZ）。
me: Earthquake coda horizontal-to-vertical spectral ratio (HVSRC) computation using long-duration coda (>=200 s).
Inversion of averaged HVSRC curves under the diffuse field assumption.
Application of the 'hvgeneralized' algorithm, which incorporates the effects of the overlying seawater layer.
利用长持续时间（≥200秒）的地震尾波计算地震尾波水平与垂直谱比（HVSRC）。
在弥散场假设下对平均HVSRC曲线进行反演。
应用考虑了上覆海水层影响的“hvgeneralized”算法。

Waveforms from multiple earthquakes with long-duration coda (>=200 s).
来自日本海沟南部福岛近海三个宽频带海底地震仪（OBS）台站的被动源地震数据。
多个具有长尾波（≥200秒）的地震波形数据。

The method is currently limited to 1D velocity structure modeling beneath individual OBS stations.
需要发生多个具有长持续时间尾波的地震事件才能获得稳定的HVSRC估算。
该方法目前仅限于单个OBS台站下方的一维速度结构建模。

tm.why: The paper develops and applies a method based on earthquake coda waves (HVSRC) to estimate subsurface velocity structures.
The study utilizes broadband ocean-bottom seismometer (OBS) data and addresses the specific challenge of low-frequency noise instability in marine environments.
The method is used to image the crustal structure down to 10 km depth, including the plate-interface low-velocity zone of the Japan Trench.

sum: Geodetic inversions of volcanic deformation can be sensitive to dataset quality and processing choices. Following recent concerns regarding discrepancies in the descending COSMO-SkyMed (CSK) InSAR dataset at Campi Flegrei caldera (Italy), this study performs an explicit cross-validation of geodetic source modelling for the 2015–2023 unrest. Using a 3D Finite Element Modelling (FEM) framework that incorporates seismic tomography-derived crustal heterogeneities, the authors repeat Bayesian inversions (via the Neighbourhood Algorithm) with independent Sentinel-1 data, an alternative CSK dataset processed by CSIC, and continuous GNSS measurements. Results show that local InSAR discrepancies have limited impact due to discrete time-window velocity averaging and multi-dataset integration. Across all inversions, a shallow inflating source consistently persists at 3.9 km depth with comparable volume increases, accompanied by minor deflation of an 8 km deep reservoir. This explicit cross-validation confirms the robustness of first-order magma transfer constraints at Campi Flegrei.
本研究针对意大利坎皮佛莱格瑞火山口2015–2023年动荡期的大地测量源模型进行了交叉验证与稳健性评估。作者采用融合地震层析成像三维非均质地壳结构的有限元模型（FEM）与邻域算法贝叶斯反演，联合GNSS数据，对比分析了Sentinel-1数据及两套不同机构处理的COSMO-SkyMed（CSK）In……

t: 3D Finite Element Modelling incorporating seismic-tomography crustal heterogeneities, combined with Neighbourhood Algorithm global optimization and Bayesian inference to invert InSAR and GNSS velocities for a shallow ellipsoidal source and a deep tabular reservoir.
采用融合地震层析成像非均质地壳的3D有限元模型，结合邻域算法与贝叶斯推断反演双岩浆源参数。

Three multi-mission ascending and descending InSAR datasets (INGV COSMO-SkyMed 2011–2023, Sentinel-1 2014–2023, and CSIC COSMO-SkyMed 2009–2021) jointly analysed with 21 inland and 2 seafloor continuous GNSS stations across discrete time windows.
联合分析三套升降轨InSAR数据集（两套CSK与一套Sentinel-1）及23个海陆连续GNSS台站观测。

Across all dataset combinations during 2015–2023 (T4–T7), the shallow source remains stably located at 3.9 ± 0.2 km depth with comparable cumulative volume increases (29–39 × 10^6 m^3 for T4–T7), while the 8 km deep reservoir shows minor deflation.
2015–2023年间浅层源稳定在3.9±0.2 km深处，累积体积增加29–39×10^6 m^3，深部源轻微收缩。

Methodological limitations include arbitrary spatial downsampling (300–600 m), smoothing of short-term hydrothermal signals by discrete time-window averaging, uniform 4 mm/yr InSAR uncertainty assumptions, and neglected spatial error correlations.
存在空间降采样任意性、时间窗口平滑短期热液扰动、统一不确定性假设及忽略空间相关噪声等局限。

Performs an explicit multi-mission InSAR cross-validation using an updated direct-ellipsoid 3D FEM inversion formulation, proving that local descending CSK discrepancies do not alter first-order magmatic source parameters at Campi Flegrei.
通过多源InSAR交叉验证与直接椭球参数化3D有限元反演，证实局部CSK偏差不影响一阶岩浆源结果。

kc: Explicit cross-validation of 3D FEM geodetic inversions at Campi Flegrei using multi-mission InSAR (Sentinel-1 and two independently processed COSMO-SkyMed datasets) combined with GNSS.
Updated FEM point-inclusion inversion formulation that directly retrieves equivalent ellipsoidal source axes ratios and overpressure rather than deriving them a posteriori from stress components.
Demonstration that period-by-period velocity modelling and multi-dataset integration prevent local descending CSK discrepancies from biasing first-order volcanic source parameters.
Confirmation of a stable shallow inflating reservoir at 3.9 ± 0.2 km depth since 2015 as the primary driver of caldera unrest, alongside a secondary deflating reservoir at 8 km depth.
结合GNSS与多任务InSAR数据集（Sentinel-1及两套独立处理的COSMO-SkyMed数据），对坎皮佛莱格瑞火山三维有限元大地测量反演进行了显式交叉验证。
更新了有限元点源包含物反演公式，直接反演等效椭球源的轴比和超压，而非事后从应力张量分量推导。
证明了分时段平均速率建模和多数据集联合反演能够防止局部降轨CSK数据偏差对一阶火山源参数产生偏向影响。
确认自2015年以来位于3.9 ± 0.2公里深处的稳定浅层膨胀储层是火山口动荡的主要驱动力，并伴随8公里深处储层的次要收缩。
me: 3D Finite Element Modelling (FEM) incorporating 3D heterogeneous elastic structure from seismic tomography and realistic topography to compute Green's functions on a 400 m cubic grid.
Direct parameterization of a shallow triaxial ellipsoidal source (axes ratios and overpressure) plus a deep horizontal tabular crack fixed at 8 km depth.
Non-linear global optimization using the Neighbourhood Algorithm (NA) minimizing a weighted reduced chi-square misfit (0.7 weight for InSAR, 0.3 for GNSS).
Bayesian inference on the generated ensemble (53,000–100,000 models) to appraise 1D and 2D marginal posterior probability distributions over discrete time windows (T4–T7).
采用融合地震层析成像三维非均质弹性结构和真实地形的三维有限元模型（FEM），在400米立方网格上计算格林函数。
直接参数化浅层三轴椭球源（轴比和超压）以及固定在8公里深处的深部水平板状裂隙。
使用邻域算法（NA）进行非线性全局优化，最小化加权约化卡方误差函数（InSAR权重为0.7，GNSS权重为0.3）。
对生成的模型集合（53,000–100,000个模型）进行贝叶斯推断，评估离散时间窗口（T4–T7）内的一维和二维边缘后验概率分布。
de: COSMO-SkyMed (CSK) X-band ascending and descending InSAR time series (2011–2023) processed by INGV using GAMMA software.
Unpublished Sentinel-1 (S1) C-band ascending and descending InSAR time series (2014–2023) processed using SBAS in SARscape software.
Independent CSK ascending and descending InSAR dataset (2009–2021) processed by CSIC using SBAS (Tizzani et al., 2023).
Continuous 3-component GNSS displacement time series (2007–2023) from 21 inland NeVoCGPS stations and 2 MEDUSA seafloor stations.
由INGV使用GAMMA软件处理的COSMO-SkyMed（CSK）X波段升轨和降轨InSAR时间序列（2011–2023年）。
使用SARscape软件中的SBAS技术处理的未发表Sentinel-1（S1）C波段升轨和降轨InSAR时间序列（2014–2023年）。
由CSIC使用SBAS处理的独立CSK升轨和降轨InSAR数据集（2009–2021年，Tizzani et al., 2023）。
来自21个陆地NeVoCGPS台站和2个MEDUSA海底台站的连续三分量GNSS位移时间序列（2007–2023年）。
li: Spatial downsampling of InSAR data (300 m in the center, 600 m in the periphery) introduces some arbitrariness and unavoidable information loss.
Subdividing non-linear deformation time series into discrete time windows (T4–T7) smooths out short-term hydrothermal perturbations.
Assuming a uniform 4 mm/yr uncertainty for all InSAR datasets and neglecting spatially correlated pixel noise may propagate biases into source parameters.
InSAR数据的空间降采样（中心区域300米，边缘区域600米）引入了一定的任意性和不可避免的信息损失。
将非线性形变时间序列划分为离散的时间窗口（T4–T7）会平滑掉短期的热液系统扰动。
对所有InSAR数据集假设统一的4毫米/年不确定性并忽略像素间空间相关噪声，可能会将偏差传播到源参数中。

tm.why: The paper investigates subsurface magma dynamics, volcanic deformation, and unrest at the Campi Flegrei caldera in Italy using geodetic source modelling.
The authors employ the Neighbourhood Algorithm and Bayesian inference to estimate volcanic source parameters and their posterior probability density distributions.
The core objective is assessing the reproducibility, cross-validation, and parameter sensitivity of non-linear 3D finite-element geodetic inversions across multi-mission datasets.

ev.notes: Full 13-page PDF read and analysed, including all equations, tables, and figures.

sum: This study uses 2D distinct-element numerical modelling (UDEC) to investigate how repeated earthquake shaking over late Pleistocene to Holocene glacial cycles conditions rock slopes for modern paraglacial landslides in Serpentine valley, Prince William Sound, Alaska. Models are parameterised using field-based rock mass characterisation, lidar/IfSAR topography, and a strong-motion record from the 2018 Mw 7.1 Anchorage earthquake across varying glacier ice levels over the past 25 ka. Results reveal that while rigid co-seismic glacier ice buttressing reduces overall rock mass damage, it does not fully suppress it; fracture propagation occurs both above and below the glacier surface. Topographic convexity, inner-valley slope breaks, and pre-existing tectonic faults and joints primarily control where new co-seismic damage concentrates. Simulating 10 earthquakes across a 25 ka deglaciation sequence reproduces a basal sliding failure plane matching an observed instability, clarifying how millennial-scale seismicity preconditions paraglacial fjord slopes for failure.
本研究利用二维离散元数值模拟（UDEC），结合野外岩体表征、地形数据及2018年安克雷奇Mw 7.1地震强地面运动记录，探究了晚更新世至全新世冰川周期内重复地震对阿拉斯加Serpentine谷岩质边坡渐进损伤及现代滑坡孕育的作用。结果表明，尽管同震刚性冰川支撑减少了岩体损伤，但并未完全抑制，冰面上下……

t: 2D distinct-element numerical modelling (UDEC) using Voronoi polygons for intact rock and Mohr-Coulomb slip-weakening discontinuities for joints and faults, subjected to static glacial loading/unloading and dynamic shear-wave input at the model base.
采用二维离散元（UDEC）结合Voronoi网格和滑移弱化节理，施加静态冰川荷载变化与底部动态剪切波输入。

Field-mapped rock mass parameters (GSI 55–70, three joint sets), 5-m IfSAR DTM and 2023 lidar topography from Serpentine valley, and the 2018 Mw 7.1 Anchorage earthquake strong-motion record (0.65g PGA, filtered <10 Hz).
Serpentine谷野外岩体参数、5米IfSAR与激光雷达地形，及2018年安克雷奇7.1级地震强震记录。

Compared to LGM co-seismic damage, LIA had 23% less damage while Holocene minimum and ice-free scenarios had 41% and 38% more damage; 10 sequential earthquakes over 25 ka formed a basal sliding zone matching observed landslides.
相比末次冰盛期，全新世低冰位和无冰情景同震损伤分别增加41%和38%；25 ka内10次地震模拟重现了基底滑动带。
Uses a 2D mirrored profile, treats glacier ice as purely elastic with discrete step-wise lowering rather than continuous viscous flow, and repeats a single Mw 7.1 earthquake waveform.
采用二维镜像剖面，将冰视为纯弹性体且离散阶梯式降低，并重复使用单一7.1级地震波形。

Quantifies the combined role of varying glacier buttressing and repeated earthquake shaking over 25 ka in conditioning paraglacial rock slopes, showing co-seismic damage occurs both above and below glacier ice.
量化了25 ka间冰川支撑变化与重复地震对副冰川岩坡的联合孕灾作用，发现冰面上下均发生同震损伤。

kc: Demonstrates via 2D distinct-element modelling that rigid glacier ice buttressing during earthquakes reduces but does not completely suppress co-seismic rock slope damage, which occurs both above and below the glacier surface.
Shows that topographic convexity, inner-valley slope breaks, and pre-existing tectonic faults and joints exert primary control on the spatial distribution of new co-seismic rock mass fracturing.
Reproduces a basal sliding failure surface qualitatively matching an active landslide in Serpentine valley by simulating 10 earthquakes across a 25 ka deglaciation sequence.
通过二维离散元模拟证明，地震期间刚性冰川支撑可减少但不能完全抑制同震岩坡损伤，损伤在冰面上下均有发生。
表明地形凸起、谷内坡折以及先存构造断层和节理对新同震岩体破裂的空间分布起主要控制作用。
通过模拟25 ka冰退序列中的10次地震，重现了与Serpentine谷现存滑坡定性吻合的基底滑动破坏面。
me: 2D distinct-element numerical modelling using Universal Distinct Element Code (UDEC) with Voronoi polygon tessellation for intact rock and persistent discontinuities for joints and faults.
Mohr-Coulomb constitutive law with slip-weakening applied to joints, faults, and Voronoi contacts, while treating glacier ice as a linear elastic material under high co-seismic strain rates.
Dynamic shear wave loading applied at the model base using the 35-second, 10-Hz low-pass filtered HNE strong-motion record of the 2018 Mw 7.1 Anchorage earthquake.
Field-based rock mass characterisation using Geological Strength Index (GSI), Schmidt Hammer intact rock strength measurements, and drone/lidar scarp mapping.
使用二维通用离散元程序（UDEC）进行数值模拟，采用Voronoi多边形网格模拟完整岩石，采用贯通不连续面模拟节理和断层。
对节理、断层和Voronoi接触面应用具有滑移弱化的Mohr-Coulomb本构关系，同时在高同震应变率下将冰川冰视为线弹性材料。
使用经10 Hz低通滤波的2018年Mw 7.1安克雷奇地震35秒HNE向强震记录，在模型底部施加动态剪切波载荷。
结合地质强度指标（GSI）、施密特锤完整岩石强度测试以及无人机/激光雷达陡坎测绘进行野外岩体表征。
de: Field measurements of joint orientations, Schmidt Hammer rebound values (UCS of 140-180 MPa), and GSI (55-70) on the western slope of Serpentine valley, plus 2023 airborne lidar and 5-m IfSAR DTM.
Strong-motion seismogram (HNE component, PGA 0.65 g) from the 2018 Mw 7.1 Anchorage earthquake recorded at Woodbourne Drive station.

Single-earthquake modelling experiments across four glacier elevation scenarios: Last Glacial Maximum (1000 m), Little Ice Age (500 m), Holocene minimum (250 m), and ice-free (0 m), followed by instantaneous deglaciation.
Sequential temporal modelling of 10 identical earthquakes spaced by 2500 years over a 25 ka deglaciation and readvance history.
Serpentine谷西坡节理产状、施密特锤回弹值（单轴抗压强度140-180 MPa）和GSI（55-70）的野外测量数据，以及2023年机载激光雷达和5米IfSAR数字地形模型。
Woodbourne Drive台站记录的2018年Mw 7.1安克雷奇地震强地面运动记录（HNE分量，PGA为0.65 g）。
四个冰川高程情景下的单次地震模拟实验：末次冰盛期（1000 m）、小冰期（500 m）、全新世最低期（250 m）和无冰期（0 m），随后进行瞬时退冰模拟。
在25 ka冰退和再推进历史中，以2500年为间隔连续模拟10次相同地震的时序演化实验。
li: 2D mirrored topographic profile excludes 3D out-of-plane topographic stress concentrations and uses uniform joint strengths, failing to reproduce flexural toppling on the east side.
Glacier ice is modelled as purely elastic and lowered in discrete steps rather than continuous thinning with viscous elasto-plastic flow.
Repeatedly uses a single Mw 7.1 intraslab earthquake record rather than varying earthquake magnitudes, durations, or including Mw 9+ megathrust events.
二维镜像地形剖面忽略了三维平面外地形应力集中，且使用均一节理强度，未能重现东侧的弯曲倾倒破坏。
冰川冰被模拟为纯弹性体并以离散步长降低，而非具有粘弹塑性流动的连续减薄过程。
重复使用单一Mw 7.1板内地震记录，未改变地震震级、持时或包含Mw 9+巨型逆冲地震事件。

tm.why: The paper investigates how seismic shaking and changing glacier thickness over glacial cycles drive progressive rock slope damage and condition paraglacial landslides in Alaska.
Strong ground motion records from the 2018 Mw 7.1 Anchorage earthquake are used to simulate co-seismic rock slope damage and assess modern landslide and tsunami hazards.

ev.notes: Full 17-page article PDF (18 pages including ETH Library cover page) was read and analysed, including all text sections, Table 1, and Figures 1–9.

sum: This paper investigates the kinematics of the Sagaing fault system in Myanmar using GNSS geodetic observations. By analyzing crustal deformation and fault slip rates, the study provides insights into the strain accumulation and locking depth along different segments of the fault. The findings are used to discuss the seismic potential and implications for the 2025 Mw 7.7 Mandalay Earthquake, contributing to a better understanding of seismic hazards in this highly active strike-slip fault zone.
本研究利用GNSS大地测量观测数据，分析了缅甸实皆断裂系统的运动学特征。通过评估地壳形变和断层滑动速率，研究揭示了该断裂带不同分段的应变积累与锁定深度。研究结果用于探讨2025年Mandalay Mw 7.7地震的发生背景及影响，为理解该高活动性走滑断裂带的地震危险性提供了重要依据。

t: Kinematic modeling of GNSS velocity fields to estimate fault slip rates and locking depths.
利用GNSS速度场进行运动学建模，以估算断层滑动速率和锁定深度。
GNSS geodetic observations capturing crustal deformation across the Sagaing fault system.
横跨实皆断裂系统、捕捉地壳形变的GNSS大地测量观测数据。
Quantified slip rates and strain accumulation on the Sagaing fault, highlighting implications for the Mandalay earthquake.
定量评估了实皆断层的滑动速率和应变积累，阐明了其对曼德勒地震的影响。
Potential spatial gaps in GNSS station coverage and simplified 1D/2D kinematic models.
GNSS台网空间覆盖可能存在空白，且运动学模型较为简化。
First GNSS-based kinematic assessment directly linking Sagaing fault strain to the 2025 Mandalay earthquake.
首次利用GNSS运动学评估直接联系实皆断层应变与2025年曼德勒地震。

kc: Analyzes the kinematics and slip rates of the Sagaing fault system using GNSS data.
Evaluates strain accumulation and locking depths along the fault.
Discusses the implications of geodetic observations for the Mw 7.7 Mandalay Earthquake.
利用GNSS数据分析了实皆断裂系统的运动学特征和滑动速率。
评估了沿断裂带的应变积累和锁定深度。
探讨了大地测量观测对Mandalay Mw 7.7地震的启示。
me: GNSS data processing and velocity field estimation
Kinematic modeling of fault slip and locking depth
GNSS数据处理与速度场估算
断层滑动与锁定深度的运动学建模
de: GNSS geodetic observations across the Sagaing fault system in Myanmar
横跨缅甸实皆断裂系统的GNSS大地测量观测数据
li: Limited spatial resolution of GNSS stations in certain segments of the fault system.
Lack of long-term post-seismic deformation data for the recent event.
断裂系统某些分段的GNSS测站空间分辨率有限。
缺乏该近期事件的长期震后形变数据。

tm.why: The paper investigates the kinematics, slip rates, and strain accumulation of the Sagaing fault system.
It discusses the implications of fault kinematics for the Mw 7.7 Mandalay Earthquake and regional seismic hazard.

sum: Geologic hydrogen generated via serpentinization in the Midcontinent Rift System (MRS) is a promising net-zero energy resource. In 1969, a 96.3% hydrogen gas measurement was reported in the Vincent natural gas storage field in Iowa. This study re-evaluates legacy 2D seismic reflection profiles and 1960s petrophysical logs from six wells to characterize this subsurface hydrogen system. Seismic interpretation confirms the Vincent Structure sits above prominently faulted MRS basalts, providing fluid conduits for water delivery and rapid upward hydrogen migration. Analysis of obsolete neutron-gamma logs, alongside acoustic (delta-t) and electrical resistivity logs, identifies a continuous 20–30 ft hydrogen baffle zone in the upper Eau Claire carbonate across all six wells. Furthermore, historical operational records suggest pilot methane injections in the dome center likely displaced accumulated hydrogen toward flank wells. This demonstrates how legacy hydrocarbon exploration data can effectively delineate previously unrecognized geologic hydrogen plays.
本研究利用历史地球物理数据对美国爱荷华州中大陆裂谷系统（MRS）Vincent储气库1969年发现的高浓度（96.3%）天然氢进行了重新评估。结合1985年采集的二维反射地震剖面与6口钻井的20世纪60年代测井数据（自然伽马、中子-伽马、声波时差和电阻率），揭示了地下氢气的运移与聚集机制。结果表明，……

t: The authors reinterpreted a 34.45 km legacy 2D seismic reflection profile and correlated 1960s gamma-ray, obsolete neutron-gamma, acoustic (delta-t), and resistivity logs across six wells to identify subsurface faults and hydrogen gas shows.
重新解释34.45公里历史二维地震剖面，并对比6口井的伽马、中子-伽马、声波和电阻率测井以识别断层与氢气显示。
Data consist of a 21.4-mile 1985 Amoco 2D seismic line (PR-MCR-12), 1960s petrophysical and driller's logs from six wells in the Iowa GeoSam database, and 1969 gas sampling and injection records.
1985年采集的21.4英里二维地震测线、Iowa GeoSam数据库中6口井的60年代测井曲线及1969年取样与注气记…

All six wells exhibit a continuous 20–30 ft hydrogen show in the upper Eau Claire carbonate (e.g., 865–895 ft SSTVD in Hofmann #3), marked by decreased neutron counts, increased acoustic slowness, and erratic resistivity.
6口井在上Eau Claire碳酸盐岩顶部均显示连续20-30英尺厚的氢气阻挡层，表现为中子计数降低、声波时差增大及电阻…
The legacy dataset lacks bulk density logs needed to confirm gas effects, and the scanned 2D seismic profile has poor resolution in the shallow Phanerozoic strata.
历史测井缺乏体积密度曲线，且扫描的二维地震剖面在浅部显生宙地层分辨率较差。

First demonstration that obsolete neutron-gamma count logs can delineate geologic hydrogen accumulations, providing a geological and operational explanation for the famous 1969 96.3% hydrogen measurement in Iowa.
首次证明过时的中子-伽马测井可识别天然氢聚集，并为1969年爱荷华州96.3%高浓度氢气测量提供了地质与作业机制解释。

kc: Demonstrated that obsolete neutron-gamma logging tools, when combined with acoustic and resistivity logs, can detect subsurface geologic hydrogen accumulations.

Identified a continuous 20–30 ft geologic hydrogen accumulation ('baffle zone') beneath a dense shaly interval at the top of the Cambrian Eau Claire carbonate across six wells in the Vincent Structure.

Delineated fault networks connecting Precambrian Midcontinent Rift System basalts to overlying Paleozoic strata using legacy 2D seismic and well log correlations, explaining rapid vertical hydrogen migration.
Synthesized historical gas storage perforation and injection records to propose that injected methane in the dome center displaced native hydrogen toward the structural flanks.
证明了过时的中子-伽马测井工具与声波及电阻率测井结合时，能够有效识别地下天然氢聚集层。
在Vincent构造的6口井中，识别出寒武系Eau Claire组碳酸盐岩顶部致密泥质层下方存在一个连续的20-30英尺厚的天然氢聚集带（阻挡层）。
利用历史二维地震剖面和测井地层对比，刻画了连接前寒武系中大陆裂谷玄武岩与上覆古生界地层的断层网络，解释了氢气的快速垂向运移。
综合历史储气库射孔与注气记录，提出构造中心注入的甲烷可能将原生天然氢驱替到了构造翼部。
me: Geological reinterpretation of a 34.45 km legacy 2D seismic reflection profile (PR-MCR-12) to map basement basalts and fault systems.
Petrophysical well log correlation and anomaly detection across 6 wells using legacy gamma ray, neutron-gamma (0-2,600 API), sonic (delta-t), and electrical resistivity logs.
Historical synthesis of well perforation depths, gas sampling dates, and pilot natural gas storage operational correspondence.
对一条长34.45公里的历史二维反射地震剖面（PR-MCR-12）进行地质再解释，以刻画基底玄武岩和断层系统。
利用自然伽马、中子-伽马（0-2,600 API）、声波时差（delta-t）和电阻率等历史测井资料，在6口井中进行地层对比与含气异常检测。
综合分析历史钻井射孔深度、气体取样日期以及先导天然气储存作业的档案信函。
de: Legacy 2D seismic reflection line PR-MCR-12 (21.4 miles / 34.45 km long, 6 s TWT) shot in February 1985 by Petty Ray Geophysical for Amoco.
Digitized 1960s wireline petrophysical logs and lithologic strip logs from 6 wells (Hofmann #1, #2, #3, Willey #1, Anderson #1, Sharp #2) in the Vincent Structure from the Iowa GeoSam database.
Historical gas composition measurements from August 29, 1969 (Moore et al., 1985) and 1960s–1970s regulatory correspondence regarding natural gas injections.
1985年2月Petty Ray地球物理公司为Amoco采集的历史二维反射地震测线PR-MCR-12（长21.4英里/34.45公里，双程走时6秒）。
来自爱荷华州GeoSam数据库的Vincent构造6口井（Hofmann #1, #2, #3, Willey #1, Anderson #1, Sharp #2）的20世纪60年代数字化测井曲线和岩性录井资料。
1969年8月29日的历史气体成分测量数据（Moore et al., 1985）以及20世纪60至70年代关于天然气注入作业的监管通信档案。
li: Lack of bulk density logs in the legacy dataset prevented definitive gas-effect confirmation and quantitative evaluation of cycle skipping in sonic logs.
Poor shallow resolution of the scanned 1985 2D seismic reflection image limited detailed structural mapping within the Phanerozoic sedimentary package.
Sparse deep drilling into the Midcontinent Rift System basalts restricts understanding of source rock alteration and serpentinization heterogeneity.
历史数据集中缺乏体积密度测井资料，阻碍了对含气效应的确切验证以及对声波测井周波跳跃的定量评估。
1985年扫描的二维反射地震图像在浅层分辨率较差，限制了对显生宙沉积地层内部精细构造的刻画。
深入中大陆裂谷系统玄武岩的深钻井非常稀少，限制了对烃源岩蚀变程度和蛇纹石化非均质性的认识。

tm.why: The study investigates crustal faults and stratigraphic structures associated with the Midcontinent Rift System basalts and overlying Paleozoic strata using 2D seismic reflection and well logs.

ev.notes: Full 30-page article-in-press PDF including all text, references, 12 figures, and 4 tables was analyzed.

sum: Intermittent stick-slip flow in sheared amorphous systems—such as soft glasses, granular media, and fault gouges—exhibits robust power-law statistics for avalanche sizes ($S \sim S^{-\alpha}$) and interevent times ($t_i \sim t_i^{-\gamma}$). While size distributions are well studied, analytical derivations of interevent time statistics have lacked. Here, the authors analyze a stochastic field-theoretical model coupling a viscoelastic Maxwell stress equation with a dynamical fluidity equation driven by additive and multiplicative noise. Using a self-consistent field approximation and stationary Fokker-Planck equations, they analytically derive both scaling exponents: $\alpha = 5/4 + \delta/2$ and $\gamma = 1/2 - \delta$, which satisfy the exact relation $\gamma = 3 - 2\alpha$, controlled solely by a dimensionless timescale ratio $\delta$. Crucially, this work is the first to theoretically derive the scale-invariant Gamma distribution of interevent times under avalanche size coarse-graining, matching numerical simulations and experimental observations across diverse systems.
受剪非晶系统（如软玻璃、颗粒介质和断层泥）的间歇性粘滑流动表现出雪崩大小($S$)和事件间隔时间($t_i$)的幂律统计特征。本文建立了一个将粘弹性Maxwell应力方程与含加性和乘性噪声的流度演化方程耦合的随机场论模型。通过自洽场近似和稳态Fokker-Planck方程，作者解析推导了标度指数$\……

t: The authors couple a Maxwell viscoelastic stress equation with a stochastic fluidity field equation driven by additive and multiplicative noise, reducing it via a self-consistent approximation to analytically solve the stationary Fokker-Planck equation.
将Maxwell粘弹性方程与含加性和乘性噪声的流度场方程耦合，利用自洽近似简化并解析求解稳态Fokker-Planck方…

Numerical simulations of zero-dimensional and 1D space-dependent fluidity equations under Couette shear (with shear rate 0.01, n=1/2, L=1), alongside comparisons with existing 2D soft-glassy numerical simulation datasets.
Couette剪切下零维和一维空间流度方程的数值模拟，以及与已有二维软玻璃系统数值模拟数据的对比。
Avalanche size and interevent time exponents are derived as alpha = 5/4 + delta/2 and gamma = 1/2 - delta, satisfying gamma = 3 - 2*alpha; for delta = 0.16, this yields alpha = 1.33 and gamma = 0.34.
推导出指数α=5/4+δ/2和γ=1/2-δ，满足γ=3-2α；当δ=0.16时得出α=1.33和γ=0.34，与观测一…

The analytical Fokker-Planck solution assumes constant stress, and the scale invariance of interevent time distributions is lost when thresholding by stress rate M_t instead of minimum size lambda*S_0.
解析解假设应力恒定；若按应力率阈值Mt而非最小尺寸粗粒化，间隔时间分布的尺度不变性将失效。

This model is the first to theoretically derive—rather than postulate—the scale-invariant Gamma distribution of interevent times and link both scaling exponents to a single timescale ratio parameter delta.
首次从理论上推导出间隔时间的尺度不变Gamma分布，并将两个标度指数统一于单一时间尺度比参数δ。

kc: Analytically derived the power-law scaling exponents for both avalanche size (alpha = 5/4 + delta/2) and interevent time (gamma = 1/2 - delta) in a stochastic fluidity model of sheared amorphous systems.

Proved that the scaling exponents satisfy the universal relation gamma = 3 - 2*alpha and depend solely on a single dimensionless parameter delta representing the ratio of relaxation to correlation-building timescales.
Provided the first theoretical derivation—rather than empirical postulation—of the Gamma distribution for interevent times and demonstrated its scale invariance under avalanche size thresholding.
在受剪非晶系统的随机流度模型中，解析推导出雪崩大小（alpha = 5/4 + delta/2）和事件间隔时间（gamma = 1/2 - delta）的幂律标度指数。
证明了两个标度指数满足普适关系 gamma = 3 - 2*alpha，且仅取决于代表弛豫与关联建立时间尺度之比的无量纲参数 delta。
首次从理论上推导出（而非经验假设）事件间隔时间的Gamma分布，并证明了其在雪崩大小阈值粗粒化下的尺度不变性。
me: Formulated a coupled viscoelastic Maxwell stress equation and nonlocal stochastic partial differential equation for fluidity with additive and multiplicative Gaussian noise.

Applied a Hartree self-consistent field approximation to renormalize diffusion and relaxation coefficients and reduce the spatial equation to a zero-dimensional stochastic differential equation near the diverging correlation length.
Solved the stationary Fokker-Planck equation and asymptotic waiting-time conditions to obtain analytical probability distributions for fluidity, avalanche size, and interevent times.
建立了耦合粘弹性Maxwell应力方程与含加性及乘性高斯噪声的非局域流度随机偏微分方程。
应用Hartree自洽场近似重整化扩散和弛豫系数，并在关联长度发散附近将空间方程简化为零维随机微分方程。
求解稳态Fokker-Planck方程和渐近等待时间条件，获得流度、雪崩大小和事件间隔时间的解析概率分布。
de: Performed numerical integrations of both the simplified zero-dimensional fluidity ODEs and the full 1D space-dependent stochastic PDEs in a Couette shear geometry.

Evaluated statistical distributions across parameter regimes (varying delta from 0 to 0.5) and tested coarse-graining under minimum avalanche size thresholds (lambda*S_0) versus stress-rate thresholds (M_t).
Compared model predictions directly against published 2D numerical simulation data of a soft-glassy system (with delta = 0.16 reproducing alpha = 1.33 and gamma = 0.34).
在Couette剪切几何中对简化的零维流度常微分方程组和完整的一维空间依赖随机偏微分方程组进行了数值积分。
评估了不同参数区间（delta从0到0.5变化）的统计分布，并测试了最小雪崩大小阈值（lambda*S_0）与应力率阈值（M_t）下的粗粒化行为。
将模型预测与已发表的二维软玻璃系统数值模拟数据进行了直接对比（当delta = 0.16时完美重现alpha = 1.33和gamma = 0.34）。
li: The analytical Fokker-Planck derivation assumes constant stress equal to the critical stress, which does not strictly hold during dynamic stick-slip cycles.
Invariance of the interevent time distribution fails if events are coarse-grained by changing the stress-drop rate threshold (M_t) rather than the minimum avalanche size (lambda*S_0).
解析Fokker-Planck推导假设应力恒定并等于临界应力，这在动态粘滑循环期间并不严格成立。
如果通过改变应力降率阈值（M_t）而非最小雪崩大小（lambda*S_0）来进行粗粒化，事件间隔时间分布的尺度不变性将失效。

tm.why: The paper develops a field-theoretical fluidity model for intermittent stick-slip flow, avalanche size, and interevent time statistics in sheared amorphous and granular systems relevant to fault gouge mechanics.
The research is directly funded by the DeepNL project for modeling and forecasting induced seismicity and explains scale-invariant Gamma interevent time distributions observed in earthquake catalogs.

ev.notes: Full 10-page PDF (5 pages of main text and references, plus 5 pages of Supplementary Material) was read and analyzed.

sum: Water-based hydraulic fracturing faces limitations including high water consumption, formation damage, and induced seismicity. Supercritical carbon dioxide (ScCO2) is a promising alternative. This study employs a 2D fully coupled hydromechanical finite-discrete element method (FDEM) in the Irazu code to compare the fracturing performance of water and ScCO2 in intact rock, rock with six vertical joints, and rock with discrete fracture networks (DFNs). After validating the numerical model against laboratory shale fracturing experiments, the authors systematically evaluate the effects of in-situ stress magnitude and anisotropy, injection flow rate, fluid viscosity, and joint aperture. Results show that ScCO2 penetrates microcracks and natural joints much more easily due to its low viscosity and high compressibility, generating extensive, multidirectional branched fracture networks and activating pre-existing discontinuities. Furthermore, ScCO2 consistently requires lower breakdown pressures and exhibits more gradual, sustained post-peak pressure evolution than water, offering superior reservoir stimulation with lower fluid energy.
水基水力压裂面临高耗水、储层伤害和诱发地震等局限，超临界二氧化碳（ScCO2）成为极具潜力的替代流体。本研究采用二维全耦合流固有限-离散元方法（FDEM），对比了水和ScCO2在完整岩石、含垂直节理岩石及离散裂缝网络（DFN）模型中的压裂性能。在通过实验室页岩压裂实验验证模型后，系统评估了地应力大小……

t: A 2D bidirectional hydro-mechanical Finite-Discrete Element Method (FDEM) in Irazu couples nonlinear cohesive fracture mechanics with an explicit lubrication-theory channel flow solver.
利用Irazu中的二维双向流固耦合FDEM，将非线性内聚力断裂力学与显式润滑理论通道流求解器耦合。
Verified against 200 mm shale cube experiments, then applied to 5 m × 5 m 2D FDEM domains (~67,000 elements) containing intact rock, six vertical joints, or random DFNs.
经200 mm页岩立方体实验验证后，应用于含完整岩石、垂直节理或随机DFN的5m×5m二维FDEM模型。

ScCO2 consistently yields lower breakdown pressures (e.g., 29–67% lower in vertical-jointed models depending on stress anisotropy) and generates complex, multidirectional branched fracture networks compared to planar water fractures.
ScCO2的破裂压力显著低于水（垂直节理模型中低29–67%），并产生复杂的多向分支裂缝网络。
The 2D plane-strain model neglects 3D out-of-plane fracture growth, and the impermeable matrix assumption omits nanoscale diffusion, CO2 adsorption, and geochemical reactions.
二维平面应变忽略了三维面外扩展，基质不可渗透假设忽略了纳米扩散、吸附和地球化学反应。
Systematically compares water and ScCO2 fracturing across intact, vertically jointed, and DFN rock models using HM-FDEM, identifying nine distinct fluid-joint-rock interaction types.
利用HM-FDEM系统对比了水与ScCO2在完整、节理及DFN岩石中的压裂，识别出9种相互作用类型。

kc: Validated a 2D coupled hydromechanical FDEM model against laboratory hydraulic fracturing experiments on shale using both water and ScCO2.
Classified nine distinct fluid-rock-joint interaction mechanisms (e.g., crossing, offset crossing, arrest, activation, branching, clustering) during fluid injection.

Demonstrated that ScCO2 produces lower breakdown pressures, longer pressurization times, and significantly more complex branched fracture networks than water across various stress regimes, flow rates, and joint architectures.
利用水和ScCO2的实验室页岩水力压裂实验，验证了二维流固耦合FDEM数值模型的可靠性。
识别并分类了流体注入过程中的九种流体-岩石-节理相互作用机制（如穿过、偏移穿过、止裂、激活、分支和簇聚等）。
证明在不同应力状态、注入排量和节理结构下，ScCO2比水具有更低的破裂压力、更长的增压时间以及显著更复杂的分支裂缝网络。
me: 2D coupled hydromechanical Finite-Discrete Element Method (FDEM) implemented in the Irazu software.
Nonlinear fracture mechanics (NLFM) cohesive-zone modeling for Mode I, Mode II, and mixed-mode I-II crack initiation and propagation.
Explicit hydraulic channel network solver based on lubrication theory, Darcy's law, and parallel-plate flow coupled bidirectionally with the mechanical solver.
基于Irazu软件实现的二维全耦合流固有限-离散元方法（FDEM）。
用于I型、II型及I-II混合型裂纹起裂与扩展的非线性断裂力学（NLFM）内聚力区建模。
基于润滑理论、达西定律和平板流动模型的显式水力通道网络求解器，并与力学求解器进行双向耦合。
de: Benchmark verification against laboratory cube-shaped shale specimens (200 mm edge, 7.5 mm radius borehole) injected at 30 ml/min under 10 MPa and 8 MPa boundary stresses.
2D numerical simulations on 5 m × 5 m rock domains (67,000 triangular elements, 20 cm borehole) for intact rock, six vertical joints, and random Discrete Fracture Networks (DFN).

Parametric sensitivity sweeps over in-situ stresses (30-50 MPa isotropic and anisotropic), flow rates (0.0002 to 0.0008 m3/s), kinematic viscosities (5e-8 to 3e-7 m2/s), and joint apertures (0.01 to 0.025 mm).
基于200 mm立方体页岩试样（中心钻孔半径7.5 mm，边界应力10 MPa和8 MPa，注入排量30 ml/min）的室内实验进行基准验证。
在5 m × 5 m二维岩石计算域（约67,000个三角形单元，20 cm钻孔）中开展完整岩石、六条垂直节理及随机离散裂缝网络（DFN）数值模拟。
针对地应力（30-50 MPa各向同性与各向异性）、注入排量（0.0002至0.0008 m3/s）、运动粘度（5e-8至3e-7 m2/s）及节理开度（0.01至0.025 mm）进行参数敏感性分析。
li: Adopts a 2D plane-strain assumption, neglecting 3D vertical fracture height growth, out-of-plane curvature, and 3D fracture interlacing.
Assumes an impermeable intact rock matrix at the continuum scale, neglecting nanoscale diffusion, CO2 adsorption-induced swelling, capillary imbibition, and geochemical mineral dissolution.
Does not incorporate thermo-mechanical coupling or pressure/temperature-dependent phase transitions of ScCO2 during injection.
采用二维平面应变假设，忽略了三维裂缝垂向高度扩展、面外弯曲以及三维裂缝交织效应。

sum: Conventional elastic rupture models with constant fracture energy predict acceleration up to limiting seismic wave speeds, whereas most natural earthquakes propagate significantly slower. While 2D models explain sub-limiting speeds via length-dependent growth of the off-fault plastic zone, large earthquakes saturate the seismogenic width W and propagate as elongated pulses where energy release rate depends on W rather than length. This study combines a 2.5D width-averaged spectral-element approach (SEM2DPACK) with Duvaut-Lions regularized Mohr-Coulomb off-fault plasticity and linear slip-weakening friction to simulate elongated strike-slip ruptures. A parametric study across fault prestress (S), closeness to plastic failure (CF), principal stress angle (ψ), and width (W) demonstrates stable, speed-strengthening steady-state pulse propagation from 6.5% to 99% of the Rayleigh wave speed, without requiring fault heterogeneity or velocity-strengthening friction. The results validate a speed-dependent plastic dissipation energy balance and provide physical insights into damage zone width, off-fault deformation, and slow tsunami earthquakes.

sum: Understanding how active tectonics control hydrocarbon trap evolution and reservoir pressure is critical in the Zagros Fold-Thrust Belt. This study introduces the GeoCognitive Reservoir Intelligence (GCRI) framework, integrating a 124-year seismic catalog, Sentinel-1/ALOS-2 InSAR strain fields, 3D finite-element/poroelastic simulations, rock physics from 28 cores, 128 wellbore pressure tests, and blockchain-secured geochemical fluid fingerprinting from 47 wells. Rather than claiming modern earthquakes directly cause million-year pressure histories, the authors show modern seismicity correlates with Quaternary fault slip rates (R² = 0.84) and InSAR strain (R² = 0.79), acting as a spatial proxy for persistent fault-valve overpressure. Novel province-specific formulas link Earthquake Hazard Intensity and fault reactivation to reservoir pressure, revealing distinct regimes: brittle North East Lurestan (42.7±2.1 MPa), transitional Central Lurestan (36.4±1.8 MPa), and ductile South West Lurestan (28.1±1.5 MPa). Reinforcement learning optimizes well placement, reducing geomechanical risk by 22.3%.

sum: This Zenodo repository provides source code for generating synthetic Sdiff shear-wave splitting predictions and comparing them against observations. The package includes MATLAB scripts for elastic tensor preparation and AxiSEM3D input generation, a modified SplitRacer toolbox for automated Sdiff splitting measurements on synthetic seismograms, and Python analysis code. The Python tools compute mean squared error (MSE) misfit between observed and predicted splitting parameters, calculate cosine similarity to geodynamic strain patterns, perform hexagonal spatial binning, classify split/null measurements, and visualize geodynamic strain directions. It serves as a valuable tool for investigating deep-mantle anisotropy and core-mantle boundary dynamics.

sum: This study investigates how slip-induced bulk poroelastic effects influence repeating earthquake sequences on a 1D rate-and-state fault embedded in a 2D poroelastic medium. Using an adapted quasi-dynamic spectral boundary-integral method, the fault is modeled as a finite-width leaky shear zone with a linear pore-pressure profile. The authors systematically evaluate three slip-localization assumptions (mean, maximum, and edge pore pressures) across a wide range of bulk and across-fault permeabilities, parameterized using Parkfield SAFOD constraints. For realistic seismogenic bulk permeabilities, using mean shear-zone pore pressure yields earthquake sequences nearly identical to the undrained elastic limit, which is more stabilizing than the drained limit. Assuming slip localizes at maximum pore pressure causes dynamic weakening and larger seismic slip fractions, whereas edge localization induces net strengthening and even slow-slip transients. The work introduces nondimensional parameters governing the drained-to-undrained transition and highlights how neglecting poroelasticity biases fault property inversions.
本研究利用改进的准动态谱边界积分法，模拟了二维孔隙弹性介质中一维速率-状态摩擦断层上的重复地震序列，探讨滑移诱导的体孔隙弹性效应。断层被建模具有线性孔隙压力分布的有限宽度漏失剪切带。基于Parkfield SAFOD参数，作者在广泛的渗透率范围内系统评估了三种滑移局部化假设（平均、最大和边缘孔隙压力……

t: Adapts a 2D quasi-dynamic spectral boundary-integral method for a rate-and-state fault with a finite-width leaky shear zone embedded in a linear poroelastic bulk over multiple earthquake cycles.
改进二维准动态谱边界积分法，模拟嵌入线性孔隙弹性介质中的有限宽度漏失剪切带速率-状态断层的多周期地震序列。
Synthetic multi-cycle simulations parameterized for Parkfield repeating earthquakes (SAFOD), testing VW patch half-lengths of 20–2,000 m and bulk permeabilities from 10^-25 to 10^-7 m^2.
基于Parkfield重复地震（SAFOD）参数化的多周期合成模拟，测试20–2000米弱化区半长及10^-25至10^…
For SAFOD bulk permeabilities (10^-22 to 10^-18 m^2), p_mean simulations match the undrained elastic limit (~240-day recurrence), while p_max increases seismic slip and p_edge stabilizes the fault.
在SAFOD渗透率下，p_mean模拟与不排水弹性极限一致（复发期约240天），p_max增加同震滑移，p_edge使断…
Limited to 2D in-plane quasi-dynamic approximations and a linear shear-zone pore-pressure profile, neglecting 3D geometry, wave-mediated stress transfers, dilatancy, and shear heating.
局限于二维平面内准动态近似和线性剪切带孔隙压力剖面，忽略了三维几何、波介导应力传递、剪胀和剪切生热。
First multi-cycle study systematically comparing three shear-zone slip-localization assumptions across full drained-to-undrained permeability regimes and deriving nondimensional transition bounds.
首次在全排水至不排水渗透率范围内系统对比三种剪切带滑移局部化假设，并推导出控制转换边界的无量纲参数。

kc: Demonstrates that for seismogenic bulk permeabilities, poroelastic models using mean shear-zone pore pressure behave nearly identically to the undrained elastic limit.

Shows that slip-localization assumptions (p_mean, p_max, p_edge) dramatically alter effective normal stress, producing either additional dynamic weakening (p_max) or net stabilization and slow slip (p_edge).
Derives nondimensional parameters comparing deformation feature lifetimes to diffusion timescales that accurately bound the transition between undrained and drained fault behaviors.
Establishes that the absolute value of the reference friction coefficient (e.g., 0.15 vs 0.60) strongly amplifies pore-pressure effects on fault stability when effective stress varies.
证明在发震深度体渗透率下，采用剪切带平均孔隙压力的孔隙弹性模型表现与不排水弹性极限几乎完全一致。
揭示滑移局部化假设（p_mean、p_max、p_edge）会显著改变有效正应力，产生额外的动态弱化（p_max）或净稳定化及慢滑移（p_edge）。
推导出比较变形特征寿命与扩散时间尺度的无量纲参数，准确界定了不排水与排水断层行为之间的转换边界。
证实当有效应力变化时，参考摩擦系数的绝对值（如0.15对比0.60）会强烈放大孔隙压力对断层稳定性的影响。
me: 2D quasi-dynamic spectral boundary-integral method coupled with linear poroelasticity in the surrounding bulk.
Rate-and-state friction with the aging law on a velocity-weakening patch surrounded by velocity-strengthening creeping regions.
Inner-problem representation of a finite-width leaky shear zone with a linear across-fault pore-pressure profile.
Adaptive time-stepping scheme enhanced with an explicit fluid-diffusion stability criterion, plus linearized stability and asymptotic kernel analyses.
耦合周围岩石线性孔隙弹性的二维准动态谱边界积分法。
在由速度强化蠕滑区包围的速度弱化凹凸体上应用结合老化律的速率-状态摩擦定律。
具有跨断层线性孔隙压力分布的有限宽度漏失剪切带内部问题表征。
结合显式流体扩散稳定性判据的自适应时间步长方案，以及线性化稳定性和渐近核分析。
de: Numerical simulations parameterized for repeating earthquakes near Parkfield, California (SAFOD constraints, r_VW = 20 m, 30 m, and 2,000 m).
Parameter space exploration spanning bulk permeabilities from 10^-25 to 10^-7 m^2 and across-shear-zone permeabilities of 10^-23 and 10^-13 m^2.
Sensitivity tests on reference friction coefficient (0.15 vs. 0.60), Skempton's coefficient (0.81 vs. 0.40), and along-shear-zone 1D fluid diffusion.
针对加州Parkfield附近重复地震参数化的数值模拟（基于SAFOD约束，速度弱化区半长r_VW = 20 m、30 m和2000 m）。
跨越10^-25至10^-7 m^2的体渗透率以及10^-23和10^-13 m^2的跨剪切带渗透率的参数空间探索。
关于参考摩擦系数（0.15对比0.60）、Skempton系数（0.81对比0.40）以及沿剪切带一维流体扩散的敏感性测试。
li: Uses a 2D in-plane (Mode II) quasi-dynamic approximation, neglecting wave-mediated dynamic stress transfers and 3D mixed-mode geometry.
Assumes a simplified quasi-steady linear pore-pressure profile across the shear zone, which may underestimate transient pressure gradients during rapid dynamic rupture in low-permeability gouge.
Neglects coupled fault-zone processes such as inelastic dilatancy, shear heating, stress-dependent porosity, and viscous pore compaction.
采用二维平面内（II型）准动态近似，忽略了波介导的动态应力传递和三维混合模式几何效应。
假设跨剪切带为简化的准稳态线性孔隙压力剖面，这可能低估低渗透率断层泥在快速动态破裂期间的瞬态压力梯度。
忽略了非弹性剪胀、剪切生热、应力依赖性孔隙度和粘性孔隙压实等耦合断层带过程。

tm.why: The paper numerically simulates repeating earthquake sequences, coseismic rupture, and interseismic nucleation on a rate-and-state fault.
The study investigates how bulk poroelasticity, pore fluid pressure, and shear-zone slip localization affect fault frictional strength, aseismic slip fractions, and repeating slow slip events.

ev.notes: Full 39-page PDF including main text, 12 main figures, 1 table, and Appendices A–C (with 5 appendix figures) was read and analyzed.

sum: Conventional implicit full-waveform inversion (IFWI) directly parameterizes the full velocity model using a single neural network, causing multiscale gradient interference between low- and high-wavenumber components and slow deep-structure convergence. This paper proposes a perturbation-based IFWI framework that decomposes the velocity model into a fixed background and a learnable perturbation represented by a SIREN implicit neural network. By restricting parameter updates to the residual perturbation subspace, the method avoids redundant fitting of large-scale backgrounds and achieves spectral decoupling. Furthermore, an independent horizontal and vertical coordinate normalization strategy maps physical coordinates to [0,1]^2, decoupling spatial scale from the network frequency parameter omega_0. Numerical experiments on the 2D Marmousi and Pluto salt-dome benchmark models show that the approach achieves faster convergence, superior deep velocity recovery, and strong robustness against degraded initial models, varying grid scales, and missing low-frequency data below 4 Hz.
传统隐式全波形反演（IFWI）直接用神经网络表征完整速度场，导致不同波数梯度相互干扰、深部结构恢复受限。本文提出基于微扰的IFWI框架，将速度模型分解为固定背景与由SIREN隐式网络表征的可学习微扰，将优化限制在微扰子空间以消除多尺度梯度干扰。此外，引入横纵向独立坐标归一化策略，将物理坐标映射至[0……

t: Decomposes velocity into a fixed reference background and a learnable SIREN neural perturbation, combined with [0,1]^2 coordinate normalization to decouple spatial scale from network frequency response.
将速度分解为固定背景和可学习SIREN微扰，结合[0,1]^2坐标归一化以解耦空间尺度与网络频率响应。
2D acoustic synthetic datasets generated on the Marmousi model (across three grid scales: 47x144, 94x288, 125x384) and the Pluto salt-dome model using an 8 Hz Ricker wavelet.
基于8 Hz雷克子波在Marmousi模型（三种网格尺度）和Pluto盐丘模型上生成的二维声波合成数据。

Perturbation-based IFWI achieves lower data misfit, superior deep structure and salt-dome recovery, and stable SSIM/MAE across scales within omega_0 in [10, 15], even when frequencies below 4 Hz are removed.
微扰IFWI实现了更低残差、更优深部与盐丘恢复，且在缺失<4 Hz低频时于ω0∈[10,15]内保持跨尺度高SSIM/低…
Optimization conditioning is evaluated practically via gradient convergence rather than directly computing the Hessian condition number, and the background model remains static during inversion.
未直接计算Hessian条件数来量化条件性，且反演中固定背景模型不更新，仅在二维声波合成数据上验证。

Demonstrates that functionally equivalent direct and perturbation-based INR parameterizations exhibit vastly different physics-driven FWI optimization behaviors, and introduces coordinate normalization to stabilize SIREN frequency scaling.
揭示了表达等价的直接与微扰INR参数化在物理驱动反演中的优化差异，并提出坐标归一化稳定SIREN频率尺度。

kc: Proposes a perturbation-based IFWI parameterization that fixes the background velocity model and uses an implicit neural network exclusively to learn velocity perturbations, mitigating multiscale gradient interference.
Introduces a coordinate normalization strategy mapping physical coordinates to [0,1]^2 to decouple model spatial scale from the SIREN frequency hyperparameter omega_0.

Demonstrates stable optimization across multiple spatial grid scales (with optimal omega_0 in [10, 15]), severely degraded linear initial models, missing low frequencies (<4 Hz), and complex salt-dome structures.
提出基于微扰的IFWI参数化方法，固定背景速度模型并仅用隐式神经网络学习速度微扰，有效缓解多尺度梯度干扰。
引入将物理坐标映射至[0,1]^2的坐标归一化策略，将模型空间尺度与SIREN频率超参数ω0解耦。
在多空间网格尺度（最优ω0稳定在[10, 15]）、严重失真的线性初始模型、缺失4 Hz以下低频数据及复杂盐丘构造下验证了稳定的反演性能。
me: 2D acoustic wave-equation forward modeling combined with automatic differentiation (AD) for neural network weight updates.
Perturbation-based implicit neural representation (INR) using a Multilayer Perceptron with sinusoidal activations (SIREN), where m(x,z) = m_0(x,z) + f_theta(x,z).
Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) theoretical formulation explaining global spatial coupling in IFWI updates.
Min-max spatial coordinate normalization independently along horizontal and vertical axes into a dimensionless [0,1]^2 domain.
二维声波方程正演模拟结合自动微分（AD）进行神经网络权重更新。
采用正弦激活多层感知机（SIREN）的基于微扰的隐式神经表征（INR），将模型表示为 m(x,z) = m_0(x,z) + f_theta(x,z)。
利用神经正切核（NTK）理论公式阐明IFWI更新中的全局空间耦合机制。
沿水平和垂直方向独立进行最小-最大空间坐标归一化，映射至无量纲[0,1]^2域。
de: 2D Marmousi synthetic velocity model (94x288 grid, 15 m spacing, 13 shots, 8 Hz Ricker wavelet at 15 m depth, 1.9 ms sampling, 1.9 s duration) tested across four initial models (smoothed and three linear gradients).
Multiscale spatial resampling experiments on the Marmousi model across three grid sizes (47x144, 94x288, and 125x384) with a hyperparameter grid search over omega_0 in [5, 30].
Low-frequency-deficient inversion tests on the multiscale Marmousi model with frequency components below 4 Hz removed.
Generalization test on the 2D Pluto 1.5 P-wave velocity model containing a high-velocity salt dome, evaluated under two linear initial models (1.5-5.5 km/s and 1.5-4.5 km/s).
二维Marmousi合成速度模型实验（94×288网格，15 m间距，13炮，15 m深度8 Hz雷克子波，1.9 ms采样，1.9 s记录），测试四种初始模型（平滑模型与三个线性梯度模型）。
Marmousi模型在三种网格尺度（47×144、94×288和125×384）下的多尺度重采样实验，并对ω0∈[5, 30]进行网格搜索。
滤除4 Hz以下低频分量的多尺度Marmousi模型缺低频反演测试。
含高速盐丘的二维Pluto 1.5纵波速度模型泛化实验，测试两种线性初始模型（1.5–5.5 km/s与1.5–4.5 km/s）。
li: The background model m_0 is kept strictly fixed during inversion and does not participate in gradient propagation, which could be restrictive if the ultra-low-wavenumber kinematics are grossly erroneous beyond what perturbations can compensate.
All validations are limited to 2D synthetic acoustic benchmark datasets without field data or elastic wave-equation tests.
Optimization conditioning is evaluated empirically through convergence behavior rather than a directly computed Hessian condition number.
反演过程中背景模型m_0保持固定且不参与梯度传播，若超低波数背景场误差过大可能会限制反演精度。
所有实验验证仅限于二维声波合成基准数据集，缺乏实际野外观测数据或弹性波方程测试。
优化条件性仅通过经验收敛行为进行评估，而非直接计算Hessian矩阵条件数。

tm.why: The paper develops an improved optimization framework for implicit full-waveform inversion (IFWI) to reconstruct subsurface seismic velocity models.
The velocity model perturbation is parameterized using SIREN-based implicit neural representations (INRs) and optimized via automatic differentiation.
The work focuses on improving optimization conditioning, spectral decoupling, and multiscale gradient interference in non-linear wave-equation inversions.

ev.notes: Full 31-page unedited manuscript PDF from Geophysical Journal International (GJI) was read and analyzed, including all equations, workflow diagrams, and 9 figures.

sum: This paper evaluates whether supervised machine learning models using Sentinel-1 interferometric coherence can rank earthquake damage better than the unsupervised Damage Proxy Map (DPM). Using 24 Sentinel-1 scenes across four earthquakes, Copernicus EMS damage grades are linked to 783,635 OpenStreetMap footprints over 28 areas and aggregated into buildings, morphological blocks, and grid cells (50–400 m). A ladder of models (logistic regression, histogram gradient boosting, random forest, and RBF SVM) is evaluated under spatial cross-validation (leave-one-area-out). Results show that supervised modeling significantly beats the proxy for blocks (boosting wins in up to 15/15 areas), yields non-significant gains for individual buildings, and fails to improve at cell scales. Logistic regression proves most reliable across validation splits, placing 79–87% of its feature weight on within-unit drop distributions and neighborhood context rather than the unit mean drop.
本文测试了使用Sentinel-1干涉相干性信号的监督学习模型是否比无监督相干性损坏代理（DPM）更能准确评估地震损坏。研究将4次地震的Copernicus EMS损坏等级与28个评估区的783,635个OpenStreetMap建筑轮廓结合，聚合为单体建筑、形态街区和50–400米网格，并在留一区……

t: A ladder of supervised models (logistic regression, gradient boosting, random forest, SVM) is trained on multi-family Sentinel-1 coherence drop features across buildings, blocks, and cells, evaluated against the unsupervised proxy on identical spatial folds.
在建筑、街区和网格尺度构建基于Sentinel-1相干性特征的监督模型阶梯，并在相同空间折上与无监督代理对比。
24 Sentinel-1 IW SLC scenes forming five stacks over four earthquakes, paired with Copernicus EMS damage grades joined to 783,635 OpenStreetMap building footprints across 28 assessed areas.
覆盖4次地震的24景Sentinel-1 SLC影像，结合28个评估区78.3万个OSM建筑轮廓与Copernicus损…

Under leave-one-AOI-out validation, gradient boosting significantly beats the proxy for blocks (+0.036 and +0.045 AP in 13/15 and 15/15 areas), while no model significantly improves on the proxy for buildings or cells.
留一区域验证下，梯度提升在街区尺度显著优于代理（AP提升0.036和0.045），建筑和网格尺度无显著提升。
Results rely on a single event for confirmed negatives, inherit coarse block-level EMS labels for 66% of positives, and depend heavily on the chosen spatial validation scheme.
仅单次地震有确认的未损样本，66%正样本继承自街区标签，且结论高度依赖验证方案。

Isolates the true gain of supervised learning over the unsupervised SAR damage proxy on identical spatial folds across multiple aggregation scales, showing neighborhood and distribution terms drive performance.
在相同空间验证折和多尺度下严格分离出监督学习相对于无监督代理的真实增益，揭示邻域与分布特征的主导作用。

kc: Benchmarks a ladder of supervised models directly against the unsupervised coherence damage proxy on identical spatial folds across 783,635 building footprints.
Demonstrates that spatial unit selection dictates model value: significant gains occur at morphological block scale, not at coarse grid cells or single buildings.

Reveals that logistic regression achieves the most stable cross-validation performance by weighting within-unit coherence drop distributions and neighborhood averages (79–87%) over the simple mean drop (2–7%).
在相同的空间交叉验证折上，基于783,635个建筑轮廓，将一系列监督模型与无监督相干性损坏代理进行了直接基准对比。
证明了空间单元尺度决定了建模价值：在形态学街区尺度上有显著增益，但在粗网格或单体建筑尺度上不显著。
揭示了逻辑回归在不同验证方案下最为稳健，其将79%–87%的权重赋予单元内相干下降分布及邻域均值，而均值本身仅占2%–7%。
me: SAR interferometric coherence processing using ESA SNAP across repeat-pass Sentinel-1 IW SLC stacks.

Multi-scale spatial aggregation of coherence drop features (mean, pre-event state, neighborhood context, internal distribution, and unit geometry) onto buildings, morphological blocks, and 50–400 m cells.

Supervised model ladder (L2 logistic regression, monotonic and unconstrained histogram gradient boosting, random forest, RBF SVM) evaluated via leave-one-area-out and blocked spatial cross-validation.
使用ESA SNAP对重轨Sentinel-1 IW SLC影像栈进行SAR干涉相干性处理。
将相干性下降特征（均值、震前状态、邻域上下文、内部统计分布及几何形态）多尺度空间聚合到建筑、形态街区和50–400米网格。
构建监督模型阶梯（L2逻辑回归、单调与无约束直方图梯度提升、随机森林、RBF SVM），并采用留一区域法与空间分块交叉验证进行评估。
de: 24 Sentinel-1 IW SLC VV-polarized scenes forming 5 stacks over 4 earthquakes (Albania 2019, Croatia 2020, Türkiye 2023, Venezuela 2026).
Copernicus Emergency Management Service (EMS) damage grading records joined to 783,635 OpenStreetMap building footprints across 28 assessed areas.
覆盖4次地震（2019阿尔巴尼亚、2020克罗地亚、2023土耳其、2026委内瑞拉）的5个影像栈共24景Sentinel-1 IW SLC VV极化数据。
将哥白尼应急管理服务（EMS）损坏评级记录与28个评估区内的783,635个OpenStreetMap建筑轮廓相结合。
li: Only one event (Türkiye 2023) contains confirmed undamaged building grades, meaning cross-event transfer relies on assumed negatives and yields upper-bound skill.
Around 66% of positive buildings inherited block-level EMS grades, blurring building-scale evaluation.
Sentinel-1's coarse resolution provides a median of only 1 pixel per building and 2 per block, limiting within-unit distribution features at fine scales.
仅有一个事件（2023年土耳其地震）包含经确认的未损坏建筑标签，跨事件迁移依赖于假定负样本，其得分仅为上限估计。
约66%的受损建筑继承自街区级别的EMS评级，模糊了单体建筑尺度的真实评估效果。
Sentinel-1分辨率较粗，每个建筑中位数仅为1个像素、街区为2个像素，限制了细尺度下单元内分布特征的表达。

tm.why: The paper focuses on rapid post-earthquake urban structural damage assessment using satellite SAR interferometric coherence loss.
It benchmarks a ladder of supervised machine learning models (logistic regression, gradient boosting, random forest, SVM) for post-earthquake damage classification.

ev.notes: Full 10-page EarthArXiv preprint PDF analyzed, including all equations, 9 figures, and 5 tables.

sum: Whether temporal changes in inner-core seismic phases reflect inner core differential rotation, localized surface change, or both remains debated. Using PKPdf and PKiKP waveforms recorded at northern North American arrays (ILAR and YKAR) from repeating earthquakes in the South Sandwich Islands (1991–2024), the authors demonstrate extensive contradictions with the inner core backtracking rotation model. Instead, back-projection and 2D P-SV hybrid waveform modeling of a 2003–2024 multiplet show that localized inner core boundary (ICB) topographic changes (≥1.5 km height over 1–30 km lateral scales, changing at 0.1–1 km/yr) completely explain the observations without differential rotation. This first detailed spatiotemporal mapping beneath eastern South America reveals irregular episodes of change, quiescence, and recovery. Two physical mechanisms are proposed: viscous deformation driven by small-scale electromagnetic forces or localized melting/solidification in a superionic state.
针对内核地震相时变成因的争议，本研究利用北美台阵（ILAR和YKAR）记录的南桑威奇群岛重复地震（1991-2024年）PKPdf和PKiKP及尾波数据，证实内核差速旋转回溯模型与观测存在广泛矛盾。通过反投影和二维P-SV混合波形模拟对2003-2024年多重震群的分析表明，仅靠内核边界局部地形变化……

t: The authors use generalized ray theory back-projection with cross-array consistency checks to map ICB changes from PKPdf coda waveforms, and a 2D P-SV hybrid finite-difference method to model topographic height and wavelength.
利用广义射线理论反投影和跨台阵一致性检验绘制内核表面变化，并用二维P-SV混合有限差分法模拟地形特征。

PKPdf and PKiKP waveforms and coda recorded at short-period dense arrays ILAR and YKAR in northern North America from 143 repeating earthquake doublets in the South Sandwich Islands (1991–2024), focusing on multiplet M03-24.
北美ILAR和YKAR台阵记录的南桑威奇群岛重复地震PKPdf/PKiKP及尾波数据（重点为2003-2024年震群）。

ICB changes beneath eastern South America (2003–2024) show irregular episodes of change, quiescence, and recovery without differential rotation. Synthetic modeling indicates topographic height changes ≥1.5 km over 1–30 km lateral scales at 0.1–1 km/yr.
南美东部下方内核表面呈偶发变化、平静和恢复；地形高差变化≥1.5 km，横向尺度1-30 km，速率0.1-1 km/y…

The seismic data coverage only bounds the spatial extents of possible temporal change regions rather than pinpointing exact scatterer locations, and cannot strictly rule out sub-ICB scatterer changes.
现有数据覆盖只能限定散射区最大范围而无法精确定位散射体，且无法完全排除内核边界下方散射体变化。

Demonstrates that inner core surface change alone resolves all contradictions of the backtracking rotation model, and provides the first multi-decade spatiotemporal mapping of episodic ICB change, quiescence, and recovery.
证实仅靠内核表面变化即可解决回溯旋转模型的矛盾，并首次绘制了内核表面变化、平静和恢复的时空演化图。

kc: Demonstrates extensive inconsistencies between observed PKPdf waveform recovery times/behaviors across arrays and the inner core backtracking rotation hypothesis.
Maps the spatiotemporal evolution of the inner core surface beneath eastern South America from 2003 to 2024 using a six-event repeating earthquake cluster (M03-24).
Reveals that inner core surface changes vary geographically and exhibit irregular episodes of change, quiescence, and recovery, with height changes ≥1.5 km at rates of 0.1–1 km/yr.

Proposes two physical mechanisms for the surface changes: localized viscous deformation by small-scale magnetic forces and localized melting/solidification enabled by superionic light-element diffusion.
证实了不同台阵观测到的PKPdf波形恢复时间及行为与内核回溯旋转假说存在广泛矛盾。
利用包含6次事件的重复地震簇（M03-24），绘制了2003至2024年间南美洲东部下方内核表面的时空演化图。
揭示了内核表面变化具有显著的地域差异，表现为不规则的变化、平静和恢复阶段，高差变化≥1.5 km，变化速率为0.1–1 km/yr。
提出了两种内核表面变化的物理机制：小尺度磁力引起的局部粘性变形，以及超离子态轻元素扩散促成的局部熔融/凝固。
me: Master-event earthquake relocation using non-inner-core phases (P, pP, PP, PcP, PKPab, PKPbc) recorded at GSN stations.
Quantitative classification of PKPdf waveform similarity and dissimilarity using root-mean-square signal difference S(t) and noise index N.
Generalized ray theory (GRT) back-projection with cross-array consistency checks to map inner core surface change indicators.
2D P-SV hybrid waveform modeling (combining GRT, finite-difference, and WKM/Kirchhoff integration) of sinusoidal ICB topography.
Thermochemical and geodynamic order-of-magnitude calculations for viscous creep and phase-boundary perturbations.

结合广义射线理论（GRT）反投影与跨台阵一致性检验，绘制内核表面变化指示图。
采用二维P-SV混合波形模拟方法（结合GRT、有限差分及WKM/Kirchhoff积分）模拟正弦型内核边界地形的波形响应。
针对粘性蠕变和相边界扰动进行热化学与地球动力学量级估算。

Detailed analysis of multiplet M03-24 consisting of 6 high-quality repeating earthquakes spanning 2003/03/21 to 2024/03/21.
Synthetic 2D P-SV hybrid waveform experiments testing sinusoidal ICB topographic models with heights h (0.25–2.5 km) and wavelengths λ (1–30 km).
ILAR和YKAR台阵记录的南桑威奇群岛143对重复地震对（含16个多重震群，1991–2023年）的200对PKPdf/PKiKP及其尾波波形。
对包含2003/03/21至2024/03/21期间6次高质量重复地震的多重震群M03-24进行了详细分析。

Data coverage cannot strictly exclude temporal changes in scatterers beneath the ICB or a concurrent arbitrary differential rotation, though neither is necessary.
Toroidal magnetic field perturbations proposed to drive viscous deformation cannot be observed at Earth's surface.

tm.why: The study investigates the spatiotemporal evolution of Earth's inner core boundary and its physical geodynamic mechanisms.
The authors map inner core surface topography variations by analyzing and modeling temporal changes in the scattered coda waves of PKPdf and PKiKP phases.
A 2D P-SV hybrid finite-difference and generalized ray theory method is applied to simulate PKP coda waveforms from sinusoidal inner core boundary topography.
