sum: Accurate P-wave phase picking is essential for earthquake monitoring, yet deep learning models require large labeled datasets and lack interpretability. This study proposes an unsupervised P-wave detection algorithm based on Zhanabaev entropy, or the normalized Information–Entropy Ratio (IER), analyzed in a 2D phase space constructed from normalized waveform amplitude and its local central difference derivative. Using sliding windows, joint and conditional probabilities are discretized to identify abrupt structural transitions at P-wave onsets. The method was evaluated on global IRIS/FDSN regional waveforms (within 3° epicentral distance, SNR ≥ 10 dB, 100 Hz) from Mw ≥ 5.5 earthquakes during Jan–Jun 2022. Under optimal parameters (window N = 5000, discretization grid M = 70, threshold ΔIER = 0.5), the method achieved 94.4% recall and 0.851 F1-score, outperforming STA/LTA and pretrained PhaseNet while remaining capable of detecting multiple transitions in continuous records unlike standard AIC.
针对深度学习震相拾取依赖大量标注数据且可解释性差的问题，本文提出一种基于相空间Zhanabaev熵（信息熵比IER）的无监督P波自动检测方法。该方法利用归一化波形振幅及其中心差分导数构建二维相空间，在滑动窗口内计算联合与条件概率分布以捕捉P波初至引起的结构跃迁。基于IRIS全球Mw≥5.5地震的区域……

Global earthquake waveforms (Mw ≥ 5.5, Jan–Jun 2022) from IRIS FDSN recorded at regional stations (≤ 3° epicentral distance), sampled at 100 Hz, filtered for SNR ≥ 10 dB, in 1200-s windows centered on P arrivals.

Introduces 2D phase-space Zhanabaev entropy combining waveform amplitude and local derivative for unsupervised P-wave picking, overcoming 1D scalar entropy limits and avoiding deep learning training requirements.

Conducted a comprehensive sensitivity analysis across sliding window length (1–60 s), state-space discretization bins (10–100), and entropy thresholds (0.1–1.0).
Benchmarked against STA/LTA, AIC, and pretrained PhaseNet on a curated global regional dataset (Mw ≥ 5.5, SNR ≥ 10 dB), achieving 94.4% recall and 0.851 F1-score.

me: Constructs a 2D phase space from normalized seismic signal amplitude x and local central difference variation y.
Discretizes the 2D state space into M × M cells within sliding windows of length N to estimate joint and conditional probability distributions.
Computes Zhanabaev entropy (Information–Entropy Ratio, IER) from conditional and joint Shannon entropies and triggers P-wave picks when inter-window |ΔIER| exceeds a threshold.
利用归一化地震信号振幅x和局部中心差分变化y构建二维相空间。
在长度为N的滑动窗口内将二维状态空间离散化为M×M个网格，以估计联合概率和条件概率分布。
由条件熵和联合香农熵计算Zhanabaev熵（信息熵比IER），当相邻窗口|ΔIER|超过阈值时触发P波拾取。

Evaluated detection classification metrics (±6 s tolerance) and arrival-time accuracy (±1 s tolerance vs manual picks) against STA/LTA, AIC, and PhaseNet.

tm.why: The paper proposes and evaluates an unsupervised algorithm for automatic P-wave arrival time detection (phase picking) in seismic waveforms.
The proposed unsupervised entropy method is framed as an interpretable alternative to deep learning phase pickers and is directly benchmarked against PhaseNet.

sum: This study applies Persistent Scatterer Interferometry (PSInSAR) to Sentinel-1 SAR data (2016–2023) across Hispaniola, merging ascending and descending tracks with GNSS velocities to construct a spatially continuous 3D velocity field. The results document interseismic deformation gradients across major fault systems. The Enriquillo–Plantain Garden fault is well-fit by a single locked-fault model, whereas the Septentrional fault system exhibits complexity suggesting multiple sub-faults. Crucially, the study models strain in southeastern Haiti and the southwestern Dominican Republic using the Jérémie-Malpasse-Bahoruco oblique reverse fault system, highlighting it as a significant but previously overlooked regional seismic hazard source. This provides a comprehensive geodetic view of active tectonics in the Caribbean-North American plate boundary.

sum: This data publication presents the seismic source inversion results for a specific crater collapse event (designated as p2) that occurred on July 2, 2021, during the Fagradalsfjall volcanic eruption in Iceland. The dataset, archived as a compressed file, contains detailed reports of the inversion results, supporting a companion study by Joachim et al. (in prep). It provides valuable observational constraints on the physical mechanisms of caldera/crater collapses.

sum: This study investigates the relationship between seismicity, geomorphic lineaments, and major faults in the Sikkim Himalaya to evaluate if lineaments act as active, deep-seated strike-slip faults. Analyzing earthquake clusters, focal mechanisms, and hypocenters, the authors find that earthquakes concentrate along certain lineaments, reflecting complex kinematics driven by basement structures and Himalayan compression. Notably, a clear concentration of low-magnitude (Mw 2–4) events is identified at a depth of 67.5 ± 0.33 km. These deep, low-magnitude events suggest active strain accommodation below the Main Himalayan Thrust, which has important implications for future seismic hazard assessments in a region predicted to host a major (Mw >= 8.4) earthquake.

sum: The 1985 Belgian local magnitude (ML) scale relies on epicentral distance and vertical 1-Hz Lg amplitudes, poorly constraining attenuation at distances <150 km and <20 km for shallow induced events. Using the BELSHAKE ground-motion database (digital waveforms since 1985), the authors automate Wood-Anderson displacement amplitude picking and recalibrate ML against hypocentral distance down to ~6 km. The new scale incorporates a four-segment piecewise continuous powerlaw geometrical spreading model with a nearly flat midsection (~60–120 km) and an exponential anelastic attenuation (kappa gradient) term. While vertical-component calibration reduces standard deviation to 0.219 (0.183 with station corrections) and lowers overestimated ML for small events (ML < 1.5), horizontal-component calibration shows >15% higher uncertainty. However, combining horizontal amplitudes with D5-95 path durations yields self-consistent Fourier-domain spreading, kappa gradients, and an empirical ML-MW relation (crossover at ML 2.7).
比利时地震台网1985年建立的地方震级（ML）标度基于震中距，在小于20 km处约束较差。本研究利用1985年以来的BELSHAKE强地面运动数据库，开发了自动振幅拾取流程，并基于震源距将ML标度重新标定至约6 km。新标度采用包含约60-120 km平坦中段的四段式分段幂律几何扩散模型及非弹性衰减……

t: Recalibrates the local magnitude scale against hypocentral distance by fitting magnitude-corrected vertical and horizontal S/Lg displacement amplitudes to a four-segment piecewise continuous powerlaw geometrical spreading function combined with an exponential regional anelastic attenuation (kappa gradient) term.
利用四段式分段连续幂律几何扩散函数与κ指数非弹性衰减项，基于震源距拟合震级校正后的S/Lg波位移振幅以重新标定ML。

Digital short-period, broadband, and accelerometric waveforms of natural and induced earthquakes (ML >= 2) in and around Belgium since 1985 from the BELSHAKE ground-motion database, plus ROB catalog events with ML <= 2.0.
采用BELSHAKE数据库中1985年以来比利时及周边ML≥2地震的数字波形，以及ROB目录中ML≤2.0的小震数据。

The vertical-component recalibration reduces residual standard deviation to 0.219 (0.183 with station corrections), eliminates magnitude overestimation for shallow earthquakes (ML < 1.5) down to ~6 km, and establishes an ML-to-MW crossover at ML = 2.7.
垂直分量标定将标准差降至0.219（台站校正后0.183），消除了约6 km以远浅源小震（ML<1.5）的高估，确定ML…
The ~10 km knickpoint in the spreading model is poorly constrained due to few recordings between 8 and 15 km and ambiguity between geometrical spreading and shallow anelastic attenuation.
8至15 km数据稀疏导致约10 km拐点约束较弱，且难以区分几何扩散与浅部非弹性衰减。

Replaces epicentral distance with hypocentral distance down to 6 km using a 4-segment spreading model and directly integrates D5-95 path durations to reconcile time- and Fourier-domain S-wave attenuation in Belgium.

Recalibrated the Belgian ML scale using hypocentral distance down to ~6 km via a 4-segment piecewise powerlaw geometrical spreading model and kappa gradient.
Developed regional S/Lg-wave path duration (D5-95) and Fourier-domain geometrical spreading models for vertical and horizontal components.
Derived an empirical ML-to-MW conversion relation for Belgium, identifying a crossover point at ML = 2.7.
开发了自动S/Lg波位移振幅测量流程并应用于1985年以来的BELSHAKE数据库，发现了早期目录中存在的2倍振幅误差。

建立了比利时地区垂直与水平分量S/Lg波的路径持续时间（D5-95）模型及傅里叶域几何扩散模型。
推导了比利时地区ML与矩震级（MW）的经验转换关系，确定两者交点位于ML = 2.7附近。

Bounded minimization fitting of magnitude-corrected station amplitudes to a 4-segment piecewise continuous powerlaw geometrical spreading function plus exponential kappa attenuation.
Conversion of time-domain spreading exponents to Fourier-domain spreading models by incorporating piecewise powerlaw fits of D5-95 path durations.
Validation of Fourier attenuation and path duration models via Boore (2003) stochastic ground-motion simulations.

通过直接结合D5-95路径持续时间的分段幂律模型，将时域几何扩散指数转换为傅里叶域几何扩散模型。
采用Boore (2003)随机地面运动模拟方法验证所推导的傅里叶域衰减模型和路径持续时间模型。

Reconstructed and validated pre-2005 legacy instrument responses stored in ASDF format.
Comparison and validation on ROB catalog events with ML <= 2.0 and two specific case studies: the 2018 ML 3.1 Kinrooi (19 km depth) and 2025 ML 1.5 Liège (<4 km depth) earthquakes.

The short-distance knickpoint around ~10 km is poorly constrained due to sparse data between 8 and 15 km and high corner-frequency variability.

水平分量（几何平均）ML标定的标准差（0.259）比垂直分量（0.219）高出15%以上，阻碍了其在日常震级测定中的采用。

sum: Suppressing strong, dispersive ground roll in land seismic data is difficult when it overlaps with low-frequency reflection signals. Conventional spatial or time-frequency (TF) filters suffer from limited resolution and amplitude distortion. This study proposes a workflow integrating the synchrosqueezed wavelet transform (SSWT) with local adaptive subtraction filtering. First, seismic data are split into high- and low-frequency components. The low-frequency traces are transformed into a highly concentrated TF domain via SSWT, where ground roll exhibits time-banded distributions and reflections align along the frequency axis. Thresholding isolates a initial ground roll model. Next, a regularized least-squares local adaptive subtraction filter calibrates the amplitude and phase of the noise model within sliding windows before subtracting it from the data. Tests on synthetic shot gathers and the Teapot Dome 3D field dataset demonstrate superior ground roll attenuation and strict amplitude preservation compared to S-transform, seislet, and standalone SSWT methods.
针对陆地地震资料中强能量、频散面波与低频有效反射信号重叠的压制难题，本文提出了一种结合同步挤压小波变换（SSWT）与局部自适应相减滤波的压制方法。首先将低频地震道通过SSWT变换至高分辨率时频域，利用面波与反射波的时频分布差异通过阈值策略提取初始面波模型；随后在局部滑动窗口内构建正则化最小二乘自适应……

t: Low-frequency seismic traces are transformed via SSWT to isolate a ground roll model by thresholding, followed by regularized least-squares local adaptive subtraction filtering to calibrate model amplitude and phase before subtraction.
通过SSWT阈值法提取低频面波模型，结合局部正则化最小二乘自适应滤波校正振幅相位并相减。
Evaluated on a 200-trace synthetic shot gather modeled with TesseralPro (35-Hz Ricker wavelet, 15-Hz ground roll) and the 966-trace 214th shot gather from the Teapot Dome field dataset in Wyoming.
采用TesseralPro合成的200道单炮记录及美国Teapot Dome实际三维数据的966道单炮记录。

The proposed method effectively attenuates residual ground roll in near-offset zones where reflections and ground roll overlap, outperforming S-transform, seislet, and standalone SSWT in low-frequency noise suppression and amplitude preservation.
有效消除了近偏移距残余面波，在低频面波压制和有效波振幅保持上均优于S变换与常规SSWT。
The method requires manual identification of ground-roll regions in the TF domain, processes SSWT trace-by-trace without 3D spatial constraints, and has high computational cost.
需人工设定时频域滤波区域，单道SSWT缺乏三维空间约束，且计算开销较大。
Integrates high-resolution synchrosqueezed wavelet transform with localized regularized least-squares adaptive subtraction to resolve amplitude and phase mismatches in ground roll model subtraction.
将高分辨率SSWT时频分离与局部自适应相减滤波结合，解决了面波模型的振幅相位失配问题。

kc: Proposes a hybrid ground roll suppression workflow combining synchrosqueezed wavelet transform (SSWT) and local adaptive subtraction filtering.
Utilizes high-resolution SSWT time-frequency concentration to isolate low-frequency ground roll models without severe signal leakage.
Employs regularized least-squares local adaptive filtering to correct amplitude and phase mismatches between the extracted noise model and true ground roll.
提出了结合同步挤压小波变换（SSWT）与局部自适应相减滤波的面波压制混合流程。
利用高分辨率SSWT的时频聚集特性提取低频面波模型，避免了严重的有效信号泄漏。
采用正则化最小二乘局部自适应滤波校正预测面波模型与实际面波之间的振幅和相位偏差。
me: One-dimensional frequency separation into high- and low-frequency seismic components.
Synchrosqueezed wavelet transform (SSWT) via continuous wavelet transform reassignment along instantaneous frequency.
Time-frequency thresholding to construct a 2D initial ground roll noise model.
Regularized least-squares local adaptive subtraction filtering within sliding windows.
利用一维滤波将地震数据分离为高频和低频分量。
基于瞬时频率对连续小波变换系数进行重排的同步挤压小波变换（SSWT）。
通过时频域阈值策略构建二维初始面波噪声模型。
在局部滑动窗口内进行正则化最小二乘自适应相减滤波。

Synthetic single-shot gather generated via TesseralPro (200 traces, 10 m interval, 4 ms sampling, 35-Hz Ricker source, 15-Hz ground roll).
Field 3D seismic shot gather (214th gather, 17 receiver lines, 966 traces, 2 ms sampling) from the Teapot Dome dataset in Wyoming, USA.
对比STFT、CWT、S变换和SSWT的一维合成非平稳复合信号实验。
使用TesseralPro正演生成的合成单炮记录（200道，10米道距，4毫秒采样，35Hz雷克子波，15Hz面波）。
美国怀俄明州Teapot Dome数据集的第214炮实际三维地震记录（17条接收线，966道，2毫秒采样）。

Operates on a trace-by-trace basis during the SSWT phase, neglecting multi-trace 3D spatial consistency.
High computational intensity for large-scale seismic datasets.
依赖经验阈值策略在时频域中识别面波主导区域，缺乏自动化识别。
SSWT阶段采用单道逐道处理，忽略了多道或三维空间一致性。
SSWT及多道处理在大规模地震数据应用中的计算复杂度较高。

The method processes multi-trace land seismic exploration shot gathers from a 17-receiver-line array to suppress coherent surface-wave noise.

sum: This paper presents an unsupervised method for suppressing erratic noise in prestack seismic gathers. By integrating implicit neural representation (INR) as a continuous prior within the Plug-and-Play Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (PnP-ADMM) framework, the method effectively separates coherent seismic reflections from sparse, erratic noise. Unlike supervised deep learning, this approach does not require labeled training datasets and preserves weak reflection events. Synthetic and real data applications demonstrate its superior performance in noise attenuation and amplitude preservation compared to conventional denoising techniques.
本文提出一种压制震前道集异常噪声的无监督方法。该方法将隐式神经表示（INR）作为连续先验融入即插即用交替方向乘子法（PnP-ADMM）框架，实现相干地震反射与稀疏异常噪声的有效分离。该方法无需训练数据集，能有效保护微弱反射信号。合成与实际数据测试表明，该方法在去噪和振幅保持上优于传统技术。

t: An unsupervised denoising method integrating implicit neural representation as a prior within the PnP-ADMM optimization framework to reconstruct clean seismic gathers.
将隐式神经表示作为先验融入PnP-ADMM优化框架的无监督地震去噪方法。
Synthetic prestack seismic gathers and real field seismic datasets contaminated with erratic, sparse, or spiky noise.
受异常、稀疏或脉冲噪声污染的合成前道集地震数据和实际野外地震数据集。
The method successfully suppresses erratic noise and preserves weak coherent reflections without requiring any labeled training data, outperforming conventional filters.
在无需标记训练数据的情况下成功压制异常噪声并保留微弱相干反射，优于传统滤波器。
High computational cost due to the iterative optimization and neural network training required for each seismic gather.
由于每个地震道集都需要进行迭代优化和神经网络训练，计算成本较高。
First integration of implicit neural representation as a continuous prior in PnP-ADMM for unsupervised prestack seismic erratic noise suppression.
首次将隐式神经表示作为连续先验引入PnP-ADMM中，用于无监督前道集异常噪声压制。

kc: Proposes a novel unsupervised seismic denoising framework combining PnP-ADMM with implicit neural representation (INR).
Eliminates the need for labeled training datasets by leveraging the self-prior of coordinate-based neural networks.
Achieves superior erratic noise suppression while preserving weak, coherent prestack reflection events.
提出了一种结合PnP-ADMM与隐式神经表示（INR）的新型无监督地震去噪框架。
利用基于坐标的神经网络自先验特性，消除了对标记训练数据集的依赖。
在压制异常噪声的同时，实现了对微弱、相干前道集反射信号的高精度保护。

Plug-and-Play Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (PnP-ADMM) for solving the joint optimization problem.
L1-norm regularization or robust loss functions to model and isolate sparse erratic noise.
利用隐式神经表示（INR）对连续地震波场进行参数化表征。

Real-world field prestack seismic datasets featuring complex noise environments.
含有模拟异常/脉冲噪声的合成前道集地震数据。
包含复杂噪声干扰的实际野外前道集地震数据集。

Potential sensitivity to hyperparameter selection in the PnP-ADMM framework.

对PnP-ADMM框架中的超参数选择可能具有一定的敏感性。

The denoising task is formulated as an optimization problem solved via the Plug-and-Play ADMM framework.

sum: Evaluating earthquake forecasts requires statistical metrics that isolate specific seismicity features. The Collaboratory for the Study of Earthquake Predictability (CSEP) uses the M-test to assess magnitude distributions of catalog-based forecasts. However, this study demonstrates that the original M-test depends on the forecasted number of events (N-test), leading to biased evaluations when event counts are inconsistent. The authors solve this by resampling synthetic catalogs from the union forecast to match the observed event count, assuming a homogeneous magnitude distribution. They further explore six alternative metrics, including a novel Modified Multinomial Log-Likelihood (MLL) score, using synthetic Gutenberg-Richter (GR) and tapered GR catalogs, as well as real ETAS forecasts for Switzerland and Europe. Results show the MLL score outperforms the resampled M-test and classical tests (like Anderson-Darling) in statistical power and interpretability, indicating the direction of model bias. Both the resampled M-test and MLL score are integrated into pyCSEP.
评估地震预测模型需要能独立检验特定地震活动特征的统计指标。本研究发现，CSEP用于评估基于目录预测震级分布的传统M检验结果受预测事件数量（N检验）的影响，导致评估偏差。作者提出通过从联合预测目录中有放回地重采样与观测事件数相同样本的方法解决了这一问题。此外，研究利用合成古登堡-里克特（GR）及截断G……

t: The authors correct the CSEP M-test by resampling synthetic catalogs of size No with replacement from the union forecast, and introduce a Modified Multinomial Log-Likelihood (MLL) log-ratio test statistic.
通过对联合预测目录进行等观测样本量有放回重采样修正M检验，并提出修正多项式对数似然比（MLL）统计量。

Evaluations use synthetic Gutenberg-Richter and Tapered-GR catalogs, plus real ETAS catalog-based forecasts for Switzerland (1933–2022, seven model variants, 100,000 simulations) and Europe (1990–2015, four model variants).
使用标准与截断GR合成目录，以及瑞士（1933–2022）和欧洲（1990–2015）的实际ETAS地震预测目录。
Resampling eliminates the M-test's dependence on event counts. The MLL metric outperforms the M-test across all synthetic scenarios and surpasses the Anderson-Darling test for sample sizes N > 50.
重采样消除了M检验对事件数的依赖；MLL在所有合成场景中优于M检验，且在N>50时优于AD检验。
The uniform resampling solution assumes magnitude distributions are homogeneous in space and time; spatially varying distributions remain affected by spatial forecast errors.
均匀重采样假设震级分布时空均匀，空间变化模型仍受空间预测误差影响。
Identifies and resolves the coupling between CSEP N-test and M-test via resampling, and introduces the directional Multinomial Log-Likelihood (MLL) score for earthquake forecast evaluation.
揭示并解决了CSEP中M检验与N检验的耦合问题，提出了能指示偏差方向的MLL评分。

kc: Demonstrated that the original CSEP catalog-based M-test is confounded by discrepancies in forecasted event counts (N-test).
Proposed a catalog resampling correction that successfully isolates the magnitude distribution evaluation for homogeneous distributions.
Formulated a novel Modified Multinomial Log-Likelihood (MLL) test statistic that handles zero-count bins and indicates the direction of forecast bias.
Benchmarked six CSEP-style metrics and three classical statistical tests (KS, Wilcoxon, Anderson-Darling) on synthetic and real European/Swiss ETAS forecasts, implementing the best tools into pyCSEP.
证明了传统的CSEP基于目录的M检验受预测事件数量差异（N检验）的干扰。
提出了一种目录重采样校正方法，在均匀震级分布假设下成功分离出独立的震级分布评估。
构建了一种新的修正多项式对数似然（MLL）检验统计量，有效处理零计数分箱并能指示预测偏差的方向。
在合成数据和瑞士/欧洲实际ETAS预测上基准测试了六种CSEP风格指标和三种经典统计检验，并将新方法集成至pyCSEP。
me: Resampling with replacement from the union forecast catalog to generate synthetic catalogs matching the exact observed event count.

Formulation of six CSEP-style discrete distribution comparison metrics: Unnormalized M-test, Chi-square, Chi-square+1, Hellinger distance, Brier score, and Modified Multinomial Log-Likelihood (MLL) score.
Statistical power analysis across varying sample sizes and cutoff magnitudes against Kolmogorov-Smirnov, Wilcoxon signed-rank, and Anderson-Darling tests.
从联合预测目录中有放回地重采样，生成与观测事件数量完全一致的合成地震目录。
构建六种CSEP风格的离散分布比较指标：非归一化M检验、卡方、卡方+1、海林格距离、Brier评分和修正多项式对数似然（MLL）评分。
在不同样本量和截止震级下进行统计检验力分析，并与KS检验、Wilcoxon符号秩检验和Anderson-Darling检验进行对比。
de: Synthetic earthquake catalogs generated from standard Gutenberg-Richter (GR) and Tapered Gutenberg-Richter (Tap-GR) distributions across varying b-values, corner magnitudes, and Poisson event rates.
Real catalog-based earthquake forecasts using seven suiETAS model variants for Switzerland across three 30-year testing periods (1933–1962, 1963–1992, 1993–2022).
Real catalog-based earthquake forecasts using ETAS model variants (b=1.0 and b=1.2) for Europe (1990–2015).
基于标准古登堡-里克特（GR）和截断GR（Tap-GR）分布生成的合成地震目录，涵盖不同b值、拐角震级和泊松事件率。
瑞士三个30年测试期（1933–1962、1963–1992、1993–2022）内七种suiETAS模型变体的实际地震目录预测。
欧洲地区（1990–2015）不同b值（1.0和1.2）ETAS模型变体的实际地震目录预测。
li: The uniform resampling correction assumes a homogeneous magnitude distribution across space and time; spatially varying magnitude distributions remain sensitive to spatial forecast inconsistencies.
Chi-square metrics exhibit non-extreme quantile concentration under inconsistency, making them unsuitable for experiments with fewer than 50 forecasting periods.
均匀重采样校正假设震级分布在时空上均匀；空间变化的震级分布检验仍受空间位置预测不一致性的影响。
卡方指标在不一致时分位数不向0或1集中，因此不适用于少于50个预测期的实验评估。

tm.why: The paper develops and tests statistical metrics for evaluating probabilistic earthquake forecasting models, which are directly used for earthquake hazard assessment and risk mitigation.
The methodology operates entirely on observed and synthetic earthquake catalogs, specifically evaluating catalog-based magnitude frequency distributions.

ev.notes: Full 28-page PDF analysed, including mathematical derivations, synthetic experiments, real-data applications in Switzerland and Europe, and Appendices A–E.

sum: The driver of accelerating unrest since 2005 at Campi Flegrei caldera remains debated. This study analyzes an unprecedented 27-year dataset (1998–2025) of over 30,000 diffuse soil CO2 flux measurements, fumarole chemistry, GNSS vertical displacement, and seismic catalogs (N=20,137). Using sequential Gaussian simulations and thermodynamic equilibrium modeling, the authors show that escalating soil CO2 emissions strongly correlate with ground uplift (r=0.93) and seismicity (r=0.79). A critical magmatic gas pulse between 2018 and 2022 focused degassing beneath the Solfatara crater, preceding exponential increases in CO2 flux and burst-like seismic swarms in 2021. Thermodynamic reconstructions demonstrate that ascending fluids pressurize the hydrothermal system, forcing steam condensation at ~0.9 km depth. The resulting thermal energy release (2.4–3.4 × 10^16 J) exceeds elastic deformation energy by an order of magnitude and seismic energy by five orders, proving that deep magmatic fluid pressurization and heating drive the unrest.
本研究分析了坎皮佛莱格瑞破火山口1998–2025年间超3万次土壤CO2通量测量、喷气孔地球化学、GNSS形变及地震目录数据。通过序贯高斯模拟、热力学平衡与弹性半空间裂隙反演，发现土壤CO2通量与地表抬升（r=0.93）及地震活动（r=0.79）高度相关。2018–2022年的岩浆气体脉冲使脱气集中……

t: Sequential Gaussian simulations map soil CO2 fluxes, thermodynamic equilibrium models of noncondensable fumarolic gases estimate hydrothermal P-T conditions and condensation heat, and penny-shaped crack inversions of GNSS data quantify elastic strain energy.
结合序贯高斯模拟、热力学气体平衡计算与弹性半空间裂隙大地测量反演，量化CO2通量、冷凝潜热与弹性应变能。

Over 30,000 soil CO2 flux and temperature measurements (41 wide-area and 216 monthly target-area campaigns, 1998–2025), fumarolic gas compositions, 15-station GNSS displacements, and 20,137 cataloged earthquakes.
1998–2025年超3万次土壤CO2通量与地温测量、喷气孔气体成分、15个GNSS站位移及20,137次地震目录。

Soil CO2 flux reaches 2200 t/d by late 2025 and strongly correlates with uplift (r=0.93) and seismicity (r=0.79); cumulative fluid thermal energy (2.4–3.4×10^16 J) far exceeds deformation (1.4–7.2×10^15 J) and seismic (~7.1×10^11 J) energies.
CO2通量与抬升(r=0.93)和地震(r=0.79)高度相关；热能(2.4–3.4×10^16 J)远超形变能与地震能…
Missing 2018–2021 wide-area soil flux data, gas equilibrium limited to ≤1 km depth above the 3–4 km source, and reliance on assumed redox conditions without direct condensation-zone tomography.
缺乏2018–2021广域通量数据，气体平衡仅反映≤1 km深度，且冷凝深度依赖氧化还原假设。

Compiles the largest 27-year geochemical dataset for a restless caldera, proving that deep magmatic fluid pressurization and condensation heating—not shallow caprock sealing—drive Campi Flegrei's accelerating unrest.
利用全球最大27年火山地球化学数据集，证实岩浆流体增压与蒸汽冷凝加热是动荡的主因。

kc: Compiled the largest volcano-monitoring soil CO2 flux dataset (>30,000 measurements over 1998–2025) and demonstrated strong statistical coupling among CO2 degassing, ground uplift (r=0.93), and seismicity (r=0.79).
Identified a critical 2018–2022 magmatic fluid pulse that spatially focused outgassing beneath the Solfatara crater prior to the 2021 onset of burst-like seismic swarms.

Demonstrated via thermodynamic and geodetic modeling that thermal energy from steam condensation (~10^16 J) exceeds elastic deformation energy (~10^15 J) and seismic energy (~10^11 J), ruling out purely hydrological caprock-sealing models.
汇编了全球规模最大的火山土壤CO2通量监测数据集（1998–2025年超3万次测量），证实CO2脱气、地表抬升（r=0.93）与地震活动（r=0.79）之间存在强统计耦合。
识别出2018–2022年关键的岩浆流体脉冲，该脉冲使脱气在空间上集中于Solfatara火山口下方，并先于2021年爆发式地震群的出现。
通过热力学与大地测量建模证明，蒸汽冷凝释放的热能（~10^16 J）远超弹性形变能（~10^15 J）和地震能量（~10^11 J），排除了单纯由水文或盖层封闭主导的模型。
me: Accumulation chamber measurements of soil CO2 fluxes and geostatistical spatial interpolation via sequential Gaussian simulation (sGs UnMix) with spatial declustering sensitivity tests.
Thermodynamic gas equilibrium modeling in the H2O-H2-CO-CO2 system to reconstruct hydrothermal pressure-temperature conditions, deep steam condensation mass, and latent heat release.

Geodetic inversion of 3D GNSS displacements using a horizontal penny-shaped crack in an elastic half-space to calculate cumulative elastic strain energy, alongside statistical correlation with seismic catalogs.
采用累积室法测量土壤CO2通量，并利用序贯高斯模拟（sGs UnMix）及空间去聚类敏感性测试进行地统计空间插值。
利用H2O-H2-CO-CO2体系热力学气体平衡模型，重建热液系统的温压条件、深部蒸汽冷凝质量及潜热释放量。
利用弹性半空间水平币状裂隙模型反演3D GNSS位移以计算累积弹性应变能，并与地震目录进行统计相关性分析。
de: Over 30,000 soil CO2 flux and 10-cm soil temperature measurements from 41 wide-area campaigns (Solfatara-Pisciarelli, 1998–2025) and 216 monthly campaigns (target area, 2004–2025).
High-frequency fumarole gas composition time series from Bocca Grande and Bocca Nuova vents.
Daily 3D GNSS displacements from 15 stations (including RITE) and the INGV SERENADE earthquake catalog (20,137 events from 2006–2025; 4,666 events with M≥0.2 in the 1.2×1.2 km control volume).
1998–2025年Solfatara-Pisciarelli区域41期广域测量和2004–2025年目标区216期月度测量获取的超3万个土壤CO2通量及10厘米地温数据。
Bocca Grande和Bocca Nuova喷气孔的高频气体化学成分时间序列数据。
15个GNSS台站（含RITE站）的日均三维位移数据，以及INGV SERENADE地震目录（2006–2025年间共20,137次事件，1.2×1.2 km控制体内4,666次M≥0.2事件）。
li: Access restrictions prevented wide-area soil CO2 flux measurements across Solfatara-Pisciarelli between 2018 and 2021, obscuring the exact onset timing of the spatial degassing reorganization.
The CO-CO2 gas geothermometer only records the last homogeneous equilibrium at ≤1 km depth, above the 3–4 km primary deformation source.
Condensation depth estimates rely on thermodynamic equilibrium under assumed redox buffers rather than direct 4D geophysical tomography of the condensation zone.
准入限制导致2018至2021年间缺乏Solfatara-Pisciarelli广域土壤CO2通量数据，难以精确锁定脱气空间重组开始的时间。
CO-CO2气体地温计仅记录≤1 km深处的最后一次均相平衡，浅于3–4 km处的主要形变源深度。
冷凝深度估计依赖于假设氧化还原缓冲条件下的热力学平衡模型，缺乏对该增压冷凝区的直接高精度层析成像约束。

tm.why: The paper investigates the mechanisms driving volcanic unrest, ground deformation, and seismicity at the Campi Flegrei caldera by coupling a 27-year geochemical dataset with GNSS uplift and earthquake catalogs.
It models the crustal plumbing system, brittle-ductile transition, and elastic deformation energy of the upper 4 km beneath the caldera.

ev.notes: Full 13-page PDF text and figures analyzed, including Introduction, Results, Discussion, Materials and Methods, and all 7 main figures.

sum: This Perspective reviews the Permian to Cretaceous paleogeographic evolution of East Asian continental blocks using a curated paleomagnetic database and site-level statistical bootstrapping that propagates age, inclination shallowing, and dispersion uncertainties. The authors propose the 'Asiana hypothesis': in the Triassic, Amuria, North China, South China, Indochina, and Sibumasu-Qiangtang-Helmand amalgamated into 'Asiana', a South America-sized continent that was never part of Pangea. Asiana subsequently converged 2000–3000 km northward with 'Eurussia', colliding in the early Cretaceous to form Eurasia. This raises the 'Asiana Conundrum': despite massive paleomagnetically recorded convergence, widespread intracontinental shortening or accretionary records are largely absent, implying non-accretionary oceanic subduction of a contiguous Mongol-Okhotsk-Waser ocean, while dinosaur fossils require transient land bridges. Finally, placing Asiana in a slab-fitted mantle reference frame links its subducted oceans to the deep-mantle seismic 'slab graveyard' beneath Asia.
本文综述了二叠纪至白垩纪东亚陆块的古地理演化，利用最新古地磁数据库和传播年龄、倾角浅化及离散度不确定性的站点级统计自举法计算了古纬度路径。作者提出“亚细亚那（Asiana）假说”：三叠纪时东亚各陆块拼贴成面积堪比南美洲、从未属于盘古大陆的独立大陆Asiana；随后向北漂移2000–3000公里，于早……

t: Adapts a site-level statistical bootstrapping approach (2000 iterations, 20–30 Myr sliding windows) to compute paleolatitude-only curves that avoid vertical-axis rotation bias while propagating age, inclination shallowing, and dispersion uncertainties.
采用站点级统计自举法（2000次迭代，20–30 Myr滑动窗）计算纯古纬度曲线，避免垂直轴旋转偏差并传播不确定性。

Compiled a curated Permian–Cretaceous paleomagnetic database for major East Asian continental blocks, retaining only primary magnetizations with N>4 spot readings and inclination-shallowing-corrected sedimentary datasets (archived at APWP-online.org).
汇编东亚主要陆块二叠纪-白垩纪精选古地磁数据库，仅保留N>4的原生磁化及经倾角浅化校正的沉积岩数据。

East Asian blocks merged in the Triassic into Asiana (~7000 x 5500 x 6500 km), which subsequently underwent 2000–3000 km of convergence with Eurussia until early Cretaceous collision (~130 Ma), leaving subducted slabs across the Asian mantle graveyard.
东亚陆块于三叠纪拼贴成Asiana大陆，随后与欧俄大陆汇聚2000–3000 km直至早白垩世碰撞，俯冲板片留存于亚洲地…

Asiana's paleolatitude between ~240 and 160 Ma is poorly constrained due to legacy sedimentary data lacking raw directions for inclination shallowing corrections, and Lhasa data show probable Permian–Jurassic remagnetization.
因早期数据缺乏原始方向无法校正倾角浅化，240–160 Ma古纬度约束较差；拉萨地块可能存在广泛重磁化。

First application of site-level uncertainty-propagating paleolatitude analysis to East Asia, defining and naming 'Asiana' as the only major continent never part of Pangea and framing the 'Asiana Conundrum'.
首次将传播不确定性的站点级古纬度分析应用于东亚，命名独立于盘古大陆的Asiana并提出Asiana悖论。

kc: Formulates the 'Asiana hypothesis', defining the Triassic amalgamation of East Asian blocks as a South America-sized continent outside Pangea.
Computes the first site-level paleolatitude-only reference curves for East Asian blocks propagating age, inclination shallowing, and dispersion uncertainties.
Identifies the 'Asiana Conundrum' reconciling 2000–3000 km of Mesozoic convergence without major intracontinental shortening against dinosaur biogeography requiring land bridges.
Correlates subducted Paleotethys, Solonker, Mesotethys, and Mongol-Okhotsk-Waser oceans with seismic tomographic slab anomalies in the Asian mantle graveyard.
提出“亚细亚那（Asiana）假说”，将三叠纪东亚陆块拼贴定义为独立于盘古大陆的南美洲大小的大陆。
首次计算了东亚陆块站点级纯古纬度参考曲线，严格传播了年龄、倾角浅化和离散度不确定性。
指出“Asiana悖论”，探讨了无大规模陆内缩短记录的2000–3000公里中生代汇聚与恐龙生物地理所需陆桥之间的矛盾。
将俯冲的古特提斯、索伦克、中特提斯及蒙古-鄂霍次克-瓦瑟洋遗迹与亚洲地幔地震层析成像中的板片墓地异常相关联。
me: Curation of a Permian–Cretaceous paleomagnetic database for East Asian blocks using strict quality criteria and inclination shallowing corrections (E/I and SVEI tests).
Site-level statistical resampling (2000 bootstrap iterations) with sliding 20–30 Myr time windows to compute paleolatitude-only curves immune to vertical-axis rotation bias.

Kinematic plate tectonic reconstruction in GPlates (updating Utrecht Paleogeography Model to v1.1) and correlation with the UUP07 P-wave seismic tomography model in a slab-fitted mantle reference frame.
基于严格质量标准和倾角浅化校正（E/I和SVEI检验），建立东亚陆块二叠纪-白垩纪古地磁数据库。
采用站点级统计重采样（2000次自举迭代）和20–30 Myr滑动时间窗，计算不受垂直轴旋转偏差影响的纯古纬度路径。
在GPlates中进行运动学板块构造重建（更新Utrecht古地理模型至1.1版），并在板片拟合地幔参考系下与UUP07纵波地震层析成像模型进行对比。
de: Curated paleomagnetic database of East Asian continental blocks (North China, Qaidam, South China, Amuria, Qiangtang, Indochina, Sibumasu, Lhasa, Tarim) archived at APWP-online.org.
Geological suture zone records, magmatic arc geochronology, and Mesozoic vertebrate (dinosaur) fossil biogeography across Asia.
Horizontal depth slices (1310 km, 1710 km, 2790 km) of the global P-wave seismic tomographic model UUP07.
归档于APWP-online.org的东亚大陆块体（华北、柴达木、华南、阿穆尔、羌塘、印支、Sibumasu、拉萨、塔里木）精选古地磁数据库。
亚洲各地质缝合带记录、岩浆弧年代学以及中生代脊椎动物（恐龙）化石生物地理数据。
全球P波地震层析成像模型UUP07的水平深度切片（1310 km、1710 km、2790 km）。
li: Large paleomagnetic data gap for Asiana between ~240 and 160 Ma due to legacy sedimentary datasets lacking sample-level directions for inclination shallowing correction.
Apparent paleolatitudinal standstill (~15°S) of the Lhasa block from Early Permian to Late Jurassic likely reflects pervasive regional remagnetization.
Locations and nature of transient Triassic–Jurassic land bridges and the cryptic Tarim–Qaidam suture segment remain geologically unconstrained.
由于早期沉积岩数据缺乏用于倾角浅化校正的样品级方向，Asiana在约240至160 Ma之间存在较大的古地磁数据空白。
拉萨地块早二叠世至晚侏罗世表现出的约15°S古纬度停滞可能反映了广泛的区域重磁化。
三叠纪-侏罗纪短暂陆桥的位置和性质以及隐伏的塔里木-柴达木缝合带段在地质上仍缺乏约束。

tm.why: The paper reconstructs the tectonic assembly of East Asian continental blocks into the continent 'Asiana' and correlates its subducted ocean basins with the deep-mantle slab graveyard below Asia.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 44-page EarthArXiv manuscript PDF including main text, boxes, figures, and supplementary methods.

sum: The timing and longevity of the ancient lunar dynamo remain debated due to conflicting sample paleomagnetic records and uncertain origins of orbital magnetic anomalies. This study performs the first 3D joint inversion of lunar gravity residual (GRGM1200B) and magnetic field data using a variation-of-information coupling constraint over the Dewar swirl region. The inversion identifies a shallow (<9 km depth, ~60 km wide) collocated high-density (+250 kg/m³) and strongly magnetized (~0.4 A/m) body consistent with an intrusive basaltic body associated with a cryptomare. Combining these constraints with subsolidus ilmenite reduction models yields a minimum paleointensity of >11.4 μT at ~4.22 ± 0.08 Ga (constrained by South Pole-Aitken and Freundlich-Sharanov basin ejecta). Additionally, comparisons across nearby anomalies demonstrate that lunar swirl formation requires both horizontal magnetization and surface FeO enrichment. This work links an orbital anomaly directly to a magmatic origin and an active early lunar dynamo.
针对月球早期发电机寿命的争议，本文首次采用基于信息变分耦合约束的三维重磁联合反演方法，结合GRGM1200B重力残差与轨道磁场数据，反演了月球背面Dewar漩涡区的地壳密度与磁化结构。结果揭示了一个宽约60 km、深达9 km的浅层高密度（+250 kg/m³）强磁化（~0.4 A/m）体，对应于隐……

t: 3D nonlinear joint inversion of lunar gravity residuals and vector magnetic field data using the jif3D framework with an iteratively relaxed Variation of Information (VI) coupling constraint.
利用jif3D框架和逐步松弛的信息变分（VI）耦合约束，对月球重力残差和矢量磁场进行三维非线性联合反演。
Gravity residuals from the GRGM1200B model (up to degree 550) after Bouguer and Moho corrections, and lunar magnetic field models (up to degree 450) sampled at 6 and 30 km altitudes.
扣除布格和莫霍面效应的GRGM1200B重力残差（550阶）及月球磁场模型（450阶），在6和30 km高度采样。
Identified a ~60 km wide, <9 km deep intrusive body beneath Dewar swirl with max magnetization ~0.4 A/m and density anomaly +250 kg/m³, requiring a minimum paleointensity of 11.4–22.0 μT at ~4.22 Ga.
发现宽60 km、深<9 km的高密度（+250 kg/m³）强磁化（0.4 A/m）体，要求42.2亿年前最小古磁场达…

High satellite altitude prevents resolving fine-scale swirl albedo transitions, and gravity inversions cannot resolve vertical density extents uniquely or deep magmatic pathways to the crust-mantle boundary.
卫星高度限制了对漩涡精细尺度的分辨，且重力反演无法解析连接壳幔边界的深部岩浆通道。
First 3D joint inversion of lunar gravity and magnetic data, enabling sample-independent orbital constraints on minimum lunar dynamo paleointensity and linking swirl formation to magmatic intrusions.
首次实现月球重磁三维联合反演，独立于样品给出了早期月球发电机古磁场强度下限及漩涡岩浆成因证据。

kc: Conducted the first 3D joint inversion of lunar gravity and magnetic field data using variation-of-information coupling to resolve crustal density and magnetization.
Identified a ~60 km wide, <9 km deep high-density (+250 kg/m³) and horizontally magnetized (0.4 A/m) intrusive magmatic body beneath the Dewar swirl.
Established a minimum paleointensity of 11.4–22.0 μT at 4.22 ± 0.08 Ga from orbital potential field data, supporting an active pre-Nectarian lunar dynamo.
Demonstrated that both horizontal crustal magnetization and surface FeO enrichment are required to form high-albedo lunar swirls via solar wind deflection.
首次利用基于信息变分耦合约束的三维重磁联合反演方法，解析了月球地壳的三维密度与磁化结构。
在Dewar漩涡下方识别出一个宽约60 km、深<9 km的高密度（+250 kg/m³）且具水平磁化（0.4 A/m）的玄武质岩浆侵入体。
仅凭轨道位场数据推算出42.2±0.08亿年前的最小古磁场强度为11.4–22.0 μT，支持前酒海纪存在活跃的月球发电机。
证实高反照率月球漩涡的形成需要同时满足地壳水平磁化（偏转太阳风）与表面富集FeO两个条件。
me: 3D nonlinear joint inversion of gravity residual and vector magnetic field data using the jif3D framework with Variation of Information (VI) coupling constraints.
Iterative relaxation of the VI coupling weight (from 10^6 down to 10^2) to separate non-collocated sources while preserving collocated gravity-magnetic structures.
Spherical harmonic Bouguer and Moho relief corrections (using DSP package) and sine-shaped high-pass degree-depth filtering to isolate crustal density anomalies.
Four-step geochemical-petrophysical parametric modeling based on subsolidus reduction of ilmenite to metallic iron during slow basalt cooling to bound minimum paleointensity.
基于jif3D框架与信息变分（VI）耦合约束，对重力残差和矢量磁场数据进行三维非线性联合反演。
采用耦合权重逐步松弛策略（从10^6降至10^2），在保留同源重磁异常共位性的同时分离非共位源。
利用球谐展开进行布格校正与莫霍面起伏扣除（DSP软件包），并结合正弦型高通滤波开展阶数-深度关系分析。
建立四步岩石物理参数化模型，基于玄武岩缓慢冷却过程中钛铁矿亚固相还原生成金属铁的机制，估算最小古磁场强度。
de: GRGM1200B lunar gravity field model expanded to spherical harmonic degree 550, LOLA shape model topography, and modeled Moho relief.
Lunar crustal magnetic field models from Kaguya and Lunar Prospector observations (Tsunakawa et al., 2015 and Ravat et al., 2020) expanded to degree 450, sampled at 6 km and 30 km altitudes.
Clementine UVVIS surface FeO and TiO2 abundance maps and Kaguya Multiband Imager mineralogical constraints.
3D synthetic prism tests evaluating overlapping, partially overlapping, and non-overlapping density and magnetization anomalies under Gaussian noise.
展开至550阶的GRGM1200B月球重力场模型、LOLA地形模型及反演得到的莫霍面起伏数据。
基于Kaguya和Lunar Prospector观测的月球地壳磁场模型（展开至450阶），并在6 km和30 km高度重采样。
Clementine UVVIS表面FeO和TiO2丰度图以及Kaguya多波段成像仪矿物学数据。
包含完全重叠、部分重叠和不重叠密度与磁化异常棱柱体的三维合成加噪反演测试。
li: Potential field inversions have limited vertical depth resolution for density structures, which tend to be driven by the magnetization depth in coupled inversions.
Owing to satellite observation altitudes, the model cannot resolve fine-scale magnetization comparable to the sharp albedo transition length scales of lunar swirls.
Gravity inversion cannot resolve deep magmatic plumbing pathways connecting the shallow magma chamber to the crust-mantle boundary.
位场反演对深部结构的垂直分辨率有限，联合反演中密度异常的垂直深度易受磁化体深度的主导。
受卫星观测高度限制，模型无法分辨与月球漩涡反照率边界尺度相当的精细小尺度磁化结构。
重力场反演无法解析连接浅部岩浆房与壳幔边界的深部岩浆通道。

tm.why: The paper conducts a 3D joint inversion of lunar gravity and magnetic data to resolve the crustal density and magnetization structure beneath the Dewar swirl and constrain early lunar geodynamic and dynamo evolution.
The study applies a nonlinear 3D joint inversion framework (jif3D) using a variation-of-information coupling constraint to simultaneously invert potential field datasets.
The study investigates planetary subsurface magmatic structures on the Moon and suggests future complementary lunar seismic observations to resolve deeper magmatic pathways.

ev.notes: Full 13-page PDF analyzed, including main text, Methods, 5 figures, and 1 table.

sum: This study uses 3D spontaneous dynamic-rupture simulations to investigate how shallow sedimentary layers affect earthquake rupture propagation across extensional and compressional strike-slip stepovers. The authors demonstrate that sedimentary layers significantly facilitate rupture jumps across extensional stepovers, especially under high-prestress conditions with supershear rupture. This enhancement is driven by sediment-guided Mach waves reflecting between the free surface and the sediment-bedrock interface, which maintains high dynamic Coulomb stress at large distances. Conversely, the effect is weaker and regime-dependent across compressional stepovers. Under optimal conditions, critical jump distances can reach 35–40 km. These findings highlight the critical role of shallow geological structures in controlling multifault earthquake hazards.
本研究利用三维自发动力学破裂模拟，探讨了浅部沉积层对拉张型和挤压型走滑断层阶区地震破裂跨越的影响。结果表明，在超剪切破裂和高初始应力条件下，沉积层能显著促进破裂跨越拉张型阶区。这种促进作用源于在自由表面与沉积-基岩界面之间往复反射的沉积引导马赫波，它在较大距离处维持了有利的动态库仑应力。而在挤压型阶……

t: Three-dimensional spontaneous dynamic-rupture simulations analyzing rupture propagation across extensional and compressional strike-slip stepovers.
采用三维自发动力学破裂模拟，分析跨越拉张和挤压型走滑阶区的破裂传播。
Synthetic numerical models of strike-slip faults embedded in a layered medium consisting of a shallow sedimentary layer over bedrock.
嵌入在分层介质（基岩上覆浅部沉积层）中的走滑断层合成数值模型。
Sedimentary layers enable maximum extensional critical jump distances of 35-40 km under high stress, facilitated by sediment-guided Mach waves.
在高应力下，沉积层引导的马赫波使最大拉张临界跨越距离达到35-40公里。
The maximum jump distances are conditional on specific reference stress, friction assumptions, and shallow stress/residual strength parameters.
最大跨越距离取决于特定的参考应力、摩擦力假设以及浅部应力和残留强度。
Identifies sediment-guided Mach waves reflecting between the free surface and sediment-bedrock interface as a key mechanism for extra-wide rupture jumps.
首次提出在自由面与沉积-基岩界面间反射的沉积引导马赫波是实现超宽破裂跨越的关键机制。

kc: Demonstrated that shallow sedimentary layers can dramatically increase the critical rupture jump distance across extensional stepovers (up to 35-40 km under high prestress).
Identified sediment-guided Mach waves reflecting between the free surface and sediment-bedrock interface as the primary physical mechanism sustaining dynamic Coulomb stress.
Revealed that the sediment effect is weaker and regime-dependent across compressional stepovers compared to extensional ones.
证明了浅部沉积层可以显著增加拉张型阶区处的临界破裂跨越距离（在高预应力下可达35-40公里）。
确定了在自由表面与沉积-基岩界面之间反射的沉积引导马赫波是维持有利动态库仑应力的主要物理机制。
揭示了与拉张型阶区相比，沉积层效应对挤压型阶区的影响较弱且依赖于破裂模式。
me: Three-dimensional spontaneous dynamic-rupture simulations.
Parametric analysis of sediment velocity, thickness, background stress, rupture regime, and fault burial.
三维自发动力学破裂数值模拟。
对沉积层速度、厚度、背景应力、破裂模式及断层埋深进行参数化分析。
de: Synthetic numerical experiments modeling strike-slip faults with extensional and compressional stepovers embedded in a layered medium (sediment over bedrock).
合成数值实验，模拟嵌入在分层介质（基岩上覆沉积层）中的具有拉张和挤压阶区的走滑断层。
li: The extra-wide jump distances (35-40 km) are highly conditional on specific reference stress, friction assumptions, and shallow stress/residual strength parameters.
The study is based on simplified 3D numerical models rather than real-world complex fault geometries.
超宽的跨越距离（35-40公里）高度依赖于特定的参考应力、摩擦假设以及浅部应力/残留强度参数。
该研究基于简化的三维数值模型，而非真实世界中复杂的断层几何形状。

tm.why: The paper uses 3D spontaneous dynamic-rupture simulations to study earthquake rupture propagation and jump distances across fault stepovers.
It investigates how fault stepovers, background stress, and friction assumptions control rupture transfer.
It models sediment-guided Mach waves and dynamic rupture propagation using 3D numerical simulations.

ev.notes: The analysis is based entirely on the detailed abstract and public metadata since no PDF was available.

sum: Earthquake magnitude depends on both rupture length and fault slip, which are often entangled in early waveform correlations. This study isolates slip ordering by stopping all ruptures at both ends of an idealized 120 km fault using 2D plane-strain dynamic simulations (fdfault) with linear slip-weakening friction. Comparing 259 ruptures with uniform background stress per event against 230 ruptures with a 10 km correlated along-strike Gaussian stress fluctuation (1.3 MPa SD), the time required for accumulated slip to reach 85% of its peak Spearman rank correlation with 20 s slip increases from 2 s to 8 s (7–9 s). Because median rupture speeds and propagation durations are nearly identical between the two sets, this 6 s delay arises from ongoing local stress-drop adjustments rather than a slower rupture front. Furthermore, early 3 s P-wave metrics (Pd and τc) predict 20 s slip much less accurately than full-record station energy.
地震震级取决于破裂长度与断层滑动量。本研究利用二维平面应变动力学模拟（fdfault）和线性滑移弱化摩擦准则，通过在120公里断层两端设置阻挡块固定破裂长度，单独分离并评估了滑动量的早期排序时间。对比259个全断层单一背景应力破裂与230个叠加10公里相关长度沿走向高斯应力起伏（标准差1.3 MPa……

t: 2D plane-strain mode II dynamic rupture simulations using the finite-difference solver fdfault with linear slip-weakening friction on a 120 km fault bounded by high-friction stopping barriers.
使用fdfault求解器和线性滑移弱化摩擦，在两端带阻挡层的120公里断层上进行二维II型动态破裂模拟。

Two ensembles of 300 stochastic draws (yielding 259 whole-fault uniform-stress ruptures and 230 ruptures with a 10 km correlated 1.3 MPa Gaussian along-strike stress field), evaluated across three 7-station layouts.
两组各300次随机预应力抽样（259个均匀应力和230个10公里相关高斯起伏破裂）及三种7台站布局。

Accumulated slip reaches 85% of peak Spearman rank correlation with 20 s slip at 2 s (1–3 s) for uniform background stress and 8 s (7–9 s) for along-strike varying stress, with equal median rupture speeds (4.81 km/s).
均匀应力下滑动排序时间为2秒（1–3秒），沿走向起伏应力下延迟至8秒（7–9秒），但破裂速度中位数相同。
Simulations are idealized 2D plane-strain models without depth propagation, free surface, or field data calibration, and stored temporal samples do not resolve dynamic cohesive-zone width.
理想化二维平面应变模型，无深度扩展、自由地表及实际观测标定，未解析动态内聚区宽度。
Separates early fault slip ordering from rupture length entanglement by fixing the rupture length with end barriers and varying only the along-strike background prestress.
通过固定破裂长度并仅改变沿走向背景应力，将滑动量的早期排序与破裂长度完全解耦。

kc: Isolates the timing of fault slip rank-ordering from rupture length variations by stopping all simulated ruptures with strong end barriers on a 120 km 2D fault.
Demonstrates that adding a 1.3 MPa along-strike stress fluctuation (10 km correlation length) delays slip rank-ordering from 2 s to 8 s (7–9 s) without slowing the rupture front.

Quantifies the visibility of on-fault slip ordering at near-field, surrounding, and rupture-forward station layouts, showing that 3 s P-wave measures (Pd, τc) yield high relative RMS errors (0.60–0.87) compared to full-record station energy (0.15–0.17).
通过在120公里二维断层两端设置强阻挡层固定破裂长度，将断层滑动的早期秩次排序与破裂长度变化完全分离。
证明加入1.3 MPa沿走向应力起伏（10公里相关长度）会将滑动排序时间从2秒推迟至8秒（7–9秒），且并非由破裂前缘减速引起。
量化了近场、环绕及破裂前方台站对断层滑动排序的观测滞后，表明P波到达后3秒内的Pd和τc相对预测误差（0.60–0.87）远高于全记录台站能量（0.15–0.17）。
me: 2D plane-strain mode II dynamic rupture modeling using the finite-difference solver fdfault with linear slip-weakening friction.

Stochastic prestress generation comparing uniform whole-fault stress draws (N(70, 0.4^2) MPa) against a 1D squared-exponential Gaussian random field along strike (SD 1.3 MPa, correlation length 10 km).
Non-parametric rank-order analysis using Spearman correlation between cumulative slip M(T) (or station waveform energy) and 20 s slip Y, with 1000-sample bootstrap confidence intervals.
Ten-fold ridge regression predicting 20 s slip from 3 s early P-wave peak displacement (Pd), characteristic period (τc), and station energy.
使用有限差分求解器fdfault和线性滑移弱化摩擦定律进行二维平面应变II型动态破裂模拟。
随机预应力生成：对比全断层均匀正态抽样（均值70 MPa，标准差0.4 MPa）与叠加沿走向平方指数协方差高斯随机场（标准差1.3 MPa，相关长度10 km）。
采用Spearman秩相关系数计算累积滑动量M(T)（或台站波形能量）与20秒滑动量Y达到峰值85%的排序时间，并进行1000次自助法（bootstrap）重采样。
利用十折岭回归（惩罚系数为1），基于预测P波到时后3秒窗口内的峰值位移（Pd）、特征周期（τc）及台站对数能量预测20秒滑动量。
de: 300 stochastic realizations each for the whole-fault draw (259 propagating ruptures) and the 10 km heterogeneous stress field (230 propagating ruptures) on a 500 m along-strike × 400 m fault-normal grid.
Mesh resolution convergence tests at 250 m and 200 m along-strike spacing, plus 200 m fault-normal spacing and widened elastic blocks (56 km vs 28 km).
Auxiliary experiments testing 5 km and 20 km correlation lengths (36 draws each) and unstopped ruptures without end barriers across six background stress settings.
在沿走向500米×垂直断层400米网格上，对全断层均匀应力（259个传播破裂）和10公里非均匀应力场（230个传播破裂）各进行300次随机模拟。
在沿走向250米和200米网格、垂直断层200米网格以及加宽弹性块体（56公里对比28公里）上进行网格分辨率收敛性测试。
开展5公里和20公里相关长度（各36次抽样）以及去除两端阻挡块体在6种应力设置下的辅助对比实验。
li: Idealized 2D plane-strain mode II geometry with no depth variation, no free surface, and a single linear slip-weakening friction law.
Purely synthetic study with parameters not calibrated to any field earthquake record.

At 500 m spacing, only ~1.4 grid points span the static cohesive zone length (though 200 m spacing resolves ~3.5 points and confirms the 2 s vs 8 s result), and temporal sampling does not resolve the dynamic cohesive zone width.
理想化的二维平面应变II型几何模型，无深度方向扩展、无自由地表，且仅使用单一线性滑移弱化摩擦准则。
纯数值模拟研究，摩擦与应力参数未针对实际观测地震记录进行标定。
500米网格在静态内聚区长度上仅约1.4个网格点（尽管200米网格达到3.5个点并验证了结论），且存储采样间隔未解析动态内聚区宽度。

tm.why: The study performs 2D dynamic rupture simulations with linear slip-weakening friction to investigate how along-strike prestress heterogeneity affects the timing of slip ordering.
The paper evaluates early waveform measures (peak displacement Pd, characteristic period τc, and station energy) at near-field and surrounding stations in the context of earthquake early warning.

ev.notes: Full 27-page PDF (24-page main manuscript + 3-page supplement) was read and analyzed in detail, including all equations, tables, and figures.

sum: This paper introduces ShallowLandslider, a hybrid physical–statistical framework coupling 3D Newmark critical-acceleration slope-stability calculations with geometric partitioning and stochastic sampling to simulate discrete coseismic shallow landslide populations. Applied to two geomorphically contrasting subregions impacted by the 2015 Mw 7.8 Gorkha earthquake in Nepal, the model evaluates competing hypotheses of regolith thickness organization against mapped landslide inventories across area, elevation, slope, and aspect distributions. Parameterizations with spatially variable regolith thickness consistently outperform a uniform 1 m baseline, achieving optimal agreement at moderate effective cohesion (10–15 kPa) typical of shallow colluvium. High-relief, bedrock-dominated terrain favors inverse-elevation regolith thinning, whereas lower-relief, soil-mantled terrain favors curvature-informed local convergence. The novelty lies in bridging deterministic slope-stability mechanics with probabilistic realization of discrete landslide geometries to infer landscape-scale subsurface regolith architecture where direct measurements are sparse.
本文提出了物理-统计混合模型ShallowLandslider，结合纽马克临界加速度边坡稳定性计算与离散滑坡群的随机抽样。研究利用2015年尼泊尔Mw 7.8戈尔卡地震的滑坡编目、30米DEM及PGA数据，在两个地貌反差显著的子区域测试了五种风化层厚度参数化方案。结果表明，空间变化的风化层厚度模型显……

t: ShallowLandslider couples 3D Newmark critical-acceleration slope-stability calculations on 30 m DEMs with aspect- and length-width-based geometric region splitting and critical-acceleration-weighted stochastic sampling to simulate discrete landslide populations.
将三维纽马克临界加速度计算与基于坡向和长宽比的几何分割及加权随机抽样相结合。
The model is tested in two contrasting Nepalese subregions using 30 m SRTM DEMs, USGS ShakeMap PGA fields, and the Roback et al. (2018) 2015 Gorkha earthquake landslide inventory.
使用2015年尼泊尔戈尔卡地震滑坡编目、USGS ShakeMap PGA及30米SRTM DEM数据。

Spatially variable regolith parameterizations outperform uniform thickness, with optimal cohesion of 10–15 kPa. Subregion 1 favors inverse-elevation thinning (elevation KS = 0.095), whereas Subregion 2 favors elevation-weighted curvature (slope KS = 0.065).
空间变化风化层优于均匀基线，最佳粘聚力10-15 kPa；子区域1偏好反高程（KS=0.095），子区域2偏好高程加权曲…

The model uses interpolated ShakeMap PGA without duration or topographic amplification, holds friction angle and saturation constant, and relies on observed length-width distributions for patch splitting.
依赖插值PGA而忽略持时与地形放大，固定摩擦角与饱和度，且分割依赖经验长宽比。
Introduces a hybrid physical–statistical framework that realizes discrete landslide geometries to test competing landscape-scale regolith thickness hypotheses against coseismic landslide inventories.
提出混合框架生成离散滑坡群，利用同震滑坡编目检验区域尺度风化层厚度分布假说。

kc: Developed ShallowLandslider, an open-source Landlab-based hybrid physical–statistical model for simulating discrete coseismic shallow landslide populations.
Demonstrated that spatially variable regolith thickness parameterizations substantially outperform uniform regolith thickness in reproducing 2015 Gorkha earthquake landslide distributions.

Identified contrasting regolith controls across geomorphic settings: inverse-elevation thinning in steep bedrock-dominated terrain versus curvature-driven thickening in lower-relief soil-mantled terrain.
Constrained optimal effective cohesion for Gorkha shallow landslides to 10–15 kPa, confirming shallow colluvial failure mechanics.
开发了基于Landlab的开源物理-统计混合模型ShallowLandslider，用于模拟离散同震浅层滑坡群。
证明了空间变化的风化层厚度参数化在重现2015年戈尔卡地震滑坡分布方面显著优于均匀厚度假设。
揭示了不同地貌背景下的风化层控制差异：高起伏基岩区受控于随高程减薄，低起伏土层覆盖区受控于曲率汇聚增厚。
将戈尔卡浅层滑坡的最佳有效粘聚力约束在10–15 kPa范围内，印证了浅层崩积物破坏机制。
me: Infinite-slope and transient 3D Newmark critical-acceleration formulation using horizontal and vertical peak ground accelerations (PGA).
Five topographic parameterizations of regolith thickness: uniform (1 m), inverse-elevation, drainage-area, planform curvature, and elevation-weighted curvature.
Recursive geometric region splitting using 20° aspect bins and empirical length–width ratios followed by critical-acceleration-weighted stochastic sampling.
Population-level distributional validation using Kolmogorov–Smirnov (KS), Kuiper (circular), and Wasserstein distance metrics.
基于水平与垂直峰值地面加速度（PGA）的无限边坡与瞬态三维纽马克临界加速度计算。
五种基于地形的风化层厚度参数化方案：均匀1米、反高程、汇水面积、平面曲率及高程加权曲率。
利用20°坡向分箱和经验长宽比进行递归几何区域分割，并结合临界加速度加权的随机抽样。
采用Kolmogorov-Smirnov（KS）统计量、Kuiper循环统计量和Wasserstein距离进行滑坡群分布验证。
de: Mapped polygonal coseismic landslide inventory (>24,000 slides) from the 2015 Mw 7.8 Gorkha earthquake (Roback et al., 2018), rasterized to 30 m.
Lightly smoothed (3x3 median filter) 30 m SRTM Digital Elevation Models (DEM) for two contrasting Himalayan subregions (Subregion 1: n=523 slides; Subregion 2: n=2,353 slides).
USGS ShakeMap horizontal and vertical peak ground acceleration (PGA) grids for the 2015 Gorkha earthquake.
Parameter sweep across four primary regolith-thickness configurations and effective cohesions (0, 5, 10, 15, 20 kPa) with fixed friction angle (30°) and saturation (m=0.5).
2015年Mw 7.8戈尔卡地震的多边形同震滑坡编目数据集（>24,000处，栅格化至30米分辨率）。
经3x3中值滤波平滑的30米SRTM数字高程模型（DEM），覆盖两个对比鲜明的喜马拉雅子区域（子区域1含523处滑坡，子区域2含2,353处滑坡）。
USGS ShakeMap提供的2015年戈尔卡地震水平和垂直峰值地面加速度（PGA）网格数据。
针对四种主要风化层厚度方案和有效粘聚力（0、5、10、15、20 kPa）的参数扫描实验（固定摩擦角30°和饱和度0.5）。
li: Seismic forcing relies on interpolated USGS ShakeMap PGA grids without resolving full acceleration time histories, shaking duration, frequency content, topographic amplification, or rupture directivity.
Recursive patch partitioning relies on empirical length–width distributions from the observed inventory, making the current setup a hindcasting tool rather than a purely prospective predictor.
30 m DEM resolution and 3x3 median smoothing cannot resolve narrow hollows, road cuts, or sub-grid bedrock structures, and deep-seated bedrock failures are not modeled.
Hydrological saturation (m=0.5) and internal friction angle (30°) are held spatially uniform and constant.
地震动输入依赖插值的USGS ShakeMap峰值加速度网格，未解析完整加速度时程、持时、频率成分、地形放大效应或破裂方向性。
递归斑块分割依赖观测编目的经验长宽比分布，使当前工作流偏向后报检验而非纯粹的前瞻性预测。
30米DEM分辨率及3x3平滑处理无法分辨狭窄凹槽、道路开挖或亚网格基岩结构，且模型未包含深层基岩滑坡机制。
水文饱和度（m=0.5）和内摩擦角（30°）被假设为空间均匀恒定。

tm.why: The study models earthquake-triggered shallow landslide populations using USGS ShakeMap peak ground acceleration (PGA) fields from the 2015 Mw 7.8 Gorkha earthquake.
The paper investigates surface processes, hillslope stability, and coseismic mass wasting in mountainous landscapes.

ev.notes: Full 22-page PDF analyzed, including equations, workflow diagrams, parameter tables, and statistical heatmaps.

sum: Three-dimensional seismic velocity model building (VMB) using native 3D neural networks is hindered by severe memory and computational costs. This paper introduces a depth-progressive 3D VMB framework powered by 2D generative diffusion models via a 'depth-as-channel' formulation, mapping the depth dimension of 3D velocity patches to the channel axis of a 2D U-Net. Starting from a shallow velocity prior, the network recursively synthesizes overlapping deeper patches conditioned on shallower predictions, optional 1D well logs, and 3D structural attributes using classifier-free guidance. A depth-attenuated Gaussian blending scheme merges overlapping patches while down-weighting deeper, more uncertain predictions. Tested on synthetic 3D benchmarks (Overthrust, SEAM Arid, SEG/EAGE) and an out-of-distribution Marmousi volume, the method outperforms an equivalent 3D diffusion benchmark in MAE and SSIM while cutting parameter count by 2.8x, per-batch training memory by 19x, and inference time by nearly 30x.
针对全3D神经网络在三维地震速度建模（VMB）中内存与计算成本过高的问题，本文提出一种基于2D生成扩散模型的深度递进式3D速度建模框架。核心创新是“深度即通道”表征，将3D速度块的深度维映射为2D U-Net的通道维。模型从浅层速度先验出发，结合分类器自由引导策略，以自顶向下的递归方式利用浅层预测、……

t: Maps the depth axis of 3D velocity patches (16x128x128) to the channel dimension of a 2D conditional U-Net diffusion model, recursively predicting deeper patches from shallow ones and blending them with depth-attenuated Gaussian weights.
将3D速度块的深度维映射为2D条件U-Net扩散模型的通道维，由浅入深递归预测并采用深度衰减高斯融合拼接。

Trained on 22,000 augmented 3D synthetic velocity volumes (128x128x128) derived via undulation extension from eight 2D/3D industrial benchmark models, paired with 60 Hz Ricker convolution images and 1D well profiles.
基于8个工业标准模型通过起伏扩展和旋转增强生成22,000个128³合成3D速度体及60Hz褶积地震图像。

Achieves lower MAE across all four test models than a 3D U-Net benchmark (e.g., 6.88 vs 20.53 m/s on Overthrust with well+image), with 2.8x fewer parameters, 19x less per-batch memory, and ~30x faster inference.
在所有测试模型上MAE均低于3D基准网络，参数量减少2.8倍，单批次内存降低19倍，推理加速近30倍。

Relies on idealized structural constraints generated by convolving true vertical reflectivity with a Ricker wavelet, which lacks acquisition artifacts, bandwidth limits, and illumination gaps found in real field seismic images.
构造约束依赖真实反射率与子波褶积的理想图像，未考虑实际采集伪影与照明不足。
First extension of depth-progressive diffusion velocity model building to 3D using a 2D depth-as-channel U-Net and depth-attenuated Gaussian patch blending, bypassing costly 3D convolutions.
首次通过“深度即通道”2D扩散架构与深度衰减高斯融合实现无需3D卷积的递进式3D速度建模。

kc: Proposed a depth-as-channel formulation that maps the depth dimension of 3D velocity patches to the channel dimension of a 2D U-Net, avoiding 3D convolutions.
Developed a recursive shallow-to-deep 3D inference workflow with classifier-free guidance to flexibly incorporate optional well logs and 3D structural attributes.
Introduced a two-stage depth-attenuated Gaussian blending scheme to seamlessly fuse overlapping 3D patches while accounting for downward error accumulation.
Demonstrated superior velocity reconstruction accuracy and ~30x faster inference compared to an equivalent native 3D diffusion model across four geological benchmarks.
提出“深度即通道”公式，将3D速度块的深度维度映射为2D U-Net的通道维度，从而完全避免高成本的3D卷积。
开发了自浅向深的递归3D推理流程，结合分类器自由引导策略灵活融入可选的测井速度与三维构造属性约束。
引入两阶段深度衰减高斯融合方案，无缝拼接重叠的三维预测块并合理降权不确定性更高的深部预测。
在四个地质基准模型上验证了该方法比同等3D扩散网络具有更高的建模精度，且推理速度提升近30倍。
me: Conditional denoising diffusion probabilistic/implicit models (DDPM/DDIM) parameterized via clean data (x0) prediction.
Depth-as-channel 2D U-Net architecture with four encoding/decoding stages, sinusoidal time/depth/well-location embeddings, and attention blocks.
Classifier-free guidance training with 5% independent dropout probability on well-log and structural attribute constraints.
Recursive top-down patch generation assembled via 1D depth-attenuated and 2D lateral Gaussian blending.
采用直接预测干净数据（x0）参数化的条件去噪扩散概率/隐式模型（DDPM/DDIM）。
包含四个编解码阶段、正弦时间/深度/井位编码及注意力机制的“深度即通道”2D U-Net架构。
对测井和构造属性约束采用5%独立丢弃率的分类器自由引导（Classifier-free guidance）混合训练。
自顶向下的递归分块生成，结合一维深度衰减与二维横向高斯加权融合技术组装完整3D数据体。
de: Augmented training dataset of 22,000 synthetic 3D velocity volumes (128x128x128) generated via undulation-based extension from 5 2D (BP1994, BP2004, Hess, Otway, Sigsbee) and 3 3D (Overthrust, SEAM Arid, SEG/EAGE) industrial models.
Synthetic seismic convolution images (vertical reflectivity convolved with a 60 Hz Ricker wavelet) used as 3D structural attribute constraints.
In-distribution evaluations on unseen Overthrust, SEAM Arid, and SEG/EAGE slices and out-of-distribution evaluation on the 3D Marmousi model under four conditioning scenarios.
Ablation study on shallow prior depth extent (16, 32, 64, 96 grid points) and computational benchmarking against a native 3D U-Net on an NVIDIA A100 GPU.
基于5个2D（BP1994、BP2004、Hess、Otway、Sigsbee）和3个3D（Overthrust、SEAM Arid、SEG/EAGE）工业模型，通过起伏扩展与旋转增强构建了22,000个128×128×128合成3D速度模型训练集。
将垂直反射率与60 Hz雷克子波褶积生成的合成地震图像作为三维构造属性约束。
在四个约束场景下，对Overthrust、SEAM Arid、SEG/EAGE进行分布内测试，并对Marmousi模型进行分布外泛化测试。
开展了浅层先验深度范围（16、32、64、96网格点）消融实验，并在单张NVIDIA A100 GPU上与原生3D U-Net进行了计算效率对比。
li: Structural constraints in all experiments rely on idealized synthetic convolution images derived from true vertical reflectivity rather than realistic migrated or field post-stack seismic volumes.
Unconditional and single-well-only generation struggle to resolve complex lateral discontinuities, fault zones, and out-of-distribution geological structures without structural image guidance.
所有实验中的构造属性均由真实反射率与雷克子波褶积的理想合成图像提供，尚未采用由平滑速度偏移得到的真实偏移图像或叠后地震数据。
在缺乏构造图像引导的无条件和仅单井约束场景下，模型难以准确恢复复杂的横向不连续面、断层带及分布外地质构造。

tm.why: The paper introduces a 2D generative diffusion model with a depth-as-channel formulation to build 3D seismic velocity models.
Stochastic sampling from the diffusion model produces ensembles whose standard deviation quantifies progressive velocity uncertainty with depth.
The method addresses 3D velocity model building, which provides critical starting models and learned priors to avoid cycle skipping in 3D FWI.

ev.notes: Full 26-page preprint PDF analyzed, including equations, methodology, 17 figures, 2 tables, and open-source code/data availability sections.

sum: Subsurface fracture characterization is difficult due to sparse observations and variable-dimensional object parameterizations. This study introduces a latent diffusion model (LDM) for unconditional and observation-conditioned generation of 2D and 3D discrete fracture networks (DFNs). Binary occupancy fields (128x128 in 2D, 32x32x32 native volumes in 3D) are compressed into continuous latent spaces via a variational autoencoder using Tversky loss in 3D to preserve thin fracture sheets. An Elucidated Diffusion Model learns the latent distribution, while sparse borehole observations are enforced using a conditioning encoder, classifier-free guidance, and diffusion posterior sampling. Tested on synthetic datasets and multiphase flow simulations, the generated ensembles accurately reproduce fracture fractions, two-point correlations, chord-length distributions, and gas-production responses. Conditional realizations honor 99.6% of well observations in 2D and 84.2% of borehole voxels in 3D without distorting global fracture density, offering a novel volumetric generative representation for subsurface inverse modeling.
针对地下裂缝网络观测稀疏及参数化困难的问题，本文提出一种基于潜在扩散模型（LDM）的二维和三维离散裂缝网络生成与条件约束框架。该方法利用变分自编码器（三维采用Tversky损失保留薄裂缝面）将二值占据场压缩至紧凑潜在空间，并通过阐述扩散模型（EDM）学习其分布；结合条件编码器、无分类器引导和扩散后验……

t: A variational autoencoder compresses binary 2D/3D fracture fields into compact latent spaces (using Tversky loss in 3D), where an Elucidated Diffusion Model samples realizations conditioned on boreholes via a context encoder, classifier-free guidance, and diffusion posterior sampling.
利用VAE将二/三维裂缝场压缩至潜在空间，结合EDM、CFG和DPS实现钻孔条件生成。

Synthetic datasets comprising 12,000 2D fracture realizations (128x128 pixels) and 10,000 3D dfnWorks realizations (32x32x32 voxels), plus multiphase gas-production simulations across three 2D fracture regimes using MRST.
1.2万个二维和1万个三维合成裂缝样本，以及三种二维裂缝构型的多相产气数值模拟。

Unconditional ensembles accurately match reference fracture fractions, two-point correlations, chord-length distributions, plane counts (ratio 1.01), and gas-production curves. Conditional generation satisfies 99.6% of 2D well observations and 84.2% of 3D borehole voxels.
无条件生成精确匹配统计与产气特征；二维和三维条件生成分别满足99.6%和84.2%的井观测。
In 3D, training-time consistency loss over-represents fracture volume fraction (46.6% vs 25.3% reference) and thickens sheets, requiring its omission and leaving 3D borehole satisfaction at 84.2%.
三维训练期一致性损失会导致裂缝体积分数膨胀至46.6%，故需舍弃，使满足率受限于84.2%。
First latent diffusion model to directly learn a native volumetric 3D representation of fracture networks while simultaneously enabling fine-resolution conditioning on sparse borehole observations.
首次实现直接学习原生三维体裂缝网络表征并支持细分辨率稀疏钻孔条件约束的潜在扩散模型。

kc: Developed a unified latent diffusion framework (VAE + EDM) for unconditional and conditional generation of 2D and native volumetric 3D binary fracture networks.

Introduced a hybrid conditioning strategy combining a learned convolutional encoder, classifier-free guidance (CFG), and inference-time diffusion posterior sampling (DPS) to honor sparse borehole observations.
Validated generated ensembles using geometric, statistical, and multiphase gas-production metrics, achieving 99.6% observation satisfaction in 2D and 84.2% in 3D.
开发了统一的潜在扩散框架（VAE + EDM），用于二维和原生三维体二值裂缝网络的无条件与条件生成。
提出了结合学习型卷积编码器、无分类器引导（CFG）和推理阶段扩散后验采样（DPS）的混合条件策略以匹配稀疏钻孔观测。
通过几何、统计和多相产气模拟指标验证了生成集合，在二维和三维中分别达到99.6%和84.2%的井观测满足率。
me: Variational autoencoder (VAE) compression mapping 128x128 2D fields to 16x16 latents and 32x32x32 3D volumes to 8x8x8 latents, utilizing Tversky loss in 3D to preserve sparse thin sheets.
Elucidated Diffusion Model (EDM) with a U-Net denoiser and 32-step Heun second-order solver operating in the frozen latent space.
Sparse observation conditioning via a stride-2 convolutional context encoder, Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG), class-balanced consistency loss (2D), and Diffusion Posterior Sampling (DPS).
Local-PCA sequential RANSAC algorithm to reconstruct discrete 3D fracture planes from binary occupancy volumes.
利用变分自编码器（VAE）将128x128二维场压缩为16x16潜在空间、32x32x32三维体压缩为8x8x8潜在空间，并在三维中采用Tversky损失以保留稀疏薄裂缝。
在冻结的潜在空间中采用基于U-Net去噪器和32步二阶Heun求解器的阐述扩散模型（EDM）。
通过步长为2的卷积上下文编码器、无分类器引导（CFG）、类别平衡一致性损失（二维）以及扩散后验采样（DPS）实现稀疏观测条件化。
采用局部PCA序列RANSAC算法从二值占据体中重建离散三维裂缝平面。
de: Synthetic 2D fracture datasets (10,000 training, 2,000 validation realizations on 128x128 grids) and 3D dfnWorks datasets (5,000 training, 5,000 validation realizations on 32x32x32 grids).
Statistical microstructure evaluation (area/volume fraction, two-point correlation, chord-length distribution) using PoreSpy and 3D plane-count recovery via sequential RANSAC.
Benchmark multiphase gas-production flow simulations across three distinct 2D fracture regimes using the MRST OpenShale Module.
Hard-data conditioning experiments with 9 point wells in 2D and 2 vertical full-column boreholes in 3D, plus consistency-loss ablation and GPU runtime benchmarking.
合成二维裂缝数据集（128x128网格，10,000个训练样本，2,000个验证样本）和三维dfnWorks数据集（32x32x32网格，5,000个训练样本，5,000个验证样本）。
使用PoreSpy进行微观结构统计评估（面积/体积分数、两点相关函数、弦长分布），并通过序列RANSAC评估三维裂缝平面恢复数量。
使用MRST OpenShale模块在三种不同二维裂缝构型下进行基准多相产气流动模拟对比。
在二维（9口点井）和三维（2口垂向全柱钻孔）中开展硬数据条件生成实验，并进行一致性损失消融实验和GPU计算耗时评估。
li: In 3D, applying the training-time fine-resolution consistency loss artificially inflates global fracture volume fraction from 26.8% to 46.6% and thickens fracture sheets, requiring its weight to be set to zero.
3D conditional satisfaction (84.2%) is lower than in 2D (99.6%) because each vertical borehole constrains an entire 32-voxel column against a highly compressed 8x8x8 latent space.
Inference-time DPS requires repeated gradient backpropagation through the 3D VAE decoder at each solver step, increasing per-realization sampling time from ~0.2 s to ~0.7–0.8 s.
在三维模型中，加入训练期细分辨率一致性损失会导致生成的全局裂缝体积分数从26.8%人为膨胀至46.6%并使裂缝变厚，因此必须将其权重设为0。
由于单口三维垂直钻孔需在高度压缩的8x8x8潜在空间中约束整列32个细网格体素，三维条件满足率（84.2%）低于二维（99.6%）。
推理阶段的DPS需要在每个求解步通过三维VAE解码器反向传播梯度，使单次样本生成时间从约0.2秒增加到0.7–0.8秒。

tm.why: The paper develops a deep generative latent diffusion model with diffusion posterior sampling to provide compact probabilistic representations for subsurface fracture-network characterization, ensemble generation, and uncertainty quantification under sparse observations.

The framework addresses subsurface parameterization and observation conditioning by mapping high-dimensional discrete fracture networks into a continuous, fixed-dimensional latent space suitable for inverse-modeling workflows.

ev.notes: Full 39-page manuscript PDF (including Supplementary Information Tables S1-S4) was read and analyzed.

sum: This paper solves the near-tip coupled hydromechanical problem of a semi-infinite hydraulic fracture steadily propagating in a permeable linear poroelastic medium. Combining boundary integral equations for plane-strain poroelasticity with lubrication theory and Linear Elastic Fracture Mechanics (LEFM), the authors solve for fracture opening, net pressure, and fluid exchange using a Chebyshev spectral collocation scheme. In viscosity-toughness scaling, the system is governed by four dimensionless parameters: permeability, effective confining stress, drained-undrained Poisson's ratio contrast, and poroelastic stress coefficient. The solution transitions from a drained toughness-dominated near-tip asymptote to an undrained storage-viscosity-dominated far-field asymptote, featuring a near-tip fluid circulation zone. By comparing the fully coupled formulation against uncoupled and one-way coupled models across realistic parameters for sandstones, granites, and shales over laboratory-to-field scales, the authors map four distinct coupling regimes. Notably, full two-way coupling is required at high dimensionless permeability and low effective confining stress.
本文求解了在渗透性线性多孔弹性介质中稳态扩展的半无限水力压裂尖端流固耦合问题。结合平面应变多孔弹性边界积分方程、润滑理论与线弹性断裂力学，采用切比雪夫谱配点法求解裂缝张开度、净压力与流体交换。基于砂岩、花岗岩和页岩的实验参数，对比了全耦合、单向耦合及非耦合模型在实验室至现场尺度下的差异。研究发现解从……

t: The solver couples plane-strain poroelastic boundary integral equations with lubrication flow and LEFM, discretizing the system via a Chebyshev spectral collocation framework on a mapped interval in diffusion scaling.
将平面应变多孔弹性边界积分方程与润滑流及LEFM耦合，采用切比雪夫谱配点法在映射区间上数值求解。

Dimensionless parameter ranges are grounded in experimentally measured poroelastic and hydraulic properties compiled from literature for three rock classes: sandstones, granites, and shales under typical confining stresses.
汇编了文献中砂岩、花岗岩和页岩三类岩石的实验多孔弹性与水力参数，以確定合理的无量纲参数范围。

Discrepancies between fully coupled and uncoupled models reach 58%, and up to 66% against one-way coupled models at large dimensionless permeability and small confining stress, defining four coupling regimes.
在高渗透率与低有效围压下，全耦合与非耦合、单向耦合模型的最大相对差异分别达58%和66%，据此划分出四种机制区。

The model is restricted to a steadily moving semi-infinite crack, assuming identical Newtonian fluids, perfect hydraulic communication without filter cake, and an LEFM propagation condition instead of a cohesive zone.
局限于稳态半无限裂纹，假设压裂液与孔隙流体相同且壁面无滤饼完全连通，并采用LEFM而非内聚力区模型。

Provides the first fully coupled hydromechanical solution for a steadily propagating semi-infinite hydraulic fracture in a poroelastic medium, retaining both direct poroelastic and two-way cross-coupling terms.
首次获得了多孔弹性介质中稳态扩展半无限水力压裂的全耦合流固耦合解，完整保留了双向交叉耦合项。

kc: Formulates and solves the first fully coupled hydromechanical model for a steadily propagating semi-infinite hydraulic fracture in a permeable poroelastic medium.
Derives the near-field (drained, toughness-dominated) and far-field (undrained, storage-viscosity-dominated) asymptotic solutions and implements a Chebyshev spectral collocation solver.
Identifies and maps four characteristic poroelastic coupling regimes across realistic parameter spaces for sandstones, granites, and shales spanning laboratory to field scales.
建立并求解了渗透性多孔弹性介质中稳态扩展半无限水力压裂尖端的首个全耦合流固耦合模型。
推导了近场（排水、韧性主导）和远场（不排水、储集-黏度主导）渐近解，并实现了切比雪夫谱配点数值求解器。
基于砂岩、花岗岩和页岩的真实参数范围，在实验室至现场尺度上识别并绘制了四种特征多孔弹性耦合机制区域图。
me: Plane-strain poroelastic boundary integral equations coupling normal stress and pore fluid pressure with direct and cross-coupling kernels.
Lubrication theory (Poiseuille flow and mass conservation) coupled with Linear Elastic Fracture Mechanics (LEFM) propagation criterion.
Chebyshev spectral collocation method on a mapped finite interval in diffusion scaling, incorporating near- and far-field asymptotic weights.
包含直接项与交叉耦合核函数的平面应变多孔弹性法向应力与孔隙流体压力边界积分方程。
结合线弹性断裂力学（LEFM）扩展准则的裂缝内流体润滑理论（泊肃叶流与质量守恒）。
在扩散尺度映射有限区间上结合近远场渐近权函数的切比雪夫谱配点法。
de: Compiled experimental poroelastic and hydraulic rock properties from literature for 12 sandstones, 9 granites, and 6 shales/claystones.
Parametric numerical simulations across dimensionless permeability and effective confining stress space, evaluated over physical comparison lengths from 0.01 m to 100 m.
汇编了文献中12种砂岩、9种花岗岩和6种页岩/粘土岩的多孔弹性和水力实验岩石物理参数。
在无量纲渗透率与有效围压空间中进行参数化数值模拟，并在0.01米至100米的物理对比尺度上进行评估。
li: Assumes a steadily moving semi-infinite crack, neglecting transient velocity variations and multiple time scales present in finite fracture geometries.
Assumes identical Newtonian fracturing and pore fluids with perfect hydraulic communication at fracture walls, neglecting filter cake or interfacial resistance.
Relies on LEFM rather than a finite-sized cohesive fracture process zone.
假设裂缝为稳态移动的半无限裂纹，忽略了有限裂缝几何中的瞬态速度变化及多时间尺度效应。
假设压裂液与孔隙流体为性质相同的牛顿流体且裂缝壁面水力完全连通，忽略了滤饼或界面阻力。
依赖于线弹性断裂力学（LEFM），未考虑有限尺寸的内聚力断裂过程区。

tm.why: The paper develops a coupled hydromechanical model for semi-infinite tensile crack propagation in a poroelastic rock medium using LEFM and boundary integral equations.
The study focuses on hydraulic fracture propagation across realistic rock parameters for sandstones, granites, and shales relevant to reservoir stimulation and induced seismicity mitigation.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 65-page PDF manuscript including main text, equations, tables, appendices, and supplementary figures.

sum: This paper investigates the acoustic modeling of large-volume, low-frequency marine seismic sources, specifically the Tuned Pulse Source (TPS), which radiates energy down to approximately 1 Hz. While spherical lumped-parameter models successfully describe its signature in deep water, shallow-water and transition-zone environments introduce complex non-spherical bubble dynamics, hydrostatic pressure gradients, buoyancy, and free-surface interactions. The authors evaluate the applicability of conventional spherical models and highlight the potential of Boundary Element Methods (BEM) to capture these complex boundary interactions and non-spherical bubble behaviors. This work establishes a physics-based framework for improving low-frequency source characterization, which is crucial for enhancing full-waveform inversion and broadband imaging.
本文研究了辐射低至1 Hz能量的大容量低频海洋地震震源（如TPS）的声学模拟。在深水中，球形集中参数模型能很好地描述其声学特征；但在浅水和过渡带环境中，大泡囊、强静水压力梯度、浮力及自由表面相互作用导致了非球形气泡动力学。作者评估了传统球形模型的适用范围，并指出边界元法（BEM）在捕获非球形气泡动力……

t: Evaluation of spherical lumped-parameter models and Boundary Element Methods (BEM) to simulate low-frequency marine source bubble dynamics.
评估球形集中参数模型和边界元法（BEM）以模拟低频海洋震源的气泡动力学。
Theoretical parameters of a large-volume Tuned Pulse Source (TPS) radiating down to 1 Hz and deep-water field observations.
辐射低至1 Hz的大容量调谐脉冲震源（TPS）的理论参数及深水野外观测。
Spherical models work well in deep water, but shallow-water transition zones require BEM to capture non-spherical bubble dynamics and boundary interactions.
球形模型在深水中表现良好，但浅水过渡带需要BEM来捕获非球形气泡动力学和边界相互作用。
Mathematical and numerical challenges in BEM for complex bubble dynamics, and a lack of transition-zone experimental validation.
BEM在处理复杂气泡动力学时面临数学和数值挑战，且缺乏过渡带实验验证。
Establishing a physics-based framework specifically for modeling very low-frequency (~1 Hz) marine sources in shallow-water transition zones.
专门针对浅水过渡带中极低频（~1 Hz）海洋震源模拟建立了物理框架。

kc: Evaluates the applicability of conventional spherical lumped-parameter models for low-frequency marine sources in shallow water.
Identifies physical challenges in transition zones, including hydrostatic pressure gradients, buoyancy, and free-surface interactions.
Highlights the potential of Boundary Element Methods (BEM) to model non-spherical bubble dynamics and complex boundary interactions.
评估了传统球形集中参数模型在浅水低频海洋震源中的适用性。
识别了过渡带中的物理挑战，包括静水压力梯度、浮力和自由表面相互作用。
突出了边界元法（BEM）在模拟非球形气泡动力学和复杂边界相互作用方面的潜力。
me: Spherical lumped-parameter modeling for first-order acoustic signatures.
Boundary Element Method (BEM) framework analysis for non-spherical bubble dynamics.
Physics-based evaluation of source-ghost coupling and hydrostatic effects.
用于一阶声学特征的球形集中参数建模。
用于非球形气泡动力学的边界元法（BEM）框架分析。
基于物理的震源-鬼波耦合及静水压效应评估。
de: Theoretical analysis and evaluation based on physical parameters of a large-volume Tuned Pulse Source (TPS) operating down to 1 Hz.
Comparison of deep-water field observations with theoretical model limits.
基于工作频率低至1 Hz的大容量调谐脉冲震源（TPS）物理参数的理论分析与评估。
深水野外观测与理论模型极限的对比。
li: Lack of direct experimental validation in complex transition-zone environments in this specific study.
Numerical and mathematical challenges associated with BEM for highly non-spherical bubble collapse.
本研究中缺乏在复杂过渡带环境中的直接实验验证。
BEM在处理高度非球形气泡破裂时面临的数值和数学挑战。

tm.why: The paper evaluates acoustic modeling techniques, including Boundary Element Methods, for simulating low-frequency marine seismic source signatures.
The study focuses on the characterization and physics of a large-volume Tuned Pulse Source (TPS) for marine seismic acquisition.
The development of low-frequency sources is motivated by improving the stability and illumination of Full-Waveform Inversion.

ev.notes: Analyzed based on the abstract from Crossref as no PDF was available.

sum: This study investigates the 2025 Mw 6.0 Afghanistan earthquake sequence using Sentinel-1 InSAR data to map coseismic deformation. The authors resolve an optimal slip model featuring conjugate thrust faults: a north-dipping mainshock segment (F1, peak slip ~1.11 m) and a south-dipping aftershock segment (F2, peak slip ~0.99 m). Integrating these faults with regional networks, they interpret the sequence as the reactivation of a positive flower structure driven by flexural bending of the Konar fault system. Coulomb failure stress analysis indicates the mainshock triggered the aftershock and loaded stress onto the Konar fault's bend segment, increasing future seismic hazard. The novelty lies in imaging a conjugate thrust system within a positive flower structure in the southern Hindu Kush using geodetic data.

利用Sentinel-1 InSAR同震形变场，通过弹性半空间位错模型反演共轭断层的滑动分布，并计算库仑应力变化。
Sentinel-1 ascending and descending track SAR data covering the 2025 Mw 6.0 mainshock and Mw 5.6 aftershock in Afghanistan.

The analysis relies solely on space geodetic data without local seismic network constraints, potentially limiting resolution of early aftershock depths and complex fault geometry.

Identified a conjugate thrust fault system (north-dipping F1 and south-dipping F2) responsible for the sequence.

Elastic dislocation modeling to invert for the optimal fault slip distribution.
