sum: This study proposes a novel seismic mitigation method for subway stations located in the Loess Plateau with locally interbedded sand layers. Using a 1/50 scale physical model of a subway station in Xi'an, the authors evaluate the performance of an Expanded Polyethylene (EPE) foam board seismic isolation layer under a 0.35 g horizontal seismic load. The experimental results show that the EPE foam board damping layer effectively reduces peak accelerations by 13.95% to 14.02% and decreases bending moments by up to 36.22%. Additionally, the isolation layer alleviates tensile stress concentrations, optimizing the overall dynamic response of the station. This method offers an economical, durable, and easily constructible solution for enhancing the seismic resilience of underground structures in complex loess regions.
本文针对黄土高原夹砂地层地铁车站提出了一种新型隔震减灾方法。研究以西安地铁车站为背景，采用1/50几何比例物理模型，系统分析了在0.35 g水平地震荷载下，采用EPE泡沫板隔震层的车站结构变形、加速度响应和弯矩规律。结果表明，EPE泡沫板减震层使各测点峰值加速度降低13.95%至14.02%，弯矩极……

t: 1/50 scale physical model testing of a subway station equipped with an EPE foam board seismic isolation layer under horizontal seismic loading.
采用1/50比例物理模型试验，测试水平地震荷载下配备EPE泡沫板隔震层的地铁车站动力响应。
Experimental measurements of acceleration, bending moments, and deformation from a 1/50 scale model representing a Xi'an subway station in loess-sand strata.
基于西安地铁车站背景，在模拟黄土夹砂地层中进行1/50缩尺模型试验获取的监测数据。
The EPE foam board reduced peak accelerations by 13.95–14.02% and maximum bending moments by up to 36.22%, while mitigating tensile stress concentrations.
EPE泡沫板使峰值加速度降低13.95-14.02%，弯矩最大降低36.22%，并缓解了拉应力集中。
Scale effects from the 1/50 physical model and testing under limited seismic load scenarios (0.35 g horizontal load only).
1/50缩尺模型存在尺寸效应，且试验仅在0.35 g水平地震荷载的单一工况下进行。
First application and experimental evaluation of EPE foam board seismic isolation for underground subway stations in loess-sand interbedded strata.
首次针对黄土高原夹砂地层地铁车站提出并试验验证了EPE泡沫板隔震减灾方法。

kc: Proposes a new seismic isolation method using EPE foam boards for subway stations in loess-sand interbedded strata.
Conducts a 1/50 scale physical model experiment to evaluate the dynamic response and deformation characteristics under horizontal seismic loads.
Demonstrates significant reductions in peak acceleration (up to 14%) and bending moments (up to 36.22%) in the station structure.
针对黄土高原夹砂地层的地铁车站，提出了一种利用EPE泡沫板的新型隔震方法。
开展了1/50比例的物理模型试验，评估了水平地震荷载作用下的动力响应和变形特征。
证明了该隔震层能显著降低车站结构的峰值加速度（达14%）和弯矩（达36.22%）。
me: 1/50 scale physical model testing (shaking table/dynamic testing).
EPE (Expanded Polyethylene) foam board installation as a seismic isolation layer.
Monitoring of acceleration, bending moments, and deformation under a 0.35 g horizontal seismic load.
1/50比例物理模型试验（振动台/动力测试）。
采用EPE（聚乙烯发泡）泡沫板作为隔震层。
在0.35 g水平地震荷载下监测加速度、弯矩和变形。
de: Physical model of a representative subway station in Xi'an's rail transit system.
Simulated loess plateau soil with localized sand-interlayered strata.
0.35 g horizontal seismic loading applied to the model.
以西安轨道交通系统典型地铁车站为背景的物理模型。
模拟具有局部夹砂地层的黄土高原土体环境。
对模型施加0.35 g水平地震荷载。
li: The study relies on a 1/50 scale physical model, which may introduce scale effects compared to full-scale underground structures.
The analysis is limited to a specific horizontal seismic load level (0.35 g) and a single soil profile.
研究依赖于1/50比例的物理模型，与足尺地下结构相比可能存在尺寸效应。
分析局限于特定的水平地震荷载水平（0.35 g）和单一的地层剖面。

tm.why: The paper evaluates a new seismic isolation method for subway stations under strong horizontal seismic loads using physical model testing.

ev.notes: No PDF was available. The analysis is based entirely on the detailed abstract and metadata from OpenAlex and Crossref.

sum: This study investigates the spatiotemporal evolution of seismicity around the Serajeh underground gas storage (UGS) facility in central Iran. By applying the SAIPy deep-learning package to continuous waveforms (2007–2024) at broadband station GHVR directly atop the reservoir, the authors compile 29,781 quality-controlled local earthquake detections (within ~30 km, SNR ≥ 10), complemented by mloc multiple-event relocation of 58 regional events and ISOLA centroid moment tensor inversions for 9 earthquakes. Relocated hypocenters cluster at 3–8 km depth near and beneath the 2.4–3.0 km Qom Formation storage reservoir, while focal mechanisms indicate predominantly strike-slip to oblique faulting. Cross-correlation between monthly gas injection and seismicity peaks at an ~8-month lag (r = 0.427). Notably, change-point analysis reveals a ~68% reduction in mean monthly seismicity (M ≥ 0.9) around April 2015, nearly four years after cyclic operations began, demonstrating an evolving, non-stationary fault–reservoir response in the Arabia–Eurasia collision zone.
本研究结合深度学习单台地震检测（SAIPy）、多事件重定位（mloc）、质心矩张量反演（ISOLA）及储层运行数据，探究了伊朗中部Serajeh地下储气库（UGS）周期注采下的地震活动时空演化。通过对储层上方GHVR台站2007–2024年连续波形的处理，获得了29,781个高质量近场地震事件。重定……

t: The workflow integrates SAIPy single-station deep-learning detection and phase picking at station GHVR, mloc hypocentroidal decomposition relocation for a multi-station cluster, ISOLA centroid moment tensor inversion, and ReshuffleCorr/change-point statistical time-series analyses.
结合SAIPy单台深度学习检测、mloc多事件质心分解重定位、ISOLA矩张量反演及ReshuffleCorr与变点统计…

Continuous broadband waveforms (2007–2024) from station GHVR atop the Serajeh reservoir and 10 regional IRSC/IIEES stations within 200 km, combined with monthly gas injection rate and field header pressure records (2011–2017).
储层上方GHVR台站2007–2024年连续波形、10个区域台站数据及2011–2017年月度注气速率与汇管压力记录。

Retained 29,781 local detections (S–P correlates with relocated distance, r=0.84). Injection–seismicity cross-correlation peaks at an ~8-month lag (r=0.427), and a change point in April 2015 marks a ~68% seismicity drop (for M≥0.9).
筛选出29,781个近场事件；注气与地震在8个月滞后处达相关峰值（r=0.427），2015年4月后M≥0.9地震率下降…

Single-station detections lack azimuth/depth constraints, field header pressure does not directly measure hypocentral pore pressure, and the small relocated (58) and CMT (9) subsets preclude resolving systematic migration.
单台检测缺乏方位和深度约束，缺乏井下直接孔隙压力数据，且重定位（58个）和CMT（9个）样本有限。

First detailed investigation of underground gas storage seismicity within the actively deforming Arabia–Eurasia collision zone (Serajeh, the only UGS in the Middle East), revealing a non-stationary multi-year seismic decline.
首次深入研究阿拉伯-欧亚碰撞带（中东唯一储气库Serajeh）周期注采诱发地震，揭示四年后地震率显著衰减。

kc: Constructed a high-resolution local seismic catalog of 29,781 quality-controlled events (out of 97,751 initial detections) at the Serajeh UGS from 2007 to 2024 using single-station deep learning (SAIPy) at station GHVR.

Validated single-station S–P arrival times against 37 independently relocated earthquakes (mloc), confirming strong correlation with hypocentral distance (Pearson r = 0.84, R² = 0.71) as a first-order proximity proxy.

Identified a peak cross-correlation (r = 0.427) between monthly gas injection rates and seismicity at an ~8-month lag using ReshuffleCorr phase-randomized surrogates, alongside conservative circular-shift and block-bootstrap sensitivity tests.

Discovered an objective change point in April 2015 (~4 years into cyclic UGS operations) marking a ~68% reduction in monthly seismicity (for M ≥ 0.9) despite continued cyclic gas injection and pressure fluctuations.

Constrained event-scale source kinematics via 9 CMT inversions (showing predominantly strike-slip to oblique faulting) and 58 relocated hypocenters clustering at 3–8 km depth within and below the 2.4–3.0 km reservoir.
利用GHVR台站连续波形和SAIPy深度学习框架，构建了2007–2024年Serajeh储气库附近包含29,781个经质量控制事件（初始检测97,751个）的高时间分辨率单台地震目录。
通过与37个独立重定位事件（mloc）比对，证实单台S–P到时差与震源距高度相关（Pearson r = 0.84, R² = 0.71），可作为近场距离筛选的有效一阶代理指标。
利用ReshuffleCorr相位随机替代法及循环移位、分块自助法检验，发现月度注气速率与地震活动率在约8个月时间滞后处存在显著互相关峰值（r = 0.427）。
通过客观变点分析发现2015年4月（储气库周期运行近4年后）地震活动率发生显著转折，M≥0.9月均地震率下降约68%，且在后续周期注采中一直维持低地震活动状态。
完成58个事件的mloc重定位和9个较大事件的ISOLA矩张量反演，揭示地震主要聚集在储层（2.4–3.0 km）及下方3–8 km深度处，震源机制以走滑至斜滑断层作用为主。
me: Single-station deep-learning earthquake detection, phase picking, and approximate magnitude estimation using SAIPy (incorporating CREIME_RT and DynaPicker_v2) on 1–45 Hz band-pass filtered waveforms.
Proximity screening and quality control using S–P arrival time intervals (retaining events within ~30 km of GHVR), signal-to-noise ratio filtering (SNR ≥ 10), and manual visual verification.
Calibrated multiple-event relocation of 58 regional/local earthquakes using hypocentroidal decomposition (mloc) with robust SnS_nSn residual scale estimation.
Full-waveform time-domain centroid moment tensor (CMT) inversion of 9 events using ISOLA (0.06–0.09 Hz band-pass filter) with a 1-D IRSC velocity model.

Statistical time-series analysis including phase-randomized cross-correlation (ReshuffleCorr), circular-shift and block-bootstrap lag testing, least-squares change-point detection on log-transformed monthly counts, and Fisher r-to-z correlation comparison.
对1–45 Hz带通滤波的三分量连续波形应用SAIPy深度学习框架（集成CREIME_RT与DynaPicker_v2），开展单台地震检测、震相拾取和近似震级估算。
基于S–P到时差进行近场距离筛选（保留GHVR台站约30 km范围内事件）、信噪比阈值过滤（SNR ≥ 10）及人工目视震相核查。
采用基于震源质心分解的多事件重定位算法（mloc）及稳健SnS_nSn残差尺度估计器，对58个具有多台记录的地震进行高精度重定位。
利用ISOLA软件在时间域（0.06–0.09 Hz频段）结合IRSC一维速度模型，对9个波形质量良好的较大地震进行全波形质心矩张量（CMT）反演。
开展时间序列统计分析，包括基于傅里叶相位随机化的互相关分析（ReshuffleCorr）、循环移位与分块自助法稳健性检验、对数月度地震频次的变点检测及Fisher r-to-z相关性检验。
de: Continuous 3-component broadband seismic waveforms (2007–2024, resampled to 100 Hz) from IIEES station GHVR located directly above the Serajeh anticline, plus regional waveform/phase data from 10 IRSC and IIEES stations within ~200 km.

Field-scale operational records from the National Iranian Oil Company (NIOC) spanning 22 September 2011 to 17 October 2017, including monthly mean gas injection rates (MMSCFD) and field header pressure (MPa).

Geological and structural constraints for the Serajeh anticline, including mapped fault traces from the Geological Survey of Iran and subsurface geometry of the fractured carbonate Qom Formation reservoir (2.4–3.0 km depth) and Upper Red Formation evaporite caprock.
位于Serajeh背斜正上方的IIEES宽频带台站GHVR的连续三分量波形数据（2007–2024年，重采样至100 Hz），以及约200 km范围内10个IRSC和IIEES区域台站的波形与震相数据。
伊朗国家石油公司（NIOC）提供的2011年9月22日至2017年10月17日储气库运行记录，包括月均注气速率（MMSCFD）和集气站汇管压力（MPa）。
Serajeh背斜的地质与构造约束资料，包括伊朗地质调查局的断层迹线图，以及2.4–3.0 km深度的Qom组裂缝性碳酸盐岩储层和上覆上红组膏盐岩盖层的地下空间几何形态。
li: Single-station detections at GHVR cannot independently constrain epicentral back-azimuths or focal depths, relying solely on S–P time as an uncalibrated first-order distance proxy up to ~30 km.

Operational data are limited to field-wide monthly injection rates and field header pressure up to October 2017, lacking well-by-well injection/withdrawal partitioning and direct downhole pore-pressure measurements.

The small sample sizes of multi-station relocated events (58) and CMT solutions (9), along with vertical depth uncertainties, prevent resolving systematic 3-D hypocentral migration or conducting formal temporal stress-field inversions.
GHVR单台检测无法独立约束震中反方位角和震源深度，仅依赖S–P到时差作为30 km范围内的近似一阶距离代理指标。
储气库运行数据仅限于截至2017年10月的全场月均注气速率和地面汇管压力，缺乏单井注采分配记录及井下储层孔隙压力的直接测量。
多台重定位事件（58个）和CMT反演解（9个）样本量较小且震源深度存在不确定性，无法定量刻画系统性的三维震源迁移路径或开展区域应力场随时间的正式反演。

tm.why: The paper directly investigates the temporal and spatial evolution of seismicity induced/modulated by cyclic gas injection and withdrawal at the Serajeh underground gas storage (UGS) facility in Iran.

The study builds a high-resolution catalog of 29,781 local detections using single-station deep learning (SAIPy) and relocates a 58-event subset using multiple-event hypocentroidal decomposition (mloc).

The authors apply deep-learning neural networks (SAIPy, CREIME_RT, DynaPicker_v2) to 17 years of continuous single-station waveforms for automated event detection, phase picking, and magnitude estimation.

ev.notes: Full 22-page PDF of the Scientific Reports article (in press) was analyzed, including abstract, main text, methodology, statistical tests, and all 7 figures.

sum: Topographic amplification is commonly invoked to explain earthquake-induced landslides, yet direct multi-facet strong-motion observations are scarce. This study analyzes 24 regional earthquakes recorded by a four-station strong-motion array spanning a ridge crest, valley bottom, and two slope facets in Totsukawa, Japan. Comparing time-domain peak ground acceleration (PGA), station-to-valley Fourier spectral ratios, HVSR, and 5%-damped elastic response spectra reveals distinct amplification regimes. While PGA ratios covary with epicentral distance and magnitude, the north-south (NS) slope exhibits a persistent, azimuth-independent narrow-band spectral peak at 3.5–4.0 Hz. Crucially, the geometric-mean 5%-damped response-spectral ratio reaches 6.67 at 0.277 s (3.61 Hz), nearly six times the corresponding horizontal PGA ratio of 1.13. Furthermore, EW-slope PGA exceeds ridge-crest PGA in 16 of 17 events. The novelty lies in directly proving with field strong-motion data that broadband PGA substantially under-represents frequency-specific elastic slope demand.
本研究利用日本十津川山脊、谷底及两个不同朝向坡面的四台强震动台阵记录的24次区域地震，对比了时域峰值地面加速度（PGA）、台站-山谷傅里叶谱比、单台HVSR和5%阻尼弹性反应谱。结果显示，EW坡面的PGA放大在17次事件中有16次超过山脊顶；而NS坡面存在持续稳定的3.5–4.0 Hz窄带谱比峰值。……

t: Combines time-domain horizontal PGA ratios, 0.2 Hz Parzen-smoothed three-component station-to-valley Fourier spectral ratios, single-station S-wave HVSR, directional horizontal rotation, and 5%-damped elastic acceleration response spectra across a four-station mountain array.
结合四台山脊台阵的时域PGA比值、三分量台站-山谷傅里叶谱比、单台HVSR、分量旋转和5%阻尼比弹性反应谱分析。

Three-component strong-motion accelerograms (100 Hz) from 24 regional earthquakes (M 2.8–6.1, distances 15–100 km, depths 4–62 km) recorded between November 2017 and December 2019 at four stations in Totsukawa, Nara, Japan.
日本奈良十津川村4个强震台站（2017–2019年）记录的24次区域地震（震级2.8–6.1，震中距15–100 km）…

The NS slope exhibits a persistent 3.5–4.0 Hz Fourier spectral-ratio peak (mean 3.55±0.55 Hz). Its geometric-mean 5%-damped response-spectral ratio reaches 6.67 at 0.277 s (3.61 Hz), nearly six times the corresponding horizontal PGA ratio of 1.13.
NS坡面存在稳定的3.5–4.0 Hz谱比峰值；其0.277 s处5%阻尼反应谱几何平均比达6.67，是对应PGA比值（…
The valley reference suffers spectral depletion at 3.5–4.0 Hz, subsurface Vs is unmeasured, and magnitude-distance covariation in the 24-event catalog prevents separating source and path effects.
山谷参考台存在特定频段能量亏损、缺乏实测剪切波速，且震级与震中距共变限制了震源与路径效应的分离。

Provides direct strong-motion field evidence from a multi-facet ridge-valley array demonstrating that broadband PGA underestimates frequency-specific elastic response on mountain slopes by nearly a factor of six.
利用山脊多坡面实地强震观测直接证明宽频带PGA将山坡特定频率的弹性地震放大效应低估了近6倍。

kc: Demonstrated via a 4-station mountain strong-motion array that 5%-damped response-spectral amplification on an NS slope reaches 6.67 at 3.61 Hz, ~5.9 times larger than the broadband PGA ratio of 1.13.
Identified a persistent narrow-band (3.5–4.0 Hz) Fourier spectral-ratio peak at the NS slope that remains stable across 19 events, distance groupings, and 11 processing variants.
Showed that PGA amplification on the EW slope exceeds that at the ridge crest in 16 of 17 paired events (median ratio ~1.4), challenging simple 2D ridge-apex dominance models.
Distinguished relative spectral contrast from absolute amplification by showing the large NS-to-valley spectral ratio combines genuine NS-slope enhancement with valley spectral depletion.
通过四台山地强震台阵证明，NS坡面在3.61 Hz处的5%阻尼反应谱放大比达6.67，比宽频带PGA比值（1.13）高约5.9倍。
发现在NS坡面存在持续稳定的3.5–4.0 Hz窄带傅里叶谱比峰值，在19次地震、不同震中距分组及11种处理参数下均保持稳定。
发现在17次配对事件中有16次EW坡面的PGA放大超过山脊顶部（中位比值约1.4），挑战了简单的二维山脊顶点占优模型。
通过绝对谱和HVSR分析指出，高台站-山谷谱比同时源于NS坡面的能量增强和山谷参考台的相对谱亏损。
me: Time-domain square-root-of-sum-of-squares (SRSS) and geometric-mean horizontal PGA station-to-valley amplification ratios.
Three-component composite station-to-valley Fourier spectral ratios smoothed with a 0.2 Hz Parzen window, plus 11 sensitivity variants.
Single-station earthquake S-wave Horizontal-to-Vertical Spectral Ratio (HVSR) and horizontal directional rotation (slope-normal vs. slope-parallel).
5%-damped linear single-degree-of-freedom (SDOF) elastic acceleration response spectra (0.04–4 s) using the Nigam and Jennings recurrence method.
Statistical correlation analysis with Benjamini-Hochberg false-discovery-rate (FDR) correction and conditional 1D quarter-wavelength resonance thickness modeling.
时域水平平方和平方根（SRSS）及几何平均PGA台站-山谷放大比分析。
采用0.2 Hz Parzen窗平滑的三分量合成台站-山谷傅里叶谱比计算及11种处理变体敏感性测试。
单台地震S波水平与垂直谱比（HVSR）以及水平分量向顺坡和沿等高线方向的旋转分析。
利用Nigam和Jennings递推法计算0.04–4 s周期范围内5%阻尼比单自由度（SDOF）弹性加速度反应谱。
结合Benjamini-Hochberg错误发现率（FDR）校正的相关性统计分析及一维四分之一波长共振层厚度条件估算。
de: Temporary 4-station strong-motion array (3-component accelerometers at 100 Hz) deployed in Totsukawa Village, Nara, Japan, from Nov 2017 to Dec 2019.
Stations positioned at contrasting topographic features on a single east-west ridge: Ridge crest, Valley bottom, EW slope, and NS slope (<1 km aperture).
Catalog of 24 screened regional earthquakes (magnitudes 2.8–6.1, epicentral distances 15–100 km, focal depths 4–62 km).
2017年11月至2019年12月在日本奈良县十津川村布设的4台临时强震动台阵（100 Hz采样三分量加速度计）。
台站分布于同一东西向山脊的不同地形部位：山脊顶、谷底、EW坡面和NS坡面（台站间距小于1 km）。
筛选出的24次区域地震目录（震级2.8–6.1，震中距15–100 km，震源深度4–62 km）。
li: The valley station is a topographic reference rather than an independently characterized bedrock reference and exhibits relative spectral depletion in the 3.5–4.0 Hz band.
No independent shear-wave velocity (Vs) or subsurface geophysical measurements exist at the temporary sites, leaving 1D compliant layer vs. fractured rock vs. 2D/3D topographic scattering unresolved.
Small catalog size (24 events) where earthquake magnitude covaries with epicentral distance (r=0.451, p=0.027), preventing separation of source-size and path distance effects.
山谷台站仅作为地形参考台而非经独立表征的基岩参考台，且在3.5–4.0 Hz频段存在相对能量亏损。
临时台站缺乏独立的剪切波速（Vs）或浅地表地球物理测量，无法唯一区分一维软弱层、裂隙岩体阻抗对比或二维/三维地形散射机制。
地震目录样本量较小（24个事件）且震级与震中距共变（r=0.451, p=0.027），无法分离震源大小与传播路径距离效应。

tm.why: The paper directly evaluates strong-motion recordings, peak ground acceleration (PGA), Fourier spectral ratios, and 5%-damped elastic response spectra to quantify topographic and slope-specific seismic amplification.
The study connects mountain-slope seismic amplification to earthquake-triggered landslide hazards and geomorphological slope stability.
It relies on a purpose-built four-station temporary strong-motion array deployed across contrasting topographic features (ridge crest, valley, and two slope facets).

ev.notes: Full 18-page PDF article from Scientific Reports (in press, 2026) including all 7 figures, 4 tables, and complete Methods section was read and analyzed.

sum: This study presents the first regional 3D P-wave (Qp^-1), S-wave (Qs^-1), and Qp/Qs attenuation tomography models of the Pampean flat-slab subduction zone (29°–32°S) in the south-central Andes. Using P- and S-wave displacement spectra (3–18 Hz) from 964 local earthquakes recorded by 57 broadband stations (SIEMBRA and ESP networks), the authors invert for path-average attenuation t* and apply a transdimensional Bayesian Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) tomography algorithm (QtomoMCMC) parameterized with Voronoi cells. Overall low Qp/Qs (<1) indicates that scattering dominates crustal attenuation. High crustal attenuation in the Precordillera and Western Sierras Pampeanas correlates with major terrane sutures and fault systems, whereas the eastern Sierras Pampeanas exhibit low attenuation. In the lithospheric mantle, along-strike variations delineate a cold dry western mantle nose, a serpentinized mantle with free fluids directly above the flat slab, a dry depleted cratonic lithosphere, and a warm re-established mantle wedge further east.
本研究提出了安第斯中南部潘帕斯平板俯冲带（29°–32°S）首个区域三维P波（Qp^-1）、S波（Qs^-1）及Qp/Qs衰减层析成像模型。作者利用57个宽频带台站记录的964次地方震P波和S波位移谱（3–18 Hz）反演路径平均衰减t*，并采用基于Voronoi网格参数化的跨维贝叶斯马尔可夫链蒙特……

t: Path-average attenuation (t*) is inverted from 3–18 Hz displacement spectra using independent corner frequencies, followed by 3D Voronoi-parameterized transdimensional Bayesian MCMC tomography (QtomoMCMC) for Qp^-1, Qs^-1, and Qp/Qs.
利用独立拐角频率从3–18 Hz位移谱反演路径衰减t*，再通过Voronoi网格跨维贝叶斯MCMC算法反演三维Qp^-1…
964 local earthquakes (Mw 2.3–5.5, depths 1.5–198.8 km) recorded by 57 broadband stations (SIEMBRA and ESP deployments, 2007–2010), yielding 7,670 t*_P and 4,949 t*_S high-SNR spectral measurements.
57个宽频带台站记录的964次地方震波形（2007–2010），筛选出7,670个P波和4,949个S波高质量t*测量值…

Peak attenuation occurs in the Precordillera crust (Qp^-1 ≈ 5.0×10^-3, Qs^-1 ≈ 3.4×10^-3) and hydrated mantle above the flat slab (Qp^-1 = 4.2×10^-3, Qs^-1 = 3.0×10^-3), with predominantly low Qp/Qs (<1).
前科迪勒拉地壳（Qp^-1≈5.0×10^-3，Qs^-1≈3.4×10^-3）与平板上方含水地幔呈现最高衰减，且整体Q…
Input corner frequencies assume laterally uniform attenuation, slightly suppressing amplitude contrasts by <0.1×10^-3, and the model lacks resolution to directly link the slab tear to anomaly M4.
输入拐角频率假设横向均匀衰减导致异常幅值轻微压低，且分辨率不足以直接连接板片撕裂与M4异常。
Presents the first 3D body-wave attenuation and Qp/Qs tomography models with Bayesian uncertainty quantification for the Pampean flat-slab subduction zone.
首次构建了潘帕斯平板俯冲带具有贝叶斯不确定性量化的三维体波衰减及Qp/Qs层析成像模型。

kc: Constructed the first regional 3D Qp^-1, Qs^-1, and Qp/Qs attenuation models with uncertainty quantification for the Pampean flat-slab subduction zone using transdimensional Bayesian MCMC tomography.

Demonstrated that crustal attenuation is dominated by elastic scattering (low Qp/Qs) localized along major terrane boundaries and basement fault systems in the Precordillera and Western Sierras Pampeanas.

Identified four distinct lithospheric mantle domains along the flat-slab profile, providing seismic attenuation evidence for free fluids within the serpentinized mantle above the flat slab and partial melt in the re-established eastern mantle wedge.
Resolved an elevated intraslab P-wave attenuation anomaly beneath Cuyania, attributing it to inherited and reactivated fracturing of the subducted Juan Fernández Ridge.
利用跨维贝叶斯MCMC层析成像方法，构建了潘帕斯平板俯冲带首个带不确定性量化的区域三维Qp^-1、Qs^-1和Qp/Qs衰减模型。
证实地壳衰减由弹性散射主导（低Qp/Qs），高衰减异常集中在前科迪勒拉和西潘帕斯山脉的主要地体边界及基底断裂系统。
识别出平板俯冲剖面上四个不同的岩石圈地幔区域，为平板上方蛇纹石化地幔中存在自由流体以及东部重建地幔楔中存在部分熔融提供了地震衰减证据。
揭示了Cuyania下方平板内部的高P波衰减异常，将其归因于俯冲胡安·费尔南德斯海岭的继承性及活化断裂。

Linearized non-negative t* inversion using the Python package AttenTIon, incorporating independent spectral-decomposition corner frequency (fc) estimates to mitigate fc–t* trade-offs.
3D ray tracing using the 3D Fast Marching Method in an existing 3D P- and S-wave velocity model.
Transdimensional Bayesian Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) attenuation tomography using the Julia package QtomoMCMC with 3D Voronoi cell parameterization (50 chains, 1 million iterations per chain).
对3–18 Hz频段内的P波（3秒窗）和S波（5秒窗）初至信号进行正弦多锥度频谱分析。
使用Python软件包AttenTIon进行线性化非负t*反演，引入独立谱分解得到的拐角频率（fc）估计值以减弱fc与t*之间的折衷效应。
基于已有的三维P波和S波速度模型，利用三维快速行进法（Fast Marching Method）计算三维射线路径。
使用Julia软件包QtomoMCMC和三维Voronoi单元参数化（50条马尔可夫链，每条链100万次迭代）进行跨维贝叶斯MCMC三维衰减层析成像。
de: Waveform recordings from 964 local crustal and intraslab earthquakes (Mw 2.3–5.5, depths 1.5–198.8 km) across 57 broadband seismic stations from the SIEMBRA (ZL) and ESP (XH) temporary networks (Dec 2007 – Dec 2010).
7,670 P-wave t* measurements (470 crustal, 7,200 intraslab) and 4,949 S-wave t* measurements (327 crustal, 4,622 intraslab) surviving SNR > 3 quality control.
Synthetic resolution and robustness tests using custom block models (sharp boundaries, swapped high/low anomalies in crust and mantle) with Gaussian noise matching observed t* uncertainties.
SIEMBRA（ZL）和ESP（XH）临时台网57个宽频带地震台站于2007年12月至2010年12月记录的964次地壳和板内地震波形数据（Mw 2.3–5.5，深度1.5–198.8 km）。
经信噪比（SNR > 3）筛选后获得的7,670个P波t*测量值（地壳470个，板内7,200个）和4,949个S波t*测量值（地壳327个，板内4,622个）。
使用自定义块体模型（陡峭边界、地壳与地幔高低异常互换）并加入与实测t*误差分布一致的高斯噪声，进行合成分辨率与稳健性测试。
li: Independent corner frequency (fc) estimates used in t* inversion assumed a laterally uniform attenuation structure, slightly suppressing high attenuation anomalies and inflating low anomalies by up to ~0.1 x 10^-3.
Unable to quantitatively separate the exact proportions of intrinsic versus scattering attenuation from the observed total attenuation.

Attenuation is insensitive to compositional transitions between normal peridotite and dry depleted cratonic lithosphere, making it difficult to delineate the full eastern extent of the depleted cratonic block.
Limited spatial resolution at the eastern edge prevents resolving a direct structural connection between the proposed slab tear/hole and the warm mantle wedge anomaly (M4).
t*反演中使用的独立拐角频率（fc）估计基于横向均匀衰减假设，导致高衰减异常幅值被轻微压低、低衰减异常被抬高（偏差小于~0.1×10^-3）。
难以从观测到的总衰减中定量分离出本征衰减和散射衰减各自的确切贡献比例。
地震衰减对普通橄榄岩与干亏损克拉通岩石圈之间的成分变化不敏感，因此难以清晰刻画亏损克拉通块体向东延伸的完整边界。
研究区东缘空间分辨率有限，无法直接分辨出拟议的板片撕裂/空洞与高衰减地幔楔异常（M4）之间的连通关系。

tm.why: The paper presents the first 3D P-wave, S-wave, and Qp/Qs attenuation models of the Pampean flat-slab subduction zone, analyzing both scattering and intrinsic attenuation mechanisms.

The authors apply a transdimensional Bayesian Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) tomography package (QtomoMCMC) with Voronoi cell parameterization to invert for 3D attenuation and quantify model uncertainties.
The resulting 3D attenuation models are used to constrain crustal deformation, fault systems, heterogeneous mantle wedge hydration, and intraslab fracturing of the Juan Fernández Ridge.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 55-page manuscript PDF including text, equations, tables, and figures.

sum: This study investigates rupture elongation in buried earthquakes to understand the spatial organization of fault stress and strength. By analyzing the rupture aspect ratio (RAR) from the spatial second seismic moment of 51 finite-fault models (Mw 4.45–7.43), the authors find RARs ranging from 1.02 to 1.59. To explain the elongated ruptures, they perform 3D boundary-integral dynamic rupture simulations. While homogeneous models only produce nearly circular ruptures, introducing directional heterogeneity in initial stress and frictional properties successfully reproduces the observed high-RAR elongation. The results indicate that initial-stress amplitude and directional structure are the primary drivers of rupture elongation, providing a statistical framework to constrain directionally structured fault states from RAR observations.
本研究通过分析埋藏地震的破裂长宽比（RAR）来揭示断层应力和强度的空间分布特征。作者分析了51个有限断层模型（Mw 4.45-7.43）的二阶地震矩，发现观测RAR介于1.02至1.59之间。随后，利用三维边界积分动力学破裂模拟进行机制研究。结果表明，均匀断层模型仅能产生近圆形破裂，而引入初始应力和……

Potential resolution and smoothing artifacts in the compiled finite-fault models, and simplified fault geometry in the 3D dynamic simulations.

sum: This study combines Himalayan GNSS measurements with a viscoelastic earthquake-cycle model to investigate interseismic locking on the Main Himalayan Thrust (MHT). The model incorporates viscous flow in the lower crust and mantle and a nonstationary locked-creeping boundary. By evaluating 20 model configurations, the authors find that strong locking is concentrated above mid-crustal ramps, and increasing viscosity shifts the locked zone downdip. Crucially, nonstationary solutions (with negative process zone stressing rates) concentrate moment accumulation within the locked zone and exhibit a rapid transition to creep, yielding moment accumulation rates twice as high as stationary models. This highlights the significant impact of rheology and boundary dynamics on geodetic coupling estimates.
本研究结合喜马拉雅GNSS观测与粘弹性地震周期模型，反演了主推覆断层的震间锁固。通过评估20种模型配置，发现强锁固集中在中地壳斜坡上方。非稳态锁固-蠕滑边界模型比稳态模型更拟合数据，使矩累积高度集中在锁固区内并快速过渡到蠕滑，其矩累积速率是稳态模型的两倍，揭示了流变学对耦合推断的重要影响。

sum: Understanding the deep magmatic structure beneath Campi Flegrei is critical for interpreting its ongoing unrest, yet local earthquake tomography loses resolution with depth and teleseismic receiver functions suffer from low frequency content. This study adapts receiver-function (RF) analysis to six intermediate- and deep-focus earthquakes (260–480 km depth) in the subducting Ionian slab recorded at regional distances (70–300 km) by 39 stations across Campi Flegrei. The steep incidence and short paths preserve high-frequency P-to-S conversions (0.5–1.1 Hz). Using 2D Fast-Marching moveout corrections, dynamic ray-tracing forward modeling (COMRAD), and Genetic Algorithm inversion with AIC model selection, the authors resolve a four-interface crustal model. They independently confirm a prominent low-Vp (~2.5 km/s), high-Vp/Vs (~2.1) melt-rich sill starting at 7.7±0.4 km depth, matching 2001 active-source reflection results, and place the Moho at 21.7–22.5±0.9 km. Synthetic tests rule out any comparable laterally coherent shallow magma body at 6–7 km depth.
为克服局地地震层析成像深部们分辨率不足及远震接收函数高频衰减问题，本研究将接收函数方法拓展应用于第勒尼安海下方伊奥尼亚俯冲板片的6个中深源地震（深260-480 km），利用坎皮佛莱格瑞破火山口39个台站记录的区域波形进行成像。通过二维快速行进法动校正、射线追踪正演及遗传算法反演，构建了四界面地壳模……

t: Frequency-domain receiver functions from regional deep-focus earthquakes are corrected for finite-distance moveout via 2D Fast-Marching travel times, stacked across the network, and inverted using dynamic ray-tracing (COMRAD) and a Genetic Algorithm with AIC model selection.
对区域深源地震计算频率域接收函数，经二维快速行进法动校正与中值叠加后，采用动态射线追踪与遗传算法反演。

Three-component waveforms from six intermediate- and deep-focus Ionian slab earthquakes (depths 260–480 km, magnitudes 4.5–6.1, epicentral distances 70–300 km, 2016–2026) recorded by 39 seismic and accelerometric stations across Campi Flegrei.
坎皮佛莱格瑞39个台站记录的6个伊奥尼亚板片中深源地震（深260-480 km，震级4.5-6.1，震中距70-300 …
Inversion identifies a carbonate basement top at ~2.5 km, a melt-rich (75–80% melt) low-velocity zone starting at 7.7±0.4 km (Vp=2.6±0.2 km/s, Vp/Vs=2.1±0.1), and the Moho at 22.5±0.9 km depth.
识别出2.5 km基底顶界、7.7±0.4 km富熔体低速层（Vp=2.6 km/s, Vp/Vs=2.1，熔体占75-…
Closely spaced shallow interfaces (2.7–5 km) smear into a single boundary, the lower boundary (~10 km) of the melt layer is poorly constrained, and small or thin shallow intrusions remain unresolved.
2.7-5 km浅部密集界面发生垂向混叠，低速层底界（~10 km）约束较弱，且无法分辨小规模薄层侵入体。

First adaptation of finite-distance receiver functions using regional deep-slab earthquakes beneath Campi Flegrei, providing steeper incidence and higher-frequency constraints than teleseismic RFs to independently verify the 7.7 km magmatic sill.
首次利用区域深源俯冲板片地震构建有限距离高频接收函数，独立证实了破火山口下方7.7 km处的持久岩浆岩床。

kc: Adapted receiver-function processing to regional intermediate- and deep-focus slab earthquakes using 2D Fast-Marching finite-distance moveout corrections.

Independently confirmed a persistent, melt-rich (75–80% melt fraction) low-velocity magmatic sill at 7.7±0.4 km depth beneath Campi Flegrei, over two decades after the 2001 SERAPIS active-source survey.

Constrained the Moho beneath Campi Flegrei at ~22 km depth (21.7–22.5±0.9 km) and demonstrated from synthetic sensitivity tests that no comparable laterally coherent magma body exists at 6–7 km depth.
将接收函数分析拓展至区域中深源俯冲板片地震，提出基于二维快速行进法的有限距离动校正流程。
在2001年SERAPIS主动源实验二十余年后，独立证实了坎皮佛莱格瑞下方7.7±0.4 km深处持续存在的富熔体（熔体比例75–80%）低速岩浆岩床。
约束破火山口下方莫霍面深度约为22 km，并通过合成敏感性测试排除了6–7 km处存在类似横向连续浅部岩浆体的可能。
me: Frequency-domain receiver function deconvolution (0.5–1.1 Hz) of three-component velocity and integrated strong-motion waveforms.
Event-dependent finite-distance moveout correction using a 2D Fast-Marching travel-time algorithm (FMM) referenced to a near-vertical ML 5.9 event, followed by station and network median stacking.
1D horizontally layered dynamic ray-tracing forward modeling (COMRAD) paired with nonlinear Genetic Algorithm (GA) inversion and Akaike Information Criterion (AIC) layer selection.
Hashin–Shtrikman effective-medium modeling to estimate melt fraction from inverted Vp and Vp/Vs, plus synthetic resolution tests for shallow layer smearing and magma detectability.
对三分量速度及积分强震动波形进行频率域接收函数反褶积（0.5–1.1 Hz）。
利用二维快速行进算法（FMM）进行事件相关的有限距离动校正（以近垂直入射的ML 5.9事件为参考），并进行台站与台网中值叠加。

基于Hashin–Shtrikman等效介质模型由Vp和Vp/Vs估算熔体比例，并开展浅部界面混叠及浅源岩浆可探测性的合成分辨率测试。
de: Three-component waveforms from 39 stations across Campi Flegrei combining broadband, short-period, and integrated strong-motion sensors (18 INGV, 16 RAN, 5 ALTA array stations).

Six intermediate- and deep-focus earthquakes (depths 260–480 km, magnitudes 4.5–6.1, epicentral distances 70–300 km) occurring between 2016 and 2026 in the Ionian slab beneath the southern Tyrrhenian Sea.

Two bandwidth-matched synthetic inversion tests assessing vertical smearing of shallow positive velocity contrasts (2.7–5 km) and detectability of a hypothetical shallow low-velocity layer at 6–7 km depth.
坎皮佛莱格瑞破火山口39个台站的三分量波形数据，融合了宽频带、短周期及积分强震动加速度计（18个INGV、16个RAN和5个ALTA台站）。
2016至2026年间南第勒尼安海伊奥尼亚俯冲板片内发生的6个中深源地震（震源深度260–480 km，震级4.5–6.1，震中距70–300 km）。
两组匹配频带的合成反演测试，分别评估浅部正速度间断面（2.7–5 km）的垂向混叠效应及6–7 km深度假想浅部低速层的可探测性。
li: Closely spaced shallow positive velocity interfaces between 2.7 and 5 km suffer from vertical smearing within the 0.5–1.1 Hz bandwidth, merging into a single effective interface at ~2.6 km.
The lower boundary (~10 km) and total thickness (2–3 km) of the 7.7 km low-velocity melt zone are poorly constrained compared to its sharp upper interface.
1D horizontally layered network-median inversion cannot rule out small, thin, or laterally restricted magmatic intrusions below the method's resolving power.
受0.5–1.1 Hz频带限制，2.7至5 km之间紧密相邻的浅部正速度间断面发生垂向混叠，仅能分辨出约2.6 km处的单一等效界面。
相比于约束良好的上界面（7.7 km），低速熔融带的下界面（约10 km）及其厚度（2–3 km）约束较差。

tm.why: The study adapts receiver-function analysis with finite-distance moveout corrections to image crustal discontinuities and the Moho beneath Campi Flegrei.
The primary target is the magmatic plumbing system, melt-rich sill, and crustal architecture of the restless Campi Flegrei volcanic caldera.
The work constrains crustal thickness (Moho depth at ~22 km) and intracrustal layering along the thinned continental margin of the Tyrrhenian back-arc basin.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 27-page manuscript PDF (preprint submitted to Geophysical Research Letters), including all main text sections (§1–§5), Table 1, and Figures 1–3.

sum: Repeatedly solving the frequency-domain Helmholtz equation is a major computational bottleneck in seismic imaging and full-waveform inversion. While Fourier neural operators (FNOs) suffer outside training distributions and diffusion models require expensive multi-step sampling, this paper introduces a conditional mean flows framework for complex scattered-wavefield generation. By conditioning on the velocity model and an analytical 2D Green's function background wavefield, the network predicts the scattered wavefield, avoiding point-source singularities. The model learns the interval-average transport velocity connecting Gaussian noise to the target wavefield via a Jacobian-vector product identity, enabling both direct one-step generation and multi-step interval partitioning. Trained on OpenFWI (CurveVel-A and FlatFault-A, 3–16 Hz), one-step mean flows achieves lower relative L2 errors than FNO and eight-step DDIM diffusion on in-distribution, out-of-distribution (Marmousi, Overthrust), and extrapolated frequency (17–18 Hz) tests, while delivering 34.3x and 12.3x speedups over serial and 16-thread parallel finite-difference solvers.
针对地震成像与全波形反演中频域Helmholtz方程重复求解耗时的问题，本文提出一种用于复数散射波场生成的条件平均流（Mean Flows）模型。该方法以速度模型和解析背景波场为条件，消除了点源奇异性，并学习连接高斯噪声与散射波场的有限区间平均传输速度，支持单步直接生成与多步区间细化。基于OpenF……

t: The model learns the interval-average transport velocity over a finite time interval from Gaussian noise to the scattered wavefield, conditioned on the velocity model and analytical background wavefield using the mean flows JVP identity.
以速度模型和解析背景场为条件，利用平均流JVP恒等式学习从高斯噪声到散射波场的有限区间平均速度。

Constructed from OpenFWI CurveVel-A and FlatFault-A families on a 70x70 grid (0.01 km spacing) across 3–16 Hz and four sources, solved via a 9-point finite-difference stencil yielding 215,040 training and 8,960 validation samples.
基于OpenFWI构建70×70网格、3–16 Hz及4震源的散射波场数据集，含215,040个训练和8,960个验证样…

One-step mean flows achieves lower relative L2 errors than 8-step diffusion across in-distribution (0.0122 vs 0.0269 on CurveVel-A) and OOD tests, while 16-frequency batched generation yields 34.3x and 12.3x speedups over serial and parallel numerical solvers.
单步平均流在分布内外测试中误差均低于8步扩散模型，16频点批量生成比串/并行数值求解快34.3和12.3倍。

The fixed 70x70 grid representation restricts direct transfer across different spatial resolutions and discretizations, and accuracy drops at extrapolated frequencies beyond the 3–16 Hz training band.
固定70×70网格限制了跨分辨率迁移，且超出训练频带外推时精度下降。

First application of conditional mean flows to complex frequency-domain scattered-wavefield generation, enabling accurate single-step generation without intermediate ODE integration or multi-step diffusion denoising.
首次将条件平均流引入复数频域散射波场生成，无需多步去噪即可实现高精度单步波场预测。

kc: Introduces a conditional mean flows generative model for frequency-domain acoustic scattered-wavefield simulation.
Conditions generation on the velocity model and analytical background wavefields to encode source and frequency priors while removing point-source singularities.
Demonstrates that one-step mean flows outperforms FNO and up to 8-step DDIM diffusion in relative L2 error across in-distribution, out-of-distribution, and frequency-extrapolation tests.
Achieves 34.3x and 12.3x speedups over single-thread and 16-thread parallel finite-difference Helmholtz solvers by batching 16 frequencies on GPU.
提出了用于频域声波散射波场模拟的条件平均流（Conditional Mean Flows）生成模型。
以速度模型和解析背景波场作为条件输入，在编码震源与频率先验的同时消除了目标场中的点源奇异性。
在分布内、分布外及频率外推测试中证明单步平均流模型的相对L2误差优于FNO和8步DDIM扩散模型。
通过在GPU上对16个频率进行批量生成，相比单线程和16线程并行有限差分求解器分别实现34.3倍和12.3倍加速。
me: Scattered-field Helmholtz decomposition using an analytical 2D Hankel function background wavefield for a homogeneous reference velocity.
Conditional mean flows parameterization learning interval-average velocity via the mean flows identity and Jacobian-vector products (JVPs) with an auxiliary instantaneous-velocity head.
Shared conditional U-Net architecture compared against a 1,000-step cosine-schedule DDIM diffusion model and a 4-layer Fourier Neural Operator (FNO) baseline.
基于均匀参考速度解析二维Hankel函数背景波场的Helmholtz散射场分解。
结合辅助瞬时速度头与雅可比向量积（JVP）恒等式，利用条件平均流参数化学习有限区间平均传输速度。
采用条件U-Net主干网络，并与基于DDIM采样的扩散模型及4层傅里叶神经算子（FNO）基线进行对比。
de: 215,040 training and 8,960 validation 2D scattered-wavefield samples generated from OpenFWI CurveVel-A and FlatFault-A models (70x70 grid, 3–16 Hz, 4 source positions) using a 9-point finite-difference solver.
In-distribution accuracy evaluations on CurveVel-A (12 Hz) and FlatFault-A (14 Hz), and out-of-distribution tests on Marmousi and Overthrust velocity models (16 Hz).
Frequency extrapolation experiments up to 17–18 Hz and CPU/GPU runtime benchmarking across 1–8 sampling steps and 1–16 batched frequencies.
使用9点有限差分格式在OpenFWI的CurveVel-A和FlatFault-A模型（70×70网格，3–16 Hz，4个震源位置）上生成215,040个训练样本和8,960个验证样本。
在CurveVel-A（12 Hz）和FlatFault-A（14 Hz）上进行分布内评估，并在Marmousi与Overthrust模型（16 Hz）上进行分布外泛化测试。
开展17–18 Hz频率外推实验，以及1–8步采样和1–16个频率批量推理的CPU/GPU计算效率基准测试。
li: Fixed 70x70 grid discretization restricts direct transfer across different spatial resolutions and grid spacings.
Prediction accuracy degrades when extrapolating to frequencies outside the 3–16 Hz training band (e.g., 17 and 18 Hz) and on complex out-of-distribution geologies.
Increasing the number of sampling steps in partitioned rollouts does not guarantee monotonic error reduction due to accumulated intermediate state errors.
固定的70×70网格离散化限制了模型在不同空间分辨率和网格间距间的直接迁移。
在超出3–16 Hz训练频带（如17和18 Hz）外推以及复杂分布外地质模型上预测精度有所下降。
由于中间生成状态误差累积，增加区间划分采样步数不能保证波场误差单调递减。

tm.why: The paper develops a conditional generative mean flows neural network for predicting frequency-domain seismic scattered wavefields.
The model serves as a fast surrogate for solving the 2D acoustic frequency-domain Helmholtz equation, achieving 12.3x–34.3x speedups over finite-difference solvers.
Frequency-domain wavefield modeling is explicitly motivated as the core forward bottleneck in seismic imaging and full-waveform inversion workflows.

ev.notes: Full 11-page PDF analyzed, including mathematical formulations, algorithms, experimental configurations, and all 15 figures.

sum: This study investigates the nucleation process of laboratory earthquakes induced by dual-well fluid injection. Utilizing laboratory rock physics experiments, the authors simulate fluid-injection-induced fault slip and monitor acoustic emissions to track the spatio-temporal evolution of earthquake nucleation. The dual-well configuration allows for the control of pore pressure gradients and stress states along the simulated fault. The findings shed light on how fluid diffusion and localized pressure build-up influence the transition from stable aseismic slip to unstable seismic rupture, providing critical insights for managing induced seismicity in geothermal and reservoir engineering.
本研究通过双井注水诱发实验室地震实验，探讨了流体诱发断层失稳的成核过程。利用岩石力学实验模拟双井注水，并通过声发射监测追踪成核的时空演化。双井配置可控制断层上的孔隙压梯度与应力状态。结果揭示了流体扩散与局部压积聚如何影响从稳定无震滑动向不稳定破裂的转变，为地热和水库工程中诱发地震的控制提供了重要依据……

t: Laboratory rock physics experiments simulating dual-well fluid injection along a pre-existing fault with acoustic emission monitoring.
利用声发射监测技术，在预设断层上模拟双井流体注水的岩石物理实验。
Experimental measurements of pore pressure, fault displacement, and acoustic emission waveforms during fluid injection.
流体注入过程中孔隙压力、断层位移及声发射波形的实验测量数据。
Characterization of the spatio-temporal evolution of earthquake nucleation controlled by pore pressure gradients from dual wells.
表征了双井孔隙压力梯度控制下地震成核的时空演化特征。
Scale effects and simplified boundary conditions compared to real-world reservoir injection sites.
与实际水库注水现场相比，存在尺度效应和简化的边界条件。
Using a dual-well injection configuration to study the nucleation phase of laboratory earthquakes.
采用双井注水配置来研究实验室地震的成核阶段。

kc: Investigated the nucleation process of laboratory earthquakes under dual-well injection conditions.
Analyzed the role of pore pressure gradients and fluid diffusion in controlling the transition from aseismic to seismic slip.
研究了双井注水条件下的实验室地震成核过程。
分析了孔隙压力梯度和流体扩散在控制无震向有震滑动转变中的作用。
me: Laboratory rock deformation experiments simulating fluid injection along a pre-existing fault.
Acoustic emission (AE) monitoring and analysis to locate and characterize micro-ruptures during nucleation.
模拟沿预设断层流体注入的室内岩石变形实验。
声发射（AE）监测与分析，用于定位和表征成核过程中的微破裂。
de: Experimental measurements of pore pressure, fault slip, and acoustic emission waveforms under dual-well injection.
双井注水条件下孔隙压力、断层滑动和声发射波形的实验测量数据。
li: Laboratory scale and simplified fault geometry may not fully capture the complexity of real-world reservoir faults.
实验室尺度和简化的断层几何结构可能无法完全捕获真实水库断层的复杂性。

tm.why: The paper investigates the nucleation process of laboratory earthquakes, which directly relates to fault mechanics and slip nucleation.
The laboratory earthquakes are induced by dual-well fluid injection, a key topic in reservoir-induced seismicity.

sum: This study systematically evaluates the long-period coda moment magnitude (Mw0) method using 132 large earthquakes (2000–2023) and synthetic tests. The authors find that while Mw0 generally aligns with GCMT Mw, background noise causes deviations for smaller events (Mw < 8.3). To address this, they propose an empirical correction relationship. The enhanced Mw0 method is robust against variations in epicenter location, station coverage, focal mechanism, and focal depth. It is applicable to earthquakes with Mw >= 7.3 given high-quality data, with a highly robust operational range of Mw >= 7.5, offering a stable tool for capturing total seismic energy release.
本研究利用2000至2023年间132个大地震数据及合成测试，系统评估了长周期尾波矩震级（Mw0）方法。结果表明，Mw0与GCMT Mw总体一致，但背景噪声会导致较小事件（Mw < 8.3）出现偏差。为此，研究提出了一种经验校正关系。改进后的方法对震中位置、台站数量变化不敏感，对震源机制和深度仅轻微……

t: Estimation of earthquake magnitude using long-period and long-lasting coda energy, combined with synthetic tests and an empirical correction for events below Mw 8.3.
利用长周期和长持续时间尾波能量估算地震震级，并结合合成测试和经验校正。
Seismic waveform data from 132 large global earthquakes between January 2000 and March 2023, alongside synthetic seismograms.
2000年1月至2023年3月期间132个全球大地震的地震波形数据及合成地震图。
The corrected Mw0 method is robust and applicable down to Mw 7.5 (and Mw 7.3 with high-quality data), showing minimal sensitivity to location and station density.
校正后的Mw0方法在Mw >= 7.5时表现稳健，对震中位置和台站密度不敏感。
The method is mildly sensitive to source focal mechanisms and hypocenter depth, and requires high-quality coda measurements for events below Mw 7.5.
该方法对震源机制和震源深度轻微敏感，且对Mw 7.5以下事件需要高质量尾波测量。
Systematic evaluation of the Mw0 method and the introduction of an empirical correction that extends its robust application range to smaller large earthquakes (Mw >= 7.5).
系统评估了Mw0方法，并引入经验校正，将其稳健应用范围推广至较小的大地震（Mw >= 7.5）。

kc: Systematically evaluated the robustness and limitations of the long-period coda moment magnitude (Mw0) method.
Identified background noise as the primary cause of Mw0 overestimation for events with Mw < 8.3.
Proposed an empirical correction relationship to improve Mw0 accuracy for smaller events.
Extended the robust operational range of the Mw0 method down to Mw >= 7.5 (and potentially Mw >= 7.3).
系统评估了长周期尾波矩震级（Mw0）方法的稳健性与局限性。
确定了背景噪声是导致Mw < 8.3事件中Mw0估算偏差的主要原因。
提出了一种经验校正关系，提高了较小事件中Mw0的准确性。
将Mw0方法的稳健运行范围推广至Mw >= 7.5（在高质量数据下可达Mw >= 7.3）。
me: Long-period coda wave energy analysis for magnitude estimation.
Synthetic seismogram testing to evaluate noise and signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) effects.
Empirical regression and correction modeling.
用于震级估算的长周期尾波能量分析。
用于评估噪声和信噪比（SNR）影响的合成地震图测试。
经验回归与校正建模。

Synthetic waveform tests to simulate background noise impacts.
2000年1月至2023年3月期间132个全球大地震（Mw >= 7.3）的地震波形数据。
用于模拟背景噪声影响的合成波形测试。

Requires a sufficient number of high-quality coda measurements for events between Mw 7.3 and 7.5.
该方法对震源机制解和震源深度的变化仍有轻微的敏感性。
对于Mw 7.3至7.5之间的事件，需要足够数量的高质量尾波测量数据。

tm.why: The paper evaluates and improves the Mw0 method, which is designed to determine the moment magnitude of large earthquakes.
The Mw0 method is based on the long-period and long-lasting coda energy of large earthquakes.

ev.notes: No PDF was available; analysis is based entirely on the provided abstract and metadata.

sum: This study evaluates and fine-tunes three pretrained deep-learning phase pickers (PhaseNet, EQTransformer, and GPD) using regional seismic network data from deep-focus earthquakes in Northeast China. Using a dataset of 1,638 manually picked arrivals from 2008–2022 and a blind test from 2023–2025 events, the authors show that regional fine-tuning significantly improves P-phase picking, with PhaseNet achieving the highest P-phase F1-score of 0.893 (at ±1.0 s tolerance). However, S-phase picking performance remains limited (F1-scores < 0.4), highlighting empirical challenges. The study demonstrates the value of regional fine-tuning for deep-focus earthquake monitoring while identifying S-phase picking and source-station geometry as key areas for future improvement.
本研究利用中国东北地区深源地震的区域地震台网数据，评估并微调了三种预训练深度学习震相拾取器（PhaseNet、EQTransformer和GPD）。基于2008-2022年间1638个手动标注震相进行微调，并在2023-2025年的事件上进行盲测。结果表明，区域微调显著提升了P波拾取性能，其中Pha……

t: Fine-tuning of three pretrained SeisBench models (PhaseNet, EQTransformer, GPD) using regional deep-focus earthquake data and S-phase data augmentation.
使用区域深震数据和S波数据增强对三种预训练SeisBench模型进行微调。
1,638 manually picked arrivals from 29 events (2008-2022) for fine-tuning, and 660 analyst-reviewed arrivals from 4 events (2023-2025) for blind testing.

sum: This paper introduces RUGON (Real-time Ubiquitous Ground-shaking Observation Network), a community-based earthquake observation and rapid response platform in Thailand. RUGON integrates distributed MEMS accelerometers, edge computing, cloud processing, and web-based decision-support tools to deliver real-time ground-motion information. The platform supports community notification, structural vibration monitoring, and situational awareness during earthquake emergencies. Sensor performance was verified via laboratory calibration, and field deployment during the 2026 ML 5.3 Myanmar earthquake demonstrated its complete workflow. While not a substitute for a national earthquake early warning system, RUGON leverages the long propagation times of regional earthquakes to provide over a minute of lead time for major Thai cities based on upstream peak ground acceleration observations.

sum: Dynamic rupture modelers commonly assume that scaling initial stress, rheological parameters, space-time coordinates, and medium properties in specific combinations yields self-similar, proportionally scaled solutions. However, this principle lacked rigorous proof for complex configurations. Using a boundary integral equation formulation and the self-similarity of elastodynamic Green's functions, this study proves the generality of solution scaling in linear elastic dynamic rupture and earthquake cycle models. Assuming solution uniqueness, the proofs hold for arbitrary fault geometries, heterogeneous velocity structures, and spatially varying on-fault parameters across four friction frameworks: linear slip-weakening, rate-and-state, linear time-weakening, and slip-rate-dependent composite rheologies. Two numerical examples—a 3D finite-element simulation of the San Gorgonio Pass fault system and a boundary-element rate-and-state cycle model—confirm the exact analytical scaling predictions. This mathematical foundation justifies extending non-dimensionalization schemes to complex scenarios, aids parameter space exploration, and links laboratory experiments to tectonic earthquakes.
本研究利用边界积分方程和弹性动力学格林函数的自相似性，严格证明了线性弹性动力学破裂模型中解缩放关系的普适性。在解唯一性假设下，该证明适用于任意复杂断层几何、非均匀介质速度结构及非均匀断层流变参数，涵盖了线性滑移弱化、速率-状态摩擦、线性时间弱化和复合流变律四种框架。通过三维有限元单次破裂模拟和边界元……

t: The authors formulate dynamic rupture as boundary integral equations coupled with fault friction laws, proving solution scaling by substituting scaled ansatz solutions and leveraging elastodynamic Green's function self-similarity.
将动力学破裂表述为耦合摩擦律的边界积分方程，利用格林函数自相似性和试探解证明缩放定律。
Two numerical experiments validate the proofs: a 3D FaultMod linear slip-weakening model of the San Gorgonio Pass fault system and a boundary-element rate-and-state dynamic cycle model.
采用San Gorgonio Pass三维有限元滑移弱化模型与边界元速率-状态地震周期模型进行验证。

Scaling initial stress and characteristic slip distances (plus reference velocity and loading rate in rate-and-state models) by C=7 yields identical rupture histories with exactly 7 times greater slip, slip rate, and traction.
将初始应力和特征滑移距离等参数放大7倍（C=7），得到完全相同的破裂演化且滑移与应力精确放大7倍。
The proofs rely on an unproved assumption of solution existence and uniqueness and do not hold for nonlinear off-fault rheologies, hydrothermal processes, or nonlinear stress-dependent friction.
依赖解的存在唯一性假设，且不适用于断层外非线性流变或热增压等非线性耦合过程。
First rigorous mathematical proof that dynamic rupture solution scaling holds for arbitrary fault geometries, heterogeneous media, and multiple friction laws beyond simple homogeneous planar faults.
首次严格证明了任意复杂断层几何、非均匀介质及多种摩擦律下动力学破裂解缩放关系的普适性。

kc: Proves the general validity of solution scaling in linear elastic dynamic rupture models with arbitrary fault geometry and medium heterogeneity using boundary integral equations.
Derives explicit parameter and space-time-medium scaling laws for linear slip-weakening, rate-and-state, linear time-weakening, and composite fault rheologies.
Extends classical non-dimensionalization schemes from homogeneous planar faults to arbitrarily heterogeneous and geometrically complex fault systems.
Validates theoretical scaling laws using 3D finite-element dynamic rupture simulations and boundary-element earthquake cycle simulations.
利用边界积分方程证明了任意断层几何与非均匀介质下线性弹性动力学破裂模型解缩放关系的普适性。
推导了线性滑移弱化、速率-状态摩擦、线性时间弱化及复合流变律下的参数与时空-介质显式缩放关系。
将经典无量纲化方案从均匀介质平面断层推广至任意非均匀介质和复杂几何断层系统。
通过三维有限元动力学破裂模拟和边界元地震周期模拟验证了理论缩放定律。
me: Formulation of 3D linear elastic dynamic rupture problems as boundary integral equations coupled with fault constitutive laws.
Analytical scaling proofs via ansatz substitution and elastodynamic Green's function self-similarity under space, time, stiffness, and density transformations.
Numerical verification using the 3D finite-element code FaultMod (linear slip-weakening) and a boundary-element code (multiplicative rate-and-state earthquake cycles).
将三维线性弹性动力学破裂问题表述为耦合断层本构律的边界积分方程组。
通过试探解代入及弹性动力学格林函数在时空、刚度和密度变换下的自相似性进行解析缩放证明。
利用三维有限元程序FaultMod（线性滑移弱化）和边界元程序（乘性速率-状态地震周期）进行数值验证。
de: 3D finite-element dynamic rupture simulations on the complex western San Gorgonio Pass fault system comparing baseline (C=1) and 7x scaled (C=7) stress and slip-weakening distance.
2D boundary-element fully dynamic rupture cycle simulations over 60,000 time steps (9 events) comparing baseline (C=1) and 7x scaled (C=7) rate-and-state parameters.
在复杂San Gorgonio Pass断层系统上进行三维有限元动力学破裂模拟，对比基准（C=1）与初始应力和滑移弱化距离放大7倍（C=7）的结果。
开展60,000个时间步（含9次地震事件）的边界元全动力学破裂周期模拟，对比基准（C=1）与速率-状态参数放大7倍（C=7）的结果。
li: The mathematical proof assumes without rigorous proof that a unique solution exists for the nonlinear fault boundary conditions.

Scaling relations generally break down when nonlinear off-fault medium rheology (e.g., plasticity), hydrothermal coupling (e.g., thermal pressurization), or nonlinear normal-stress-dependent friction is included.

Numerical artifacts, resolution limits, or artificial thresholds in solvers (e.g., switching between quasi-dynamic and fully dynamic schemes) can introduce extra scales and violate theoretical scaling.
数学证明假设非线性断层边界条件存在唯一解，但未对该唯一性进行严格数学证明。
当包含断层外非线性介质流变（如塑性）、热液耦合（如热增压）或摩擦系数对正应力的非线性依赖时，缩放关系通常不再成立。
数值格式中的高频噪声、分辨率限制或求解器人为阈值可能引入额外尺度，从而违背理论缩放关系。

The study investigates multiple fault rheologies (slip-weakening, rate-and-state, time-weakening, composite) and demonstrates scaling in fully dynamic earthquake cycle simulations.
The paper uses elastodynamic Green's functions, boundary integral equations, and 3D finite-element/boundary-element simulations to validate scaling for large-scale simulation campaigns.

sum: This study evaluates the structural health of supporting limestone pillars in an underground quarry in Burgundy, France, by combining electrical resistivity tomography (ERT) and refraction seismic tomography (RST). Using horizontal sensor rings around three pillars (CB04, CB06, CB10), the authors performed a three-phase petrophysical joint inversion (P-JIv) based on Archie's and Wyllie's laws on unstructured triangular finite-element meshes. Compared to independent inversions, P-JIv improved spatial coverage, reduced model artifacts, and directly estimated rock, water, and air volumetric fractions. High resistivity and low P-wave velocity zones correlated strongly with visual fracturing and low Rock Quality Designation (RQD) in core logs. Finally, a Mean Shift clustering algorithm classified the inverted velocity-resistivity pairs into three structural health states, revealing that pillars CB04 and CB06 have >78% intact rock while CB10 has only 16.2%, providing an objective proxy to prioritize engineering reinforcement.
本研究结合电阻率层析成像（ERT）和折射地震层析成像（RST）评估法国勃艮第地下采石场石灰岩支撑柱的结构健康状况。作者在三个石柱周围环向布设传感器，基于Archie和Wyllie定律，在非结构化三角有限元网格上进行了三相岩石物理联合反演（P-JIv）。与独立反演相比，P-JIv改善了空间覆盖率，减少……

t: A three-phase petrophysical joint inversion (P-JIv) couples ERT and RST data on an unstructured mesh using Archie's and Wyllie's laws to solve for rock, water, and air fractions, followed by Mean Shift clustering.
基于Archie和Wyllie定律，在非结构化网格上进行ERT与RST三相岩石物理联合反演，并结合均值漂移聚类。

Horizontal 2D rings of ERT electrodes and 14 Hz seismic geophones (0.5–1 m spacing) were acquired around three limestone quarry pillars (CB04, CB06, CB10), alongside 3.25 m core drills and lab rock tests.
围绕三个石灰岩柱采集水平二维ERT和14 Hz地震折射数据（间距0.5–1 m），并配合3.25 m钻孔岩芯与实验测试。
P-JIv reduced ERT RRMS to 4.8–8.8% and yielded porosities of 36±8% (CB04, CB06) and 41±10% (CB10). Clustering showed CB04 and CB06 have >78% healthy rock, whereas CB10 has only 16.2%.
联合反演降低了残差，反演孔隙度为36–41%；聚类显示CB04和CB06完好岩石超78%，而CB10仅16.2%。

Petrophysical parameters (cementation and saturation exponents) were approximated without site-specific laboratory calibration, and small pillar dimensions relative to trigger accuracy caused high RST traveltime misfits.
岩石物理指数缺乏现场标定，且支柱尺寸较小导致地震走时触发相对误差较大。

Adapts the 4-phase permafrost petrophysical joint inversion to a 3-phase model for underground limestone pillars and combines it with automated clustering to establish a quantitative structural damage proxy.
将三相岩石物理联合反演与自动聚类结合，首次为地下采石场支柱建立了定量的结构损伤评估指标。

kc: Applied a 3-phase petrophysical joint inversion (P-JIv) of ERT and RST data to image 2D horizontal cross-sections of underground limestone pillars.
Validated geophysical inversions and derived rock/water/air fractions against core drilling logs, RQD, and laboratory rock physics measurements.
Implemented an automated Mean Shift clustering algorithm on inverted resistivity-velocity pairs to quantify pillar damage percentages and guide reinforcement.
应用电阻率与地震折射数据的三相岩石物理联合反演（P-JIv），对地下石灰岩支柱进行二维水平截面成像。
通过钻孔岩芯记录、岩石质量指标（RQD）和实验室岩石物理测量，验证了地球物理反演及导出的岩石/水/空气体积分数。
在反演的电阻率-速度数据对上实施自动均值漂移聚类算法，量化支柱损伤百分比以指导加固工程。
me: Independent Gauss-Newton inversions (IIv) of apparent resistivity and P-wave traveltimes using BERT and pyGIMLI on unstructured closed meshes.
Three-phase petrophysical joint inversion (P-JIv) linking resistivity and P-wave velocity via Archie's law and Wyllie's time-average equation solved with LSQR.
Model appraisal using cumulative sensitivity coverage maps and Depth of Investigation (DOI) indices.
Automated Mean Shift clustering in the 2D (resistivity, P-wave velocity) feature space to classify rock integrity.
在非结构化闭合网格上使用BERT和pyGIMLI对视电阻率和P波走时进行独立高斯-牛顿反演（IIv）。
通过Archie定律和Wyllie时间平均方程关联电阻率与P波速度，利用LSQR求解三相岩石物理联合反演（P-JIv）。
利用累积灵敏度覆盖图和探测深度（DOI）指数进行模型评估。
在二维（电阻率，P波速度）特征空间中进行自动均值漂移聚类，以对岩石完整性进行分类。
de: 2D horizontal ERT profiles (Wenner-Schlumberger, 0.5–1.0 m electrode spacing) acquired around three Kimmeridgian limestone pillars (CB04, CB06, CB10).
Co-located 2D horizontal active-source seismic refraction surveys using 14 Hz geophones, a hammer source, and 4000 Hz sampling.
Three 3.25 m horizontal core drills through the pillars providing RQD logs, porosity (30–36%), water content (15–20%), and uniaxial compressive strength (16.2–36.9 MPa).
围绕三个Kimmeridgian石灰岩支柱（CB04、CB06、CB10）采集的二维水平ERT剖面（Wenner-Schlumberger装置，电极间距0.5–1.0 m）。
同位置采集的二维水平主动源地震折射测量，使用14 Hz检波器、锤击震源和4000 Hz采样率。
穿过支柱的三个3.25 m水平岩芯钻孔，提供RQD记录、孔隙度（30–36%）、含水量（15–20%）和单轴抗压强度（16.2–36.9 MPa）。
li: Archie's exponents (m=1.4, n=2.4) and pore water resistivity were approximated from literature rather than calibrated on site-specific rock samples, limiting strict quantitative interpretation.
Surface drying and chemical reactions at pillar borders were neglected when interpreting air fraction as a proxy for fracturing.
Small pillar dimensions relative to seismic trigger accuracy (0.1 ms) caused high RST relative misfits (RRMS 21–41%).
Archie指数（m=1.4, n=2.4）和孔隙水电阻率取自文献近似值而非现场岩样标定，限制了严格的定量解释。
将空气体积分数作为裂缝指标解释时，忽略了支柱边缘的表面干燥和化学反应。
相对于地震触发精度（0.1 ms），较小的支柱尺寸导致RST相对拟合差较高（RRMS为21–41%）。

The core methodology is a three-phase petrophysical joint inversion coupling electrical resistivity and P-wave traveltime data on unstructured finite-element meshes.
The study applies near-surface environmental and engineering geophysics to assess structural damage and stability in an underground limestone quarry.

sum: This study investigates the La Praz unstable rock slope (~13,000–15,000 m³) in the French Alps using repeated passive seismic surveys spanning over a decade, up to two months before its complete collapse in August 2023. The authors used the Horizontal-to-Vertical Spectral Ratio peak amplitude (aHVSR(fp)) to map mechanical decoupling across fractures and classify compartments by rockfall hazard, finding values of 26–157 in the most unstable zones compared to 2.7 on stable rock. Crucially, the HVSR peak frequency (fp) showed unambiguous drops of 15%, 14%, and 11% in three highly unstable compartments prior to failure, far exceeding reversible environmental fluctuations (3.9–4.8%). Combined with extensometer, total station, and GNSS deformation data, these frequency drops are interpreted as progressive in-depth slope damage. This work demonstrates for the first time that passive seismic monitoring can detect precursory damage in a complex, heterogeneous, and heavily fractured rock slope.
本研究对法国阿尔卑斯山La Praz不稳定岩质边坡（约1.3–1.5万立方米）开展了十余年的重复被动源地震监测，直至2023年8月完全坍塌前两个月。研究利用水平与垂直谱比峰值振幅（aHVSR(fp)）划分裂隙力学解耦程度并评估落石危险性，发现极不稳定区块幅值达26–157，而稳定基岩仅为2.7。结合……

One continuous passive seismic deployment (2011–2013) and five punctual campaigns (2019–2023, up to two months before collapse) across six rock compartments, complemented by extensometers, robotic total station, and GNSS.
包含2011–2013年连续地震监测和2019–2023年五期流动观测（至坍塌前两个月），结合伸缩仪、全站仪和GNSS形…

Mean HVSR peak amplitudes ranged from 26–157 on the most unstable compartments versus 2.7 on stable rock, while HVSR peak frequencies dropped by 14%, 11%, and 15% on compartments A1', A2, and B1 prior to collapse.
高危岩体区块HVSR平均峰值幅值达26–157（稳定基岩为2.7），坍塌前A1'、A2和B1区块峰值频率分别下降14%、…

Safety and time constraints prevented measurements on the most unstable compartment A1 and stable slope S during the final survey I6, and punctual campaigns missed the final two months before failure.
因安全和时间限制，最后一次观测未能测量最危险的A1区块和稳定基岩，且缺乏坍塌前两个月内的连续监测。
First real-case demonstration of precursory resonance frequency drops revealing progressive in-depth damage prior to the collapse of a complex, heterogeneous, and heavily fractured rock slope.
首次在实际复杂、非均质且严重破碎的岩质边坡坍塌前观测到反映深部渐进损伤的共振频率显著下降。

kc: Demonstrated that HVSR peak amplitude (aHVSR(fp)) correlates across two orders of magnitude with rockfall hazard and delineates mechanically decoupling fractures.
Detected unambiguous precursory resonance frequency drops (-11% to -15%) two months before the catastrophic collapse of a complex, fractured rock slope.
Showed that pre-failure frequency drops significantly exceed environmentally driven thermoelastic fluctuations (3.9% to 4.8%) calibrated over a multi-year continuous baseline.
证明了HVSR峰值振幅跨越两个数量级的变化与落石危险性高度相关，并能圈定起力学解耦作用的主控裂隙。
在复杂破碎岩质边坡发生灾难性坍塌前两个月，观测到明确的共振频率前兆性下降（-11%至-15%）。
利用多年连续监测基线证明坍塌前的频率下降幅度远超由温度引起的可逆环境波动（3.9%至4.8%）。
me: Horizontal-to-Vertical Spectral Ratio (HVSR) computation on ambient vibration recordings following SESAME guidelines using 30 s tapered windows and Konno-Ohmachi smoothing.
3D component rotation aligning the North component with the mean resonance dip plane (4.7° downward slope) prior to HVSR calculation.
Multi-sensor surface deformation tracking combining invar wire extensometers, automatic robotic total station (Leica MS60), and RTK-GNSS surveys.
Linear regression of resonance frequency against air temperature to separate thermoelastic environmental wandering from irreversible mechanical damage.
遵循SESAME指南，采用30秒加窗和Konno-Ohmachi平滑滤波器计算环境振动的水平与垂直谱比（HVSR）。
在计算HVSR前进行三分量旋转，将北分量与沿坡向下的平均共振倾角平面（4.7°）对齐。
结合殷钢丝伸缩仪、自动全站仪（Leica MS60）和RTK-GNSS测量进行多传感器地表形变追踪。
建立共振频率与气温的线性回归模型，以区分热弹性环境波动与不可逆的力学损伤。
de: Continuous passive seismic monitoring (Survey I1, 2011–2013) using three 3-component Lennartz LE 3D 5s sensors sampled at 250 Hz.
Five punctual passive seismic campaigns (Surveys I2–I6, 2019–2023) using 2 Hz Mark Products L22-D sensors recording 20–30 min at 1000 Hz.
Continuous hourly crack aperture time-series from three extensometers (E1–E3, 2006–2023) and hourly total station targets (2018–2023), plus two GNSS campaigns (2021, 2023).
使用3台Lennartz LE 3D 5s三分量传感器开展连续被动源地震监测（I1测次，2011–2013年，采样率250 Hz）。
使用2 Hz Mark Products L22-D传感器开展五期阶段性流动地震观测（I2–I6测次，2019–2023年，采样率1000 Hz，时长20–30分钟）。
3台伸缩仪（E1–E3，2006–2023年）和自动全站仪（2018–2023年）的每小时连续形变序列，以及两期GNSS观测（2021年、2023年）。
li: No seismic measurements could be performed on the most hazardous compartment (A1) or stable reference mass (S) during the final pre-collapse survey (I6) due to safety and time constraints.
Reliance on punctual surveys between 2019 and 2023 precluded continuous tracking of the final two months leading up to the August 2023 collapse.
HVSR peak amplitude did not show a clear temporal increase toward failure, contradicting some previous numerical models of rock bridge breakage.
受安全和时间限制，在坍塌前的最后一次观测（I6）中未能对最危险区块（A1）和稳定参考基岩（S）进行测量。
2019至2023年间仅依赖阶段性流动观测，缺乏2023年8月最终坍塌前两个月内的连续地震记录。
HVSR峰值振幅在临近坍塌时未表现出明显的时间递增趋势，这与先前的岩桥断裂数值模拟预期不符。

tm.why: Uses ambient seismic vibrations to characterize rockfall hazard and detect precursory damage before a catastrophic rock slope collapse.
Employs Horizontal-to-Vertical Spectral Ratio (HVSR) analysis of passive ambient noise recordings over a ten-year period.
Performs microzonation and hazard mapping of unstable rock compartments based on spectral amplification ratios and resonance frequencies.

ev.notes: Full 24-page preprint PDF (accepted in Engineering Geology, vol. 338, 2024, 107627) including all text, 7 figures, and 3 tables was analyzed.

sum: This paper introduces SeidarT, an open-source finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) software package combining Fortran solvers with Python scripting for full-waveform modeling of seismic (4th-order space, 2nd-order time) and electromagnetic (2nd-order) waves in heterogeneous, attenuating, and fully anisotropic media (up to 21 stiffness coefficients). To eliminate complex mesh generation, model geometries are defined via PNG images paired with JSON configuration files. The toolbox includes Convolutional Perfectly Matched Layer (CPML) absorbing boundaries, automatic CFL and bandlimit stability checks, and OpenMP/CUDA parallelization. It natively calculates bulk snow and ice properties from temperature, pressure, porosity, liquid water content, and EBSD crystal orientation fabrics using Hill, Gassmann, or Self-Consistent Approximation (SCA) homogenization. Validation against Storglaciären borehole radar data, theoretical Rayleigh dispersion curves, layered body-wave synthetics, and 3D orthorhombic velocity surfaces confirms high accuracy, while documenting late-time CPML instabilities in monoclinic and triclinic media.
本文介绍了开源有限差分时域（FDTD）软件包SeidarT，结合Fortran计算核心与Python脚本，统一模拟非均匀、衰减及全张量各向异性介质中的地震与电磁波传播。该工具采用PNG图像与JSON文件构建模型，免去了复杂的网格剖分，并集成了CPML吸收边界、稳定性检查及OpenMP/CUDA加速。……

t: SeidarT uses a staggered-grid finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) solver (4th-order seismic, 2nd-order EM) in Fortran with Python scripting, combining PNG image-based geometries, JSON configurations, CPML boundaries, and rock-physics homogenization (Hill, Gassmann, SCA).
采用Fortran/Python交错网格FDTD求解器，结合PNG图像建模、CPML边界及冰雪均匀化方法。

The software is benchmarked on 2D/2.5D transversely isotropic grids (up to 1000x1000) and validated against Storglaciären 100 MHz borehole radar ZOP data, 6-layer elastic surface/body wave models, and 3D anisotropic crystal symmetry models.
基于横观各向同性网格开展性能基准测试，并利用瑞典冰川钻孔雷达、6层弹性模型及三维各向异性模型验证。

OpenMP multi-threading achieves up to 35.7 Mcells/s (2D) and 27.5 Mcells/s (2.5D), Zstandard Block I/O reduces write penalties by up to 40%, and synthetic waveforms accurately match field radar arrivals, MASW dispersion, and 3D orthorhombic velocities.
多线程峰值达35.7 Mcells/s，分块I/O降低40%写入开销，模拟结果与雷达观测及理论频散高度吻合。

CPML boundaries exhibit late-time instabilities in monoclinic and triclinic media due to energy-flux misalignment, and rectilinear grids produce staircased boundary errors requiring 2-4x finer spatial sampling.
CPML在单斜和三斜介质后期出现不稳定，且直角网格在倾斜界面存在阶梯伪影。

Provides the first unified, open-source FDTD framework natively coupling full 21-component anisotropy, Q attenuation, EBSD fabric homogenization, and mesh-free PNG/JSON model construction for seismic and EM waves in cryospheric media.
首个集全张量各向异性、EBSD组构均匀化与PNG无网格建模于一体的冰雪地震与电磁开源FDTD工具。

kc: Developed SeidarT, an open-source Fortran/Python staggered-grid FDTD solver unifying full-tensor anisotropic, viscoelastic seismic and lossy electromagnetic wave propagation.
Created a mesh-free model building workflow using raster PNG images for domain geometry and JSON files for material and survey parameterization, alongside EBSD Euler angle ingestion.

Integrated temperature-, pressure-, porosity-, and LWC-dependent snow and ice parameterizations with automated switching between Hill, Gassmann, and Self-Consistent Approximation (SCA) homogenization.
Benchmarked CPU/GPU parallel performance and validated physical accuracy across borehole GPR profiles, MASW Rayleigh dispersion, body-wave kinematics, and 3D anisotropic phase velocities.
开发了开源Fortran/Python交错网格FDTD求解器SeidarT，统一了全张量各向异性粘弹性地震波与有损电磁波传播模拟。
创建了基于PNG栅格图像定义几何结构与JSON文件配置参数的无网格建模流程，并支持直接导入EBSD欧拉角数据。
集成了受温度、压力、孔隙度和液态水含量控制的冰雪物性参数化方案，可根据阈值自动切换Hill、Gassmann和自洽近似（SCA）均匀化方法。
评估了CPU/GPU并行计算性能，并通过钻孔GPR剖面、MASW瑞利波频散、体波运动学及三维各向异性相速度全面验证了物理精度。
me: Staggered-grid finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) discretization (4th-order spatial / 2nd-order temporal for elastodynamics; 2nd-order for Maxwell's equations) with component-wise Q attenuation.
Unsplit Convolutional Perfectly Matched Layer (CPML) absorbing boundaries tuned for anisotropic media, paired with automated CFL and wavenumber-bandlimit stability checks.

Microstructural homogenization of polyphase snow and ice via Bond matrix rotations of EBSD crystal fabrics, Hill averaging, Gassmann fluid substitution, and iterative Self-Consistent Approximation (SCA).
Automated 3-component anisotropic phase picking in ray-centered quasi-coordinates (Q, SV, SH) combining moving-window rectilinearity and the Akaike Information Criterion (AIC).
采用交错网格有限差分时域（FDTD）离散方法（弹性波空间四阶/时间二阶，麦克斯韦方程二阶）及分量式Q衰减模型。
实施针对各向异性介质调优的卷积完全匹配层（CPML）吸收边界，并结合自动CFL与波数带限稳定性检查。
通过EBSD晶体组构的Bond矩阵旋转、Hill平均、Gassmann流体替换及迭代自洽近似（SCA）实现多相冰雪微结构均匀化。
在射线中心准坐标系（Q, SV, SH）中结合滑动窗口线性度与赤池信息准则（AIC）实现三分量各向异性震相自动拾取。
de: Computational throughput benchmarks (Mcells/s) across 250x250, 500x500, and 1000x1000 transversely isotropic ice grids using serial, OpenMP (8 threads), CUDA GPU, and hybrid backends.
2D electromagnetic simulation of a 100 MHz borehole radar zero-offset profile (ZOP) replicating field observations from the polythermal Storglaciären, Sweden (Gusmeroli et al., 2010b).
2.5D electromagnetic plane-wave polarization and birefringence tests across strong (66%), moderate (33%), and near-isotropic (<1%) transversely isotropic media.
6-layer elastic synthetic experiments validating Rayleigh surface-wave dispersion (against disba analytical curves) and P/S body-wave reflections, refractions, and conversions.
3D anisotropic seismic stability tests across crystal symmetries (isotropic to triclinic) and 4824-receiver omnidirectional spherical shell tests for orthorhombic velocity mapping.
在250x250、500x500和1000x1000横向各向同性冰网格上，测试串行、OpenMP（8线程）、CUDA GPU和混合后端的计算吞吐量（Mcells/s）。
开展100 MHz钻孔雷达零偏移距剖面（ZOP）二维电磁模拟，复现瑞典Storglaciären多热冰川的野外观测结果（Gusmeroli et al., 2010b）。
在强（66%）、中（33%）和近各向同性（<1%）横向各向同性介质中进行2.5D电磁平面波极化与双折射数值实验。
利用6层弹性合成实验验证瑞利面波频散（对比disba解析曲线）以及P/S体波反射、折射和转换波。
开展不同晶系（各向同性至三斜晶系）的三维各向异性地震稳定性测试，以及基于4824个接收器全向球壳阵列的正交各向异性速度制图实验。
li: CPML absorbing boundaries exhibit late-time numerical instabilities in low-symmetry (monoclinic and triclinic) anisotropic media due to misalignment between PML stretching and energy flux.
Rectilinear Cartesian grids create staircased artifacts at non-axis-aligned interfaces, introducing O(1) boundary errors and O(h) phase errors requiring 2-4x finer grid spacing.

Component-wise relaxation reduces the 4th-order attenuation tensor to 2nd-order for efficiency, and default empirical snow permittivity equations neglect certain microstructural and chemical/acidity effects.
在低对称性（单斜和三斜）各向异性介质中，由于PML拉伸方向与能量通量不一致，CPML吸收边界在模拟后期会出现数值不稳定。
直角笛卡尔网格在非轴对齐界面处会产生阶梯状伪影，引入O(1)边界误差和O(h)相位误差，需将网格加密2至4倍。
为提高计算效率将四阶衰减张量简化为二阶分量松弛，且默认的经验雪介电常数公式忽略了部分微观结构及化学酸度效应。

tm.why: Presents a staggered-grid FDTD software package for 2D/2.5D elastic and electromagnetic wave propagation with OpenMP and CUDA GPU acceleration.
Specifically parameterizes and validates the wave propagation toolbox for snow and ice environments, including polythermal glaciers and snowpacks.
Natively incorporates full 21-component elastic stiffness tensors, EBSD crystal orientation fabrics, and homogenization schemes to model anisotropic wave propagation.

ev.notes: All metadata, equations, benchmarks, validation experiments, and figure analyses were extracted directly from the 26-page Copernicus (The Cryosphere) PDF manuscript.

sum: Short-period (1–10 s) teleseismic studies of the deep Earth are severely limited by ocean-generated microseismic noise. This paper presents an accessible, computationally efficient workflow using a supervised time-frequency deep-learning denoising auto-encoder (DAE) trained solely on 1D Instaseis synthetics and real global noise from the Global Seismographic Network, avoiding costly 3D simulations or scarce clean real signals. The authors also demonstrate two-stage transfer learning using 3D AxiSEM3D synthetics and tapered real Sdiff waveforms. Combined with array beamforming and stacking, the DAE preserves phase arrival times and directional information while substantially boosting SNR. Applied to real teleseismic datasets, the method uncovers previously undocumented short-period Sdiff precursors and post-cursors from the Hawaiian, Galápagos, and Pitcairn ultra-low velocity zones (ULVZs), and identifies Hawaiian ULVZ Sdiff+ signals recorded on Japanese F-net stations from East Pacific Rise earthquakes, providing the first perpendicular cross-cutting ray paths to resolve ULVZ 3D morphology.
海洋微震噪声严重限制了利用短周期（1-10秒）远震数据研究地球深部结构。本文提出了一种高效、易用的深度学习去噪自编码器（DAE）工作流，仅利用一维Instaseis合成地震图和全球台网（GSN）真实噪声进行监督训练，无需昂贵的三维模拟或稀缺的高信噪比真实信号。研究还展示了结合三维AxiSEM3D合成……

t: A supervised convolutional denoising auto-encoder takes the real and imaginary parts of a trace's Short-Time Fourier Transform (STFT) and predicts time-frequency mask functions to separate teleseismic signal from noise, optionally refined via transfer learning.
监督式卷积去噪自编码器以波形STFT的实部和虚部为输入，预测时频掩码分离远震信号与噪声，并支持迁移学习微调。

Training combines 512,000 STA/LTA-filtered 600-s horizontal noise traces from the Global Seismographic Network with 1D Instaseis synthetics, 3D AxiSEM3D ULVZ synthetics, and augmented real Sdiff waveforms, tested on 2000–2024 ULVZ record sections.
训练集结合了GSN的51.2万条600秒噪声、一维Instaseis合成波、三维AxiSEM3D合成波及真实Sdiff波…

The DAE recovers synthetic signals with median timing errors of 0–1 samples down to SNR 0.5, achieves >20–40 dB SNR gains on real data, and reveals perpendicular Hawaiian ULVZ Sdiff+ paths (78° azimuth difference) in Japan.
在信噪比低至0.5时仍保持0-1采样点中位时移误差，实测信噪比提升超20-40 dB，并在日本发现相差78°的夏威夷UL…
Imperfect signal-noise mask partitioning causes inconsistent amplitude loss across different seismic phases, making denoised waveforms unsuitable for absolute or relative amplitude measurements.
时频掩码分割不完美导致不同震相出现不一致的振幅损失，因此去噪波形不适用于振幅测量。

First demonstration of a supervised DAE trained purely on 1D synthetics and global noise to extract 3D deep-Earth diffracted ULVZ phases, discovering short-period precursors and cross-cutting Hawaiian ULVZ ray paths.
首次仅用一维合成波与全球噪声训练监督式DAE提取深部三维ULVZ衍射震相，发现了短周期前驱波与正交路径观测。

kc: Developed a computationally efficient supervised DAE training workflow using 1D Instaseis synthetics and global GSN noise without requiring 3D simulations or clean real signals.
Demonstrated that transfer learning with 3D synthetics or tapered real data and combining DAE with linear array stacking further enhances SNR while preserving back-azimuth information.
Discovered previously undocumented short-period Sdiff precursors and secondary arrivals sampling the Hawaiian, Galápagos, and Pitcairn ULVZs.
Identified Sdiff+ arrivals from the Hawaiian ULVZ on F-net stations in Japan (~78° azimuthal difference from North American paths), providing the first perpendicular ray path constraints.
开发了高效的监督式去噪自编码器（DAE）训练流程，仅使用一维Instaseis合成波形和GSN全球噪声，无需昂贵的三维模拟或纯净真实信号。
证明了利用三维合成数据或加窗真实数据进行迁移学习，并将DAE与台阵线性叠加结合，可在保留反方位角信息的同时进一步提高信噪比。
发现了采样夏威夷、加拉帕戈斯和皮特凯恩超低速带（ULVZ）的前人未报道的短周期Sdiff前驱波和次生震相。
在日本F-net台站识别出夏威夷ULVZ的Sdiff+震相（与北美路径方位角相差约78°），首次提供了正交射线路径约束。
me: Time-frequency domain convolutional denoising auto-encoder (DAE) predicting soft signal and noise masks applied to Short-Time Fourier Transform (STFT) representations.
Supervised training using synthetic signals (1D Instaseis PREM_a_2s) summed with STA/LTA-screened real noise traces at random time shifts and amplitude ratios.
Two-stage transfer learning (freezing encoder weights and retraining the decoder) to adapt general models to regional noise, 3D AxiSEM3D synthetics, or tapered real waveforms.
Array beamforming and linear stacking within a 2° radius at CMB critical slowness (8.36 s/°) applied to denoised traces.
时频域卷积去噪自编码器（DAE），通过对短时傅里叶变换（STFT）预测软信号掩码和噪声掩码实现信噪分离。
利用一维Instaseis合成信号与经STA/LTA筛选的真实噪声以随机时移和振幅比叠加进行监督训练。
采用两阶段迁移学习（冻结编码器权重，仅重训练解码器），将通用模型适配于区域噪声、三维AxiSEM3D合成波形或加窗真实数据。
对去噪后的波形在2°半径内固定核幔边界临界慢度（8.36 s/°）进行台阵聚束与线性叠加。
de: 512,000 horizontal-component 600-s noise traces from GSN (networks CU, IC, II, IU) and 128,000 localized noise traces each from contiguous US (TA, US), Alaska (AK, AV), and Japan (F-net).
Synthetic training datasets generated via 1D Instaseis (S, SS, Sdiff between 2–100 s) and a 3D AxiSEM3D simulation of a cylindrical ULVZ down to 4 s period.
724 manually screened high-SNR real Sdiff traces from 30 earthquakes recorded in the contiguous US (augmented to 51,200 traces, tapered and untapered).
Test dataset of teleseismic T-component Sdiff record sections (2000–2024) sampling Hawaiian, Galápagos, Pitcairn, Central Pacific, and Vanuatu ULVZs.
来自GSN的512,000条600秒水平分量噪声记录，以及美国本土、阿拉斯加和日本F-net各128,000条区域噪声记录。
利用一维Instaseis生成的合成训练集（2–100秒的S、SS和Sdiff震相）以及最短周期4秒的圆柱形ULVZ三维AxiSEM3D合成数据。
从美国本土记录的30个地震中人工筛选出的724条高信噪比真实Sdiff波形（数据增强至51,200条，分加窗与未加窗两组）。
2000至2024年间采样夏威夷、加拉帕戈斯、皮特凯恩、中太平洋和瓦努阿图ULVZ的远震切向分量Sdiff记录剖面测试集。
li: Imperfect partitioning of signal and noise by the time-frequency masks causes inconsistent amplitude loss across phases, precluding reliable absolute or relative amplitude measurements.
Signals that deviate substantially from the training distribution (such as strongly distorted off-axis Sdiff+ arrivals) experience partial suppression by the 1D-trained DAE.
Denoising performance and timing accuracy degrade rapidly when the signal-to-noise peak amplitude ratio drops below 0.5.
时频掩码对信号和噪声的分割不完美会导致不同震相出现不一致的振幅损失，因此不宜在去噪波形上进行绝对或相对振幅测量。
偏离训练分布较远的信号（如受强烈畸变的离轴Sdiff+震相）会被基于一维合成数据训练的DAE部分压制。
当信噪峰值振幅比低于0.5时，去噪性能和到时提取精度会迅速下降。

tm.why: The paper develops and evaluates a supervised time-frequency deep-learning denoising auto-encoder (DAE) with transfer learning to suppress microseismic noise in teleseismic waveforms.

The denoiser is applied to core-mantle boundary diffracted waves (Sdiff and Sdiff+) to constrain ultra-low velocity zones (ULVZs) in the lowermost mantle, including new observations of the Hawaiian ULVZ.
The study extensively benchmarks and combines trace-by-trace deep-learning denoising with seismic array beamforming and linear stacking across dense networks (USArray, F-net, Alaska).

ev.notes: Full 26-page PDF analyzed, including equations, network architecture, training workflows, synthetic tests, and real ULVZ case studies.

sum: This study presents a 3D displacement mapping framework using offset tracking on high-resolution LiDAR-derived shaded relief images, applied to the active Slumgullion landslide in Colorado, USA. The method successfully identifies previously undetected secondary mini-slides near the landslide's margins and headscarp, confirming ongoing material supply. By comparing these results with historical displacement data dating back to 1939, the authors demonstrate a long-term deceleration of the landslide's motion, including a ~36% reduction in toe advance since the 1990s. Despite this deceleration, the landslide remains highly dynamic, with maximum shear strain rates reaching approximately 1 yr⁻¹. This work provides a transferable methodology for high-resolution 3D deformation mapping of landslides and other geohazards.
