t: 3D displacement mapping using offset tracking on high-resolution shaded relief images derived from multi-temporal LiDAR datasets.
利用多时相LiDAR阴影起伏图像进行偏移追踪以重建三维滑坡位移。
Multi-temporal LiDAR data of the Slumgullion landslide in Colorado, USA, combined with historical displacement records dating back to 1939.
美国科罗拉多州Slumgullion滑坡的多时相LiDAR数据及历史位移记录。
Revealed secondary mini-slides near margins and a long-term deceleration of the landslide, with toe advance slowing by ~36% since the 1990s.
揭示了滑坡边缘的次级微滑坡，并发现自1990年代以来前缘推进减速约36%。
Dependent on high-resolution multi-temporal topography and potentially sensitive to surface vegetation changes or erosion.
高度依赖高分辨率多时相地形数据，且易受地表植被变化干扰。
First application of shaded relief offset tracking to resolve 3D landslide displacements and identify subtle marginal secondary failures.
首次将阴影起伏偏移追踪应用于三维滑坡位移解析与边缘微滑坡识别。

kc: Developed a transferable framework for mapping 3D landslide displacements using offset tracking on LiDAR-derived shaded relief images.
Discovered previously unrecognized secondary mini-slides near the margins and headscarp of the Slumgullion landslide.
Documented a multi-decadal deceleration of the landslide, including a ~36% decrease in toe advance since the 1990s.
开发了一种利用LiDAR阴影起伏图像偏移追踪制图三维滑坡位移的可推广框架。
首次发现了Slumgullion滑坡边缘和主后壁附近未被识别的次级微型滑坡。

me: Offset tracking (pixel correlation) applied to high-resolution shaded relief images derived from LiDAR.
3D displacement reconstruction from multi-temporal elevation datasets.
Strain rate analysis to identify shear zones and structural dynamics.
对基于LiDAR的高分辨率阴影起伏图像进行偏移追踪（像素相关性分析）。
利用多时相高程数据集重建三维位移。
进行应变率分析以识别剪切带和动力学特征。
de: Multi-temporal LiDAR-derived digital elevation models (DEMs) and shaded relief images of the Slumgullion landslide, Colorado.
Historical displacement datasets dating back to 1939 for long-term decadal trend analysis.
美国科罗拉多州Slumgullion滑坡的多时相LiDAR数字高程模型（DEM）及阴影起伏图像。

sum: This study uses 2-D spectral-element simulations (SPECFEM2D) to quantify how elastic focusing affects apparent teleseismic S-wave differential attenuation (Δt*). By toggling intrinsic anelasticity on and off while correcting for physical dispersion via the Kramers-Kronig relation, the authors isolate purely extrinsic focusing effects in idealized Gaussian anomalies and complex geodynamic mid-ocean ridge (MOR) models. Results show that elastic focusing can contribute over 50% of the apparent Δt* signal, peaking when circular anomaly diameters are 2–4 times the wavelength or slightly prolate parallel to propagation. The authors validate a novel 'focus score' (F) metric based on divergence between amplitude and phase spectra in the fAxP method, establishing F_crit ≈ 0.28 to flag substantial focusing. Applied to MORs, sub-lithospheric melt pockets cause strong focusing oscillations, whereas mantle volatile and spreading-rate variations yield Δt* differences likely below observational noise.
本研究利用二维谱元法（SPECFEM2D）模拟量化了弹性聚焦对远震S波视差分衰减（Δt*）的影响。通过结合Kramers-Kronig频散校正并开关本征非弹性，作者在理想高斯异常体和洋中脊（MOR）地球动力学模型中分离出纯外因聚焦效应。结果表明，弹性聚焦可贡献超过50%的视Δt*信号，在异常体直径为……

t: Propagates 0.3 Hz plane S-waves through 2-D velocity/attenuation structures using SPECFEM2D, isolating extrinsic focusing by toggling intrinsic attenuation while matching effective velocities via Kramers-Kronig relaxation, and measuring Δt* with the fAxP method.
用SPECFEM2D模拟0.3 Hz平面S波，结合Kramers-Kronig松弛并开关本征衰减以分离聚焦效应，用fAx…

Uses synthetic waveforms from idealized 2-D Gaussian anomalies (varying diameter 6–30 km and aspect ratio) and geodynamic mid-ocean ridge models (Keller et al., 2017) with varying volatiles and spreading rates.
采用不同尺寸和纵横比的二维高斯异常体及不同挥发分和扩张速率的洋中脊地球动力学模型合成波形。

Elastic focusing contributes >50% of apparent Δt* for many anomalies, peaking at diameters of 2–4 wavelengths and moderately prolate shapes; a focus score threshold F_crit ≈ 0.28 reliably flags focusing >0.1 s.
弹性聚焦可贡献超50%的视Δt*，在2-4倍波长直径和适度长椭球形状时达峰值；阈值F_crit≈0.28可有效识别显著聚…
Simulations are limited to 2-D geometry and frequency-independent absorption bands in SPECFEM2D, while MOR geodynamic models omit grain-size evolution, dislocation creep, and melt diking.
局限于二维模拟和SPECFEM2D平坦吸收带假设，且洋中脊模型忽略了晶粒演化、位错蠕变和岩脉排水机制。

Validates a quantitative amplitude-phase divergence metric (focus score F) for body-wave Δt* quality control and demonstrates that elastic focusing cannot explain large observed MOR body-wave attenuation.
验证了基于振幅-相位谱分歧的体波聚焦评分指标（F），并证明弹性聚焦无法解释洋中脊实测的高体波衰减。

kc: Quantified elastic focusing contributions to teleseismic S-wave apparent attenuation (Δt*) using SPECFEM2D, showing extrinsic effects can exceed 50% of total observed attenuation.
Determined geometric controls on focusing: extrinsic Δt* peaks for anomaly diameters of 2–4 wavelengths and moderately prolate shapes parallel to wave propagation.
Validated a quantitative 'focus score' (F) metric based on amplitude-phase spectral slope divergence, establishing a threshold of F_crit ≈ 0.28 (log10(F) = -0.55) for quality control.

Demonstrated on geodynamic mid-ocean ridge (MOR) models that off-axis melt pockets dominate Δt* via focusing, while mantle volatile content and spreading rate produce subtle Δt* variations below typical noise.
利用SPECFEM2D量化了弹性聚焦对远震S波视衰减（Δt*）的贡献，表明外因效应可占总观测衰减的50%以上。
明确了聚焦的几何控制因素：当异常体直径为2-4倍波长且沿波传播方向呈适度长椭球形时，外因Δt*达到峰值。
验证了基于振幅-相位谱斜率分歧的定量“聚焦评分”（F）指标，确立了F_crit ≈ 0.28（log10(F) = -0.55）的质量控制阈值。
在洋中脊（MOR）地球动力学模型中证明，离轴熔体囊通过聚焦主导Δt*波动，而地幔挥发分含量和扩张速率产生的Δt*差异低于典型观测噪声。
me: 2-D spectral-element wavefield simulation (SPECFEM2D) of plane S-waves (0.3 Hz dominant Ricker wavelet) at 0° and -22.3° incidence angles.
Isolation of extrinsic vs. intrinsic attenuation by running paired elastic and anelastic simulations with Kramers-Kronig velocity relaxation at 0.3 Hz to control for physical dispersion.
Thermochemical-to-seismic property conversion using the Abers & Hacker (2016) MATLAB toolbox and the Very Broadband Rheology Calculator ('premelt' scaling).
Measurement of differential travel times (ΔT) via cross-correlation and differential attenuation (Δt*) via the Filter Amplitude and Phase (fAxP) method.
Calculation of the focus score (F), elastic amplitude ratio (EAR), and fractional elastic contribution (ϵ) to evaluate extrinsic focusing.
利用二维谱元法（SPECFEM2D）模拟0°和-22.3°入射角的平面S波（主频0.3 Hz Ricker子波）传播。
通过在0.3 Hz处应用Kramers-Kronig速度松弛控制物理频散，成对运行弹性和非弹性模拟以分离外因与本征衰减。
使用Abers & Hacker (2016)工具箱和甚宽频带流变计算器（“预熔融”标度关系）将地球动力学热化学参数转换为地震属性。
通过互相关测量差分走时（ΔT），并利用滤波振幅和相位（fAxP）方法测量差分衰减（Δt*）。
计算聚焦评分（F）、弹性振幅比（EAR）和弹性贡献百分比（ϵ）以评估外因聚焦效应。
de: Simple 2-D Gaussian low-velocity, high-attenuation anomaly models (M1–M5) testing systematic variations in diameter (σ from 6 to 30 km) and aspect ratio (prolate to oblate).

Synthetic mid-ocean ridge (MOR) models derived from two-phase reactive melt transport geodynamic simulations (Keller et al., 2017) with varying volatile contents (0 to 200 ppm) and half-spreading rates (1 to 7 cm/yr).
2-D ray-tracing predictions computed using the TauP Toolkit for baseline intrinsic ΔT and Δt* comparisons.
Comparison of synthetic MOR profiles and observables against East Pacific Rise surface-wave constraints (MELT/GLIMPSE, Yang et al., 2007) and real-world OBS body-wave Δt* datasets.
简单的二维高斯低速高衰减异常体模型（M1–M5），系统测试直径（σ从6到30 km）和纵横比（长椭球到扁椭球）的变化。
基于两相反应熔体运移地球动力学模拟（Keller et al., 2017）构建的合成洋中脊（MOR）模型，涵盖不同挥发分含量（0至200 ppm）和半扩张速率（1至7 cm/yr）。
使用TauP工具包计算的二维射线追踪预测值，作为本征ΔT和Δt*的基准对比。
将合成MOR剖面和观测值与东太平洋海隆面波约束（MELT/GLIMPSE, Yang et al., 2007）及实际海底地震仪（OBS）体波Δt*数据集进行对比。
li: Simulations are restricted to 2-D domains, which may not fully capture complex 3-D out-of-plane wave scattering and focusing phenomena.

SPECFEM2D approximates attenuation with a flat, frequency-independent absorption band, which is inconsistent with laboratory-derived frequency-dependent anelasticity far from the 0.3 Hz reference frequency.

The underlying MOR geodynamic models assume constant grain size and linear diffusion creep, omitting dislocation creep, grain-size evolution, and diking mechanisms that could drain unrealistically high-porosity (>40%) melt pockets.
模拟局限于二维计算域，可能无法完全捕捉复杂的三维面外波散射和聚焦现象。
SPECFEM2D使用平坦的频率无关吸收带近似衰减，这在远离0.3 Hz参考频率时与实验室得出的频率相关非弹性不一致。
底层的MOR地球动力学模型假设恒定晶粒尺寸和线性扩散蠕变，忽略了位错蠕变、晶粒演化和岩脉侵入机制，导致模型中出现孔隙度过高（>40%）的熔体囊。

tm.why: The paper explicitly investigates how elastic wave propagation and focusing effects influence apparent teleseismic body-wave attenuation (Δt*) versus intrinsic anelasticity.

The study uses geodynamic models of mid-ocean ridges (MORs) to evaluate how volatile content, spreading rate, and sub-lithospheric melt pockets affect seismic velocities and attenuation in the oceanic upper mantle.
The authors rely extensively on 2-D spectral-element wavefield simulations (SPECFEM2D) with and without intrinsic attenuation to isolate elastic focusing effects.

ev.notes: Full 50-page manuscript PDF (GJI accepted/unedited manuscript) was read and analyzed, including all sections (§1–§5) and all 12 main-text figures.

sum: This study addresses the lack of accelerograms in coastal La Guaira, Venezuela, during the Mw 7.5 earthquake by conducting an inverse analysis of CCTV video showing parked SUVs rocking. The authors model a Daihatsu Terios SUV as a block on tensionless springs and dashpots representing the suspension system. Using idealized wavelets derived from comparable tectonic settings as base excitation, they constrain plausible ground-velocity and acceleration pulse amplitudes by matching computed and observed peak rotation angles. A second, heavier Jeep Cherokee provides a consistency check. This work demonstrates that video-recorded nonlinear rocking of structures/vehicles can quantitatively constrain near-fault seismic pulses in regions lacking traditional instrumentation.
本研究针对委内瑞拉Mw 7.5地震中缺乏强震记录的问题，利用CCTV视频中停放SUV的摇晃画面进行了反演分析。作者将大发Terios SUV简化为支撑在无拉力弹簧和阻尼器（代表悬架系统）上的块体，并以类似构造背景下的理想化子波作为基底输入，通过对比计算与观测的峰值旋转角，约束了合理的地面速度和加速度……

t: Nonlinear rocking analysis of vehicles modeled as blocks on tensionless spring-dashpot suspension systems subjected to idealized wavelet base excitations.
将车辆简化为无拉力弹簧-阻尼器悬架系统上的块体，进行理想化子波基底激励下的非线性摇晃分析。
CCTV video recordings of two parked SUVs rocking during the Mw 7.5 Venezuela earthquake, combined with seismologically comparable reference wavelets.
委内瑞拉Mw 7.5地震期间两辆停放SUV摇晃的CCTV视频记录，以及地震学上可比的参考子波。
Successfully constrained plausible ranges of coherent near-fault ground-velocity and acceleration pulse amplitudes at a damaged coastal site lacking accelerograms.
在缺乏强震仪记录的受灾海岸场地上，成功约束了相干近断层地面速度和加速度脉冲振幅的合理范围。
Provides non-unique bounds rather than precise time-histories, heavily dependent on simplified vehicle suspension assumptions and video resolution.
仅提供非唯一的振幅范围而非精确的时程曲线，且严重依赖于简化的车辆悬架假设和视频分辨率。
First study to quantitatively constrain near-fault seismic pulse amplitudes using CCTV video-recorded rocking responses of parked passenger vehicles.
首次利用CCTV视频记录的停放乘用车非线性摇晃响应，定量约束近断层地震脉冲振幅。

kc: Developed an inverse analysis framework to estimate near-fault ground motion parameters using video footage of rocking vehicles.
Modeled vehicle suspension systems using tensionless springs and dashpots to simulate nonlinear rocking and wheel uplift.
Constrained plausible ranges of coherent acceleration and velocity pulses for the Mw 7.5 Venezuela earthquake at a site lacking accelerograms.
开发了一种利用摇晃车辆视频画面估算近断层地面运动参数的反演分析框架。
利用无拉力弹簧和阻尼器对车辆悬架系统进行建模，以模拟非线性摇晃和车轮抬升。
在缺乏强震仪记录的场地上，约束了委内瑞拉Mw 7.5地震相干加速度和速度脉冲的合理范围。
me: Nonlinear rocking analysis of a vehicle modeled as a rigid block on a spring-dashpot suspension system.
Forward simulation using idealized wavelets as base excitation.
Parameter estimation by comparing simulated peak rotation angles and wheel uplift with CCTV video observations.
将车辆简化为弹簧-阻尼器悬架系统上的刚性块体，进行非线性摇晃分析。
使用源自相似地震动记录的理想化子波作为基底激励进行正演模拟。
通过对比模拟的峰值旋转角及车轮抬升与CCTV视频观测值来进行参数估计。
de: CCTV video recordings from two stations in Caraballeda showing the rocking of a Daihatsu Terios SUV and a Jeep Cherokee during the Mw 7.5 earthquake.
Idealized wavelets derived from strong-motion records of earthquakes with similar seismological and geotechnical conditions.
来自Caraballeda两个监控台站的CCTV视频记录，显示了Mw 7.5地震期间大发Terios SUV和吉普切诺基的摇晃过程。
源自具有相似地震学和岩土工程条件地震的强震记录的理想化子波。
li: The estimated ground motion pulses are bounds rather than unique predictions due to simplified vehicle modeling and wavelet assumptions.
Relies on visual estimation of vehicle rotation and uplift from CCTV footage, which may have resolution and frame-rate limitations.
由于简化的车辆建模和子波假设，估算的地面运动脉冲是范围边界而非唯一预测。
依赖于对CCTV画面中车辆旋转和抬升的视觉估计，这可能受到分辨率和帧率限制。

tm.why: The paper estimates near-fault ground-velocity and acceleration pulse amplitudes from an earthquake where no accelerograms are available.
The study uses an inverse analysis of vehicle rocking responses to constrain ground motion parameters.

ev.notes: No PDF was available; analysis is based entirely on the detailed abstract.

sum: While large earthquakes on smooth megathrusts often exhibit precursory slow slip, past laboratory studies suggested smooth faults inhibit such precursors. Here, the authors conduct biaxial stick-slip experiments on diagonally cut polymethyl-methacrylate (PMMA) fault plates with varying roughness (RMS ~0.1, ~1.0, and ~5.0 μm) under different lateral stresses (1–3 MPa). Using digital image correlation (DIC) and strain gauges across 62 seismic cycles, they capture full-field fault slip and shear stress evolution. They find that smooth faults under low normal stress exhibit energetic slow slip and pronounced acceleration in preseismic moment release, which vanishes at higher stress. Conversely, rougher faults show moderate to pronounced acceleration via coalescing slow slip zones regardless of stress. This reconciles the field-laboratory discrepancy, providing an experimental mechanism explaining why smooth, fluid-overpressured (low effective stress) subduction megathrusts frequently display detectable precursory phases.
针对野外平滑俯冲大断层常观测到震前慢滑移而实验室认为平滑断层抑制前兆的矛盾，本文对不同粗糙度（RMS约0.1、1.0和5.0微米）的PMMA断层样品开展了双轴加载粘滑实验（侧向应力1-3 MPa）。结合数字图像相关法（DIC）和应变片，记录了62个地震周期的全场滑移和剪应力演化。结果表明，低应力下平……

t: Biaxial stick-slip experiments on diagonally cut PMMA plates with varying sandblasted roughness, monitored via 5 fps Digital Image Correlation (DIC) for full-field slip and 1 kHz/1 MHz strain gauges for interseismic/coseismic shear stress.
对不同粗糙度的PMMA断层开展双轴粘滑实验，结合5帧/秒DIC测量全场滑移及1 kHz/1 MHz应变片监测剪应力。
62 complete laboratory earthquake cycles recorded across smooth (~0.1 μm), inter-rough (~1.0 μm), and rough (~5.0 μm) PMMA faults under lateral stresses of 1, 2, and 3 MPa.
在1、2、3 MPa侧向应力下记录平滑（~0.1μm）、中糙（~1.0μm）和粗糙（~5.0μm）断层的62个完整地震周…

Smooth faults show pronounced preseismic moment release acceleration (100% at 1 MPa) that vanishes at 3 MPa, whereas rougher faults exhibit moderate to pronounced acceleration across all stress levels.
平滑断层在1 MPa下呈100%显著矩释放加速，在3 MPa下消失；粗糙断层在所有应力下均呈中到显著加速。

Rough interfaces generate spatial variations in normal stress and friction, preventing full decoupling of geometric roughness from induced frictional heterogeneity; scaling to natural rock faults is only approximate.
无法完全解耦几何粗糙度与诱发摩擦非均质性的影响，且向天然岩石断层的比例外推仅为近似。
Demonstrates that under low normal stress, smooth faults produce stronger precursory slow slip signals than rough faults, reconciling contradictory laboratory and field megathrust observations.
证明低正应力下平滑断层能产生显著前兆慢滑移，调和了实验室与野外俯冲带观测的矛盾。

kc: Demonstrated experimentally that smooth faults under low normal stress generate energetic precursory slow slip and pronounced moment release acceleration.
Classified preseismic moment release into three regimes controlled jointly by fault roughness, normal stress, slip rate, propagation speed, and slip zone size.
Reconciled the discrepancy between laboratory experiments and field observations regarding precursors on smooth, fluid-rich subduction megathrusts.
实验证明低正应力下的平滑断层能够产生强震前慢滑移和显著的矩释放加速。
将震前矩释放划分为三个受断层粗糙度、正应力、滑移速率、传播速度和滑移区大小共同控制的模式。
调和了实验室与野外观测关于富含流体的平滑俯冲大断层震前前兆的矛盾。
me: Biaxial electro-hydraulic servo loading of diagonally cut PMMA plates with sandblasted interfaces of three RMS roughness levels (~0.1, ~1.0, and ~5.0 μm).
Full-field displacement and fault slip tracking at 5 frames/s using a CCD camera and Digital Image Correlation (DIC) with a Fill-Boundary algorithm.
Continuous shear stress monitoring along the fault using 15 strain gauges at 1 kHz (interseismic) and 7 gauges at 1 MHz (coseismic rupture back-projection).
Piecewise linear-exponential curve fitting to quantify interseismic and precursory moment release rates.
对具有三种喷砂粗糙度（RMS约0.1、1.0、5.0微米）的对角切割PMMA板进行双轴电液伺服加载。
利用CCD相机（5帧/秒）结合数字图像相关法（DIC）及边界填充算法追踪全场位移与断层滑移。
利用15个1 kHz应变片监测震间剪应力，7个1 MHz应变片监测同震破裂并通过反投影定位震中。
采用分段线性-指数函数拟合定量评估震间和前兆阶段的矩释放率。
de: 62 full stick-slip laboratory earthquake cycles across three fault roughness levels (~0.1, ~1.0, ~5.0 μm) and three lateral stress conditions (1, 2, 3 MPa).
Spatiotemporal datasets of full-field fault slip (spatial resolution ~2 mm, displacement uncertainty ~1 μm) and detrended shear stress.
涵盖3种断层粗糙度（~0.1、~1.0、~5.0微米）和3种侧向应力（1、2、3 MPa）的62个完整实验室粘滑地震周期。
全场断层滑移（空间分辨率约2毫米，位移标准差约1微米）和去趋势剪应力的时空演化数据集。
li: Rough interfaces inherently induce spatial variations in normal stress and friction, making it impossible to fully decouple geometric roughness from frictional heterogeneity.
Direct extrapolation to natural faults requires caution due to scale, material (PMMA vs. rock), and loading condition differences, as scaling does not capture all dimensionless parameters.
Slow slip front propagation velocity measurements carry a relative uncertainty of up to ±50% due to high displacement gradients near the front.

sum: This study investigates the slip rates and locking depths of the eastern Kunlun fault (KLF) in northeastern Tibet by integrating Sentinel-1 InSAR (2014–2021) and regional GNSS observations into a horizontal velocity field within a regional-average local reference frame. Using Bayesian inversion with the No-U-Turn Sampler, the authors compare 2D elastic dislocation models against viscoelastic earthquake-cycle deformation (VECD) models after correcting for 2001 Kokoxili postseismic deformation. The VECD results show a general eastward decrease in slip rate from 8–9 mm/yr (Xidatan–Dongdatan) to 2–5 mm/yr (Maqu), modulated by local structural fluctuations such as a local high along the Maqin segment. Importantly, accounting for lower-crustal and upper-mantle viscoelasticity yields shallower locking depths that agree much better with 95% regional seismicity cutoffs and coseismic slip depths, while demonstrating how elastic models systematically bias parameter estimates depending on the earthquake-cycle stage.
本研究融合2014–2021年Sentinel-1 InSAR与区域GNSS观测构建了局部参考框架下的水平速度场，并在扣除2001年可可西里地震震后变形后，采用基于NUTS算法的贝叶斯框架对比了弹性与粘弹性地震周期变形（VECD）模型对东昆仑断裂运动学参数的反演。结果显示断裂滑动速率总体呈自西向东递……

VECD slip rates decrease eastward from ~8–9 mm/yr (P1–P2) to ~2–5 mm/yr (P11–P12) with a local high at P8–P9, while yielding shallower locking depths matching 95% seismicity depths.

sum: This publication by Andreas Fichtner provides a comprehensive overview of variational inference (VI) in the context of geophysical inverse problems. As an alternative to computationally expensive Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) methods, variational inference reformulates the Bayesian inference problem as an optimization task. By fitting a tractable family of probability distributions (such as Gaussian or normalizing flows) to the true posterior distribution, VI enables efficient uncertainty quantification in high-dimensional spaces. The chapter covers the theoretical foundations, including the Kullback-Leibler divergence and the Evidence Lower Bound (ELBO), and discusses applications to seismic tomography and wave-equation-based inversion.
本书章由Andreas Fichtner撰写，系统介绍了地球物理反演中的变分推断（VI）方法。作为计算昂贵的马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）方法的替代方案，变分推断将贝叶斯推断问题重新表述为一个优化问题。通过将易于处理的概率分布族（如高斯分布或正则化流）拟合到真实的后验分布，VI实现了高维空间中高效的……

t: Reformulating Bayesian inference as an optimization problem by minimizing the Kullback-Leibler divergence between a tractable variational distribution and the true posterior.

Synthetic non-linear inverse problems and simplified seismic velocity models used to benchmark the accuracy and efficiency of variational approximations.
用于基准测试变分近似准确性和效率的合成非线性反演问题和简化地震速度模型。
Variational inference provides orders-of-magnitude speedups compared to MCMC while successfully capturing the main features of the posterior probability density.

sum: This paper serves as the introduction to the BSSA Special Section on 'Earthquake Physics, Earthquake Forecasting, and Beyond,' marking the 50th anniversary of the 1975 Ms 7.3 Haicheng earthquake in China. It summarizes the historical significance of the Haicheng earthquake, which is widely known for its successful short-term prediction, and outlines the subsequent five decades of progress in earthquake physics, monitoring, and forecasting. The special section compiles modern research on fault mechanics, precursor observations, statistical forecasting models, and advanced machine learning applications in seismology, highlighting the transition from empirical forecasting to physics-based understanding.

sum: Resolving earthquake rupture speed, particularly transient supershear propagation, is often ambiguous using finite-fault inversion or back-projection. This study introduces a new metric—the onset time difference (OTD) between fault-parallel (FP) and fault-normal (FN) velocity pulses recorded within 3 km of the fault—to identify rupture speed regimes in strike-slip earthquakes. Using 3-D finite-element dynamic rupture simulations (PyLith), the authors prove that FP pulse onsets track the local rupture front, yielding positive OTD for subshear ruptures, negative OTD for steady supershear ruptures, and a sharp along-strike OTD drop during subshear-to-supershear transitions. Applying OTD to continuous near-fault strong-motion records along the Amanos segment of the 2023 Mw 7.8 Kahramanmaraş earthquake pinpoints a transient supershear transition between stations #2718 and #3143, which is validated by realistic curved-fault simulations. The metric also successfully classifies rupture regimes at individual near-fault stations from the 2002 Denali, 2010 Darfield, and 2025 Mandalay earthquakes.
本研究提出利用近断层（<3 km）平行断层（FP）与垂直断层（FN）速度脉冲的起跳时间差（OTD）来识别走滑地震的超剪切破裂及瞬态转变。基于三维有限元动力学破裂模拟（PyLith），证明FP脉冲可追踪局部破裂前缘：亚剪切破裂OTD为正，稳态超剪切OTD为负，而超剪切转变表现为OTD沿走向骤降。将该方……

t: Calculates the onset time difference (OTD) between fault-parallel (FP) and fault-normal (FN) velocity pulses (and OTD' using the local minimum between double FP pulses) at near-fault (<3 km) stations, validated via 3-D PyLith dynamic rupture simulations.

Within a transient supershear zone, OTD values at larger off-fault distances (e.g., 2 km) may not turn strictly negative and require neighboring stations to observe a sharp OTD drop.

sum: This study performs ambient noise tomography using 12 years of continuous seismic data recorded in Central and South Kamchatka. By cross-correlating continuous seismic records, the authors extract surface-wave dispersion curves to reconstruct high-resolution 3D shear-wave velocity models of the crust. The resulting models successfully image the plumbing systems of active volcanoes and major fault zones in the region. The novelty lies in the use of a decadal-long dataset, which significantly improves the signal-to-noise ratio and spatial resolution of the crustal structures compared to previous short-term deployments, providing critical insights into the magmatic and tectonic processes of the Kamchatka subduction zone.

sum: This study investigates Wuxi nephelinites in eastern China to provide the first direct petrological evidence for geophysically detected low-velocity zones (LVZs) above the mantle transition zone (MTZ). By analyzing volatile- and Fe-rich melt inclusions within these rocks, the authors identify high FeO T content (up to 21.8 wt%) and Cl/K ratios (up to 0.15), along with phlogopite, confirming their volatile-rich nature. Density calculations indicate these dense melts are initially stable atop the MTZ. However, sustained volatile influx or melt-rock reactions lower their density, triggering upward migration to form nephelinites. This work successfully bridges seismic tomography observations of LVZs with physical rock samples, confirming the existence of a molten layer above the MTZ.
本研究通过分析中国东部无锡碧玄岩，首次为地幔过渡带（MTZ）上覆地球物理观测到的低速带（LVZ）提供了直接的岩石学证据。研究发现这些岩石中存在富含挥发分和铁的熔体包裹体（FeO T高达21.8 wt%，Cl/K比值达0.15），且未均匀化的包裹体中含有金云母，证实了其富挥发分特征。密度计算表明，这些……

结合高压熔体密度计算和地震断层成像约束，对无锡碧玄岩中的熔体包裹体进行地球化学分析。
Natural nephelite rock samples from Wuxi, eastern China, containing volatile- and Fe-rich melt inclusions and associated seismic tomography data.
来自中国东部无锡的天然碧玄岩样品，其中含有富挥发分和铁的熔体包裹体，以及相关的地震断层成像数据。
Identification of melt inclusions with up to 21.8 wt% FeO T and 0.15 Cl/K ratio, confirming dense, volatile-rich melts stable atop the MTZ.
鉴定出FeO T高达21.8 wt%、Cl/K比值达0.15的熔体包裹体，证实了稳定在MTZ上方的致密富挥发分熔体。
Findings are based on a single regional locality in eastern China, requiring further validation across other global low-velocity zones.
研究结果基于中国东部单一区域，需在全球其他低速带进行进一步验证。
First direct petrological and geochemical evidence of volatile- and Fe-rich melts verifying the geophysically detected low-velocity layer above the MTZ.

Mineralogical identification of phlogopite in unhomogenized inclusions.
Melt density calculations under high-pressure mantle conditions.

sum: This study presents a coupled neural operator framework for stress-conditioned temporal extrapolation of seismic velocity fields in 1D layered elastic media. The predictor-corrector architecture combines a time-integrator-embedded Deep Operator Network (TI-DeepONet), which uses an embedded fourth-order Runge-Kutta (RK4) scheme to advance the velocity field, with a Fourier Neural Operator (FNO) that learns a spatial residual correction. Trained jointly with Gaussian noise perturbation, the model predicts velocity autoregressively beyond the training window while conditioned on reference stress fields and base excitation. Evaluated on four synthetic SH-wave propagation cases across 50 m and 280 m four-layer soil columns with 0.5–6 Hz DOG3 wavelet excitations, the framework extrapolates up to twice the training duration. It accurately reproduces principal arrivals and depth-dependent reflections, achieving mean peak-normalized RMSEs of 0.53%–2.31% over full windows and 0.61%–2.82% during extrapolation.
本研究提出一种耦合神经算子框架，用于一维层状弹性介质中地震速度场的应力条件时间外推。该预测-校正架构结合了内嵌四阶龙格-库塔（RK4）格式的深度算子网络（TI-DeepONet）与学习空间残差校正的傅里叶神经算子（FNO）。在50米和280米四层土柱、0.5–6 Hz DOG3小波激发的四个一维SH……

t: A predictor-corrector neural operator coupling TI-DeepONet (with an embedded RK4 time integrator) and FNO (for spatial residual correction) predicts next-step velocity fields autoregressively under reference-stress conditioning.
耦合内嵌RK4积分的TI-DeepONet与FNO空间残差校正器，在参考应力条件下自回归预测速度场。
Synthetic 1D SH-wave simulations in four-layer elastic soil columns (50 m and 280 m depths, 500–1000 profiles per case) excited at the base by 0.5, 3.5, and 6 Hz DOG3 wavelets.
50米和280米深四层弹性土柱的一维SH波合成数据（每算例500–1000个剖面），由0.5–6 Hz DOG3小波激发…
Across four test cases, mean peak-normalized RMSEs range from 0.53% to 2.31% over full evaluation windows and 0.61% to 2.82% over extrapolation intervals up to twice the training duration.
四个算例的全时窗平均NRMSE为0.53%–2.31%，长达训练时长两倍的外推区间平均NRMSE为0.61%–2.82%…
The model requires reference stress fields throughout rollout rather than autonomously evolving the coupled velocity-stress system, and neglects soil damping and nonlinearity.
推演需持续输入参考应力场，无法自主演化耦合速度-应力系统，且未考虑阻尼和非线性。
Joint end-to-end training of an RK4-embedded TI-DeepONet temporal predictor with an FNO spatial residual corrector for temporal extrapolation of oscillatory wavefields in layered media.
首次端到端联合训练内嵌RK4的TI-DeepONet时间预测器与FNO空间残差校正器以实现层状介质波场时间外推。

kc: Developed a jointly trained predictor-corrector neural operator coupling TI-DeepONet (with embedded RK4 integration) and FNO (for spatial residual refinement).
Formulated a multi-branch input encoding with Fourier feature and adaptive wavelet trunk activations to capture oscillatory wavefields across heterogeneous soil profiles.
Demonstrated accurate temporal extrapolation up to twice the training duration across four 1D SH-wave propagation cases, achieving mean extrapolation NRMSEs between 0.61% and 2.82%.
开发了联合训练的预测-校正神经算子框架，将内嵌RK4积分的TI-DeepONet与用于空间残差校正的FNO相耦合。
设计了多分支输入编码，并在主干网络中结合傅里叶特征和自适应小波激活函数，以捕捉非均质土层剖面中的振荡波场。
在四个一维SH波传播算例中验证了长达训练窗口两倍的时间外推能力，外推区间的平均NRMSE在0.61%至2.82%之间。
me: Time-integrator-embedded Deep Operator Network (TI-DeepONet) parameterizing the velocity-rate function within an embedded classical fourth-order Runge-Kutta (RK4) scheme.

Four-branch input encoding (stress, velocity, base traction, and time at two time levels) fused via Hadamard product, addition, and linear projection, paired with a trunk network using Fourier features and adaptive wavelet activations.
Fourier Neural Operator (FNO) acting as a state-dependent spatial residual corrector taking current velocity, preliminary RK4 prediction, and depth coordinate as inputs.
End-to-end joint training over [0, T_tr) with annealed zero-mean Gaussian noise added to velocity inputs to improve autoregressive rollout stability.
内嵌时间积分器的深度算子网络（TI-DeepONet），在经典四阶龙格-库塔（RK4）格式内参数化速度变化率函数。

在[0, T_tr)区间内进行端到端联合训练，并在速度输入中加入退火零均值高斯噪声以提高自回归推演的稳定性。

Two total column depths (shallow H = 50 m sampled at 0.25 m; deep H = 280 m sampled at 1 m) with layer thicknesses and shear velocities perturbed by ±20% on discrete grids under a strictly increasing velocity constraint.
Four test cases excited by third-order Gaussian-derivative (DOG3) wavelets: Deep 0.5 Hz (500 profiles), Deep 3.5 Hz (500 profiles), Shallow 3.5 Hz (500 profiles), and Shallow 6.0 Hz (1000 profiles).
一维垂直传播SH波在四层弹性土柱中的数值模拟，采用自由表面边界和Lysmer-Kuhlemeyer吸收基底边界。
两种土柱总深度（浅层H = 50 m，采样间隔0.25 m；深层H = 280 m，采样间隔1 m），层厚和剪切波速在严格递增约束下于离散网格上进行±20%扰动。
由三阶高斯导数（DOG3）小波激发的四个测试算例：深层0.5 Hz（500个剖面）、深层3.5 Hz（500个剖面）、浅层3.5 Hz（500个剖面）和浅层6.0 Hz（1000个剖面）。

The model is restricted to 1D linear elastic wave propagation without material damping, nonlinear soil behavior, or multi-dimensional spatial interactions.
Some test profiles exhibit high-error tails (up to 13.11% NRMSE in the Deep 3.5-Hz case), and prediction quality is sensitive to the chosen training window duration.
该框架在自回归推演过程中依赖于持续提供的参考应力场，尚不能自主演化耦合的速度-应力系统。

The paper models 1D horizontally polarized shear (SH) wave propagation in layered elastic media using an embedded RK4 time-stepping scheme.

sum: This study investigates the ~50 km Kandili Fault Zone (KFZ) bordering the northern margin of the North Gulf of Evia rift, Greece, located at the interface of Hellenic back-arc extension and propagating North Anatolian shear. Integrating field fault-slip and tidal notch measurements, 10-m DEM landscape analysis (fluvial knickpoints and triangular faceted spurs), and 2D marine seismic reflection profiles (Sparker and airgun), the authors resolve deformation across kyr to Myr timescales. Topographic and acoustic basement relief define a five-segment normal fault array (Ilia, Rovies, Limni, Kandili, Politika). Hanging-wall depocenters (0–325 ka), knickpoints (0.3–3.4 Ma), facets, and Holocene notches yield consistent slip rates up to 1.8 mm/yr, with maxima at the northwestern and southeastern tips rather than the fault center. Auxiliary strike-slip faults and rift-oblique folds match transtensional strain models, demonstrating that cross-cutting shear structures control border fault segmentation and rift-wide strain partitioning.
本研究结合野外断层擦痕与潮汐凹槽测量、10米DEM地貌分析（河流裂点与三角面山）及二维高分辨率海洋地震反射数据，研究了希腊北埃维亚湾裂谷北缘约50公里长的Kandili正断层带（KFZ）在千年至百万年尺度上的演化。地形和声学基底起伏揭示KFZ由五个断层段组成。上盘沉积中心（0-325 ka）、河流裂……

t: The authors integrate field fault kinematics and tidal notches, 2D marine seismic reflection stratigraphy (0–325 ka), and 10-m DEM geomorphic analyses of fluvial knickpoints and faceted spurs to resolve fault slip rates across kyr-to-Myr timescales.
综合野外断层运动学与潮汐凹槽、二维海洋地震反射地层学及10米DEM河流裂点与三角面地貌分析，厘定千年至百万年尺度断层滑动…

Datasets comprise ~1800 km of high-resolution Sparker seismic profiles (WATER 2017–2021), 3.5 kHz airgun seismic lines (AMPHITRITE 2004), a 10-m Copernicus DEM (25 streams, 59 facets), and field measurements of 17 fault planes and 11 tidal notches.
包含WATER高分辨率电火花地震剖面、AMPHITRITE气枪测线、10米Copernicus DEM（25条河流、59…

The KFZ comprises five segments (5–15 km long) with Myr knickpoint uplift rates of 0.2–0.5 mm/yr (~0.7–1.7 mm/yr slip), 0–325 ka seismic subsidence of 0.3–0.7 mm/yr (~0.5–1.5 mm/yr slip), and greatest slip on the Ilia and Kandili segments.
KFZ分为5段，百万年裂点隆升速率0.2-0.5 mm/yr，0-325 ka地震沉降速率0.3-0.7 mm/yr，滑…

Poor coastal access restricts field measurements geographically, while deep acoustic basement in the Central Basin exceeds seismic imaging depth (>1200 ms TWTT) and the Kandili fault plane is unimaged offshore.
海岸交通不便限制野外测量范围，中央盆地深部基底超出地震成像深度，且Kandili段断层面未在海上直接成像。

First multi-timescale onshore-offshore tectonic integration of an active transtensional rift border fault, demonstrating how North Anatolian shear segments normal faults and drives asymmetric slip distributions.
首次对活动张扭裂谷边界断层进行多时间尺度海陆综合研究，揭示北安纳托利亚剪切对正断层分段和非对称滑动的控制。

kc: Establishes that the ~50 km Kandili Fault Zone (KFZ) is a five-segment dip-slip normal fault array (Ilia, Rovies, Limni, Kandili, Politika) with slip initiating around ~3.4 Ma.

Reconciles multi-timescale slip rates of ~0.4–1.8 mm/yr across Holocene tidal notches, late-Pleistocene triangular facets, 0–325 ka hanging-wall seismic stratigraphy, and Plio-Pleistocene fluvial knickpoints.
Calibrates the triangular facet slope-uplift scaling relationship for Mediterranean carbonate/metamorphic lithologies, revising the erosion coefficient k from 0.28 to 1.09 ± 0.14.

Demonstrates that cross-cutting NE-SW dextral oblique-slip faults, NNW-SSE sinistral strike-slip faults (Melouna Fault), and NE-SW folds fit a regional North Anatolian transtensional strain model that segments the rift.
确立了约50公里长的Kandili断裂带（KFZ）是由五个倾滑正断层段（Ilia、Rovies、Limni、Kandili、Politika）组成的断层阵列，初始活动时间约为3.4 Ma。
综合全新世潮汐凹槽、晚更新世断层三角面、0-325 ka上盘地震地层学以及上新世-更新世河流裂点，厘定了多时间尺度下约0.4–1.8 mm/yr的滑动速率。
针对地中海碳酸盐岩/变质岩岩性校准了断层三角面坡度-隆升标度关系，将侵蚀系数k从0.28修正为1.09 ± 0.14。
证明了横切裂谷的NE-SW向右旋斜滑断层、NNW-SSE向左旋走滑断层（Melouna断层）和NE-SW向褶皱符合北安纳托利亚区域张扭应变模型，并控制了裂谷分段。
me: Field structural mapping of polished fault planes and slip vectors (n=21) alongside elevation surveying of emerged and submerged coastal tidal notches.

2D marine seismic reflection interpretation (high-resolution Sparker and deep-penetrating 3.5 kHz airgun) using a 0–325 ka syn-rift stratigraphic age model (horizons H1–H3) and flexural subsidence-to-uplift scaling (U:S = 1:1.2–2.2).
Fluvial drainage and knickpoint retreat modeling on 25 footwall trunk streams using a unit stream power erosion law (m=0.5, n=1, K=0.8–1.6 x 10^-6 yr^-1) on a 10-m Copernicus DEM.
Morphometric extraction of 59 footwall triangular faceted spurs and calibration of the cubic tangent slope-uplift relationship U = k(tan θ)^3.
对抛光断层面和滑动矢量（n=21）进行野外构造测绘，并测量出露和淹没的海岸潮汐凹槽高程。
利用0–325 ka同裂谷地层年代模型（层位H1–H3）和岩石圈挠曲沉降-隆升标度比（U:S = 1:1.2–2.2），解释二维海洋地震反射剖面（高分辨率电火花和3.5 kHz气枪）。
基于10米分辨率Copernicus DEM，采用单位河流水力侵蚀定律（m=0.5, n=1, K=0.8–1.6 x 10^-6 yr^-1）对25条下盘干流进行水系和裂点后退模拟。
提取59个下盘断层三角面山的形态参数，并校准斜率-隆升立方正切关系式 U = k(tan θ)^3。
de: High-resolution single-channel Sparker (500–1000 J) 2D seismic reflection lines from the WATER I and II cruises (2017–2021) and 3.5 kHz airgun seismic profiles from the AMPHITRITE survey (2004).
Copernicus EEA-10 Digital Elevation Model (10 m nominal spatial resolution) and EMODnet bathymetry.
Field measurements of 17 fault planes, 21 slip vectors, and 7 coastal tidal notches collected in April and October 2025, supplemented by 4 radiocarbon-dated notches from Evelpidou et al. (2012).
WATER I和II航次（2017–2021年）采集的高分辨率单道电火花（500–1000 J）二维地震反射测线，以及AMPHITRITE航次（2004年）的3.5 kHz气枪地震剖面。
Copernicus EEA-10数字高程模型（10米标称空间分辨率）和EMODnet水深数据。
2025年4月和10月采集的17个断层面、21个滑动矢量和7个海岸潮汐凹槽的野外测量数据，并结合Evelpidou等（2012）的4个放射性碳测年凹槽数据。
li: Poor coastal road/footpath access restricted direct field fault-plane and notch measurements to limited exposures near the southeastern tip and selected beaches.
Acoustic basement in the deep Central Basin (hanging wall of the Ilia and Rovies segments) exceeds seismic imaging depth (>1200 ms TWTT) and Sparker penetration is limited in deep water.
The Kandili segment fault plane is located immediately along the coastline and is not directly imaged in offshore seismic profiles, yielding only minimum seismic subsidence estimates.
Stream power erodibility K and uplift-to-subsidence ratios (U:S) are not locally calibrated in the North Gulf of Evia and must be borrowed from the Gulf of Corinth.
海岸道路和步道交通不便，限制了野外断层面和潮汐凹槽的直接测量仅能集中在东南端和部分海滩。
深水中央盆地（Ilia和Rovies段上盘）的声学基底超过了地震成像深度（>1200 ms TWTT），且电火花震源在深水区的穿透能力有限。
Kandili段断层面紧邻海岸线，未在海上地震剖面中直接成像，因此只能给出地震沉降速率的下限估计。
河流水力侵蚀系数K和隆升-沉降比（U:S）未在北埃维亚湾进行本地校准，必须借用科林斯湾的参数。

tm.why: The paper investigates the kyr-to-Myr deformation history, fault segmentation, and transtensional geodynamic evolution of the North Gulf of Evia rift border fault system using marine seismic reflection, geomorphology, and structural field data.

The study focuses on normal fault segmentation, segment linkage barriers, slip rate distributions across multiple timescales, and strain partitioning between dip-slip border faults and cross-cutting strike-slip shear zones.

ev.notes: Full 80-page EarthArXiv preprint PDF (manuscript submitted to Tectonics) including all figures, captions, equations, and Table 1 was read and analyzed.
